Ver.Ka and other grades interpret the complex transformation differently, so the edition’s actual conversion steps should be checked before handling. The model’s appeal comes from the relationship between mobile suit proportions and its aircraft-like form.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka revisits Zeta’s form and transformation in Katoki’s styling, distinct from older Master Grade Zeta releases.
kits.lore:
Kamille Bidan’s Zeta Gundam is a transformable mobile suit from the Gryps Conflict, capable of changing into Wave Rider mode.

Further background: Developed for the AEUG, it combines a fast-moving Waverider configuration with high-performance mobile suit combat. Its biography is closely tied to Kamille’s growth, the Gryps Conflict and the tensions between the Earth Federation, Titans and anti-Titans forces. The transformation becomes a defining feature of later variable-geometry Gundam designs.

kits.name: Eclipse Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Eclipse Gundam is the lead transformable machine from the SEED Eclipse side story, drawing on Orb and broader Cosmic Era technology.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG kit emphasizes its sleek armor, aircraft-like transformation, and the distinctive Eclipse silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Eclipse’s sharp geometry and transformation-related body details distinguish it from the mainline Strike and Freedom families. Its story placement and design should be recorded independently rather than treated as a recolor of an existing Gundam.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG kit emphasizes its sleek armor, aircraft-like transformation, and the distinctive Eclipse silhouette.
kits.lore:
Eclipse Gundam is the lead transformable machine from the SEED Eclipse side story, drawing on Orb and broader Cosmic Era technology.

Further background: Eclipse Gundam is the central mobile suit in the Gundam SEED Eclipse side story. Its development reflects the complicated international and technological aftermath of the first Cosmic Era war. The machine is notable for a transformable configuration and designs connected to the mobile suit technologies evolving between Gundam SEED and its successor works.

kits.name: Gundam Virtue
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Tieria Erde pilots the heavily armored Gundam Virtue, which conceals the slimmer Gundam Nadleeh beneath its outer equipment.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Master Grade release highlights Virtue’s bulk and its layered design relationship with Nadleeh.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Virtue models emphasize broad armor masses and heavy beam equipment. The internal Nadleeh reveal is part of the machine’s identity, but support for displaying that form depends on the specific model kit. The MG edition is especially focused on the relationship between the armored Virtue and concealed Nadleeh.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The Master Grade release highlights Virtue’s bulk and its layered design relationship with Nadleeh.
kits.lore:
Tieria Erde pilots the heavily armored Gundam Virtue, which conceals the slimmer Gundam Nadleeh beneath its outer equipment.

Further background: GN-005 Gundam Virtue is the heavy-armor, artillery-oriented member of Celestial Being’s original Gundam team in Gundam 00. Piloted by Tieria Erde, it uses a massive GN Bazooka and GN Cannons, contrasting sharply with Exia’s close-combat specialty. Virtue also conceals Gundam Nadleeh beneath its armor, making the machine’s true configuration part of the team’s strategic capabilities and the mystery surrounding the organization.

kits.name: Wing Gundam Zero EW Ver.Ka
kits.series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is distinguished by feather-like wings and iconic twin buster rifles used by Heero Yuy.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka models the Endless Waltz wing arrangement with intricate posing and backpack presentation; it is not the TV Wing Zero.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The layered wing feathers are the principal display feature of the Endless Waltz design. This form should not be confused with the television Wing Gundam Zero, whose backpack and silhouette are different. At MG or MGSD scale, compare how each release handles the wings’ shape, articulation and support requirements.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka models the Endless Waltz wing arrangement with intricate posing and backpack presentation; it is not the TV Wing Zero.
kits.lore:
Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is distinguished by feather-like wings and iconic twin buster rifles used by Heero Yuy.

Further background: Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is defined by large, feather-like wings rather than the angular wing arrangement of its television depiction. The machine is connected to Heero Yuy and the conflict following the events of Gundam Wing. Its Twin Buster Rifle embodies the extraordinary destructive potential of the Zero system’s Gundam lineage, while the angelic wing silhouette creates a deliberate contrast with that power.

kits.name: Rick Dom
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Rick Dom is the space-adapted variant of Zeon’s Dom mobile suit, used in large numbers during the One Year War.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2022 MG Rick Dom focuses on the familiar heavy armor and space-use configuration, distinct from the ground-combat Dom.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large skirt armor, bell-shaped legs and imposing torso make Rick Dom visually distinct from slender Zeon suits. The model is a space-use Rick Dom, not simply the terrestrial Dom with a different label.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The 2022 MG Rick Dom focuses on the familiar heavy armor and space-use configuration, distinct from the ground-combat Dom.
kits.lore:
The Rick Dom is the space-adapted variant of Zeon’s Dom mobile suit, used in large numbers during the One Year War.

Further background: In contrast to the ground-operating Dom, its equipment and mobility systems are adapted to space combat, and it serves alongside other mass-produced Zeon units against Federation forces. Its broad purple-and-black silhouette is among the era’s signature designs.

kits.name: Sazabi Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Char Aznable’s personal Sazabi is a powerful Newtype mobile suit featuring funnels, heavy armor, and striking red colors.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka is a highly detailed, large-scale Sazabi with Katoki-inspired layered armor; it is separate from RG Sazabi.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Sazabi’s defining model features are its bulky red armor, funnel equipment, large shoulder structures and extensive rear thruster area. The Ver.Ka and RG interpretations have very different approaches to panel lines and engineering. When identifying a release, distinguish a standard Sazabi from special editions such as the MSN-04FF.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka is a highly detailed, large-scale Sazabi with Katoki-inspired layered armor; it is separate from RG Sazabi.
highlights: Distinct RG, MG and special-edition interpretations
kits.lore:
Char Aznable’s personal Sazabi is a powerful Newtype mobile suit featuring funnels, heavy armor, and striking red colors.

Further background: The massive red machine is designed to exploit the abilities of a Newtype pilot, combining substantial armor and powerful thrusters with funnel remote weapons. Its confrontation with Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam gives the final act of the film much of its emotional weight. Sazabi symbolizes Char’s return to open conflict over humanity’s future on Earth and in space.

kits.name: ν Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s final personal Gundam combines psycho-frame technology with deployable Fin Funnels to oppose Char’s Sazabi.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka interprets Nu Gundam with prominent internal detail and a full Fin Funnel arrangement, distinct from the RG and Entry Grade kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka interprets Nu Gundam with prominent internal detail and a full Fin Funnel arrangement, distinct from the RG and Entry Grade kits.
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s final personal Gundam combines psycho-frame technology with deployable Fin Funnels to oppose Char’s Sazabi.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: Hi-ν Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack - Beltorchika's Children
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Hi-Nu Gundam is an alternate Nu Gundam interpretation associated with the Beltorchika’s Children continuity and a blue-and-white color scheme.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Master Grade Ver.Ka release features Hi-Nu’s wide funnels and layered design; it is separate from the RG Hi-Nu.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wing-like Fin Funnel arrays and the blue-and-white coloring provide Hi-ν’s most recognizable look. Its RG and Ver.Ka editions are substantially different products; comparisons should focus on proportions, color separation and the specific edition’s included stand or weapon parts.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The Master Grade Ver.Ka release features Hi-Nu’s wide funnels and layered design; it is separate from the RG Hi-Nu.
kits.lore:
Hi-Nu Gundam is an alternate Nu Gundam interpretation associated with the Beltorchika’s Children continuity and a blue-and-white color scheme.

Further background: Hi-ν Gundam is a reinterpretation of Amuro Ray’s advanced mobile suit associated with the Beltorchika’s Children version of the Char’s Counterattack story. It shares the Newtype-oriented concept of ν Gundam but has a distinctive white-and-blue palette and a more symmetrical array of Fin Funnels. Although related in fiction and design development, Hi-ν is not identical to the film’s RX-93 ν Gundam.

kits.name: Mobile Ginn
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The GINN is a standard ZAFT mass-production mobile suit in Gundam SEED and a common sight in early Cosmic Era battles.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG provides a larger, more detailed depiction of a regular ZAFT mobile suit rather than a protagonist Gundam.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Ginn is recognized by its mono-eye head, broad backpack and utilitarian armor. The MG interpretation emphasizes the structure of an ordinary ZAFT machine rather than a unique protagonist Gundam. Keep it separate from specialist Ginn variants.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG provides a larger, more detailed depiction of a regular ZAFT mobile suit rather than a protagonist Gundam.
kits.lore:
The GINN is a standard ZAFT mass-production mobile suit in Gundam SEED and a common sight in early Cosmic Era battles.

Further background: It serves as one of the PLANT forces’ defining early-war units and helps establish how mobile suit technology changed the military balance in the Cosmic Era. Although less exotic than the advanced Gundams, Ginn is essential to the setting as a widely deployed machine whose variants reflect different battlefield needs.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos Lupus
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki’s Gundam following its earlier combat damage, with enhanced close-range capability.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2025 MG Lupus models the mid-series Barbatos configuration, which is distinct from both MG Barbatos and HG Lupus Rex.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This edition represents the Lupus redesign, not the original Barbatos or the later Lupus Rex. Focus on the larger shoulders, revised limbs, angular head and signature sword-mace profile. The kit’s grade determines the level of mechanical detailing; check the release-specific contents before assuming extra weapons or optional forms are included.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The 2025 MG Lupus models the mid-series Barbatos configuration, which is distinct from both MG Barbatos and HG Lupus Rex.
highlights: Distinct from Barbatos and Lupus Rex
kits.lore:
Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki’s Gundam following its earlier combat damage, with enhanced close-range capability.

Further background: Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki Augus’s Gundam Frame used as Tekkadan’s conflicts intensify. Its redesigned armor and altered proportions emphasize acceleration and physical aggression, making it visually distinct from earlier Barbatos forms. It retains the defining connection between Mikazuki, the Alaya-Vijnana interface and Tekkadan’s rise through the post-Calamity War political landscape.

kits.name: Providence Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Rau Le Creuset pilots Providence Gundam, a heavily armed ZAFT machine carrying a DRAGOON remote weapon system.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG kit focuses on Providence’s huge rear DRAGOON equipment and aggressive end-of-series appearance.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large DRAGOON units around the backpack and rear silhouette are the defining display features. Providence should not be confused with Legend Gundam or Strike Freedom, which also use remote armaments but have different shapes and equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG kit focuses on Providence’s huge rear DRAGOON equipment and aggressive end-of-series appearance.
kits.lore:
Rau Le Creuset pilots Providence Gundam, a heavily armed ZAFT machine carrying a DRAGOON remote weapon system.

Further background: Providence Gundam is Rau Le Creuset’s heavily armed mobile suit in Gundam SEED. It uses an extensive DRAGOON remote weapon system, allowing multi-directional attacks that challenge the protagonists during the final phase of the war. Its stark head design and radiating backpack distinguish it from ZAFT’s other advanced Gundams, while Rau’s role as its pilot makes it closely linked to the story’s debate over human destiny and resentment.

kits.name: Gundam Aerial
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Suletta Mercury’s Gundam Aerial is a GUND-Format machine built around a shield system comprising remote GUND-BIT components.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGSD Aerial reinterprets the original Aerial design in Master Grade-inspired SD proportions; it is separate from the HG and Full Mechanics kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Aerial’s design contrasts relatively smooth white armor with translucent-looking shell-unit details and multiple GUND-BIT components. Check the release name carefully: the original Aerial and Aerial Rebuild have different silhouettes and equipment. The standard HG, Full Mechanics and MGSD releases offer distinct interpretations of the same core machine.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
MGSD combines super-deformed proportions with relatively ambitious detail and engineering. It is not assigned a conventional numerical scale.
kits.summary: The MGSD Aerial reinterprets the original Aerial design in Master Grade-inspired SD proportions; it is separate from the HG and Full Mechanics kits.
kits.lore:
Suletta Mercury’s Gundam Aerial is a GUND-Format machine built around a shield system comprising remote GUND-BIT components.

Further background: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series.

kits.name: Unicorn Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Banagher Links pilots the Unicorn Gundam, which features an NT-D transformation from restrained Unicorn Mode into Destroy Mode.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGEX release is a premium Unicorn model with an illuminated psycho-frame emphasis and Ver.Ka detailing; it is distinct from regular MG Unicorn kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
MGEX is an advanced 1/100 Master Grade line built around a showcase engineering or visual theme. The specific theme depends on the named release.
kits.summary: The MGEX release is a premium Unicorn model with an illuminated psycho-frame emphasis and Ver.Ka detailing; it is distinct from regular MG Unicorn kits.
kits.lore:
Banagher Links pilots the Unicorn Gundam, which features an NT-D transformation from restrained Unicorn Mode into Destroy Mode.

Further background: RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is a prototype mobile suit central to the events of Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

kits.name: Gundam Aerial
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Suletta Mercury’s original Aerial fights using GUND-BIT components that can form a shield or operate independently in battle.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 1/100 Full Mechanics Aerial brings the rounded proportions of the original design to a larger scale, distinct from the HG and MGSD releases.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Aerial’s design contrasts relatively smooth white armor with translucent-looking shell-unit details and multiple GUND-BIT components. Check the release name carefully: the original Aerial and Aerial Rebuild have different silhouettes and equipment. The standard HG, Full Mechanics and MGSD releases offer distinct interpretations of the same core machine.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The 1/100 Full Mechanics Aerial brings the rounded proportions of the original design to a larger scale, distinct from the HG and MGSD releases.
kits.lore:
Suletta Mercury’s original Aerial fights using GUND-BIT components that can form a shield or operate independently in battle.

Further background: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series.

kits.name: Calamity Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Calamity Gundam is an Earth Alliance artillery-focused mobile suit piloted by Orga Sabnak during the later Gundam SEED battles.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit depicts its bulky ranged-combat configuration and dual shoulder-mounted cannons in 1/100 scale.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large shoulder-mounted and handheld ranged weapons are central to Calamity’s look. In Full Mechanics scale, the emphasis remains on the heavy-artillery design rather than transformable or close-combat gimmicks.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit depicts its bulky ranged-combat configuration and dual shoulder-mounted cannons in 1/100 scale.
kits.lore:
Calamity Gundam is an Earth Alliance artillery-focused mobile suit piloted by Orga Sabnak during the later Gundam SEED battles.

Further background: It is associated with the Biological CPU pilot Orga Sabnak and specializes in heavy artillery support. Its oversized ranged weapons create a broad silhouette distinct from the fast-moving Raider and defensive Forbidden, the two other mobile suits frequently fielded alongside it.

kits.name: Raider Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Raider Gundam is a transformable Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Clotho Buer, capable of changing to a mobile armor form.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit captures its distinctive black-and-red coloring and flight-oriented transformation silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Its black-and-red armor, transformation-oriented shapes and distinctive weaponry set Raider apart from Calamity’s artillery role. Confirm the specific conversion steps and included parts in the edition’s instructions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit captures its distinctive black-and-red coloring and flight-oriented transformation silhouette.
kits.lore:
Raider Gundam is a transformable Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Clotho Buer, capable of changing to a mobile armor form.

Further background: Raider Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit in Gundam SEED that can transform into a flight-oriented mobile armor configuration. Piloted by Clotho Buer, it operates alongside Calamity and Forbidden as part of the Alliance’s trio of advanced units. Its black-and-red coloring and unusual weapons reflect a design philosophy centered on attack speed and close-range pressure.

kits.name: Forbidden Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Forbidden Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Shani Andras, known for its unique backpack and energy-deflecting systems.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit highlights its large backpack profile and unusual weapon arrangement in 1/100 scale.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large scythe, broad rear equipment and curved armor define the Forbidden look. Unlike Raider, its identity centers on defensive systems and unusual beam interactions rather than a flight transformation.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit highlights its large backpack profile and unusual weapon arrangement in 1/100 scale.
kits.lore:
Forbidden Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Shani Andras, known for its unique backpack and energy-deflecting systems.

Further background: Forbidden Gundam is one of three Earth Alliance advanced units introduced in Gundam SEED. Piloted by Shani Andras, it combines a distinctive heavy, curved combat form with defensive technology designed to distort incoming beam attacks. Its large scythe and dark coloration distinguish it from the Calamity and Raider units used by the same group.

kits.name: RX-78-2 Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s RX-78-2 is the original Federation Gundam and an icon of the One Year War.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade version is designed as an approachable, tool-light introduction to Gunpla, distinct from HG, RG, and PG versions.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade version is designed as an approachable, tool-light introduction to Gunpla, distinct from HG, RG, and PG versions.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s RX-78-2 is the original Federation Gundam and an icon of the One Year War.

Further background: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history.

kits.name: Strike Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato’s early mobile suit in Gundam SEED, designed to use different Striker Packs for varying missions.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade Strike focuses on easy assembly of the recognizable base Strike design; accessories and pack configurations differ between products.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The core Strike body has a white-blue-red color scheme and a distinctive attachment system for Striker equipment. The standard Strike, Perfect Strike and other package-specific releases must be identified separately; not every product includes all Striker packs.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade Strike focuses on easy assembly of the recognizable base Strike design; accessories and pack configurations differ between products.
kits.lore:
Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato’s early mobile suit in Gundam SEED, designed to use different Striker Packs for varying missions.

Further background: Strike Gundam is the GAT-X105 Earth Alliance prototype that Kira Yamato pilots early in Gundam SEED. Its Striker Pack compatibility allows it to be equipped for different combat roles, including the Aile, Sword and Launcher configurations. The machine’s versatility and conflict with ZAFT’s stolen Gundams place it at the center of the early Cosmic Era narrative.

kits.name: ν Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels during the events of Char’s Counterattack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade Nu is an accessible version of the Nu Gundam design. It should not be confused with RG or MG releases, and equipment varies by product.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade Nu is an accessible version of the Nu Gundam design.
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels during the events of Char’s Counterattack.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: Wing Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Heero Yuy pilots Wing Gundam, a transformable Operation Meteor machine armed with the buster rifle in Gundam Wing.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This 2025 Entry Grade release provides a simplified build of the TV Wing Gundam design.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Bird Mode silhouette and Buster Rifle are the most recognizable features of this original Wing Gundam. It should not be confused with Wing Gundam Zero, whose weaponry, systems and body configuration are significantly different.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: This 2025 Entry Grade release provides a simplified build of the TV Wing Gundam design.
kits.lore:
Heero Yuy pilots Wing Gundam, a transformable Operation Meteor machine armed with the buster rifle in Gundam Wing.

Further background: Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.name: Perfect Strike Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Perfect Strike Gundam combines the Aile, Sword, and Launcher Striker equipment into a heavily outfitted version of the Strike Gundam.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade kit presents the full multi-pack loadout at 1/60 scale with a large, equipment-heavy silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large combined Striker pack, heavy sword and long-range cannon are essential identifiers. A Perfect Strike product is not the same as an ordinary Strike Gundam kit, which may omit some or all of the additional equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade kit presents the full multi-pack loadout at 1/60 scale with a large, equipment-heavy silhouette.
highlights: Combined Aile, Sword and Launcher equipment
kits.lore:
Perfect Strike Gundam combines the Aile, Sword, and Launcher Striker equipment into a heavily outfitted version of the Strike Gundam.

Further background: Perfect Strike Gundam is a configuration of the GAT-X105 Strike Gundam associated with the combination of the Aile, Sword and Launcher Striker systems in Gundam SEED. The Strike was originally intended to adapt to different missions by exchanging its equipment; the Perfect Strike combines their functions into a heavily armed form. Its silhouette is crowded with equipment compared with the standard Strike Gundam.

kits.name: 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
00 Gundam Seven Sword/G is a weapon-focused variation of Setsuna’s 00 Gundam with multiple blades and a GN Sword II Blaster.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The PG release emphasizes its expansive sword equipment and oversized 1/60 presentation.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The diverse sword loadout is the main reason to select this version. Verify the release’s listed weapon parts and mounting arrangements, rather than treating it as a standard 00 Gundam. The large blade equipment strongly shapes how the model balances on display.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The PG release emphasizes its expansive sword equipment and oversized 1/60 presentation.
kits.lore:
00 Gundam Seven Sword/G is a weapon-focused variation of Setsuna’s 00 Gundam with multiple blades and a GN Sword II Blaster.

Further background: Seiei’s twin-drive 00 Gundam from the Gundam 00 universe. Its design emphasizes multiple swords and bladed equipment, extending the close-combat heritage established by Exia. The equipment distinguishes this configuration from both the standard 00 Gundam and the 00 Raiser; the exact set of weapons matters when cataloging the kit.

kits.name: Gundam Exia
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Setsuna F. Seiei pilots the close-combat Gundam Exia, an early Celestial Being machine equipped with multiple GN-powered blades.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade Exia uses a large frame and detailed mechanical structure to recreate the GN Drive-era design.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade Exia uses a large frame and detailed mechanical structure to recreate the GN Drive-era design.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept
kits.lore:
Setsuna F. Seiei pilots the close-combat Gundam Exia, an early Celestial Being machine equipped with multiple GN-powered blades.

Further background: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents.

kits.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Banshee Norn is a black-and-gold Unicorn-series machine with a powerful NT-D mode and equipment distinct from Banagher’s white Unicorn.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade release recreates Banshee Norn’s armor and transformation at 1/60 scale, separate from the PG Unicorn.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The dark armor, gold psycho-frame appearance and Armed Armor equipment provide the key visual cues. For this release, distinguish Banshee Norn from standard Banshee and the white Unicorn: their backpack and armament arrangements vary.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade release recreates Banshee Norn’s armor and transformation at 1/60 scale, separate from the PG Unicorn.
kits.lore:
Banshee Norn is a black-and-gold Unicorn-series machine with a powerful NT-D mode and equipment distinct from Banagher’s white Unicorn.

Further background: Banshee Norn is a reconfigured form of the second RX-0 Unicorn Gundam, associated with Riddhe Marcenas in Gundam Unicorn. Its black-and-gold armor sharply contrasts with Banagher’s white Unicorn, while its advanced equipment and psycho-frame technology make it central to the closing struggle over Laplace’s Box. Banshee Norn is a distinct configuration from the earlier Banshee and from Unicorn Gundam.

kits.name: Unicorn Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Unicorn Gundam is the central mobile suit of Gundam Unicorn, featuring a dramatic transformation from Unicorn Mode to Destroy Mode.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The PG model provides the transformation in a large 1/60 display kit; it is a different release from the MGEX Unicorn.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The PG model provides the transformation in a large 1/60 display kit; it is a different release from the MGEX Unicorn.
kits.lore:
The Unicorn Gundam is the central mobile suit of Gundam Unicorn, featuring a dramatic transformation from Unicorn Mode to Destroy Mode.

Further background: Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

kits.name: Strike Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Kira Yamato’s Strike Freedom Gundam is a high-mobility Cosmic Era machine equipped with DRAGOON remote weapons and a distinctive winged backpack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade release emphasizes the enormous wing span and elaborate weapons at 1/60 scale, unlike the MGEX or smaller-scale variants.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade release emphasizes the enormous wing span and elaborate weapons at 1/60 scale, unlike the MGEX or smaller-scale variants.
kits.lore:
Kira Yamato’s Strike Freedom Gundam is a high-mobility Cosmic Era machine equipped with DRAGOON remote weapons and a distinctive winged backpack.

Further background: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.name: AILE STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 エールストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Aile Strike models combine the white, blue and red Strike armor with the long-winged Aile Striker equipment. The pack gives the silhouette a very different balance from Launcher and Sword Strike. Included mounts, beam sabers and pack mechanisms vary by grade and edition; do not assume every Strike release contains an Aile Striker.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s Strike Gundam configured for mobile Aile Striker combat.
kits.lore: The GAT-X105 Strike Gundam is an Earth Alliance prototype central to Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and famously piloted by Kira Yamato. Its modular Striker Pack system lets it adapt to different kinds of combat; the Aile Striker is designed around flight mobility and balanced armament. The suit's battles help define the growing conflict between Earth and ZAFT and Kira's changing allegiances.

kits.name: BEARGGUY III
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Beargguy III's large round head, cute facial details, paws and decorative ribbon make it intentionally unlike conventional Gundam kits. Its bright presentation suits characterful posing and custom decoration. Do not confuse it with later Beargguy Family or Petit'gguy variations, which are separate designs.
kits.summary: China Kousaka’s cheerful bear-themed custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Beargguy III is a customized Gunpla featured in Gundam Build Fighters and built by China Kousaka. Rather than representing an ordinary military mobile suit, it transforms the Acguy-inspired design into a playful teddy-bear figure that reflects its builder's personality. Its role highlights the series' idea that creativity and a personal attachment to a model can be just as important as combat performance.

kits.name: GUNTANK EARLY TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144　ガンタンク初期型
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This release's angular tracks, front-heavy armored hull and raised cannons emphasize a more conventional vehicle than the familiar RX-75 Guntank. It is a separate design, so its story and detailing should not be interchanged with the original series machine.
kits.summary: An early Federation tracked combat machine from The Origin.
kits.lore: The Guntank Early Type appears in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin as an early Earth Federation armored fighting machine predating the Federation's mature mobile suit program. Its tank-like configuration reflects a military approach that relies on conventional firepower and protection rather than the mobility of a humanoid suit. It helps establish the technological setting from which later Project V machines emerge.

kits.name: MOBILE WORKER MW-01 MODEL 01 LATE TYPE (MASH)
aliases: HG 1/144 MOBILE WORKER MW-01 MODEL 01 LATE TYPE (MASH)
HG 1/144 モビルワーカーMW-01 01式後期型（マッシュ機）
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: Mobile Worker models have compact construction-machine proportions and a very different silhouette from the finished Zaku family. The Mash configuration has its own presentation and equipment details. The design is best displayed as an early prototype or testing vehicle rather than a full-size mainline Zaku.
kits.summary: A late-model test vehicle from Zeon’s early mobile suit development.
kits.lore: The MW-01 Mobile Worker is part of Zeon's early technological development portrayed in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin. The later test configurations help establish how smaller mechanical work vehicles eventually contribute ideas to the military mobile suit program. Mash's involvement ties the vehicle to pilots who later become well known for their service in Zeon's forces.

kits.name: CATSITH
aliases: ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: RX-77-2 GUNCANNON
kits.notes: The recognizable red armor, broad chest and paired shoulder cannons give the Guncannon an unusually sturdy silhouette. Different releases emphasize shoulder articulation, cannon mounting and cockpit details differently. Compare the original Guncannon with The Origin's earlier Guncannon First Type, which represents a separate developmental stage.
kits.summary: White Base’s red, cannon-equipped Earth Federation support mobile suit.
kits.lore: The RX-77-2 Guncannon is an Earth Federation support mobile suit from the One Year War, operated by White Base's crew alongside the original Gundam. Kai Shiden and Hayato Kobayashi are among its best-known pilots. Its shoulder-mounted cannons and substantial armor emphasize dependable medium-range fire support rather than the Gundam's all-purpose dueling role.

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The original Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray, reinterpreted across numerous Gunpla grades.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. Later Gundam designs repeatedly refer back to its configuration and combat record.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X1 FULL CLOTH TYPE.GBFT
aliases: HGBF 1/144 CROSSBONE GUNDAM X1 FULL CLOTH TYPE.GBFT
HGBF 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムX1フルクロス TYPE.GBFT
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-Ⅱ(TITANS)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムMk-II（ティターンズ仕様）
kits.notes: The Titans version is most readily distinguished by its dark armor rather than the AEUG's white scheme. The underlying suit design remains the Gundam Mk-II, but named pilot, color and edition variations deserve precise identification. Armor finish and decal options depend on grade and release.
kits.summary: The Titans’ original dark-colored Gundam Mk-II.
kits.lore: The RX-178 Gundam Mk-II is developed by the Titans before several units are captured by the AEUG at the beginning of Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Its early black-and-dark-blue Titans color scheme signals its original ownership by the elite Federation faction. This machine's movable-frame innovations later influence the wider development of Gryps-era mobile suits.

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-Ⅱ(AEUG)
aliases: HGUC 1/144ガンダムMk-II（エゥーゴ仕様）
kits.notes: This AEUG edition uses the familiar white armor with dark blue and yellow detail rather than the Titans' black color scheme. Its angular head, chest vents and characteristic backpack distinguish it from the RX-78-2. Different grades interpret the early movable-frame concept through different internal construction.
kits.summary: The white AEUG-operated Gundam Mk-II from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The RX-178 Gundam Mk-II begins Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam as a Titans-developed successor to the original Gundam. Kamille Bidan becomes closely associated with the AEUG's captured white-colored version, whose movable-frame technology helps bridge earlier mobile suit design and later Zeta-era machines. Its role remains important even after more advanced units arrive.

kits.name: PROTOTYPE GOUF (TACTICAL DEMONSTRATOR)
aliases: HG 1/144 プロトタイプグフ（戦術実証機）
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: Prototype Gouf models use blue armor and early-development design features that recall the classic Gouf but are not identical to it. Differences in chest, arms and equipment distinguish this test machine from the production Gouf and Gouf Custom. Product-specific accessories should be checked against its manual.
kits.summary: A Zeon Gouf-development test mobile suit from The Origin.
kits.lore: The Prototype Gouf (Tactical Demonstrator) appears in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin as part of Zeon's continuing experimentation with mobile suits before the One Year War. It illustrates steps in the development of the later Gouf family and the shift toward more specialized combat machines. Its different equipment is best understood as a precursor design rather than the same suit Ramba Ral pilots later.

kits.name: KAMIKI BURNING GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 カミキバーニングガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Kamiki Burning has prominent red details, athletic proportions and a posing language built around kicks and punches. It should be distinguished from Build Burning and Try Burning versions, which represent different stages of the same general design approach.
kits.summary: Sekai Kamiki’s martial-arts-focused custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Kamiki Burning Gundam is a custom Gunpla associated with Sekai Kamiki in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its martial-arts-oriented design expresses Sekai's hand-to-hand combat style, making the model a direct extension of its user's fighting technique. The suit's visual identity emphasizes physical strikes and explosive movement instead of conventional firearms.

kits.name: EX VLKYLANDER
aliases: SDBD:R エクスヴァルキランダー

kits.notes: The HG release showcases transitional Dom features in a prototype silhouette. Its name identifies an experimental unit, not a frontline production Dom or Rick Dom.
kits.summary: The HG release showcases transitional Dom features in a prototype silhouette.
kits.lore: The Dom Test Type is a development-stage Zeon machine depicted in the mechanical history of Gundam The Origin. It stands between earlier mobile-suit experiments and the eventual Dom family's characteristic heavy hover-combat design.

kits.notes: This kit emphasizes the early Zaku I equipment and its specific pilot-linked designation. Treat the two-name release as a distinct presentation rather than equating it with a generic MS-05.
kits.summary: This kit emphasizes the early Zaku I equipment and its specific pilot-linked designation.
kits.lore: Denim and Slender are Zeon pilots associated with the early encounters between Zaku forces and the Earth Federation's new Gundam. The Origin revisits these soldiers within its expanded One Year War narrative.

kits.name: GUNCANNON FIRST TYPE (IRON CAVALRY SQUADRON)

kits.notes: The First Type's more utilitarian armor and heavy weapon structure distinguish it from White Base's red Guncannon. Specific squad color arrangements and rollout variants differ, so the Iron Cavalry release needs its own designation and presentation.
kits.summary: An early Guncannon development machine used by the Iron Cavalry Squadron.
kits.lore: The Guncannon First Type is an early Federation combat machine in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin, representing an earlier stage than the familiar RX-77-2 Guncannon. Its deployment with the Iron Cavalry Squadron reflects the Federation's effort to develop practical heavy combat units before the mature Project V program. The machine's role helps illustrate the technological escalation before the One Year War.

kits.name: MS-04 BUGU [RAMBA RAL]
aliases: HG 1/144 MS-04 ブグ（ランバ・ラル機）
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The model's retro-technical armored body and Ral-specific blue presentation mark a design stage before the classic Zaku II. This named Bugu is not an MS-05 or a later Gouf.
kits.summary: The model's retro-technical armored body and Ral-specific blue presentation mark a design stage before the classic Zaku II.
kits.lore: The MS-04 Bugu is a Zeon predecessor to the Zaku mobile-suit line featured in Gundam The Origin. Veteran pilot Ramba Ral is associated with its early deployment and testing.

kits.name: MS-05 ZAKU I [CHAR AZNABLE]
aliases: HG 1/144 ザクＩ　(シャア・アズナブル機)
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This release presents a pilot-specific Zaku I rather than the familiar MS-06S red Zaku II. Its older mobile-suit silhouette and edition-specific color identity must be retained.
kits.summary: This release presents a pilot-specific Zaku I rather than the familiar MS-06S red Zaku II.
kits.lore: The MS-05 Zaku I predates Zeon's famous Zaku II and plays a role in the early-war setting of Gundam The Origin. A Char Aznable-associated version links the old model to Zeon's most recognizable ace.

kits.name: GUNDAM 00 DIVER
aliases: HGBD 1/144 ガンダムダブルオーダイバー
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: 00 Diver models retain the 00 Gundam's twin-drive silhouette while changing armor and details for Riku's customized build. The 00 Diver Ace and later 00 Sky units are separate upgraded forms with additional equipment; don't assign their exact accessories to the initial Diver.
kits.summary: Riku Mikami’s first custom Gunpla in Build Divers.
kits.lore: Gundam 00 Diver is the custom Gunpla used by Riku Mikami at the beginning of Gundam Build Divers. Based on the 00 Gundam concept, it becomes Riku's introduction to the Gunpla Battle Nexus Online world. The story emphasizes experimentation, teamwork and personal growth through digital Gunpla battles.
highlights: Distinct from Diver Ace and 00 Sky

kits.name: GRIMOIRE RED BERET
aliases: HGBD 1/144 グリモアレッドベレー
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: An oversized military-style head, thick limbs and red-beret identity give this build an armored special-forces appearance. It is a custom Gunpla rather than the stock Grimoire, so both its story and visual modifications must be kept distinct in the catalog.
kits.summary: Rommel’s tactical custom Grimoire from Gundam Build Divers.
kits.lore: The Grimoire Red Beret is the customized Gunpla of Rommel, a veteran strategist in Gundam Build Divers. Based on the Grimoire from Reconguista in G, it becomes an individualized combat machine whose practical equipment suits Rommel’s tactical approach within the online Gunpla Battle environment.

kits.name: GMIII BEAM MASTER
aliases: HGBD 1/144 ジムIIIビームマスター
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: Bright orange elements and emphasized rifle-based equipment distinguish Beam Master from an ordinary green-and-white GM III. This build’s game-specific customization is its identity; it should not be described as a standard Universal Century Federation production kit.
kits.summary: Yukki’s ranged-focused GM III custom from Build Divers.
kits.lore: GM III Beam Master is the custom Gunpla used by Yukio Hidaka, also known as Yukki, in Gundam Build Divers. It uses the classic Federation GM III as a foundation but adapts it to the competitive and cooperative battles of Gunpla Battle Nexus Online with a more specialized ranged-combat focus.
highlights: Gunpla Battle build, not UC stock GM III

kits.name: MOMOKAPOOL
aliases: ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: Its rounded aquatic body, small size and cute facial treatment make Momokapool look unusually mascot-like compared with serious military mobile suits. It should not be confused with the standard Kapool or Capule; its charm comes from the deliberate Gunpla customization.
kits.summary: Momo’s cheerful Kapool-based custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Momokapool is Momo’s playful customized Gunpla in Gundam Build Divers, created from the Kapool design originally associated with Turn A Gundam. It reflects its builder’s cheerful personality and the creativity of virtual Gunpla Battle, where a familiar mobile suit can be reimagined completely.
highlights: Build-series custom rather than stock Kapool

kits.name: OGRE GN-X
aliases: ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: The machine combines heavy black-and-purple armor with imposing horn-like details and an intense close-combat stance. It should be kept separate from the original Gundam 00 GN-X family, since the customized silhouette belongs to a game-world builder.
kits.summary: Ogre’s intimidating GN-X customization in Build Divers.
kits.lore: Ogre GN-X is the personal Gunpla of Do-ji’s older brother Ogre in Gundam Build Divers. Based on the GN-X family from Gundam 00, it reinterprets that design for aggressive battles in Gunpla Battle Nexus Online, reflecting its pilot’s interest in challenging powerful opponents.

ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: Its broad white armored silhouette, bold panels and additional vehicle-like design cues distinguish Scheherazade from the original Seravee. Despite the inherited name, it is a specific Gunpla Battle build and should not be assigned the original Seravee pilot’s story.
kits.summary: Shahryar’s elaborate Seravee-based Gunpla from Build Divers.
kits.lore: Seravee Gundam Scheherazade is the customized Gunpla associated with Shahryar in Gundam Build Divers. Built around the Seravee Gundam design from Gundam 00, it transforms the familiar heavy-support concept into a visually elaborate competitive machine within GBN.
highlights: GBN customization rather than Gundam 00 original

kits.name: GUNDAM 00 DIVER ACE
aliases: HGBD 1/144 ガンダムダブルオーダイバーエース
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: The Ace version adds a distinctive equipment package and a wider, more aggressive silhouette compared with 00 Diver. Its appearance should not be confused with the original base suit or the later 00 Sky. Check the particular model kit for weapon and effect-part inclusions.
kits.summary: Riku Mikami’s evolved 00 Diver Ace custom.
kits.lore: Gundam 00 Diver Ace is an upgraded version of Riku Mikami's original Gunpla in Gundam Build Divers. The design builds upon his early online-battle experiences with improved equipment and a more assertive fighting style. It marks a step forward in the team's progress through GBN.

aliases: HGBD 1/144 ガンダムジーエンアルトロン
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: The vivid green dragon-themed silhouette and extended arm details echo Altron while introducing a more stylized martial-arts presence. This is a Build Divers customization, not Chang Wufei’s original Altron; the name and model lore must remain distinct.
kits.summary: Tigerwolf’s martial-arts Altron-inspired custom Gundam.
kits.lore: Gundam Jiyan Altron is Tigerwolf’s personalized fighting Gunpla in Gundam Build Divers. Inspired by the Altron Gundam of Gundam Wing, it is tailored to its builder’s martial-arts identity and emphasizes a very different style from straightforward ranged combat in GBN.

aliases: HGBD 1/144 ガンダムAGEIIマグナム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: AGEII Magnum features a sleeker AGE-2-derived body, angular blue armor and a transforming profile. SV and other named equipment versions are separate customizations and should not be assumed to share all accessories with the original Magnum kit.
kits.summary: Champion Kyoya Kujo’s AGE-2-derived custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Gundam AGEII Magnum is the customized Gunpla operated by champion Kyoya Kujo in Gundam Build Divers. Drawing on Gundam AGE-2 design principles, it combines transformable high mobility with a strong dueling identity. Its reputation in GBN reflects the player's skill as well as a carefully refined custom model.

kits.name: GALBALDY REBAKE
aliases: HGBD 1/144 ガルバルディリベイク
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: A powerful thick-limbed silhouette and blocky armor distinguish the Rebake from a standard Universal Century Galbaldy. It is a deliberately modified Gunpla with its own battle identity; the name should not be confused with Gundam Gusion Rebake.
kits.summary: A heavy custom Gunpla based on the Galbaldy family.
kits.lore: Galbaldy Rebake is a customized Gunpla appearing in Gundam Build Divers, built around a Galbaldy-derived body with new elements inspired by a much heavier combat aesthetic. The build demonstrates how GBN participants combine design traditions from unrelated Gundam eras.

kits.name: GUNDAM 00 SKY
aliases: HGBD 1/144　ガンダムダブルオースカイ
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: 00 Sky uses a bolder silhouette and prominent backpack equipment compared with 00 Diver. The HWS and Higher Than Sky Phase designations describe specific versions that should not automatically receive base-kit equipment details.
kits.summary: Riku Mikami’s advanced custom Gunpla in Build Divers.
kits.lore: Gundam 00 Sky is a later customized Gunpla used by Riku Mikami in Gundam Build Divers. Combining visual inspirations from the 00 lineage and other Gundam fighting concepts, it reflects the pilot's growing confidence and the team's increasing ambitions in GBN. The suit's development is closely tied to the story's themes of friendship and responsibility.

kits.name: RX-ZEROMARU
aliases: ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: The compact SD form, dramatic crest and Japanese ninja styling make Zeromaru look very different from a conventional Unicorn Gundam. Variants such as Shinki Kessho have their own visual distinctions and should not be matched to the base version indiscriminately.
kits.summary: Ayame’s SD ninja-inspired Unicorn custom from Build Divers.
kits.lore: RX-Zeromaru is the ninja-themed SD Gunpla used by Ayame in Gundam Build Divers. Its custom design draws inspiration from the RX-0 Unicorn Gundam yet translates that source into a compact, transformation-oriented ninja identity suited to stealth and sudden attacks in GBN.

kits.notes: Dark armor, an asymmetrical outline and imposing customized equipment distinguish No-Name from the familiar red- or blue-framed Astrays of Gundam SEED Astray. Its design tells a different Build Divers story, so it requires its own independent profile.
kits.summary: Tsukasa Shiba’s dark, heavily modified Astray Gunpla.
kits.lore: Gundam Astray No-Name is Tsukasa Shiba’s heavily customized Gunpla in Gundam Build Divers. Based on the Gundam Astray design family, it reflects its creator’s troubled history with Gunpla Battle and makes a striking antagonist presence within the online world.

kits.lore: Gundam Love Phantom is the customized Gunpla piloted by Magee in Gundam Build Divers. It adapts the Strike Freedom Gundam lineage into a dark theatrical design and expresses the distinctive personal style of one of GBN’s experienced players.

kits.summary: A sleek Shining Gundam-inspired Gunpla redesign.
kits.lore: Gundam Shining Break is a customized Gunpla built around the Shining Gundam design in Gundam Build Divers-related material. It reimagines the martial-arts mobile suit as a sleek machine with a strong emphasis on high-speed movement and a transformed outline.

kits.notes: Pointed orange-toned armor, additional equipment and a dramatic transformed-looking profile help distinguish Zerachiel from standard Harute. It is a customized Build-series machine, so Harute’s original story and precise kit contents should not be applied automatically.
kits.summary: A customized high-mobility Gundam based on the Harute family.
kits.lore: Gundam Zerachiel is a custom Gunpla from the Gundam Build Divers setting that reworks the Gundam Harute design lineage from Gundam 00. Its complex shape reflects the Gunpla Battle tradition of repurposing an existing high-mobility mobile suit for a different builder’s tactics.

kits.name: OO-RAISER
aliases: PG 1/60 ダブルオーライザー
kits.notes: 00 Raiser kits add the 0 Raiser equipment to the already recognizable twin-shouldered 00 Gundam, creating a wider backpack profile. Whether the support craft separates, and how its wings and joints work, depends on the exact release. Full Saber and special Trans-Am editions have distinct identities.
kits.summary: The combined 00 Gundam and 0 Raiser from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser combines Setsuna F. Seiei's 00 Gundam with Saji Crossroad's 0 Raiser support craft in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. The combined machine is central to unlocking the Twin Drive System's potential and becomes a major symbol of the story's second season. Its capabilities and partnership reflect the series' growing focus on mutual understanding and change.

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-ⅡTITANS (BLACK)
aliases: PG 1/60 ガンダムMk-II(ティターンズカラー)
kits.notes: The Titans-black Mk-II combines a classic Gundam head with more restrained and mechanical mid-Universal Century armor forms. Its dark presentation must not be merged with the AEUG white version of the same basic frame.
kits.summary: The Titans-black Mk-II combines a classic Gundam head with more restrained and mechanical mid-Universal Century armor forms.
kits.lore: The Gundam Mk-II begins as a Titans-developed successor concept to the original RX-78. Its early black coloring signifies Titans control before the AEUG captures machines and brings the movable-frame technology into its campaign.

kits.name: GP01 RX-78 GUNDAM GP01/FB
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This title explicitly refers to GP01 and the Full Burnern upgrade. Preserve the distinction between the terrestrial Zephyranthes configuration and the space-focused GP01Fb.
kits.summary: This title explicitly refers to GP01 and the Full Burnern upgrade.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP01 Gundam Zephyranthes receives space upgrades to become the Full Burnern configuration during Operation Stardust. Kou Uraki's machine becomes a key Federation opponent to Anavel Gato's plans.

kits.name: RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM
aliases: PG 1/60 RX-0 ユニコーンガンダム
kits.notes: The design contrasts a restrained white, single-horned Unicorn Mode with the opened armor, V-fin and illuminated psychoframe of Destroy Mode. The selected release determines how that transformation is represented, so this record must not assume every scale offers the same mechanism.
kits.summary: The white psychoframe Gundam at the heart of the Universal Century's Laplace conflict.
kits.lore: The RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is the psychoframe-equipped prototype at the center of Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot amid the struggle over Laplace's Box. Its transformation from Unicorn Mode to Destroy Mode reveals the full-frame psychoframe and its anti-Newtype system.

kits.name: RX-0[N] UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN
aliases: PG 1/60 RX-0[N] UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN
PG 1/60 RX-0[N] ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン
kits.notes: Norn's dark armor, golden horn details, Armed Armor DE shield and Armed Armor XC backpack distinguish this configuration from the original Banshee. An exact release should preserve its Unicorn-versus-Destroy presentation instead of borrowing accessory claims from other Banshee kits.
kits.summary: The black Unicorn Gundam Unit 02 in its later Banshee Norn configuration.
kits.lore: The Banshee Norn is the later equipment configuration of Unicorn Gundam Unit 02, piloted by Riddhe Marcenas in Gundam Unicorn. This black-and-gold psychoframe machine retains the NT-D system but replaces the earlier Banshee's asymmetric armed armor arrangement with different armaments.
highlights: Armed Armor DE and XC design

kits.summary: Nils Nielsen's samurai-style Sengoku Astray Gunpla.
kits.lore: The Sengoku Astray Gundam is a custom Gunpla built by Nils Nielsen in Gundam Build Fighters. Based on the Astray concept, it combines Gunpla Battle technology with a deliberately samurai-inspired fighting style and ornamentation.

kits.summary: This Perfect Grade Unleashed interpretation makes the familiar RX-78-2 a large-scale mechanical showcase, emphasizing layered assembly and the relationships between internal mechanisms and exterior armor rather than simply enlarging a smaller kit..
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the Earth Federation prototype piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Its distinctive tricolor armor and beam weapons came to define the visual identity of the Gundam franchise.

kits.name: CHAOS GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Chaos Gundam has a distinctive purple-and-green palette, tall shoulder equipment and a streamlined mobile armor concept. Its transformation and remote-weapon silhouette set it apart from Gaia and Abyss. The extent of transformation shown by the plastic model varies between individual releases.
kits.summary: Sting Oakley’s transformable stolen Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X24S Chaos Gundam is a ZAFT-developed transformable prototype stolen by Phantom Pain at the beginning of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Sting Oakley pilots the machine, whose mobile armor form and remote attack capabilities suit mobile high-speed engagements. It is one of the three stolen Gundams that complicate the early conflict with ZAFT's new-generation suits.

kits.name: LUNAGAZER GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ルナゲイザーガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Lunagazer's white-dominant styling and sweeping equipment elements create a distinctly elegant, customized shape. It is a Build Fighters variant in its own right and should not be indexed as a standard Hyaku-Shiki or Stargazer release.
kits.summary: Lunagazer's white-dominant styling and sweeping equipment elements create a distinctly elegant, customized shape.
kits.lore: Lunagazer Gundam is a customized Gunpla from Gundam Build Fighters side material, drawing from established Gundam design lines for a new builder-created machine. Its identity belongs to the Gunpla Battle setting rather than to a single historical Universal Century campaign.

kits.name: BUILD STRIKE GALAXY COSMOS
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ビルドストライクギャラクシーコスモス
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Galaxy Cosmos variant preserves recognizable Build Strike proportions while giving the backpack and glowing-effect areas more prominence. This named release is not the original Build Strike Full Package or Star Build Strike.
kits.summary: The Galaxy Cosmos variant preserves recognizable Build Strike proportions while giving the backpack and glowing-effect areas more prominence.
kits.lore: Build Strike Galaxy Cosmos is a later development of Sei Iori's Build Strike Gundam in Gundam Build Fighters-related material. It extends the original custom Gunpla concept with a more elaborate display of energy-themed back equipment and revised armor.

kits.notes: This AEUG white Mk-II has the familiar Gundam face but features the distinctive knee, chest and shoulder shapes of the RX-178 family. The color and faction identity distinguish it from the black Titans model.
kits.summary: This AEUG white Mk-II has the familiar Gundam face but features the distinctive knee, chest and shoulder shapes of the RX-178 family.
kits.lore: Following the capture of Titans prototypes, the AEUG deploys white-colored Gundam Mk-II machines during the Gryps Conflict. Kamille Bidan and later pilots use them as the anti-Titans side develops its own high-performance force.

kits.name: XXXG-00W0 WING GUNDAM ZERO EW

RG 1/144 XXXG-00W0 ウイングガンダムゼロ EW
kits.notes: This RG kit represents the Wing Zero EW silhouette, not the television design or the MGSD version. The layered wing surfaces are the key visual identity of this specific interpretation.
kits.summary: This RG kit represents the Wing Zero EW silhouette, not the television design or the MGSD version.
kits.lore: The Endless Waltz interpretation of Wing Gundam Zero is associated with Heero Yuy and its iconic featherlike binders. Its ZERO System and Twin Buster Rifle underpin the legendary machine's story role.

kits.name: DREISSEN (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ドライセン（ユニコーンVer.）
kits.notes: The Unicorn-era Dreissen has a squat, broad-shouldered body and prominent armored limbs. Its intimidating outline contrasts with the sleek Federation designs of the same period, making it a strong subject for weathering and remnant-force displays.
kits.summary: The Unicorn-era Dreissen has a squat, broad-shouldered body and prominent armored limbs.
kits.lore: The Dreissen is a heavy Neo Zeon mobile suit whose design traces back to the First Neo Zeon War. In Gundam Unicorn, surviving machines appear among the eclectic equipment used by Zeon remnants, emphasizing how older designs remain in service.

kits.name: GUNDAM OO SKY MOEBIUS
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ガンダムダブルオースカイメビウス
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Its dramatic blue-and-white colors and broad wing-like equipment echo the original 00 Sky while giving the upgraded design its own profile. It is not simply the unmodified 00 Sky from the original series, so named editions should be cataloged independently.
kits.summary: The upgraded Moebius form of Riku’s Gundam 00 Sky.
kits.lore: Gundam 00 Sky Moebius is an upgraded custom Gunpla associated with Riku Mikami in the extended Gundam Build Divers storyline. The redesign continues his tradition of blending visual influences from multiple Gundam series rather than reproducing a single canonical mobile suit unchanged.

kits.notes: The Crossbone Maoh stands out through its angular chest, large weapon concepts and a distinct builder-custom presentation. Its identity differs from ordinary Crossbone X1 and Crossbone X1 Full Cloth designs.
kits.summary: The Crossbone Maoh stands out through its angular chest, large weapon concepts and a distinct builder-custom presentation.
kits.lore: Crossbone Gundam Maoh is a customized Crossbone Gundam built by Mao Yasaka for Gunpla Battle. It combines the compact pirate-inspired mobile suit with Mao's imaginative approach to weaponry and showmanship.

kits.notes: The shoulder cannon and missile-pod equipment change the otherwise spare GM outline into a heavier fire-support configuration. Preserve the named equipment combination rather than treating this release as a standard, unarmed GM.
kits.summary: The shoulder cannon and missile-pod equipment change the otherwise spare GM outline into a heavier fire-support configuration.
kits.lore: The RGM-79 GM was the Federation's principal mass-production mobile suit during the final stages of the One Year War. Optional support armaments diversified the basic frame for different battlefield requirements.

kits.notes: Gremory models use a dark cloaked silhouette, unusual armor panels and a weapon profile unlike the familiar Barbatos. Their dramatic shapes lend themselves to heavily contrasted lighting and unusual stances. Exact weapon accessories and cloak articulation vary by kit release.
kits.summary: An unusually styled Gundam Frame from the IBO side stories.
kits.lore: Gundam Gremory is a Gundam Frame mobile suit appearing in the Iron-Blooded Orphans side-story setting. Like other Gundam Frames, it belongs to the rare family of powerful machines whose origins trace back to the Calamity War. Its distinctive design and later ownership give the wider IBO universe another machine shaped by history rather than mass production.

kits.summary: Ral's custom Gouf R35 from Gundam Build Fighters.
kits.lore: The Gouf R35 is Ral's heavily modified blue Gouf Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters. The machine pays tribute to the classic Ramba Ral mobile suit while incorporating later Gunpla Battle design ideas suited to its veteran builder.

kits.lore: Cyclase's Schwalbe Custom is a personalized machine from Iron-Blooded Orphans side material, building on the high-performance Schwalbe family used by Gjallarhorn and related pilots. Its identity is tied to a particular pilot and equipment presentation.

機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM
kits.notes: Immortal Justice is distinguished by its reddish armor, streamlined head and mobile-armor transformation silhouette. The design should not be confused with Athrun's earlier Infinite Justice or the later Type II version. Separate releases can differ in transformation and weapon presentation.
kits.summary: The Compass-era transformable Justice-line Gundam from SEED Freedom.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X191M2 Immortal Justice Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom as a new-generation mobile suit developed for the Compass peacekeeping organization. Shinn Asuka pilots the machine during the film's early conflict. Its relationship to the Justice lineage lies in its mobile combat profile, transformation concept and distinct armament arrangement.
highlights: Distinct from Infinite Justice Type II

kits.name: GUNDAM FENICE RINASCITA
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムフェニーチェリナーシタ
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Rinascita's angular wing equipment and revised green-white styling differ from the earlier asymmetric Fenice. It should not be reduced to a color swap of the original Wing Gundam or the original Fenice. The model's exact transformation/display possibilities vary with edition.
kits.summary: Ricardo Fellini’s rebuilt Wing-inspired Gunpla.
kits.lore: Gundam Fenice Rinascita is the rebuilt custom Gunpla of Ricardo Fellini in Gundam Build Fighters. It develops from Fellini's heavily modified Wing Gundam Fenice after years of battles and repairs, demonstrating the attachment of a builder to a frequently rebuilt model. The renewed design returns to a more symmetrical appearance while preserving its flamboyant fighting identity.

kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury

kits.name: DESTROY GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 デストロイガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Destroy Gundam is exceptionally large in-fiction, with a heavy fortress-like upper body, multiple integrated weapons and a transformation concept unlike standard-sized Gundams. Scale comparisons matter more than for ordinary protagonist suits. Confirm the exact product's dimensions before comparing it with standard 1/144 kits.
kits.summary: The Earth Alliance’s massive destructive mobile armor from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The GFAS-X1 Destroy Gundam is an immense Earth Alliance mobile armor/mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Its overwhelming firepower and destructive deployment are closely associated with Stella Loussier's tragic story. The machine's size and changing combat form make it a symbol of the escalating damage caused by the war.

kits.name: DEMI TRAINER
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: The Demi Trainer's rounded single-eye head, compact frame and practical yellow armor make it distinctive among larger school dueling machines. Custom units, the Demi Barding and the later Demi Garrison should remain separate entries rather than being described as the same basic kit.
kits.summary: Asticassia’s practical mass-use training mobile suit.
kits.lore: The MSJ-105CC Demi Trainer is an inexpensive training and dueling mobile suit widely seen at Asticassia School of Technology in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. It provides students with a practical learning platform rather than the specialized capabilities of the major Gundams. Its standardized design helps establish the everyday environment of the academy.
