kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ハインドリーシュトルム
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Heindree Sturm kits emphasize a heavier battlefield appearance and revised equipment. Compare it with the standard Heindree to see the changes in armor and weapon profile; do not treat the two product packages as identical.
kits.summary: The battlefield-equipped version of Grassley’s Heindree.
kits.lore: The Heindree Sturm is a military variant of Grassley's Heindree mobile suit from The Witch from Mercury. It modifies the company's characteristic knight-like design for combat operations beyond the school environment. Its equipment and colors help distinguish a deployed fighting machine from the standard Heindree configuration.

kits.name: GUNDVÖLVA
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Gundvölva kits have a slender silhouette and subdued gray-blue styling that distinguishes them from the brightly colored academy protagonists. The machine is associated with coordinated deployment, so multiple identical models can create an effective diorama; that is a display suggestion, not a claim about included accessories.
kits.summary: A remote-operation GUND-Format mobile suit from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundvölva units in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury are GUND-Format mobile suits used in connection with Earth-based conflict and remote coordinated combat. Their unmanned or remotely directed role contrasts with the series' many individually piloted school dueling machines. The design emphasizes the unsettling military uses of technologies tied to the GUND-ARM program.

kits.name: DEMI BARDING
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 デミバーディング
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Demi Barding combines a utilitarian trainer-inspired frame with more substantial shoulder and backpack equipment. Its yellow, white and dark accents emphasize a practical support-unit style. It should be listed separately from ChuChu’s Demi Trainer and the standard Demi Trainer.
kits.summary: An upgraded Earth House mobile suit related to the Demi Trainer line.
kits.lore: The MSJ-R122 Demi Barding is a support-oriented mobile suit seen in The Witch from Mercury and associated with Earth House. It is connected to Chuatury Panlunch’s later role in the series and represents an evolution beyond the school’s basic Demi Trainer platform. Its additional backpack equipment helps distinguish it from ordinary student-use units.

kits.name: SIGRÚN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Sigrún's slender armor, sweeping shapes and unusual weapon silhouette make it visibly different from mass-production Graze machines. The named design should not be conflated with Grimgerde despite their shared frame background.
kits.summary: Sigrún's slender armor, sweeping shapes and unusual weapon silhouette make it visibly different from mass-production Graze machines.
kits.lore: The Sigrún is a Valkyrja Frame mobile suit from the Iron-Blooded Orphans expanded setting, sharing a technological family with other agile Calamity War-era designs. It emphasizes an elegant but battle-ready silhouette.

kits.name: ZOWORT HEAVY
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ザウォートヘヴィ
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: The Heavy variant changes the Zowort silhouette with extra armor and armament emphasis. Its military color palette and equipment layout are key identifiers. Do not assume the standard Zowort release has these additional components.
kits.summary: The military-equipped derivative of Peil’s Zowort.
kits.lore: Zowort Heavy is a combat-focused derivative of the Peil Technologies Zowort in The Witch from Mercury. It adapts the underlying mobile suit platform for a more heavily equipped military environment, contrasting with the standard school-use machine. The design expresses how the same manufacturer can produce both academy and battlefield variants.

kits.name: DILANZA SOL
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Dilanza Sol maintains the rounded, powerful silhouette of the Dilanza family but has a more utilitarian combat appearance. It should not be treated as Guel's personalized school unit or Lauda's separately colored machine. Exact weapons and effect parts depend on the specific kit release.
kits.summary: A battlefield-oriented Jeturk Dilanza variant.
kits.lore: Dilanza Sol is a military-oriented version of Jeturk Heavy Machinery's Dilanza family in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. The design applies the same robust industrial approach seen in Asticassia's dueling machines to operations outside the school. Its heavier combat identity illustrates Jeturk's wide range of products and customers.

kits.name: BEGUIR-PENTE
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Beguir-Pente models use a white-and-dark color scheme and the sharp silhouettes typical of Grassley designs. Although it recalls the earlier Beguir-Beu, the Pente has its own appearance and equipment. Use only the specific product's instructions to verify its included accessories.
kits.summary: A later Grassley machine associated with anti-GUND technology.
kits.lore: The Beguir-Pente is a Grassley mobile suit that appears in the later conflict of Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. Part of a wider family of machines associated with anti-GUND technology, it reflects Grassley's long involvement in developing countermeasures against Gundam-type mobile suits. Its deployment gives the series another example of corporate engineering turned toward open warfare.

機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM
kits.notes: This model focuses on Lunamaria's red custom armor and the equipment arrangement of the Gelgoog Menace. The named color variant is separate from the standard machine and should not be merged with old Universal Century Gelgoog lore. Confirm release-specific stickers, weapons and optional parts with Bandai's manual.
kits.summary: Lunamaria Hawke’s red Gelgoog Menace from SEED Freedom.
kits.lore: Lunamaria Hawke's Gelgoog Menace is a personalized Compass mobile suit seen in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom. It belongs to the Cosmic Era's Gelgoog-inspired development line rather than Zeon's Universal Century MS-14 family. Lunamaria's distinctive red colors mark this as a named pilot variation of the Compass general-purpose design.

kits.name: ZOWORT
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Zowort models feature slim gray-green armor, unusual leg proportions and a compact sensor-rich head. The Zowort Heavy represents a more military-oriented equipment arrangement and must be kept separate from the standard Zowort kit.
kits.summary: Peil Technologies’ practical general-purpose mobile suit.
kits.lore: The F/D-19 Zowort is a Peil Technologies general-purpose mobile suit seen in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. Its clean, aircraft-inspired lines and practical construction distinguish it from the more personalized Gundams appearing in school duels. It illustrates Peil's broader engineering philosophy beyond the highly specialized Gundam Pharact.

kits.name: TICKBALANG
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女

kits.name: GUNDAM LFRITH UR
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムルブリスウル
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Lfrith Ur has a broad upper body, dark heavy-looking armor and a blocky silhouette markedly different from Aerial. Its compactness and bulky arm structures are the distinctive visual features. It should not be confused with Lfrith Thorn or the original Lfrith prototype.
kits.summary: Sophie Pulone’s GUND-ARM from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundam Lfrith Ur is one of the Gundam-type mobile suits operated by the Earth-based Dawn of Fold in The Witch from Mercury. Sophie Pulone pilots the machine, whose use of GUND Format technology puts its operator at significant risk. Its story connects the Asticassia duels to the broader political violence beyond the school.
highlights: Sophie Pulone and Dawn of Fold

kits.name: HEINDREE
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: Heindree's helmet-like head, deep armored chest and shield-oriented profile give it a distinctive knightly appearance. The Heindree Sturm is a separate variant with different combat equipment and should have its own description rather than inheriting every standard-unit detail.
kits.summary: A Grassley-designed general-purpose mobile suit.
kits.lore: The Heindree is a Grassley Defense Systems mobile suit featured in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. Its design follows the company's angular, knight-like aesthetic while filling a more ordinary military role than the specialized dueling machines. Grassley's broader lineup illustrates the competing corporate approaches to mobile suit production at Asticassia.

kits.name: GUNDAM AERIAL REBUILD
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムエアリアル(改修型)
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes: The Rebuild has sharper armor, more imposing shoulders and a more heavily armed silhouette than the original Gundam Aerial. It should not automatically receive the original kit's accessories or assembly notes; each release has a distinct parts arrangement.
kits.summary: The dramatically redesigned Aerial from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundam Aerial Rebuild is the significantly altered form of Suletta Mercury's Gundam Aerial appearing in the second part of Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury. Its revised appearance accompanies major developments in the relationships among Suletta, Miorine and the people behind the GUND-ARM program. The transformed design signals both increased power and changes in the story's stakes.

kits.name: GUNDAM LFRITH THORN
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムルブリスソーン
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Lfrith Thorn has a strikingly compact torso and unusually long arms, lending its design a forward-leaning silhouette. The machine is not a recolor of Lfrith Ur; the two have different body layouts. Edition-specific parts and weapons should be verified from the selected kit.
kits.summary: Norea Du Noc’s distinctive long-armed GUND-ARM.
kits.lore: Gundam Lfrith Thorn is the companion Gundam-type machine to Lfrith Ur in The Witch from Mercury, piloted by Norea Du Noc. Like Ur, it places GUND Format risk at the center of its combat power and connects the school narrative with the Earthian conflict. Its unconventional body proportions make it immediately recognizable beside other Gundams.

kits.name: GYAN Strom (AGNES GIEBENRATH CUSTOM)
aliases: HG 1/144 ギャンシュトローム（アグネス・ギーベンラート機）
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blitz has dark armor, angular limbs and a large multifunction shield-mounted weapon system. The aggressive black-purple silhouette contrasts sharply with the brighter Duel and Aegis. Any included effect parts and the execution of its stealth-oriented equipment depend on the specific release.
kits.summary: Nicol Amalfi’s stealth-focused GAT-X machine from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X207 Blitz Gundam is a stolen Earth Alliance prototype piloted by Nicol Amalfi in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Its Mirage Colloid technology allows stealthy approaches that conventional mobile suits cannot easily counter. Nicol’s deployment of the Blitz becomes important in the escalating conflict between the Archangel crew and ZAFT pursuit forces.

kits.name: FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY (RED FRAME)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアストレイ レッドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astray Red Frame models feature distinctive exposed red frame sections, white armor and sword-oriented posing. They vary considerably between normal, Kai and other equipment configurations. Check the precise edition before assuming a particular katana, backpack or effect part is included.
kits.summary: Lowe Guele’s salvager Gundam with striking red framework and sword imagery.
kits.lore: The MBF-P02 Gundam Astray Red Frame is a prototype from Gundam SEED Astray, the side-story setting around the main Cosmic Era conflict. Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild becomes its signature pilot and uses ingenuity and salvaged equipment to survive much larger battles. The Red Frame is especially associated with a Japanese-style sword, giving it a different fighting identity from ordinary rifle-equipped Gundams.
highlights: Lowe Guele and the Junk Guild

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY (BLUE FRAME)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blue Frame retains the Astray family’s angular armor and visible frame styling but uses blue accents and a more military identity. Second L, D and other named upgrades differ dramatically in equipment and should not automatically inherit this base-profile entry. Compare the complete title when identifying the exact release.
kits.summary: Gai Murakumo’s mercenary-operated Astray prototype.
kits.lore: The MBF-P03 Gundam Astray Blue Frame belongs to the same Orb prototype family as the Red Frame but follows a different path in Gundam SEED Astray. It is strongly associated with mercenary pilot Gai Murakumo and his Serpent Tail group. Combat modifications emphasize professional battlefield practicality and mission-specific armament.

kits.name: MOBILE GINN (MIGUEL'S GINN)
aliases: HG 1/144 モビルジン (ミゲル・アイマン専用機)
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Miguel's vivid orange custom coloration distinguishes this GINN from standard green ZAFT production suits. The machine retains the bulky mono-eye frame and utilitarian early Cosmic Era proportions rather than adopting a later ZAKU Warrior shape.
kits.summary: The orange personal GINN associated with Miguel Ayman.
kits.lore: Miguel Ayman's GINN is a pilot-specific edition of ZAFT's early ZGMF-1017 mobile suit from the Gundam SEED era. It is associated with the well-known ace nicknamed the Magic Bullet of Dusk and carries the visual identity of his personal machine.

kits.name: GINN TYPE HIGH-MANEUVER
aliases: HG 1/144 ジンハイマニューバ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The high-mobility additions visibly change the standard GINN's backpack and equipment silhouette, while its recognizable mono-eye head and armored legs remain. It must be distinguished from ordinary GINN kits and later specialist variants.
kits.summary: A mobility-enhanced version of ZAFT's original GINN.
kits.lore: The GINN High Maneuver Type is a performance-oriented development of the early ZAFT GINN in the Gundam SEED setting. Its upgraded propulsion and combat capabilities reflect the continuing refinement of first-generation mobile suit designs during the Cosmic Era.

kits.name: HYPERION GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ハイペリオンガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The compact armored Gundam shape and conspicuous shield-related equipment give Hyperion a unique identity. The model should not be described as a main-series Strike or Freedom variant, and its exact barrier-effect parts must be checked per release.
kits.summary: The barrier-oriented Hyperion Gundam of SEED X Astray.
kits.lore: Hyperion Gundam is an Earth Alliance-linked prototype featured in Gundam SEED X Astray. Its defining feature is an extensive defensive barrier concept that distinguishes it from more conventional Gundam weapon systems in the Cosmic Era side stories.

kits.name: CGUE Type D.E.E.P.ARMS
aliases: HG 1/144 シグーディープアームズ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The variant's large shoulder-mounted beam weapons and distinctive CGUE silhouette make it considerably different from the unmodified commander machine. Its special equipment belongs to this development type, not to every CGUE kit.
kits.summary: A CGUE development machine built around experimental beam weapons.
kits.lore: The CGUE D.E.E.P. Arms is a specialized version of ZAFT's commander-oriented CGUE from the SEED side stories. It introduces experimental beam armament in a period when the technologies of conventional mobile suits were still rapidly evolving.

kits.name: 105DAGGER + GUNBARREL
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: This entry explicitly combines the 105 Dagger with Gunbarrel equipment, shifting the silhouette toward the rear-mounted specialized apparatus. It should not be mistaken for a basic Strike Dagger or a standalone Gunbarrel component.
kits.summary: This entry explicitly combines the 105 Dagger with Gunbarrel equipment, shifting the silhouette toward the rear-mounted specialized apparatus.
kits.lore: The 105 Dagger is a refined Earth Alliance mass-production machine in Gundam SEED side stories. Its Gunbarrel equipment links the design to specialized all-range combat experiments and to the more conventional Dagger family.

kits.name: FORCE IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 フォースインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Force Impulse models highlight a red-white-blue core suit with wing-shaped equipment attached at the back. The modular Silhouette idea is central to its identity, but part separation and transformation engineering differ by kit grade. Keep Force, Sword and Blast Silhouette variations distinct when assigning release-specific features.
kits.summary: The high-mobility Force configuration of Shinn Asuka’s Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam is a ZAFT machine from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny, first piloted by Shinn Asuka. Its modular Silhouette System changes combat capabilities; the Force Silhouette prioritizes speed and mobile aerial fighting. The Impulse's dramatic role during the war also sets it against established pilots and their more famous machines.

kits.name: GRIMOIRE
aliases: ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: ZAKU WARRIOR
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The standard ZAKU Warrior kit presents the base machine rather than a Gunner or Blaze equipment package. The name and equipment distinction are important for collection tracking.
kits.summary: The standard ZAKU Warrior kit presents the base machine rather than a Gunner or Blaze equipment package.
kits.lore: The ZAKU Warrior is a ZAFT mass-production mobile suit from Gundam SEED Destiny, equipped with a modular Wizard system. It replaces earlier ZAFT grunt concepts with a flexible modern platform.

kits.name: GAIA GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Gaia models emphasize the unusual ability to change between a humanoid suit and a quadrupedal combat silhouette. Black and purple armor distinguishes the original Phantom Pain machine, while later pilot-specific versions alter its colors. Always distinguish these editions before making kit-specific claims about conversion hardware.
kits.summary: The transformable ZAFT prototype seized by Phantom Pain.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X88S Gaia Gundam is a ZAFT prototype stolen by the Earth Alliance's Phantom Pain team in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Stella Loussier is its best-known pilot. A four-legged mobile armor configuration gives Gaia an aggressive ground-oriented fighting style, contrasting with the humanoid forms of many other Gundams in the series.

kits.name: SINANJU STEIN (NARRATIVE Ver.) Ver.Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 シナンジュ・スタイン (ナラティブ Ver.) Ver.Ka
機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ）
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Stein’s more restrained armor and shoulder shapes are the clearest contrast with the Sinanju. Narrative version details and markings must be checked against the specific box, especially when comparing Ver.Ka and earlier editions. Do not replace a Stein catalog entry with standard Sinanju artwork.
kits.summary: A white-armored Sinanju-line mobile suit seen in Gundam Narrative.
kits.lore: Sinanju Stein represents the development lineage behind the red Sinanju. The Narrative version appears in Gundam Narrative in connection with Zoltan Akkanen and the Neo Zeon remnant forces. Its paler, straighter-edged armor makes it visibly different from Full Frontal’s highly ornamented red machine. Version labels matter, because Unicorn and Narrative interpretations are not necessarily the same depicted configuration.

kits.name: GUNNER ZAKU WARRIOR (LUNAMARIA HAWKE CUSTOM)
aliases: HG GUNNER ZAKU WARRIOR (LUNAMARIA HAWKE CUSTOM)
HG 1/144 ガナーザクウォーリア（ルナマリア・ホーク専用機）
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The HG kit is specifically Lunamaria's red Gunner configuration, distinct from plain green ZAKU Warriors and other pilots' weapon packs. Keep the named pilot and equipment together.
kits.summary: The HG kit is specifically Lunamaria's red Gunner configuration, distinct from plain green ZAKU Warriors and other pilots' weapon packs.
kits.lore: Lunamaria Hawke pilots a red ZAFT ZAKU Warrior with the Gunner Wizard equipment in Gundam SEED Destiny. Its long-range cannon emphasizes support fire from a flexible Wizard-system mobile suit.

kits.name: SD GUNDAM CROSS SILHOUETTE GUNDAM CALIBARN
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: SDガンダム クロスシルエット ガンダムキャリバーン
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女

kits.name: INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM TypeII
aliases: HG 1/144 インフィニットジャスティスガンダム弐式
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: SAVIOUR GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 セイバーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Saviour's red armor, slim wings and high-speed transformation design produce an aerodynamic silhouette. Its mobile suit and aircraft-like forms are both central to the kit's presentation; transformation implementation depends on the product's grade. Do not conflate Saviour with later Justice-series Gundams also flown by Athrun.
kits.summary: Athrun’s red transformable Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X23S Saviour Gundam is a transformable ZAFT mobile suit piloted by Athrun Zala in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Its fighter-like mobile armor form and balanced combat equipment reflect a different approach from the Impulse's modular Silhouettes. Athrun's deployment of Saviour occurs during a period of personal uncertainty about the conflict and his responsibilities.

kits.name: SWORD IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ソードインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Sword Silhouette gives the Impulse an unmistakable close-combat look through its large blades and related red equipment. This kit should remain distinct from Force Impulse releases: the central mobile suit shares a design lineage, but the backpack and posing priorities differ greatly.
kits.summary: The close-combat Sword Silhouette version of the Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: Sword Impulse is a melee-focused configuration of the ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. With the Sword Silhouette fitted, the machine changes from flexible ranged movement to aggressive close combat. Shinn Asuka uses the Impulse's different loadouts to respond to the demands of the battlefield, underscoring ZAFT's modular approach.

kits.name: ABYSS GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Abyss models display a broad blue-and-black amphibious silhouette with shell-like rear equipment and prominent beam weapon features. Its transformable marine role should be distinguished from ordinary terrestrial Gundams. Verify the exact kit before describing working transformation parts or effect accessories.
kits.summary: Phantom Pain’s amphibious transformable Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X31S Abyss Gundam is a ZAFT prototype captured by Phantom Pain and piloted by Auel Neider in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Built for underwater and amphibious combat, it transforms into a specialized mobile armor configuration. Its battlefield identity sets it apart from the land-focused Gaia and the high-mobility Chaos.

kits.name: DUEL BLITZ GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 デュエルブリッツガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM
kits.notes: The model combines an unmistakably Duel-derived silhouette with newer equipment and sharper detail. It should not inherit the equipment or story of the untouched GAT-X102 Duel simply because the base name is similar. Consult this exact kit's manual for accessories and backpack components.
kits.summary: Yzak’s updated Duel-derived machine in SEED Freedom.
kits.lore: The Duel Blitz Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom as a heavily revised machine connected to the original Duel Gundam and Yzak Joule. Its new equipment updates a familiar Cosmic Era design for a later conflict, preserving the older prototype's visual identity while reshaping its combat role. The name also acknowledges the related Blitz Gundam lineage.

kits.name: GUNDAM 00 COMMAND QAN[T] DESERT TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144 GUNDAM 00 COMMAND QAN[T] DESERT TYPE
HG 1/144 ガンダムダブルオーコマンドクアンタ・デザートタイプ
ガンダムビルドメタバース

kits.name: GUNDAM AMAZING BARBATOS LUPUS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアメイジングバルバトスルプス
ガンダムビルドメタバース

kits.name: GINN TYPE HIGH-MANEUVER 2
aliases: HG 1/144 ジンハイマニューバ2型
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This HG release depicts the second high-mobility GINN variation rather than a basic GINN or the original High Maneuver Type. Its variant suffix is essential to correct identification.
kits.summary: This HG release depicts the second high-mobility GINN variation rather than a basic GINN or the original High Maneuver Type.
kits.lore: The High Maneuver Type II is a specialist descendant of ZAFT's GINN family in the SEED Destiny era. It reflects the continued use of improved earlier-generation mobile suits alongside newer ZAKU designs.

kits.name: GOUF IGNITED
aliases: HG 1/144 グフイグナイテッド（ハイネ・ヴェステンフルス専用機）
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The kit emphasizes the GOUF Ignited's swept shoulders and melee-oriented configuration. Unlike custom releases, this is the ordinary named GOUF Ignited entry.
kits.summary: The kit emphasizes the GOUF Ignited's swept shoulders and melee-oriented configuration.
kits.lore: The GOUF Ignited is an agile ZAFT mobile suit from SEED Destiny whose close-range equipment and arm-mounted weapons distinguish it from ZAKU Warriors. Its name pays homage to an older Gundam design in a different continuity.

kits.name: INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 インフィニットジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Infinite Justice is recognizable by its vivid pink-red armor and the Fatum-01 lifter. Leg-mounted beam weapon themes give it a different silhouette and combat presentation from the earlier Justice. Do not mix it with the Infinite Justice Type II, whose updated design belongs to a later story.
kits.summary: Athrun’s upgraded Justice Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X19A Infinite Justice Gundam is Athrun Zala’s advanced successor to the original Justice in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It maintains the mobile suit’s characteristic high-mobility flight equipment while bringing a stronger close-combat emphasis to the final conflict. It forms a memorable pairing with Kira’s Strike Freedom in the story’s late battles.

kits.name: DOM TROOPER
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The model portrays the CE-universe DOM Trooper, not the One Year War Dom or Rick Dom. Its bulky armor and distinctive three-unit association are integral to its identity.
kits.summary: The model portrays the CE-universe DOM Trooper, not the One Year War Dom or Rick Dom.
kits.lore: The DOM Trooper is a late-stage ZAFT-derived heavy mobile suit in SEED Destiny, used by the three-person team supporting Lacus Clyne's forces. Its hovering movement and defensive equipment evoke the classic Dom family.

kits.name: GUNDAM AMAZING EXIA
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムアメイジングエクシア
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The blue-and-white customized Exia armor and enlarged GN blade equipment distinguish Amazing Exia from Setsuna's original Gundam 00 machine. It also differs from the later dark-matter-equipped version associated with a different battle context.
kits.summary: The third Meijin Kawaguchi's customized Amazing Exia.
kits.lore: Amazing Exia is an advanced customized Gundam Exia used by the third Meijin Kawaguchi in Gundam Build Fighters. It builds on Exia's close-combat identity with enhanced equipment crafted for high-level Gunpla Battle competition.

kits.name: BLAZE ZAKU PHANTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 ブレイズザクファントム（レイ・ザ・バレル専用機）
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This standard Blaze ZAKU Phantom kit highlights the backpack configuration and command-style ZAKU head. Pilot-specific color variants should remain distinct catalog records.
kits.summary: This standard Blaze ZAKU Phantom kit highlights the backpack configuration and command-style ZAKU head.
kits.lore: The ZAKU Phantom is a commander-oriented ZAFT variant of the ZAKU Warrior platform in SEED Destiny. The Blaze Wizard adds high-mobility equipment to the same basic combat doctrine.

kits.name: GAIA GUNDAM (ANDOREW WALDFELD CUSTOM)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガイアガンダム(アンドリュー・バルトフェルド専用機)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The kit represents Waltfeld's recognizable personalized Gaia, rather than the original black-color unit. Both the pilot designation and contrasting color scheme are part of the edition.
kits.summary: The kit represents Waltfeld's recognizable personalized Gaia, rather than the original black-color unit.
kits.lore: The Gaia Gundam is a variable-form mobile suit from SEED Destiny that can take on a four-legged beastlike combat shape. Andrew Waltfeld later uses a distinct custom-color Gaia configuration.

kits.name: GOUF IGNITED (MASS PRODUCTION)
aliases: HG 1/144 グフ イグナイテッド(量産機)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Mass Production edition emphasizes the ordinary service-color version of the GOUF Ignited. It should not inherit the paint treatment or biography of Yzak or Heine's personal suits.
kits.summary: The Mass Production edition emphasizes the ordinary service-color version of the GOUF Ignited.
kits.lore: The GOUF Ignited is a melee-capable ZAFT machine deployed in the SEED Destiny conflict. General service variants complement the distinctive personalized units used by named pilots.

kits.name: LEGEND GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 レジェンドガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Legend’s dark gray and blue accents, broad backpack and remote-weapon silhouette set it apart from standard frontline Gundams. Its DRAGOON equipment is key to the design, though the way deployed weapons can be displayed differs among releases. Avoid confusing it with Providence despite their shared remote-weapon concepts.
kits.summary: Rey Za Burrel’s DRAGOON-equipped Gundam in SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X666S Legend Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny and is piloted by Rey Za Burrel. It employs a DRAGOON remote-weapon system, reflecting Cosmic Era interest in all-range combat. Legend’s appearance contributes to the conflicts surrounding the Destiny Plan and ZAFT’s final military operations.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.name: MURASAME (ANDOREW WALDFELD CUSTOM)
aliases: HG 1/144 ムラサメ(アンドリュー・バルトフェルド専用機)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The named Waltfeld edition portrays his individual Murasame configuration, not the standard Orb Defense Force unit. The pilot-linked color treatment is central to the retail distinction.
kits.summary: The named Waltfeld edition portrays his individual Murasame configuration, not the standard Orb Defense Force unit.
kits.lore: The Murasame is Orb's transformable defensive mobile suit in SEED Destiny, able to operate in an aircraft-like mobile-armor form. Andrew Waltfeld has a distinctive personal Murasame coloring.

kits.name: SHIRANUI AKATSUKI GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 シラヌイアカツキガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The reflective gold armor is a defining feature, while the wide Shiranui remote-weapon pack creates the configuration's own distinctive outline. This is not simply an Oowashi recolor; the equipment is different. Check the release to confirm which backpack and display parts are included.
kits.summary: The space-oriented Shiranui equipment version of Akatsuki.
kits.lore: Shiranui Akatsuki is a space-oriented equipment configuration of Orb's golden ORB-01 Akatsuki Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It is associated with Mu La Flaga's later service and the machine's important defensive role during the conflict. The Shiranui pack's remote weapons distinguish it from the Oowashi configuration's fighter-like equipment.

kits.name: MURASAME
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This standard Murasame kit uses the ordinary Orb unit identity rather than Andrew Waltfeld's individual color version. The swept aircraft-like surfaces are the design's defining characteristic.
kits.summary: This standard Murasame kit uses the ordinary Orb unit identity rather than Andrew Waltfeld's individual color version.
kits.lore: The Murasame serves the Orb Defense Force in Gundam SEED Destiny and converts between humanoid and atmospheric flight forms. It reflects Orb's investment in mobile suits able to act as aircraft.

kits.name: OOWASHI AKATSUKI GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 オオワシアカツキガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Oowashi flight pack gives Akatsuki a winged outline that differs from the Shiranui remote-weapon configuration. The gleaming gold body is common to the family, but the included pack and accessories are specific to this release. Do not confuse the two packages when describing the model.
kits.summary: Akatsuki equipped with the winged Oowashi flight pack.
kits.lore: Oowashi Akatsuki is an atmospheric high-mobility configuration of Orb's gold-armored Akatsuki Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It emphasizes a large backpack system with fighter-like proportions. The machine's symbolic significance is tied to Orb and its continuing struggle for independence during the Cosmic Era conflict.

kits.name: LIGHTNING BUSTER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ライトニングバスターガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM
kits.notes: Lightning Buster keeps the broad ranged-combat silhouette of its predecessor but adds revised armor and equipment details. Treat the SEED Freedom version as its own kit, not merely a recolor of the older GAT-X103. The exact package determines weapon and backpack options.
kits.summary: Dearka’s revised artillery Gundam from SEED Freedom.
kits.lore: Lightning Buster Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom as an upgraded machine based on the original Buster Gundam lineage. Dearka Elsman returns in association with this long-range support design. Its enhanced configuration revisits Buster's artillery-focused identity in a later Cosmic Era battlefield rather than depicting the unchanged original prototype.

kits.name: SD GUNDAM CROSS SILHOUETTE MIGHTY STRIKE FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: SDガンダム クロスシルエット マイティーストライクフリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: STRIKE NOIR GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ストライクノワールガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Its black-and-gray armor, angular head, pistol-oriented presentation and Noir Striker binders define a stealthy silhouette unlike the original Aile Strike. The kit should not inherit standard Strike equipment as though both were the same variant.
kits.summary: The covert-operations Strike Noir Gundam from Stargazer.
kits.lore: Strike Noir Gundam is the black-armored Earth Alliance machine used by Sven Cal Bayang in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer. It is part of the advanced Actaeon Project family, developed for covert and specialized combat roles.

kits.name: BUILD BURNING GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ビルドバーニングガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Build Burning favors a compact athletic silhouette, prominent fists and limb mobility for dynamic martial-arts poses. Later Try Burning and Kamiki Burning machines should be treated as distinct designs. Some kit releases include different effect options, so check the actual package.
kits.summary: Sekai Kamiki’s agile melee-focused Gunpla in Build Fighters Try.
kits.lore: Build Burning Gundam is the principal custom Gunpla piloted by Sekai Kamiki early in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Originally tied to Sei Iori's design work, it becomes the perfect match for Sekai's martial-arts fighting. The machine's battles emphasize that a fighter's movements can be just as expressive as the plastic model's mechanical specifications.

kits.name: VERDE BUSTER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ヴェルデバスターガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The green-and-cream armor, large gun equipment and redesigned weapon-carrying details distinguish Verde Buster from Dearka's original Buster Gundam. Its more modern equipment arrangement should be retained as its own kit identity.
kits.summary: An updated heavy-firepower Buster-type Gundam from Stargazer.
kits.lore: Verde Buster Gundam is a revised Buster-type mobile suit appearing in Gundam SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer. Operated by Shams Couza, it updates the heavy-artillery concept of the original Buster for the Actaeon Project's special warfare operations.

kits.name: 105 SLAUGHTER DAGGER
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Its dark military color treatment and practical Dagger-family armor distinguish the Phantom Pain machine from standard Strike Dagger and regular 105 Dagger releases. The selected Striker equipment must be verified per kit edition.
kits.summary: Phantom Pain's modified mass-produced Slaughter Dagger.
kits.lore: The Slaughter Dagger is an Earth Alliance mass-production mobile suit used by Phantom Pain in the SEED Stargazer setting. Derived from the Dagger family, it reflects the organization's preference for modified, combat-focused versions of familiar Alliance equipment.

kits.name: GINN TYPE INSURGENT
aliases: HG 1/144 ジン タイプ インサージェント
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: KERBEROS BuCUE HOUND
aliases: HG 1/144 ケルベロス・バクゥハウンド
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Its low-slung quadruped frame and distinctive multi-headed Kerberos Wizard equipment distinguish the Hound from a basic BuCUE. The animal-machine silhouette is central; individual model releases may differ in weapons or additional parts.
kits.summary: The heavily equipped quadrupedal Kerberos BuCUE Hound.
kits.lore: The Kerberos BuCUE Hound is a specialized four-legged mobile suit from the Gundam SEED Stargazer setting. It develops the animal-like BuCUE lineage with equipment suited to aggressive pursuit and close combat, giving the design a more menacing and heavily armed identity.

kits.name: STARGAZER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 スターゲイザーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The predominantly white circular-motif design and large light-ring propulsion silhouette make Stargazer visually unique. Editions should be described as exploration technology rather than assuming the machine was originally created as a conventional battlefield Gundam.
kits.summary: The deep-space exploration Gundam from SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer.
kits.lore: Stargazer Gundam is a research-oriented mobile suit developed for the DSSD's deep-space exploration program in the Cosmic Era. Unlike front-line combat Gundams, its mission emphasizes autonomous long-distance travel and the distinctive Voiture Lumiere propulsion system.

kits.name: MOBILE BuCUE
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This SEED Destiny-cataloged BuCUE represents the recognizable quadrupedal ZAFT design rather than a later Cerberus-type derivative. Its layout is clearly distinct from a ZAKU.
kits.summary: This SEED Destiny-cataloged BuCUE represents the recognizable quadrupedal ZAFT design rather than a later Cerberus-type derivative.
kits.lore: The BuCUE is ZAFT's four-legged combat vehicle-like mobile suit family, appearing throughout the SEED timeline. Its low silhouette and animal-inspired movement differ from humanoid machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムエクシア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Setsuna’s original Seven Swords mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents. It later undergoes major repairs and modifications following the first season’s battles.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept

kits.name: GUNDAM DYNAMES
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムデュナメス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Dynames models emphasize a long rifle, shoulder-mounted shields and a comparatively slim chest. A GN-Arms combination is a separate package and should not be treated as the standard Dynames kit. Trans-Am and clear-color releases retain the same broad machine identity but differ in presentation and product specifics.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s specialist long-range Gundam piloted by Lockon Stratos.
kits.lore: The GN-002 Gundam Dynames is Celestial Being’s specialized long-range Gundam in the first season of Gundam 00. Lockon Stratos pilots it as one of the original Gundam Meisters, concentrating on precision shooting while teammates cover other combat roles. Its GN Sniper Rifle and head targeting arrangement support its specialist identity; Haro assists during demanding combat situations.

kits.name: GUNDAM KYRIOS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムキュリオス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Kyrios design combines an orange-and-white color scheme with a pointed, aircraft-influenced silhouette. Its transformation is the most obvious design difference from Exia and Dynames. Whether a model performs a full conversion or uses alternative parts depends on the specific grade and release.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s transformable Gundam piloted by Allelujah Haptism.
kits.lore: The GN-003 Gundam Kyrios is a transformable Gundam operated by Celestial Being in Gundam 00. Allelujah Haptism pilots it and makes use of its aircraft-like form for high-speed operations. Kyrios complements the first-generation Gundam team by giving it mobility and transformation options alongside the other units’ specialist roles.

kits.name: ZAKU II F TYPE SOLARI (RFV)
aliases: HG 1/144 ZAKU II F TYPE SOLARI (RFV)
HG 1/144 ザクII F型 ソラリ機 (復讐のレクイエム)
機動戦士ガンダム 復讐のレクイエム

kits.name: GUNDAM EX (RFV)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムEX (復讐のレクイエム)
機動戦士ガンダム 復讐のレクイエム

kits.name: MURASAME KAI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM
kits.notes: Murasame Kai kits emphasize slim fighter-like proportions and a transformation-focused design. Their details should be distinguished from earlier standard Murasame units and custom colors. Grade-specific conversion mechanisms must be verified with the actual product instructions.
kits.summary: An upgraded Orb transformable mobile suit seen in SEED Freedom.
kits.lore: The Murasame Kai is an improved version of Orb's transformable Murasame mobile suit appearing in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom. Like its predecessor, it reflects Orb's focus on fast, aircraft-like machines able to serve in coordinated formations. Its continued use demonstrates the importance of mass-production units beyond the film's most powerful Gundams.

kits.name: BLACK KNIGHT SQUAD Cal-re.A
aliases: HG 1/144 ブラックナイトスコードカルラ
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: GUNDAM VIRTUE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムヴァーチェ
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Virtue models emphasize broad armor masses and heavy beam equipment. The internal Nadleeh reveal is part of the machine’s identity, but support for displaying that form depends on the specific model kit. The MG edition is especially focused on the relationship between the armored Virtue and concealed Nadleeh.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Tieria’s heavily armored Celestial Being Gundam from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: GN-005 Gundam Virtue is the heavy-armor, artillery-oriented member of Celestial Being’s original Gundam team in Gundam 00. Piloted by Tieria Erde, it uses a massive GN Bazooka and GN Cannons, contrasting sharply with Exia’s close-combat specialty. Virtue also conceals Gundam Nadleeh beneath its armor, making the machine’s true configuration part of the team’s strategic capabilities and the mystery surrounding the organization.

kits.name: UNION FLAG
aliases: HG 1/144 ユニオンフラッグ量産型
kits.notes: Flag Gunpla have an unusually light, narrow frame, long limbs and recognizable flight-transformation concept. Graham's custom Flag and Over Flag equipment variants should not be mistaken for the initial mass-production model. Check an individual kit's instructions for conversion and posing limitations.
kits.summary: The Union’s transformable conventional mobile suit in Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The VMS-01 Union Flag is a transformable mobile suit of the Union in Mobile Suit Gundam 00, used by conventional military pilots before the world's armed forces acquire technology comparable to Celestial Being. The Flag family becomes especially associated with ace pilot Graham Aker. Its aircraft-like construction reflects the technological contrast with Gundams powered by GN Drives.
highlights: Distinct from Graham Custom and Over Flag

kits.name: TIEREN Ground Type
aliases: HG 1/144 ティエレン 地上型
kits.notes: Ground Type Tieren kits emphasize massive slab-like armored plates, industrial pistons and an unmistakably heavy stance. Space Type and Taozi models share the broader lineage but differ visibly in propulsion and equipment. The exact model determines which specialized pieces are provided.
kits.summary: A heavily armored Human Reform League mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The MSJ-06II-A Tieren Ground Type serves the Human Reform League in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. Heavily armored and designed for conventional battlefield operations, it shows the military world's technological baseline before the revolutionary GN Drive-equipped Gundams appear. Sergei Smirnov and other League personnel operate machines in the Tieren family.

kits.name: TIEREN Space Type
aliases: HG 1/144 ティエレン 宇宙型
kits.notes: The Space Type retains the Tieren's robust armor but uses a spacecraft-oriented equipment arrangement rather than the Ground Type's terrestrial stance. Color and propulsion details help distinguish the variants. Confirm the particular kit before assuming common accessory contents between them.
kits.summary: The orbital-service variant of the Human Reform League Tieren.
kits.lore: The Tieren Space Type adapts the Human Reform League's familiar heavy mobile suit design for orbital and zero-gravity missions in Gundam 00. Conventional engines and defensive armor are central to the League's fleet doctrine before widespread access to GN Drive technology. It highlights how the same basic platform can take on a very different deployment environment.

kits.name: TIEREN TAOZI
aliases: HG 1/144 ティエレンタオツー
kits.notes: Taozi's striking pinkish armor and unique equipment separate it from Ground and Space Type Tierens. Its more specialized styling should be treated as a distinct product rather than a color option automatically available in every Tieren kit.
kits.summary: Soma Peries’s specialized high-performance Tieren.
kits.lore: The MSJ-06II-SP Tieren Taozi is a high-performance Human Reform League mobile suit associated with Soma Peries in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. It adapts the dependable Tieren platform for a specially enhanced pilot, emphasizing agility and responsive combat beyond a typical heavy production suit. The machine serves as a visual contrast between the League's traditional engineering and its elite-pilot program.

kits.name: GUNDAM THRONE EINS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムスローネアイン
kits.notes: Throne Eins has an angular crimson-and-black body with large cannon equipment defining its silhouette. Its specialized ranged role differs from Throne Zwei's attack-oriented equipment and Throne Drei's support functions. Compare individual release accessories rather than treating all three Thrones as interchangeable.
kits.summary: Johann Trinity’s heavy fire-support Gundam Throne.
kits.lore: The GNW-001 Gundam Throne Eins is part of Team Trinity's group of GN Drive Tau-powered Gundams in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. Johann Trinity pilots the machine, which specializes in heavy long-range fire support. Team Trinity's methods challenge the ideals associated with Celestial Being and deepen the conflict around Gundam intervention.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM SpecII&ZEUS SILHOUETTE
aliases: HG 1/144 デスティニーガンダムSpecII&ゼウスシルエット
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: BOLINOAK-SAMMAHN
aliases: HG 1/144 ボリノーク･サマーン
kits.notes: Unlike the leaner Zeta-era Gundams, Bolinoak Sammahn has large rounded armor and an unusual head-and-torso profile. The model's recon-oriented identity is the key difference from ordinary combat mobile suits.
kits.summary: Unlike the leaner Zeta-era Gundams, Bolinoak Sammahn has large rounded armor and an unusual head-and-torso profile.
kits.lore: The Bolinoak Sammahn is an unusual reconnaissance and electronic-warfare mobile suit linked to Paptimus Scirocco's forces in Zeta Gundam. Its distinctive sensors and bulky body reflect its specialist battlefield role.

kits.name: GUNDAM THRONE ZWEI
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムスローネ ツヴァイ
kits.notes: Throne Zwei is distinguished by its wide attack equipment, angular proportions and remote GN Fang identity. It shares a general design language with Eins and Drei but differs meaningfully in armament and presentation. Only list included parts verified for the specific kit.
kits.summary: The assault-oriented Team Trinity Gundam equipped with GN Fangs.
kits.lore: The GNW-002 Gundam Throne Zwei is the assault-focused member of Team Trinity's Gundam trio in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. Michael Trinity pilots it early in the story, with subsequent events tying the machine to another dangerous adversary. Its GN Fangs and striking close-combat capabilities reinforce the unsettling impact of Team Trinity's intervention tactics.

kits.name: GUNDAM THRONE DREI
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムスローネ ドライ
kits.notes: Throne Drei keeps the pointed Team Trinity armor language but emphasizes the equipment associated with GN Stealth Field operations. Its colors and armament differ from Eins and Zwei. For display, the exact pack contents and special-effect options should be checked per release.
kits.summary: Nena Trinity’s support-oriented Gundam Throne.
kits.lore: The GNW-003 Gundam Throne Drei is the electronic-support and area-control member of Team Trinity in Mobile Suit Gundam 00, piloted by Nena Trinity. Although visually linked to the other Thrones, its GN Stealth Field gives it a very different operational role. Nena's choices make the machine part of some of the series' most consequential events.

kits.name: GN ARMS TYPE-E + GUNDAM EXIA (TRANS MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 GN ARMS TYPE-E + GUNDAM EXIA (TRANS MODE)
HG 1/144 GNアームズTYPE-E＋ガンダムエクシア（トランザムモード)
kits.notes: This named Exia and GN Arms combination makes the oversized support craft central to the display instead of treating Exia as a standalone figure. The Trans Mode designation is part of this release's specific presentation.
kits.summary: This named Exia and GN Arms combination makes the oversized support craft central to the display instead of treating Exia as a standalone figure.
kits.lore: Celestial Being's GN Arms Type-E operates as a support platform for Gundam Exia, combining mobility and heavy attack capability with the GN Drive-powered Gundam. The pairing emphasizes the scale and sophistication of Celestial Being's early equipment.

kits.name: BLAZE ZAKU PHANTOM (DEARKA ELTHMAN CUSTOM)
aliases: HG BLAZE ZAKU PHANTOM (DEARKA ELTHMAN CUSTOM)
HG 1/144 ブレイズザクファントム(ディアッカ・エルスマン専用機)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The release specifically identifies Dearka's color and pilot association alongside the Blaze backpack. It is different from both the generic Blaze Phantom and other ace-custom versions.
kits.summary: The release specifically identifies Dearka's color and pilot association alongside the Blaze backpack.
kits.lore: Dearka Elsman is a veteran ZAFT pilot from the Gundam SEED storyline. A named Blaze ZAKU Phantom configuration ties that character to the more advanced SEED Destiny equipment line.

kits.name: GOUF IGNITED [YZAK JULE CUSTOM]
aliases: HG 1/144 グフ イグナイテッド〔イザーク・ジュール専用機〕
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This HG Yzak Custom version is a pilot-specific GOUF, distinct from the mass-production version and the Heine machine. The personalized color identity is not a cosmetic detail to discard.
kits.summary: This HG Yzak Custom version is a pilot-specific GOUF, distinct from the mass-production version and the Heine machine.
kits.lore: Yzak Joule is a major ZAFT pilot whose command roles continue into SEED Destiny. His named GOUF Ignited variation uses the mobile suit's emphasis on aggressive close fighting.

kits.name: CLANCHE CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 クランシェカスタム
kits.notes: The Custom retains the Clanche’s swept aircraft-like geometry but has distinct colors and refinement details. A catalog entry labeled Custom should not be merged with the plain Clanche or assigned assumed kit accessories from the original version.
kits.summary: A specialized version of the Federation’s transformable Clanche.
kits.lore: Clanche Custom is a modified version of the Earth Federation’s transformable Clanche from the later Gundam AGE era. It represents a more specialized configuration of the third-generation flight-capable design rather than an entirely different mobile suit family.

kits.name: POWERED GM CARDIGAN
aliases: HGBF 1/144 パワードジムカーディガン
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Bright yellow armor, added shielding and large back-mounted support equipment define the Cardigan's silhouette. It is not a standard Universal Century Powered GM despite its recognizable mass-production inspiration.
kits.summary: Fumina Hoshino's yellow support-oriented Powered GM Cardigan.
kits.lore: Powered GM Cardigan is a customized Gunpla assembled by Fumina Hoshino for Gundam Build Fighters Try. The build takes a utilitarian Federation GM-type base and adds equipment suited to a mobile support role within a Gunpla Battle team.

kits.name: UNION FLAG (GRAHAM CUSTOM)
aliases: HG 1/144 グラハム専用ユニオンフラッグカスタム
kits.notes: The dark custom color scheme, prominent flight surfaces and lean transforming Flag bodywork differentiate Graham's machine from the regular Union Flag. Kit-specific weapon choices should be checked instead of assuming every Flag configuration is identical.
kits.summary: The customized Union Flag flown by Graham Aker.
kits.lore: The Graham Custom Flag is a modified Union Flag associated with ace pilot Graham Aker in the first season of Gundam 00. It sacrifices ordinary machine expectations for extreme performance, becoming a distinctive rival to Celestial Being's Gundams.

kits.name: OVER FLAG
aliases: HG 1/144 オーバーフラッグ
kits.notes: This machine retains the slim, aircraft-like transformable Flag architecture but adds visible refinements that identify it as the improved squadron version. Avoid confusing its equipment or markings with Graham's individually tuned Custom Flag.
kits.summary: The upgraded Flag variant fielded by the Over Flags team.
kits.lore: The Over Flag is an improved Union Flag deployed with the Over Flags squadron in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. Its modifications reflect the Union's determination to challenge the Gundams with advanced conventional machinery and expert pilots rather than GN Drives.

kits.name: GYAN
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gyan models center on a narrow helmet-like head, a fencing-style beam saber and an unusual rounded shield design. The relatively slim torso and broad leg armor give it a unique silhouette. Do not confuse the original Gyan with Gyan Strom or Build-series reinterpretations.
kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

kits.name: Z'GOCK
kits.notes: The broad shell-like torso, ribbed limbs and clawed hands give this Z'Gok an organic aquatic silhouette. This unnamed entry represents the ordinary machine, distinct from Char Aznable's specially colored version.
kits.summary: The broad shell-like torso, ribbed limbs and clawed hands give this Z'Gok an organic aquatic silhouette.
kits.lore: The MSM-07 Z'Gok was one of Zeon's amphibious mobile suits, specialized for underwater movement and coastal assaults in the One Year War. Its integrated claws make it instantly distinguishable from land-based Zaku designs.

kits.name: GUNCANNON
aliases: HGUC 1/144 RX-77 ガンキャノン
kits.notes: The recognizable red armor, broad chest and paired shoulder cannons give the Guncannon an unusually sturdy silhouette. Different releases emphasize shoulder articulation, cannon mounting and cockpit details differently. Compare the original Guncannon with The Origin's earlier Guncannon First Type, which represents a separate developmental stage.
kits.summary: White Base’s red, cannon-equipped Earth Federation support mobile suit.
kits.lore: The RX-77-2 Guncannon is an Earth Federation support mobile suit from the One Year War, operated by White Base's crew alongside the original Gundam. Kai Shiden and Hayato Kobayashi are among its best-known pilots. Its shoulder-mounted cannons and substantial armor emphasize dependable medium-range fire support rather than the Gundam's all-purpose dueling role.

kits.name: TRANS-AM RISER
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 トランザムライザー
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Riser interpretation emphasizes the 00 Raiser configuration and its special-state presentation. It is a different catalog edition from a standard 00 Gundam or ordinary 0 Raiser and should retain that distinction.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Riser interpretation emphasizes the 00 Raiser configuration and its special-state presentation.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser unites the twin-drive 00 Gundam with the 0 Raiser support unit. Its Trans-Am states are key moments in the second season of Gundam 00, showcasing the striking capabilities and unusual requirements of the Twin Drive System.

kits.name: 武者ガンダムMk-II 徳川家康Ver.
aliases: MG 1/100 武者ガンダムMk-II 徳川家康Ver.
ＭＧ 1/100 武者ガンダムMK-2 徳川家康Ｖｅｒ．

kits.name: RB-79K BALL K-TYPE & RB-79 BALL SET
aliases: HGUC 1/144 RB-79K BALL K-TYPE & RB-79 BALL SET
ＨＧ 1/144 ボールK型(第08MS小隊版)&ボール(シャークマウス仕様)

kits.name: QUBELEY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Look for the sweeping shoulder binders, compact central torso, funnel containers and smooth organic armor shapes. Depending on the exact kit, posing the binders and representing deployed funnels can be central to the display. Qubeley Mk-II, mass-production Qubeley and Build-series redesigns deserve separate references.
kits.summary: Haman Karn’s funnel-equipped Newtype mobile suit from Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The AMX-004 Qubeley is a Newtype-use machine associated with Haman Karn and the Axis forces in Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ. Its remote-controlled funnels, curved armor and broad shoulder binders create a silhouette unlike the Federation’s conventional mobile suits. Haman’s ability to employ the Psycommu-controlled weapons makes the Qubeley a formidable opponent. Later Qubeley Mk-II units use related technology but belong to different pilots and must not be mistaken for the original.

kits.name: ZAKU-Ⅲ CUSTOM
kits.notes: The kit's broad body, high shoulders and character-specific custom appearance matter more than resemblance to a One Year War Zaku. It is not the standard Zaku III release.
kits.summary: The kit's broad body, high shoulders and character-specific custom appearance matter more than resemblance to a One Year War Zaku.
kits.lore: Mashymre Cello pilots a striking Zaku III Custom in Gundam ZZ during Neo Zeon's conflict with the AEUG. The customized type extends the Zaku name into a larger and more advanced era of mobile suits.

kits.name: HYAKU-SHIKI
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Hyaku-Shiki model is defined by its gold surfaces, distinctive narrow head and rear binders. Metallic coatings, painted gold and ordinary molded finishes can look very different, even when the underlying machine is the same. Keep the standard Hyaku-Shiki separate from Hyaku-Shiki Kai and custom Build-series variants when comparing products.
kits.summary: The AEUG’s gold mobile suit piloted by Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The golden MSN-00100 Hyaku-Shiki is a prototype mobile suit used by the AEUG during the Gryps Conflict. Quattro Bajeena, Char Aznable operating under an assumed identity, becomes its best-known pilot. Its development is connected to the Delta Gundam design line, and it favors mobility and skilled piloting over a conventional Gundam face. The machine is particularly memorable for its gold armor and its appearances alongside the Zeta Gundam and Gundam Mk-II.

kits.name: GUNTANK
kits.notes: Guntank models are defined by the long cannon barrels, tread assemblies and wide armored torso. The vehicle-like running gear makes it visually distinct from legged Gunpla. The original RX-75 should not be confused with the Guntank Early Type from The Origin, which depicts a different machine and development context.
kits.summary: The tracked Project V support machine accompanying White Base.
kits.lore: The RX-75 Guntank is one of the earliest Earth Federation Project V machines in Mobile Suit Gundam. Piloted during the One Year War by White Base personnel, it combines a tracked lower body with large-caliber shoulder weapons. Its hybrid tank-and-mobile-suit configuration shows the Federation's experimentation before humanoid Gundams became the dominant symbol of the project.

kits.name: STRIKE ROUGE
aliases: ENTRY GRADE 1/144 ストライクルージュ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Strike Rouge models are most immediately distinguished by their pink-toned armor and Strike-derived frame. Different releases use Aile, I.W.S.P. or other backpack configurations; these are not interchangeable as factual kit contents. Confirm the exact product title before listing included pack equipment.
kits.summary: Orb’s pink-armored Strike derivative associated with Cagalli.
kits.lore: The MBF-02 Strike Rouge is Orb's reconstruction and adaptation of Strike Gundam technology in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, strongly associated with Cagalli Yula Athha. Its distinctive pink-red armor and upgraded equipment embody Orb's growing role in the Cosmic Era conflict. The machine later continues to serve as an important bridge between the original Strike and newer technologies.

kits.name: GOUF
kits.notes: The Gouf's deep-blue armor, curved shoulder spikes and whip-oriented fighting identity distinguish it from Zaku designs. Model kits differ in the articulation and interpretation of its specialized weapons. The original Ramba Ral Gouf and the later Gouf Custom are related but not identical machines.
kits.summary: Ramba Ral’s close-combat Zeon mobile suit from the One Year War.
kits.lore: The MS-07B Gouf is a Zeon ground-combat mobile suit notably piloted by Ramba Ral in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Designed with close-quarters fighting in mind, it contrasts with the more widespread Zaku II through specialized equipment and a distinctive battlefield presence. Ral's encounters with Amuro Ray make the blue Gouf one of the early story's memorable rival machines.

kits.name: LIGHTNING GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ライトニングガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Lightning Gundam emphasizes a compact sniper-oriented body and equipment suited to stable ranged stances. Its backpack and weapon systems have several custom variations across Build Fighters releases. Only describe the equipment confirmed for the precise Lightning kit edition.
kits.summary: Yuuma Kousaka’s long-range custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Lightning Gundam is Yuuma Kousaka's custom Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its long-range shooting specialization fits Yuuma's tactical approach to team battles and provides a contrast with Sekai's close-quarters style. The design is built around precision, support and adaptable weapon systems rather than a single heroic charge.

kits.name: RICKDIAS
kits.notes: Rick Dias kits emphasize a broad rounded body, compact head and distinctive rear equipment. Colors vary between standard and Quattro-associated releases. Its styling reflects the same wider design family as many Anaheim machines, but it should not be confused with the similarly named Rick Dom.
kits.summary: The AEUG mobile suit famously associated with Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The RMS-099 Rick Dias is an AEUG mobile suit developed with Anaheim Electronics and used by several important Zeta Gundam characters. Quattro Bajeena pilots a red version, while earlier standard units are seen in a darker scheme. The design reflects the AEUG's blend of cutting-edge engineering and personnel connected to different sides of the previous war.

kits.name: QUBELEY Mk-Ⅱ
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II retains the striking shoulder binders and curved armored form of the original Qubeley. Color and edition information are vital: Elpeo Ple and Ple Two versions should be treated as distinct kit releases where appropriate. Do not apply the white original Qubeley’s artwork or markings to a Mk-II by default.
kits.summary: A successor Qubeley used by different Newtype pilots in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: Qubeley Mk-II machines are derived from the original Qubeley and appear in Gundam ZZ under different Newtype pilots, including Elpeo Ple and Ple Two. Although related to Haman Karn’s original mobile suit, each machine has its own colors and narrative role. Funnel-equipped all-range attacks remain the defining combat concept, placing the Mk-II within the wider Axis Newtype weapons program.

aliases: MG 1/100 MS-０７B3 GOUF CUSTOM (GRAVITY BATTLE LINE IMAGE COLOR VER.)
ＭＧ 1/100  グフカスタム(重力戦線イメージカラーＶｅｒ．)
機動戦士ガンダム MS IGLOO

機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This named combination depicts two distinct Federation machines together. It should not be mistaken for a standalone GM or Ball kit, and neither component is itself a Gundam.
kits.summary: This named combination depicts two distinct Federation machines together.
kits.lore: The GM Type C is a later Federation GM variant appearing in the period around Operation Stardust. The Ball Type C is its small support-craft counterpart, reflecting the continued use of practical mass-production units.

kits.name: DRA-C (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ドラッツェ(ユニコーンＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Unicorn-era Dra-C keeps a narrow central body, long propulsion units and an unusual legless space-combat silhouette. Its later details and markings separate this edition from earlier Stardust Memory depictions; do not substitute equipment descriptions from a different Dra-C release.
kits.summary: A later Unicorn-era appearance of the unusual space-combat Dra-C.
kits.lore: The Dra-C is a space-use mobile suit lineage dating to the Delaz Conflict, assembled around repurposed Zeon hardware. In the era of Gundam Unicorn, surviving and modified machines remain among the forces associated with the Sleeves, illustrating the continuing use of older Zeon designs.

kits.name: GM Ⅱ DESERT COLOR Ver.
aliases: HGUC 1/144 GM Ⅱ DESERT COLOR Ver.
ＨＧ 1/144 ジムII デザートカラーＶｅｒ．
kits.notes: This edition uses a desert-toned GM II presentation. It should be distinguished from the differently colored Unicorn GM II and from the GM III, despite their related Federation lineages.
kits.summary: This edition uses a desert-toned GM II presentation.
kits.lore: The GM II is a Federation mass-production mobile suit that continues to appear in the Universal Century after the One Year War. Desert-color examples highlight the varied equipment and deployments visible around the Unicorn-era conflict.

kits.name: HI-ZACK
kits.notes: The Hizack keeps a mono-eye head and external pipes but uses revised armor and Federation-era proportions. That hybrid lineage sets it apart from an ordinary One Year War Zaku II kit.
kits.summary: The Hizack keeps a mono-eye head and external pipes but uses revised armor and Federation-era proportions.
kits.lore: The Hizack is a Federation and Titans mass-production mobile suit that visibly continues the earlier Zeon Zaku design language. Its presence symbolizes how postwar Federation forces adopted once-enemy machine concepts.

kits.name: GAT-X105 STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 ストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The Strike has an angular red-white-blue torso, blocky knees and characteristic backpack connection designed around interchangeable Striker systems. Plain Strike releases should not be assumed to include an Aile, Sword or Launcher backpack; verify each kit package before claiming specific accessories.
kits.summary: The versatile GAT-X105 prototype at the center of Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X105 Strike Gundam is one of the five Earth Alliance GAT-X prototypes built for the Cosmic Era conflict. Kira Yamato unexpectedly becomes its pilot during the attack on Heliopolis and continues to develop his combat skills through the war. The Strike's interchangeable equipment is central to its versatility and to the design philosophy of the broader prototype program.

kits.name: GAT-X105 STRIKE GUNDAM DEACTIVE MODE
aliases: RG 1/144 GAT-X105 STRIKE GUNDAM DEACTIVE MODE
ＲＧ 1/144 ストライクガンダム ディアクティブモード
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: JUAGGU (MSV Ver.)
kits.notes: This MSV-branded Juaggu focuses on the elephant-like central trunk, rounded body, and bulky multi-tube forearms. It represents the MSV interpretation rather than the separately listed Unicorn-era Juaggu.
kits.summary: This MSV-branded Juaggu focuses on the elephant-like central trunk, rounded body, and bulky multi-tube forearms.
kits.lore: The Juaggu is an unusual Zeon amphibious design proposed for the Jaburo assault, carrying prominent artillery-style launchers on its arms and a trunk-like face. Its ungainly profile belongs to the experimental aquatic branch of Zeon development.

kits.name: NEMO UNICORN DESERT COLOR Ver.
aliases: MG NEMO UNICORN DESERT COLOR Ver.
ＭＧ 1/100 ネモ ユニコーンデザートカラーＶｅｒ．
kits.notes: This Desert Color version changes the appearance of the Nemo without turning it into a different machine. Its sandy deployment scheme separates it from ordinary and Unicorn-color Nemo listings.
kits.summary: This Desert Color version changes the appearance of the Nemo without turning it into a different machine.
kits.lore: The Nemo is an Anaheim-built general-purpose mobile suit originally associated with the AEUG. By the time of Unicorn, examples of this older Federation-compatible design remain in service under varied conditions.

kits.name: NEMO UNICORN COLOR Ver.
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ネモ ユニコーンカラーＶｅｒ．
kits.notes: This Unicorn-color Nemo emphasizes the straightforward visor head, rounded shoulder armor and utilitarian GM-family proportions. The edition-specific color arrangement distinguishes it from the earlier Zeta-era Nemo kits even though the underlying design is familiar.
kits.summary: This Unicorn-color Nemo emphasizes the straightforward visor head, rounded shoulder armor and utilitarian GM-family proportions.
kits.lore: The Nemo is an Anaheim Electronics mass-production mobile suit first associated with the AEUG in the Gryps Conflict. Its continued appearances in Gundam Unicorn reflect the long service life of dependable Federation-aligned machines after those earlier wars.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 Ver.Ka FULL PSYCHO FRAME PROTOTYPE MOBILE SUIT BANSEE
aliases: MG UNICORN GUNDAM 02 Ver.Ka FULL PSYCHO FRAME PROTOTYPE MOBILE SUIT BANSEE
ＭＧ 1/100 小説版ユニコーンガンダム2号機バンシィＶｅｒ．Ka 最終決戦仕様
kits.notes: The Ver.Ka Banshee design centers on the black-and-gold frame contrast and the second-unit designation. The original title's BANSEE spelling is preserved for product identification.
kits.summary: The Ver.Ka Banshee design centers on the black-and-gold frame contrast and the second-unit designation.
kits.lore: The second Unicorn-series machine, Banshee, is a dark-colored psycho-frame Gundam tied to the Vist Foundation and Federation forces. Its destructive transformation gives the unit a different presence from Banagher's white Unicorn.

kits.name: GMIII（UNICORN DESERT COLOR VER.）
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジムIII (ユニコーンデザートカラーＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Desert Color version highlights the GM III's updated visor and armament-ready shape in a muted field scheme. It should not be substituted with an earlier GM II desert release.
kits.summary: The Desert Color version highlights the GM III's updated visor and armament-ready shape in a muted field scheme.
kits.lore: The GM III updates the long-running Earth Federation GM lineage with more modern equipment. Unicorn-era desert deployment colors suggest the persistence of these older production suits on Earth's frontlines.

kits.name: GEARA DOGA (FULL FRONTAL USE)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ギラ・ドーガ(フル・フロンタル専用機)
kits.notes: The distinctive Geara Doga silhouette combines a mono-eye head, armored skirt and curved shoulder shapes. The Full Frontal-use presentation should be cataloged separately from ordinary Geara Dogas and later Geara Zulus, which belong to related but different releases.
kits.summary: The distinctive Geara Doga silhouette combines a mono-eye head, armored skirt and curved shoulder shapes.
kits.lore: The Geara Doga originated as a Neo Zeon mass-production machine during Char's Rebellion. This Full Frontal-associated variant connects that older design lineage with the Sleeves faction portrayed in Gundam Unicorn and its related side material.

kits.name: RX-78 GP01 ZEPHYRANTHES
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムGP01 ゼフィランサス
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The GP01's white and blue armor retains classic Gundam cues while adopting more complex postwar prototype styling. This original Zephyranthes form is distinct from its space-adapted Full Burnern revision.
kits.summary: The GP01's white and blue armor retains classic Gundam cues while adopting more complex postwar prototype styling.
kits.lore: Gundam GP01 Zephyranthes is an Anaheim Electronics prototype in the Gundam Development Project, piloted by Kou Uraki during the Delaz Conflict. It begins as a primarily terrestrial combat machine before major modifications.

kits.notes: This Real Type Color release applies a distinct visual treatment to the RX-78-2 Ver.2.0 design. Its significance lies in the color and presentation rather than a different fictional Gundam unit.
kits.summary: This Real Type Color release applies a distinct visual treatment to the RX-78-2 Ver.2.0 design.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is Amuro Ray's Federation prototype from the One Year War. Real Type coloring interprets that familiar machine through more restrained military-inspired graphics associated with vintage model-kit artwork.

kits.summary: The version names the Ver.2.0 Zaku II and its Real Type styling together.
kits.lore: The MS-06S is the command-grade Zaku II associated most famously with Char Aznable. The Real Type scheme belongs to the model-art tradition that reimagines One Year War equipment with subdued colors.
