kits.name: ReZEL TYPE-C (GR)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 リゼルC型(ゼネラル・レビル配備機)
kits.notes: ReZEL Type-C differs visually from a standard ReZEL through its specialized configuration and General Revil association. Its angular aircraft-derived lines and large backpack make this a distinct reference entry rather than a generic ReZEL listing.
kits.summary: ReZEL Type-C differs visually from a standard ReZEL through its specialized configuration and General Revil association.
kits.lore: The ReZEL is a transformable Earth Federation mobile suit developed for the post-Char's Rebellion era. Its Type-C configuration is associated with the General Revil's forces in Gundam Unicorn, where organized Federation formations contrast with the scattered Zeon remnants.

kits.name: MS-06S ZAKUⅡ（BLACK TRI-STARS CUSTOM）VER.2.0
kits.notes: The Ver.2.0 edition emphasizes a team-specific color and marking variant of the Zaku II. Its identity is distinct from the Black Tri-Stars' high-mobility MS-06R machines and their later Doms.
kits.summary: The Ver.2.0 edition emphasizes a team-specific color and marking variant of the Zaku II.
kits.lore: The Black Tri-Stars are Zeon ace pilots associated with coordinated attacks during the One Year War. A Black Tri-Stars-themed Zaku II ties their signature black-and-purple identity to the familiar MS-06S silhouette.

kits.name: BASE JABBER（UNICORN ZEON REMNANTS COLOR VER.）
aliases: HGUC BASE JABBER（UNICORN ZEON REMNANTS COLOR VER.）
ＨＧ 1/144 ベースジャバー(ユニコーンジオン軍残党カラーＶｅｒ．)

kits.name: GM Ⅱ（A.E.U.G. COLOR VER.）
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジムII(エゥーゴカラーＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: This GM II is defined by its visor-faced utilitarian body and the AEUG-specific colors. It should remain distinct from standard Federation color schemes and earlier RGM-79 GM releases.
kits.summary: This GM II is defined by its visor-faced utilitarian body and the AEUG-specific colors.
kits.lore: The GM II is a post-One Year War upgrade to the Federation's classic GM, appearing on several sides of the Gryps Conflict. The AEUG color version reflects the anti-Titans organization's use of available mass-production machines.

kits.name: ReZEL （DEFENSER b-UNIT）
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 リゼル(ディフェンサーbユニット)
kits.notes: This kit entry concentrates on the Defenser b-Unit silhouette, especially the substantial backpack and the more heavily equipped profile. Its added equipment changes the balance of the ReZEL design compared with the clean standard machine.
kits.summary: This kit entry concentrates on the Defenser b-Unit silhouette, especially the substantial backpack and the more heavily equipped profile.
kits.lore: The ReZEL family extends the Zeta Gundam's transformation principles into a Federation production platform. The Defenser b-Unit is an additional mission configuration intended to strengthen the ReZEL's combat capabilities beyond the standard machine.

kits.name: AMX-011 ZAKUⅢ
kits.notes: The ordinary Zaku III kit retains the machine's heavy Neo Zeon silhouette without the individual Custom's specific styling. This is a separate release from the Mashymre-associated variant.
kits.summary: The ordinary Zaku III kit retains the machine's heavy Neo Zeon silhouette without the individual Custom's specific styling.
kits.lore: The AMX-011 Zaku III is a Neo Zeon mass-production candidate in Gundam ZZ, reflecting attempts to revive the Zaku legacy with a more modern machine. Its substantial armor differs dramatically from the old MS-06.

kits.name: TALLGEESE Ⅱ
kits.notes: Its refined predominantly white armor, crested head and Tallgeese-style thruster outlines distinguish it from the original Tallgeese. It should not be confused with the later Tallgeese III or the different Endless Waltz and special-finish product editions.
kits.summary: Treize’s personalized Tallgeese II from Gundam Wing.
kits.lore: Tallgeese II is Treize Khushrenada’s custom mobile suit introduced late in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. Derived from the formidable Tallgeese design, it becomes a visual emblem of Treize’s convictions and role in the final stages of the Earth–colony conflict.
highlights: Not original Tallgeese or Tallgeese III

kits.notes: This Ver.Ka custom unit emphasizes additional funnel structures and the large rear-mounted winglike display. It is a named enhanced configuration and should not be merged with an ordinary Nu Gundam Ver.Ka listing.
kits.summary: This Ver.Ka custom unit emphasizes additional funnel structures and the large rear-mounted winglike display.
kits.lore: The RX-93 Nu Gundam is Amuro Ray's final mobile suit in Char's Counterattack, developed with psycho-frame technology and armed with fin funnels. A double-fin-funnel treatment expands the recognizable remote-weapon silhouette beyond the standard arrangement.

kits.name: AMX-107 BAWOO
kits.notes: This entry captures the angular winged Bawoo design, emphasizing its unique split-transformation identity in the fictional setting. It represents the named Bawoo rather than the mass-production recolor.
kits.summary: This entry captures the angular winged Bawoo design, emphasizing its unique split-transformation identity in the fictional setting.
kits.lore: The Bawoo is a transformable Neo Zeon mobile suit in Gundam ZZ, known for its unusual division into upper and lower flying components. Glemy Toto is strongly associated with its commander variant.

kits.name: GELGOOG MARINE
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-14F ゲルググマリーネ
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Marine type combines Gelgoog ancestry with revised armor and a utilitarian military appearance. This is the standard Marine, not Cima Garahau's dedicated command machine.
kits.summary: The Marine type combines Gelgoog ancestry with revised armor and a utilitarian military appearance.
kits.lore: The Gelgoog Marine is a Zeon-derived mobile suit used by surviving forces in the post-One Year War era. Its sturdy combat role and older design heritage make it a natural participant in the Delaz Conflict.

kits.name: DOM TROPEN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: Its thick armored legs, skirt and heavy rounded torso recall the classic Dom while adding desert-service refinements. The Tropen designation separates it from an ordinary space Rick Dom.
kits.summary: Its thick armored legs, skirt and heavy rounded torso recall the classic Dom while adding desert-service refinements.
kits.lore: The Dom Tropen is a desert-oriented descendant of Zeon's Dom heavy mobile suit. Delaz Fleet-aligned forces deploy similar machines during the events surrounding Gundam 0083 and the pursuit of Gundam GP02.

kits.name: LAUNCHER STRIKER / SWORD STRIKER PACK for MG 1/100 AILE STRIKE GUNDAM Ver. RM
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 エールストライクガンダム Ｖｅｒ．ＲＭ用 ランチャーストライカー/ソードストライカーパック

kits.name: RX-78 GP01Fb
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Full Burnern's conspicuous rear binder thrusters and revised body equipment are visually distinct from the original ground GP01. The Fb designation is essential to identify the correct model configuration.
kits.summary: The Full Burnern's conspicuous rear binder thrusters and revised body equipment are visually distinct from the original ground GP01.
kits.lore: The GP01 Full Burnern is the space-adapted version of Kou Uraki's Gundam GP01 in Gundam 0083. Rebuilt after serious damage, it adds propulsion intended for high-mobility fighting in orbit.

kits.name: MS-06S ZAKUⅡ JOHNNY RIDDEN CUSTOM

kits.notes: The catalog title specifically identifies a Johnny Ridden custom of the MS-06S type. It should remain separate from Ridden's MS-06R high-mobility units and his Gelgoog variants.
kits.summary: The catalog title specifically identifies a Johnny Ridden custom of the MS-06S type.
kits.lore: Johnny Ridden is one of the best-known Zeon aces in Mobile Suit Variations, closely associated with vivid crimson colors and high-performance Zakus. This named custom extends his personalized machine lineage.

kits.name: GATO’S GELGOOG
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ガトー専用ゲルググ
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Gato-associated Gelgoog retains the family's sweeping shoulders and massive lower legs while carrying its individual ace-pilot treatment. Do not merge it into generic mass-production Gelgoog entries.
kits.summary: The Gato-associated Gelgoog retains the family's sweeping shoulders and massive lower legs while carrying its individual ace-pilot treatment.
kits.lore: Anavel Gato is a veteran Zeon ace whose earlier combat exploits precede his prominent role in Gundam 0083. His personal Gelgoog connects the Delaz Conflict to the final battles of the One Year War.

kits.name: MARASAI（UNICORN COLOR Ver.）
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 マラサイ(ユニコーンカラーＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Unicorn version retains the Marasai's characteristic elongated helmet, shoulder armor and asymmetrical visual weight. Its later-era coloring and remnant association merit a distinct listing from the original Titans-color interpretation.
kits.summary: The Unicorn version retains the Marasai's characteristic elongated helmet, shoulder armor and asymmetrical visual weight.
kits.lore: The Marasai began as a Titans-operated mobile suit in the Gryps War, derived from Anaheim development work. Gundam Unicorn brings surviving examples back into view with Zeon remnant units, illustrating the shifting ownership of machines across Universal Century conflicts.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY GOLD FRAME AMATSU
aliases: HG 1/144 GUNDAM ASTRAY GOLD FRAME AMATSU
ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムアストレイゴールドフレーム天
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The Amatsu's black-and-gold color design, ornate shoulders and clawlike offensive equipment separate it from the standard gold-armed Astray. Later Amatsu Mina refinements must remain distinct entries with their own specific descriptions.
kits.summary: The extensively modified Astray Gold Frame Amatsu.
kits.lore: Gold Frame Amatsu is a drastically altered form of the Astray Gold Frame in the Gundam SEED Astray side stories. Its dark modified armor and specialized equipment reflect the machine's transformation from its original Orb-developed prototype identity.

kits.notes: The Char's Custom presentation pairs the Z'Gok's rounded underwater frame and pointed claws with a recognizable red-toned commander color scheme. Keep it separate from ordinary green or blue Z'Gok releases.
kits.summary: The Char's Custom presentation pairs the Z'Gok's rounded underwater frame and pointed claws with a recognizable red-toned commander color scheme.
kits.lore: Char Aznable piloted a distinctive commander-use Z'Gok during the battle at Jaburo, extending his reputation beyond the familiar red Zaku. The amphibious suit's powerful claws are central to its close-range fighting style.

kits.notes: Rezin's named machine carries a distinctive color and commander-associated presentation over the Geara Doga's broad shoulders and armored skirt. It is separate from standard Neo Zeon Geara Doga releases.
kits.summary: Rezin's named machine carries a distinctive color and commander-associated presentation over the Geara Doga's broad shoulders and armored skirt.
kits.lore: Rezin Schnyder pilots a personalized Geara Doga in Neo Zeon's forces during Char's Counterattack. The Geara Doga is the organization's mainline military mobile suit, continuing the Zeon mono-eye infantry tradition.

kits.name: EWAC ZACK/GAZA C/GEARA DOGA (GUNDAM UNICORN Ver.) SET
aliases: HGUC 1/144 EWAC ZACK/GAZA C/GEARA DOGA (GUNDAM UNICORN Ver.) SET
ＨＧ 1/144 アイザック/ガザC/ギラ・ドーガ(ユニコーンＶｅｒ．)セット

kits.name: ZAKU CANNON (GUNDAM UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ザク・キャノン（ユニコーンカラーVer.）
kits.notes: The high-mounted cannon is the defining break from the ordinary Zaku outline, with sensors and utility-style armor reinforcing its support role. This is the Gundam Unicorn edition, not the earlier MSV depiction of the same basic machine.
kits.summary: The high-mounted cannon is the defining break from the ordinary Zaku outline, with sensors and utility-style armor reinforcing its support role.
kits.lore: The Zaku Cannon adapts the classic Zaku lineage to artillery support, replacing the familiar general-purpose profile with a more specialized battlefield role. A Unicorn-era appearance connects this veteran design to the aging mobile suits operated by Zeon remnants.

kits.name: Z’GOK (GUNDAM UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ズゴック（ユニコーンカラーVer.）
kits.notes: The rounded torso, bellows-like limbs and prominent claw hands give this Unicorn-era Z'Gok a very different outline from conventional humanoid suits. The listing preserves its specific later-era presentation rather than treating every Z'Gok kit as equivalent.
kits.summary: The rounded torso, bellows-like limbs and prominent claw hands give this Unicorn-era Z'Gok a very different outline from conventional humanoid suits.
kits.lore: The Z'Gok is a Zeon amphibious mobile suit built around powerful underwater mobility and close-range claws. Its return among the remnant machines of Gundam Unicorn reinforces the series' theme of old One Year War hardware appearing in later battles.

kits.name: SILVER BULLET (FUNNEL TEST TYPE)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 シルヴァ・バレト(ファンネル試験型)
kits.notes: This experimental configuration should be identified by its funnel-testing equipment rather than merged into ordinary Silver Bullet releases. The broad upper body and layered mechanical design provide a striking base for the specialized testing silhouette.
kits.summary: This experimental configuration should be identified by its funnel-testing equipment rather than merged into ordinary Silver Bullet releases.
kits.lore: The Silver Bullet is derived from the Doven Wolf design lineage and repurposed for Federation-linked evaluation work. The Funnel Test Type explores remote-weapon technology, creating a connection between older heavy mobile suits and later psycommu research.

kits.name: Z’GOK
kits.notes: A Z'Gok model features large articulated claws, curved joint housings and a low-profile amphibious silhouette. The standard blue-green type and Char's red commander machine are distinct color variants, and later timelines reuse the design name in different contexts. Confirm the listed designation when comparing kits.
kits.summary: Zeon’s claw-equipped amphibious mobile suit.
kits.lore: The MSM-07 Z'Gok is a Zeon amphibious mobile suit built for underwater movement and close-range assault during the One Year War. Its clawed hands and streamlined body depart sharply from the familiar Zaku. The type is seen in fighting around Federation coastal installations, while Char's personalized red unit is especially remembered for the attack on Jaburo.

kits.name: MS-06F ZAKU II (DOZLE ZABI USE)
aliases: MG 1/100 MS-06F ZAKU II (DOZLE ZABI USE)
ＭＧ 1/100 ドズル・ザビ専用ザクII
kits.notes: The Dozle Zabi release is identified by its ornamental customized Zaku presentation. The F-type designation and named-user styling matter more here than assumptions about a generic mass-production Zaku.
kits.summary: The Dozle Zabi release is identified by its ornamental customized Zaku presentation.
kits.lore: Dozle Zabi, commander of Zeon's space attack force, is associated in MSV material with a richly decorated personal Zaku II. The customized appearance suits a high-ranking officer rather than an ordinary front-line machine.

kits.name: GUNDAM Ez-SR
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Ez-SR retains the rugged ground-combat heritage of the original Ez8 but presents sharper tactical armor and mission-focused silhouettes. It should be recognized as a Build Fighters kit, not as a standard 08th MS Team Ez8 release.
kits.summary: Ez-SR retains the rugged ground-combat heritage of the original Ez8 but presents sharper tactical armor and mission-focused silhouettes.
kits.lore: Gundam Ez-SR represents a militarized Gunpla Battle reinterpretation of the Gundam Ez8 design family. Its team-oriented approach stresses interchangeable tactical roles instead of the usual single protagonist's all-purpose combat style.

kits.name: RGM-79 GM
kits.notes: The GM is identifiable by its visor-type head, simplified white-and-red armor and clean Federation proportions. Gunpla interpretations vary in head detailing, cockpit structure and optional armaments. Later GM II, GM III, GM Sniper and other variants represent different models and should retain their own references.
kits.summary: The standard Federation mass-production mobile suit descended from the Gundam.
kits.lore: The RGM-79 GM is the Earth Federation's mass-production mobile suit introduced late in the One Year War. Derived from technologies tested in the RX-78-2 Gundam, it enables the Federation to field far more mobile suits than the prototype program alone could provide. Its appearances at major battles such as Solomon and A Baoa Qu make it a defining symbol of ordinary Federation pilots.

kits.name: M’QUVE’S GOUF
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 マ・クベ専用グフ
kits.notes: This named Gouf should be distinguished from Ramba Ral's iconic blue frontline example. The personalized livery and M'Quve designation are the essential differences for catalog identification.
kits.summary: This named Gouf should be distinguished from Ramba Ral's iconic blue frontline example.
kits.lore: M'Quve is a Zeon officer and collector associated with his own distinctive take on the Gouf. The personalized machine belongs to the side-story and variation material expanding One Year War unit assignments.

kits.name: RGM-89D JEGAN D TYPE
kits.notes: The D Type keeps the Jegan's compact helmet and practical armor language while revising its protective surfaces and service-era details. This entry refers to the RGM-89D configuration, not the earlier RGM-89 or the later special-mission Jegan types.
kits.summary: The D Type keeps the Jegan's compact helmet and practical armor language while revising its protective surfaces and service-era details.
kits.lore: The Jegan is a long-serving Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit introduced around Char's Rebellion. The RGM-89D revision represents its continued development for the Unicorn period, when upgraded Jegans remain common Federation equipment.

kits.name: MS-14C GELGOOG CANNON (MSV COLOR)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ゲルググキャノン(MSVカラー)
kits.notes: The MSV Color edition presents the MS-14C Gelgoog Cannon in a variation-specific scheme. The cannon-equipped form must remain separate from an ordinary Gelgoog or high-mobility Gelgoog.
kits.summary: The MSV Color edition presents the MS-14C Gelgoog Cannon in a variation-specific scheme.
kits.lore: The Gelgoog Cannon is an artillery-oriented offshoot of Zeon's late-war Gelgoog family. Its shoulder-mounted cannon silhouette signals an emphasis on support fire rather than the standard beam-rifle role.

kits.name: ASSHIMAR (GREEN DIVERS Ver.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 アッシマー(グリーンダイバーズＶｅｒ．)

kits.name: PALE RIDER(GROUND HEAVY EQUIPMENT TYPE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 PALE RIDER(GROUND HEAVY EQUIPMENT TYPE)
ＨＧ 1/144 ペイルライダー(陸戦重装備仕様)

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The original Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray, reinterpreted across numerous Gunpla grades.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. Later Gundam designs repeatedly refer back to its configuration and combat record.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions

kits.name: MS-09RS ANAVEL GATO’S RICK DOM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-09RS ANAVEL GATO’S RICK DOM
ＨＧ 1/144 アナベル・ガトー専用リック・ドム
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The MS-09RS Rick Dom associated with Gato is separate from his later Gelgoog and stolen Gundam GP02A. The custom pilot association and Rick Dom space-type design are essential identifiers.
kits.summary: The MS-09RS Rick Dom associated with Gato is separate from his later Gelgoog and stolen Gundam GP02A.
kits.lore: Anavel Gato is the renowned Zeon pilot central to Operation Stardust. A named Rick Dom custom belongs to the earlier part of his service as a pilot of powerful Zeon mobile suits.

kits.name: GEIRAIL SCHARFRICHTER & LANDMAN RODI SET
aliases: HG 1/144 GEIRAIL SCHARFRICHTER & LANDMAN RODI SET
ＨＧ 1/144 ゲイレールシャルフリヒター&ランドマンロディ セット
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ

kits.name: 00 GUNDAM SEVEN SWORD/G INSPECTION
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ダブルオーガンダム セブンソード/G インスペクション
kits.notes: Seven Sword/G's visual appeal is the dramatic spread of sword shapes around the compact 00 Gundam frame. The Inspection designation distinguishes this release from normal-color Seven Sword/G and standard 00 Gundam products.
kits.summary: Seven Sword/G's visual appeal is the dramatic spread of sword shapes around the compact 00 Gundam frame.
kits.lore: The 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G extends the 00 Gundam concept with multiple bladed weapons and an additional gun. The Inspection version is a specially presented interpretation of that equipment-intensive configuration rather than a separate mobile suit in the television story.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FRAME
aliases: ＰＧ 1/60 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blue Frame retains the Astray family’s angular armor and visible frame styling but uses blue accents and a more military identity. Second L, D and other named upgrades differ dramatically in equipment and should not automatically inherit this base-profile entry. Compare the complete title when identifying the exact release.
kits.summary: Gai Murakumo’s mercenary-operated Astray prototype.
kits.lore: The MBF-P03 Gundam Astray Blue Frame belongs to the same Orb prototype family as the Red Frame but follows a different path in Gundam SEED Astray. It is strongly associated with mercenary pilot Gai Murakumo and his Serpent Tail group. Combat modifications emphasize professional battlefield practicality and mission-specific armament.

kits.name: BALLUTE PACK
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 バリュートパック

kits.name: MSN-02 ZEONG
kits.notes: Zeong kits center on the huge torso, broad skirt thrusters, detachable or articulated arm assemblies and lack of conventional legs. Its display demands differ greatly from ordinary standing humanoid Gunpla. Some editions emphasize internal frame detailing, but those features must be checked against the exact grade and release.
kits.summary: Char Aznable’s experimental Newtype mobile suit at A Baoa Qu.
kits.lore: The MSN-02 Zeong is an experimental Zeon Newtype-use mobile suit deployed by Char Aznable near the end of the One Year War. Its unfinished legless appearance becomes central to the climactic confrontation with Amuro Ray's Gundam at A Baoa Qu. Wire-guided hands and powerful beam weapons make it a striking expression of Zeon's late-war experimentation with remote attack systems.

kits.name: G-DEFENSER & FLYINGARMOR
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 Gディフェンサー & フライングアーマー
kits.notes: This named equipment set is a collection of support machines, not a standalone new mobile suit. Its aircraft-shaped components belong to the Gundam Mk-II support ecosystem and merit an accessory-specific catalog description.
kits.summary: This named equipment set is a collection of support machines, not a standalone new mobile suit.
kits.lore: The G-Defenser and Flying Armor are support systems associated with AEUG operations during the Gryps Conflict. They augment Gundam Mk-II deployment and illustrate the use of specialized equipment alongside developing movable-frame machines.

kits.name: RX-78-3 G-3 GUNDAM
kits.notes: This entry highlights the G-3's characteristic neutral colors and RX-78-series lines. The kit is not simply a standard RX-78-2 listing even when the underlying Gundam silhouette is familiar.
kits.summary: This entry highlights the G-3's characteristic neutral colors and RX-78-series lines.
kits.lore: The RX-78-3 G-3 Gundam is a sibling unit of the original Federation Gundam prototype family. Its gray-toned visual identity distinguishes it from the famous tricolor RX-78-2.

kits.name: METEOR UNIT
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ミーティアユニット
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 クロスボーンガンダムX2 Ver．Ka
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム

kits.name: CASVAL’S GUNDAM
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 キャスバル専用ガンダム
kits.notes: The familiar RX-78 design is recast in Char-associated colors and markings. The catalog should identify the Casval concept explicitly, as it is not merely a red repaint representing Amuro's regular machine.
kits.summary: The familiar RX-78 design is recast in Char-associated colors and markings.
kits.lore: Casval Rem Deikun is the birth name of Char Aznable. Casval's Gundam belongs to an alternate-history interpretation that imagines an RX-78-type machine associated with him rather than Amuro Ray's standard One Year War Gundam.

kits.name: MS-06R-1A ZAKUII UMA LIGHTNING CUSTOM
aliases: MG 1/100 MS-06R-1A ZAKUII UMA LIGHTNING CUSTOM
ＭＧ 1/100 ユーマ・ライトニング専用ザクII
kits.notes: The named custom combines the MS-06R-1A high-mobility backpack and legs with Uma Lightning's specific unit identity. It must not be grouped with Johnny Ridden or Shin Matsunaga customs.
kits.summary: The named custom combines the MS-06R-1A high-mobility backpack and legs with Uma Lightning's specific unit identity.
kits.lore: Uma Lightning is a Zeon ace associated with specialized MSV machines. His personal high-mobility Zaku follows the MS-06R branch built around enhanced space-combat propulsion.

kits.name: ZOGOK (Operation Capture of Jaburo ver.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ZOGOK (Operation Capture of Jaburo ver.)
ＨＧ 1/144 ゾゴック(ジャブロー攻略戦仕様)
kits.notes: This named Operation Capture of Jaburo edition points to the original amphibious assault setting. Preserve its Zogok identity instead of merging it with similarly named Z'Gok releases.
kits.summary: This named Operation Capture of Jaburo edition points to the original amphibious assault setting.
kits.lore: The Zogok is an eccentric Zeon amphibious mobile suit proposed for the attack on the Federation's Jaburo stronghold. Its unusual arm-mounted weapons and boomerang-like head projectiles contrast with more conventional aquatic types.

kits.name: MSA-0011 S-GUNDAM
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This HG model represents the S Gundam's angular, modular mobile-suit form rather than its strengthened Ex-S or booster configurations. The chest, shoulders and equipment arrangement are central to its striking identity.
kits.summary: This HG model represents the S Gundam's angular, modular mobile-suit form rather than its strengthened Ex-S or booster configurations.
kits.lore: The MSA-0011 S Gundam appears in Gundam Sentinel as an advanced Earth Federation prototype operated by Task Force Alpha. Its ALICE artificial-intelligence system and modular equipment distinguish it from more conventional Gundam designs.

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X3 Ver.Ka
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 クロスボーンガンダムＸ３ Ｖｅｒ．Ka
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム

kits.name: STAR BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM Ver.RG SYSTEM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 STAR BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM Ver.RG SYSTEM
ＨＧ 1/144 スタービルドストライクガンダム Ｖｅｒ．ＲＧシステム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The RG System edition puts special emphasis on the visual appearance of Star Build Strike during this power-up state. Its core design is still the advanced Build Strike, but color and finish choices differ among product versions. Confirm any translucent pieces or effect accessories against the exact release.
kits.summary: Star Build Strike portrayed in its RG System state.
kits.lore: Star Build Strike Gundam is Sei Iori and Reiji's advanced custom Gunpla from Gundam Build Fighters. The RG System represents an important development in how Sei channels energy through his model's internal structure. This version highlights the spectacular visible effects associated with that system during key tournament battles.

kits.name: MS-06R-1A ZAKU II ANAVEL GATO'S CUSTOM
aliases: MG MS-06R-1A ZAKU II ANAVEL GATO'S CUSTOM
ＭＧ 1/100 アナベル・ガトー専用ザクＩＩ Ｖｅｒ．２．０
kits.notes: The kit identifies Gato's personal MS-06R-1A variant, with the high-mobility Zaku silhouette and pilot-specific presentation. It is not his Gelgoog or the Physalis Gundam.
kits.summary: The kit identifies Gato's personal MS-06R-1A variant, with the high-mobility Zaku silhouette and pilot-specific presentation.
kits.lore: Anavel Gato is a celebrated Zeon pilot later central to Stardust Memory. His high-mobility Zaku customization places him within the ace-specific MSV lineage before later machines made his reputation.

機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY

kits.name: REBAWOO
kits.notes: ReBawoo is identifiable by its pointed head, angular red armor and the distinct upper and lower sections of its splitting machine. The mechanical emphasis differs from a standard Bawoo; exact transformation parts depend on the particular model release.
kits.summary: A Unicorn-era Neo Zeon development of the transforming Bawoo.
kits.lore: The ReBawoo is a Neo Zeon prototype that reworks the Bawoo concept with technology associated with the Sleeves in the Gundam Unicorn setting. Its mobile suit can separate into coordinated upper and lower flight-capable components, connecting an older transforming design to later developments.

kits.name: MS-06FS ZAKU II (GARMA ZABI USE)
aliases: MG 1/100 MS-06FS ZAKU II (GARMA ZABI USE)
ＭＧ 1/100 ガルマ・ザビ専用 ザクII
kits.notes: The MS-06FS designation and Garma's personalized presentation distinguish this model from a standard MS-06F and from the MS-06S associated with Char.
kits.summary: The MS-06FS designation and Garma's personalized presentation distinguish this model from a standard MS-06F and from the MS-06S associated with Char.
kits.lore: Garma Zabi is the youngest child of the Zeon ruling family and an Earth invasion commander. His personal Zaku II is represented as a command-oriented customization rather than an anonymous grunt suit.

aliases: ＨＧ1/144 バイアラン・カスタム2号機(バンデシネ版)

ＭＧ 1/100ドズル・ザビ専用リック・ドム
kits.notes: The named Rick Dom uses the heavy Dom family silhouette with officer-specific styling. It is distinct from the famous mass-production space Rick Dom and Dozle's decorated Zaku.
kits.summary: The named Rick Dom uses the heavy Dom family silhouette with officer-specific styling.
kits.lore: The Rick Dom is Zeon's space-adapted version of the heavy Dom mobile suit. A Dozle Zabi personal edition connects this machine with a leading officer's customized wartime equipment.

kits.name: RMS-141 XEKU EINS
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The kit showcases the Xeku Eins' broad shoulder armor, substantial legs and distinctive utilitarian body. The core machine should not be confused with the task-specific weapon packages depicted in separate configurations.
kits.summary: The kit showcases the Xeku Eins' broad shoulder armor, substantial legs and distinctive utilitarian body.
kits.lore: The Xeku Eins is a large, versatile mobile suit associated with the New Desides faction in Gundam Sentinel. Its modular equipment variations reflect a philosophy of adaptable mass-production machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY GOLD FRAME
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムアストレイゴールドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The base machine has a recognizably standard Astray body outline with a gold-colored internal frame. It should not inherit the black armor, claws or specialized silhouette of the later Amatsu configurations just because they share its origin.
kits.summary: The original gold-frame prototype of the Astray family.
kits.lore: Astray Gold Frame is one of the prototype mobile suits created through Orb's Astray development program in the SEED Astray chronology. Its story follows its loss, recovery and later reconstruction, providing the starting point for several increasingly altered Gold Frame variants.

ＨＧ 1/144 ジェガン ノーマルタイプ(F91Ｖｅｒ．)

aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムアストレイ レッドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astray Red Frame models feature distinctive exposed red frame sections, white armor and sword-oriented posing. They vary considerably between normal, Kai and other equipment configurations. Check the precise edition before assuming a particular katana, backpack or effect part is included.
kits.summary: Lowe Guele’s salvager Gundam with striking red framework and sword imagery.
kits.lore: The MBF-P02 Gundam Astray Red Frame is a prototype from Gundam SEED Astray, the side-story setting around the main Cosmic Era conflict. Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild becomes its signature pilot and uses ingenuity and salvaged equipment to survive much larger battles. The Red Frame is especially associated with a Japanese-style sword, giving it a different fighting identity from ordinary rifle-equipped Gundams.
highlights: Lowe Guele and the Junk Guild

kits.notes: This Custom 02 edition has a specialized airborne-combat silhouette with extensive thrust structures and long limb shapes. The model needs its own catalog identity because its details are not interchangeable with the original Byarlant or first Custom.
kits.summary: This Custom 02 edition has a specialized airborne-combat silhouette with extensive thrust structures and long limb shapes.
kits.lore: The Byarlant Custom line rebuilds the unusual Titans-era Byarlant for later Federation service. The second Custom configuration continues experimentation with a machine distinguished by powerful aerial maneuvering without ordinary aircraft-style transformation.

kits.name: RX-78-1 PROTOTYPE GUNDAM

kits.notes: This catalog entry presents the RX-78-1 prototype concept, including its distinctive black-white-red contrast. It must not be mistaken for Amuro's tricolor RX-78-2 release.
kits.summary: This catalog entry presents the RX-78-1 prototype concept, including its distinctive black-white-red contrast.
kits.lore: The RX-78-1 Prototype Gundam represents an earlier machine in the Earth Federation's Gundam development series. Its darker palette and differing detailing separate the prototype from the deployed RX-78-2.

kits.name: RX-78GP03S GUNDAM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムGP03S ステイメン
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This RX-78GP03S listing identifies the Stamen component rather than the full Dendrobium weapons platform. Its streamlined Gundam silhouette should be kept separate from the combined unit.
kits.summary: This RX-78GP03S listing identifies the Stamen component rather than the full Dendrobium weapons platform.
kits.lore: The GP03S Stamen is the Gundam mobile suit at the heart of the GP03 Dendrobium system. In Stardust Memory, the Stamen operates as part of a much larger mobile-armor platform.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The dark armor, gold psycho-frame appearance and Armed Armor equipment provide the key visual cues. For this release, distinguish Banshee Norn from standard Banshee and the white Unicorn: their backpack and armament arrangements vary.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Riddhe’s dark RX-0 mobile suit from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: Banshee Norn is a reconfigured form of the second RX-0 Unicorn Gundam, associated with Riddhe Marcenas in Gundam Unicorn. Its black-and-gold armor sharply contrasts with Banagher’s white Unicorn, while its advanced equipment and psycho-frame technology make it central to the closing struggle over Laplace’s Box. Banshee Norn is a distinct configuration from the earlier Banshee and from Unicorn Gundam.

kits.name: GEARA ZULU (CUARON USE)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ギラ・ズール(キュアロン機)
kits.notes: The Cuarón-use release highlights the Geara Zulu's military uniform-inspired armor, mono-eye head and distinctive Sleeves motifs. It should remain distinct from standard units and other named pilots' Geara Zulus in the searchable kit catalog.
kits.summary: The Cuarón-use release highlights the Geara Zulu's military uniform-inspired armor, mono-eye head and distinctive Sleeves motifs.
kits.lore: The Geara Zulu is the Sleeves faction's main mass-production machine in Gundam Unicorn, developed after earlier Neo Zeon designs. This named version is associated with Cuarón, one of the personnel serving the Neo Zeon remnants during the conflict.

kits.name: ZSSA
kits.notes: The distinctive blocky torso and densely armed silhouette are the kit's main visual characteristics. Its appearance is separate from later Unicorn-era Zssa versions and their color schemes.
kits.summary: The distinctive blocky torso and densely armed silhouette are the kit's main visual characteristics.
kits.lore: The Zssa is a missile-heavy Neo Zeon mobile suit in Gundam ZZ, created around overwhelming fire support. Its numerous launchers and rounded outer shell favor saturation attacks over a sleek dueling profile.

kits.name: GEARA ZULU (GILBOA SANT USE)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ギラ・ズール(ギルボア・サント機)
kits.notes: The Gilboa Sant-use Geara Zulu centers on the familiar mono-eye infantry silhouette but preserves the identity of this named machine. Its details and presentation belong to this specific entry rather than every generic Geara Zulu kit.
kits.summary: The Gilboa Sant-use Geara Zulu centers on the familiar mono-eye infantry silhouette but preserves the identity of this named machine.
kits.lore: Gilboa Sant is a Sleeves pilot and family man encountered during the events of Gundam Unicorn. His Geara Zulu ties the faction's ordinary soldiers to the series' more personal view of the conflict beyond its ace pilots and prototype Gundams.

kits.name: FULL FRONTAL’S GEARA DOGA
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ギラ・ドーガ(フル・フロンタル専用機)
kits.notes: This named Geara Doga should be cataloged apart from a regular Geara Doga or Full Frontal's Sinanju. The custom appearance is the central distinction, rather than an entirely new mobile-suit family.
kits.summary: This named Geara Doga should be cataloged apart from a regular Geara Doga or Full Frontal's Sinanju.
kits.lore: The Geara Doga is a Neo Zeon mass-production machine developed around Char's Counterattack. Full Frontal's association with Neo Zeon remnants gives this custom a link to the Unicorn-era Sleeves faction.

kits.name: G GUNDAM VS MASTER GUNDAM SCHOOL OF TOHO FUHAI HYPER MODE SET
aliases: HGFC 1/144 G GUNDAM VS MASTER GUNDAM SCHOOL OF TOHO FUHAI HYPER MODE SET
ＨＧ 1/144 ゴッドガンダム VS マスターガンダム 流派東方不敗ハイパーモードセット

kits.name: GEARA DOGA(UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ギラ・ドーガ(ユニコーンＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: This Unicorn-branded release interprets the Geara Doga with the story's later-era visual treatment. It should remain distinct from Rezin's custom and the original Char's Counterattack editions.
kits.summary: This Unicorn-branded release interprets the Geara Doga with the story's later-era visual treatment.
kits.lore: The Geara Doga remains recognizable as a classic Neo Zeon frontline machine in the Universal Century. Unicorn features older Zeon equipment alongside newer Sleeves units during the renewed conflict.

kits.name: FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM (RED COLOR VER.)
aliases: MG 1/100 FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM (RED COLOR VER.)
ＭＧ 1/100 フルアーマー・ユニコーンガンダム(レッドカラーＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Red Color Version identifies a specific Full Armor Unicorn presentation, rather than the later green-frame final battle scheme. The extra silhouette of weapons and tanks is central to the design.
kits.summary: The Red Color Version identifies a specific Full Armor Unicorn presentation, rather than the later green-frame final battle scheme.
kits.lore: The RX-0 Unicorn Gundam uses a psycho-frame system that reacts dramatically to Newtype phenomena. Its heavily equipped Full Armor form adds extensive weaponry, while the red psycho-frame treatment evokes the unit's earlier state.

kits.name: GN ARMS TYPE-E (Real Color Ver.)
aliases: HG 1/144 GN ARMS TYPE-E (Real Color Ver.)
ＨＧ 1/144 GNアームズ TYPE-E(リアルカラーＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Real Color Version applies a different visual presentation to the Exia-compatible GN Arms Type-E. This is a support craft entry rather than a second Gundam Exia mobile suit.
kits.summary: The Real Color Version applies a different visual presentation to the Exia-compatible GN Arms Type-E.
kits.lore: GN Arms Type-E is a support craft designed to dock with Gundam Exia and augment Celestial Being's combat power. The platform transforms the Exia's fighting profile by adding large external equipment.

kits.name: S-GUNDAM BOOSTER UNIT TYPE
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 Sガンダム ブースター・ユニット装着型
ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The MG kit illustrates how changing the S Gundam's lower and rear structures produces an unusually propulsion-heavy form. It is distinct from the standard S Gundam and the armored Ex-S.
kits.summary: The MG kit illustrates how changing the S Gundam's lower and rear structures produces an unusually propulsion-heavy form.
kits.lore: The S Gundam Booster Unit Type is a high-mobility arrangement of the S Gundam from Gundam Sentinel. Its booster-focused configuration trades the conventional mobile-suit silhouette for increased propulsion capability.

kits.name: MS-14Fs GELGOOG MARINE CIMA CUSTOM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-14Fs GELGOOG MARINE CIMA CUSTOM
HGUC 1/144 MS-14Fs ゲルググマリーネシーマカスタム
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: Cima's custom emphasizes the Gelgoog Marine's broad equipment surfaces with a commander-specific presentation. It is a named machine rather than a standard green Marine-type release.
kits.summary: Cima's custom emphasizes the Gelgoog Marine's broad equipment surfaces with a commander-specific presentation.
kits.lore: Cima Garahau commands a faction of Zeon remnants during the Delaz Conflict and pilots a personalized Gelgoog Marine. Its distinctive appearance marks the character as separate from ordinary Marine-type units.

kits.name: RGM-89S STARK JEGAN (CCA-MSV Ver.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 スタークジェガン(CCA-MSV Ｖｅｒ．)
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAEA TYPE-F
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 ガンダムアストレア タイプ-F
kits.notes: The Type F's scarlet armor, Gundam-style head and 00-generation weapon design separate it from standard white Astraea. Multiple Type F equipment editions exist, so a basic profile should not claim the Full Weapon Set is included in every release.
kits.summary: The red Astraea Type F from Gundam 00's side stories.
kits.lore: Gundam Astraea Type F is a distinctive red variant of the original Astraea from the Gundam 00 side-story chronology, associated with the covert organization Fereshte. The design emphasizes the overlap between early Celestial Being technology and later secret missions.

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X1 KAI
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムX1改
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム

kits.name: RGM-89R JEGAN A TYPE(F91Ver.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジェガン Aタイプ(F91Ｖｅｒ．)

kits.name: ALTRON GUNDAM EW
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 アルトロンガンダム EW
kits.notes: This MG EW kit centers on the Altron's paired dragon-fang arm equipment and distinctive coloring. It is separate from the television Altron and from the earlier Shenlong EW.
kits.summary: This MG EW kit centers on the Altron's paired dragon-fang arm equipment and distinctive coloring.
kits.lore: Chang Wufei's Altron Gundam appears in the Endless Waltz interpretation of Gundam Wing. Its dragon-themed extending arms carry forward the close-combat traditions of the original Shenlong.

kits.name: MSZ-006P2/3C ZETA GUNDAM III P2 TYPE RED ZETA
aliases: MG 1/100 MSZ-006P2/3C ZETA GUNDAM III P2 TYPE RED ZETA
ＭＧ 1/100 ゼータガンダム3号機P2型 レッド・ゼータ

kits.name: TRANS-AM RAISER GLOSS INJECTION Ver.
aliases: RG 1/144 TRANS-AM RAISER GLOSS INJECTION Ver.
ＲＧ 1/144 トランザムライザー グロスインジェクションＶｅｒ．
kits.notes: This Gloss Injection edition focuses on the Trans-Am Raiser appearance and its special surface treatment. The finish is a retail distinction, not a newly developed fictional 00 Gundam.
kits.summary: This Gloss Injection edition focuses on the Trans-Am Raiser appearance and its special surface treatment.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser combines Setsuna F. Seiei's 00 Gundam with the O Raiser support craft. The pairing enables powerful GN particle output and the famous Trans-Am combat mode.

kits.name: MSZ-006-3B ZETA GUNDAM III B TYPE GRAY ZETA
aliases: MG 1/100 MSZ-006-3B ZETA GUNDAM III B TYPE GRAY ZETA
ＭＧ 1/100 ゼータガンダム3号機B型 グレイ・ゼータ

kits.name: MS-09F DOMTROPEN (SAND BROWN)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ドムトローペン サンドブラウン
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Sand Brown kit is a specifically colored Dom Tropen edition rather than an ordinary Dom or standard space Rick Dom. Its bulk and desert operational identity define this listing.
kits.summary: The Sand Brown kit is a specifically colored Dom Tropen edition rather than an ordinary Dom or standard space Rick Dom.
kits.lore: Dom Tropen is a desert-operating evolution of the Zeon Dom family shown in Stardust Memory. Its sand-toned appearance reflects the remnants' continuing ground warfare after the One Year War.

kits.name: TALLGEESE III
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Tallgeese III’s Mega Cannon, shield-mounted heat rod and modified head design are its most recognizable distinctions from the original Tallgeese. The exact contents and support arrangements depend on the kit edition. Standard Tallgeese and Tallgeese II entries should remain separate.
kits.summary: The upgraded Tallgeese associated with Endless Waltz.
kits.lore: Tallgeese III is an advanced machine associated with Milliardo Peacecraft in Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz. It draws from the Tallgeese lineage but introduces significant weapons and styling changes, making it a separate configuration rather than a simple repaint. Its striking head crest and powerful equipment reinforce its role in the final conflict.

kits.name: ∀ GUNDAM （MOONLIGHT BUTTERFLY Ver.）
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ターンエーガンダム(月光蝶Ｖｅｒ．)

kits.name: ELF BULLOCK MASS PRODUCTION TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144 ELF BULLOCK MASS PRODUCTION TYPE
ＨＧ 1/144 エルフ・ブルック(量産機)
ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: MACK KNIFE MASS PRODUCTION TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144 MACK KNIFE MASS PRODUCTION TYPE
ＨＧ 1/144 マックナイフ(量産機)
ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: GAEL CHAN’S SILVER BULLET
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 シルヴァ・バレト(ガエル・チャン専用機)
kits.notes: This named Silver Bullet is tied to Gael Chan rather than to the separately released Funnel Test Type. The modified Döven Wolf-based proportions are the key recognition feature.
kits.summary: This named Silver Bullet is tied to Gael Chan rather than to the separately released Funnel Test Type.
kits.lore: Gael Chan is associated with the Silver Bullet, a mobile suit derived from the Döven Wolf development lineage. In Unicorn, the Silver Bullet represents an advanced remnant of earlier Federation and Zeon-era engineering.

kits.name: HEAVY GUNDAM
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ヘビー・ガンダム
kits.notes: The bulkier armor profile and heavy-weapons emphasis set this Heavy Gundam apart from the basic RX-78-2. The catalog entry reflects the named MSV design rather than a generic Gundam.
kits.summary: The bulkier armor profile and heavy-weapons emphasis set this Heavy Gundam apart from the basic RX-78-2.
kits.lore: The Heavy Gundam is an RX-78-family design emphasizing reinforced armor and additional firepower. It belongs to the alternative and expanded One Year War development material associated with MSV.

kits.name: RGC-80 GM CANNON
kits.notes: The RGC-80 designation and asymmetrical cannon silhouette define this kit. Keep the GM Cannon separate from the RX-77 Guncannon and from ordinary RGM-79 GM releases.
kits.summary: The RGC-80 designation and asymmetrical cannon silhouette define this kit.
kits.lore: The RGC-80 GM Cannon adapts the Federation's GM mass-production platform for artillery support. Its shoulder cannon and revised armored shape make it a different battlefield specialization from standard GM units.

kits.name: JEGAN TYPE-A2 (GENERAL REVIL DEPLOYMENT)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジェガンA2型(ゼネラル・レビル配備機)
kits.notes: The General Revil deployment type retains the recognizable Jegan silhouette but has an edition-specific equipment and color presentation. It belongs in a different catalog record from D Type and ordinary Jegan releases.
kits.summary: The General Revil deployment type retains the recognizable Jegan silhouette but has an edition-specific equipment and color presentation.
kits.lore: The Jegan family served the Federation for years, with specialist versions appearing as military needs evolved. The Type-A2 is linked to the General Revil fleet seen in Gundam Unicorn, reflecting the ship's sizable and carefully equipped mobile-suit contingent.

kits.name: JESTA CANNON
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ジェスタ・キャノン
kits.notes: The Jesta Cannon's large shoulder-mounted weapons, increased armor mass and darker military palette distinguish it from the regular Jesta. The model's defining visual theme is the support-loadout silhouette rather than the slim baseline escort configuration.
kits.summary: The heavily armed fire-support version of the Federation's Jesta.
kits.lore: Jesta Cannon is a heavy support variant of the RGM-96X Jesta, a high-performance Federation machine developed to support the RX-0 Unicorn project. The Cannon equipment trades the standard Jesta's streamlined profile for additional armor and sustained supporting fire.

kits.name: ZETA PLUS C1
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This release represents the C1's long-nosed, space-combat identity rather than the atmospheric A1 type. Its sleek flying-machine lines are a defining feature of the design.
kits.summary: This release represents the C1's long-nosed, space-combat identity rather than the atmospheric A1 type.
kits.lore: The Zeta Plus C1 is a space-oriented version of the Zeta Plus transformable mobile suit featured in Gundam Sentinel. It adapts the Zeta Gundam legacy into a military aircraft-like variable-form design.

kits.name: EX-S GUNDAM
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The HG kit depicts the heavily equipped Ex-S with bulkier armor and extensive external structures. Its identity should stay separate from an ordinary S Gundam kit.
kits.summary: The HG kit depicts the heavily equipped Ex-S with bulkier armor and extensive external structures.
kits.lore: The Ex-S Gundam is an enhanced form of the S Gundam developed in Gundam Sentinel. Additional armor, propulsion systems and a powerful weapon configuration substantially change the original mobile suit's appearance.

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X2 KAI
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムX2改
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム

kits.name: OO GUNDAM SEVEN SWORD
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 ダブルオーガンダム セブンソード
kits.notes: The Seven Sword model is identified by multiple distinct blade silhouettes around the 00 Gundam frame. It remains separate from Seven Sword/G, which adds a different gun-sword configuration.
kits.summary: The Seven Sword model is identified by multiple distinct blade silhouettes around the 00 Gundam frame.
kits.lore: The 00 Gundam Seven Sword variation equips the twin-drive machine with a diverse suite of blade weapons. The concept emphasizes the 00 Gundam's close-quarters versatility beyond its standard equipment.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FRAME
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blue Frame retains the Astray family’s angular armor and visible frame styling but uses blue accents and a more military identity. Second L, D and other named upgrades differ dramatically in equipment and should not automatically inherit this base-profile entry. Compare the complete title when identifying the exact release.
kits.summary: Gai Murakumo’s mercenary-operated Astray prototype.
kits.lore: The MBF-P03 Gundam Astray Blue Frame belongs to the same Orb prototype family as the Red Frame but follows a different path in Gundam SEED Astray. It is strongly associated with mercenary pilot Gai Murakumo and his Serpent Tail group. Combat modifications emphasize professional battlefield practicality and mission-specific armament.

kits.name: PLE TWO’S QUBELEY Mk-II
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 キュベレイMk-II (プルツー専用機)
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II retains the striking shoulder binders and curved armored form of the original Qubeley. Color and edition information are vital: Elpeo Ple and Ple Two versions should be treated as distinct kit releases where appropriate. Do not apply the white original Qubeley’s artwork or markings to a Mk-II by default.
kits.summary: A successor Qubeley used by different Newtype pilots in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: Qubeley Mk-II machines are derived from the original Qubeley and appear in Gundam ZZ under different Newtype pilots, including Elpeo Ple and Ple Two. Although related to Haman Karn’s original mobile suit, each machine has its own colors and narrative role. Funnel-equipped all-range attacks remain the defining combat concept, placing the Mk-II within the wider Axis Newtype weapons program.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY GOLD FRAME
aliases: ＲＧ 1/144 ガンダムアストレイゴールドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The base machine has a recognizably standard Astray body outline with a gold-colored internal frame. It should not inherit the black armor, claws or specialized silhouette of the later Amatsu configurations just because they share its origin.
kits.summary: The original gold-frame prototype of the Astray family.
kits.lore: Astray Gold Frame is one of the prototype mobile suits created through Orb's Astray development program in the SEED Astray chronology. Its story follows its loss, recovery and later reconstruction, providing the starting point for several increasingly altered Gold Frame variants.

kits.name: M.P.T. HYAKUSHIKI-KAI
kits.notes: This design emphasizes the modified Hyaku-Shiki Kai profile and its mass-production designation. It should remain distinct from Quattro Bajeena's gold Hyaku-Shiki and the prototype Kai.
kits.summary: This design emphasizes the modified Hyaku-Shiki Kai profile and its mass-production designation.
kits.lore: The mass-production Hyaku-Shiki Kai imagines a more practical production-focused development of the upgraded Hyaku-Shiki concept. Its place is in the extended Anaheim Electronics design lineage rather than the original television unit roster.

kits.name: ZETAplus(UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ゼータプラス(ユニコーンＶｅｒ．)
kits.notes: The Unicorn-era Zeta Plus stands out through its aircraft-like surfaces, swept wings and angular head profile. The named color and equipment treatment should not be conflated with older Sentinel or other Zeta Plus variants.
kits.summary: The Unicorn-era Zeta Plus stands out through its aircraft-like surfaces, swept wings and angular head profile.
kits.lore: The Zeta Plus family reinterprets the Zeta Gundam concept as practical transformable equipment for Earth Federation-related forces. Gundam Unicorn presents an updated operational appearance of this line long after the Gryps Conflict.

kits.name: GUNDAM G-SELF (REFLECTOR PACK EQUIPPED)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムG-セルフ(リフレクターパック装備型)
ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM [FINAL BATTLE Ver.]
aliases: PG 1/60 RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM [FINAL BATTLE Ver.]
ＰＧ 1/60 ユニコーンガンダム(最終決戦Ｖｅｒ．)
kits.notes: This Final Battle Version distinguishes the late-story look from earlier red psycho-frame or Unicorn Mode depictions. Keep the edition-specific designation even when the basic RX-0 frame is shared.
kits.summary: This Final Battle Version distinguishes the late-story look from earlier red psycho-frame or Unicorn Mode depictions.
kits.lore: During the climax of Unicorn, the RX-0's psycho-frame becomes central to the story's spectacular Newtype events. The final-battle presentation is associated with the increasingly brilliant psycho-frame response.

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-Ⅱ
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムMk-II(ティターンズ)
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II has a recognizably squared-off chest, prominent head vulcan pod arrangement and understated backpack. Compare the AEUG and Titans colors carefully: editions can share a silhouette without representing the same faction. A kit’s exact release and grade determine how its movable-frame concept is interpreted; do not assume two similar Mk-II boxes contain identical assemblies.
kits.summary: The Gundam Mk-II is the pivotal Titans prototype later operated by the AEUG.
kits.lore: The RX-178 Gundam Mk-II begins its story as a Titans prototype in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Kamille Bidan becomes entangled in the conflict after encountering the machines at Green Noa, and captured units are subsequently used by the AEUG. Its movable-frame construction marks a major technological transition from early One Year War designs. AEUG white and Titans dark-blue versions represent the same basic machine under rival factions, though their colors and markings tell different parts of the story.

kits.name: GMII SEMI STRIKER
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジムII・セミストライカー
kits.notes: This Semi-Striker design combines an ordinary GM-family armored body with a more forceful close-quarters identity. It is visually different from a standard GM II and from the fully outfitted GM Striker, so a separate catalog record is important.
kits.summary: This Semi-Striker design combines an ordinary GM-family armored body with a more forceful close-quarters identity.
kits.lore: The GM II is an updated descendant of the original Federation GM. The Semi-Striker is a close-combat adaptation encountered in the Gundam Unicorn period, notable for bringing specialized melee equipment to an otherwise utilitarian mass-produced frame.

kits.name: ZAKU II ERIC MANTHFIELD’S CUSTOM
aliases: MG 1/100 ZAKU II ERIC MANTHFIELD’S CUSTOM
ＭＧ 1/100 エリック・マンスフィールド専用ザクII
kits.notes: This entry is specifically Eric Manthfield's Zaku II rather than a blank mass-production suit. Preserve the pilot label and unique markings when comparing it with other Zaku ace releases.
kits.summary: This entry is specifically Eric Manthfield's Zaku II rather than a blank mass-production suit.
kits.lore: Eric Manthfield is among the named Zeon aces represented in mobile-suit variation material. His customized Zaku II joins a larger family of personalized One Year War machines.

kits.name: CATHEDRAL GUNDAM
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 カテドラルガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Cathedral's dramatic angular armor and elevated, almost ceremonial outline make it stand apart from basic protagonist machines. The kit identity is tied to this particular Build Fighters customization and its extensive design language.
kits.summary: The Cathedral's dramatic angular armor and elevated, almost ceremonial outline make it stand apart from basic protagonist machines.
kits.lore: Cathedral Gundam belongs to the Gunpla Battle world of Gundam Build Fighters and its related stories. Its elaborate, imposing design treats a customized Gunpla as a competitive creation rather than an ordinary in-universe military unit.

kits.name: GUNDAM FENICE RINASCITA ALBA
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムフェニーチェリナーシタアルバ
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: This Alba-named Fenice Rinascita should remain separate from the regular green-dominant Rinascita and the original asymmetrical Fenice. The refined wing and body silhouette carries the same lineage through a new edition.
kits.summary: This Alba-named Fenice Rinascita should remain separate from the regular green-dominant Rinascita and the original asymmetrical Fenice.
kits.lore: Gundam Fenice Rinascita is the rebuilt successor to Ricardo Fellini's Wing Gundam Fenice in the Build Fighters world. The Alba variation gives this personal custom a distinct special presentation within the larger Fenice design family.

kits.name: GUNDAM AMAZING EXIA
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムアメイジングエクシア
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The blue-and-white customized Exia armor and enlarged GN blade equipment distinguish Amazing Exia from Setsuna's original Gundam 00 machine. It also differs from the later dark-matter-equipped version associated with a different battle context.
kits.summary: The third Meijin Kawaguchi's customized Amazing Exia.
kits.lore: Amazing Exia is an advanced customized Gundam Exia used by the third Meijin Kawaguchi in Gundam Build Fighters. It builds on Exia's close-combat identity with enhanced equipment crafted for high-level Gunpla Battle competition.

kits.name: ∀GUNDAM SHIN
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ターンエーガンダムシン
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: GILLA-SHIKI
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Gilla-Shiki's mixed design motifs make it interesting as a hybrid custom: the recognizable body language is transformed by altered armor and color decisions. This distinct Build Fighters release should not merge with its original inspiration.
kits.summary: The Gilla-Shiki's mixed design motifs make it interesting as a hybrid custom: the recognizable body language is transformed by altered armor and color decisions.
kits.lore: Gilla-Shiki is a customized Gunpla tied to Gundam Build Fighters side stories, borrowing the appearance of recognizable Universal Century mobile suit design families. Its purpose is Gunpla Battle expression rather than depiction of a canonical production military machine.

kits.name: BEARGGUY F [Family]
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ベアッガイF(ファミリー)
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: AMX-107 BAWOO (MASS PRODUCTION)
kits.notes: The release represents the mass-produced version of the angular, winged Bawoo machine. Do not merge it with either the original-colored Bawoo or other-scale interpretations in the database.
kits.summary: The release represents the mass-produced version of the angular, winged Bawoo machine.
kits.lore: The mass-production Bawoo adapts Neo Zeon's transformable Bawoo concept for broader deployment in Gundam ZZ. Its colors and role distinguish it from Glemy Toto's more individual presentation.

kits.name: MSA-009 RICK DIAS (RED)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 リックディアス（クワトロ・バジーナカラー）
kits.notes: The red Rick Dias highlights the suit's domed head, wide chest and short stout armor. The color designation separates the red machine from the darker early Quattro-associated appearance.
kits.summary: The red Rick Dias highlights the suit's domed head, wide chest and short stout armor.
kits.lore: The Rick Dias is a prominent AEUG mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics and deployed early in Zeta Gundam. Its Gundarium-alloy lineage and rounded frame anticipate the technical progression toward the Zeta project.

kits.name: ZAKUⅡ F TYPE LeSEAN & ZAKUⅡ (UNIDENTIFIED TYPE) LeSEAN (RFV)
aliases: HG 1/144 ZAKUⅡ F TYPE LeSEAN & ZAKUⅡ (UNIDENTIFIED TYPE) LeSEAN (RFV)

kits.name: PMX-003 THE-O
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The-O combines broad yellow armor, thick legs, large skirt sections and a surprisingly small head. Its hidden sub-arms are an important identity feature; check how a particular kit represents them. The machine’s bulk makes balance and support more relevant to display planning than its seemingly simple weapon silhouette suggests.
kits.summary: Paptimus Scirocco’s massive, highly responsive mobile suit from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The PMX-003 The-O is Paptimus Scirocco’s personal machine in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Designed around extreme responsiveness and close-quarters combat, it appears massive and heavily armored despite emphasizing control in the hands of its exceptionally capable pilot. Its hidden sub-arms create unexpected possibilities in melee combat. The-O takes a central role in the final battles of the Gryps Conflict.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Alex models can be identified by the white-and-blue Federation scheme and their variant armor treatment. Chobham armor changes the silhouette dramatically, but whether it is included depends on the exact release. The NT-1 should not be confused with the earlier RX-78-2 despite their common design lineage.
kits.summary: The RX-78NT-1 Alex tested at Side 6 in War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex is a Federation prototype created for Newtype-oriented operation during the One Year War. In War in the Pocket it is tested by Christina Mackenzie, and its development is central to the conflict around Side 6. Its distinctive appearance can be augmented by Chobham armor, contrasting the slim prototype with an armored protective configuration.
highlights: War in the Pocket story role

kits.lore: The G-Armor is a combined support configuration developed for the RX-78-2 Gundam, using the G-Fighter support craft to expand the Gundam's deployment and combat options. It belongs to the original show's experimentation with combined mecha.

kits.lore: The GN-X IV is a later-generation Earth Sphere Federation mobile suit appearing around the events of A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Its mass-production variant represents the evolution of GN-X equipment into a principal military platform.

kits.lore: The Destiny Impulse is a conceptual development of the Impulse Gundam platform within Gundam SEED Destiny side material. It merges features associated with the later Destiny Gundam and the modular Impulse family.

kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large combined Striker pack, heavy sword and long-range cannon are essential identifiers. A Perfect Strike product is not the same as an ordinary Strike Gundam kit, which may omit some or all of the additional equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: A heavily armed Strike Gundam configuration combining multiple Striker systems.
kits.lore: Perfect Strike Gundam is a configuration of the GAT-X105 Strike Gundam associated with the combination of the Aile, Sword and Launcher Striker systems in Gundam SEED. The Strike was originally intended to adapt to different missions by exchanging its equipment; the Perfect Strike combines their functions into a heavily armed form. Its silhouette is crowded with equipment compared with the standard Strike Gundam.
highlights: Combined Aile, Sword and Launcher equipment

kits.lore: The Zaku Minelayer reconfigures the ubiquitous Zeon Zaku platform for mine deployment rather than a typical rifle-and-axe frontline role. Its rear equipment gives it a distinctive operational silhouette.

kits.name: GN-X III (A-LAWS TYPE)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ジンクスIII (アロウズ型)
kits.notes: The A-Laws edition is distinguished by its red-toned armor, angular GN-X silhouette and large standard-use equipment. Its colors and service branch must stay separate from the Earth Sphere Federation's differently colored GN-X III variant.
kits.summary: The A-Laws variant of the GN-X III from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-X III is a later mass-production GN-powered machine appearing in Gundam 00's second season. Units assigned to the A-Laws reflect the organization's military power and the widespread adoption of pseudo-GN Drive technology beyond early Gundam prototypes.

kits.name: GM SNIPER CUSTOM
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジム・スナイパーカスタム
kits.notes: This standard GM Sniper Custom listing reflects the specialized sniper appearance. Named ace machines, including Tenneth A. Jung's version, remain separate retail entries.
kits.summary: This standard GM Sniper Custom listing reflects the specialized sniper appearance.
kits.lore: The GM Sniper Custom is an upgraded Federation GM designed for more specialized precision combat. Its modified sensor visor and weapon-oriented form distinguish it from the everyday RGM-79.

kits.name: REGELGU
kits.notes: The kit's dramatically extended shoulder structures identify it at a glance, despite its Gelgoog ancestry. It should not inherit descriptions or box assumptions from standard Gelgoog models.
kits.summary: The kit's dramatically extended shoulder structures identify it at a glance, despite its Gelgoog ancestry.
kits.lore: The Regelgu is a Neo Zeon modernization of the Gelgoog concept appearing in Gundam ZZ. Its conspicuous shoulders and updated equipment give the legacy design a distinctive silhouette.

kits.name: GUNDAM GROUND TYPE (PARACHUTE PACK)

aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 陸戦型ガンダム(パラシュート・パック仕様)
機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊

kits.name: ZETA GUNDAM[U.C.0088]
kits.notes: The U.C.0088 Zeta maintains the familiar angular head, wing-shaped structures and transformable silhouette. The date-qualified variant should be kept separate from earlier releases and special-effect color editions.
kits.summary: The U.C.0088 Zeta maintains the familiar angular head, wing-shaped structures and transformable silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeta Gundam was developed during the Gryps Conflict and remained influential into subsequent Universal Century campaigns. Its U.C.0088 designation identifies a particular later-period equipment or appearance treatment.

kits.name: GUNDAM AVALANCHE EXIA’
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムアヴァランチエクシアダッシュ
kits.notes: Avalanche Exia alters the clean original Exia silhouette with bulky propulsion equipment at the shoulders and lower body. This named kit is about that equipment configuration rather than an ordinary Exia armor finish.
kits.summary: Avalanche Exia alters the clean original Exia silhouette with bulky propulsion equipment at the shoulders and lower body.
kits.lore: Gundam Avalanche Exia is a mobility-focused equipment variant of Celestial Being's Gundam Exia, associated with Gundam 00 side stories. Additional thrust hardware gives the sword-centered Exia a distinctive high-speed assault profile.

kits.name: GN-X III (ESF COLORS)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ジンクスIII (連邦カラー)
kits.notes: The ESF model emphasizes its Federation color scheme and the recognizable GN-X III body, making its institutional identity a major feature. The distinction is an edition-level color and service difference, not a separate invented mobile-suit history.
kits.summary: The regular Earth Sphere Federation version of GN-X III.
kits.lore: This GN-X III represents machines used by the Earth Sphere Federation's regular forces in Gundam 00. It shares the improved GN-X III family but has a separate visual identity from the A-Laws' more aggressively colored units.

kits.summary: The Space Commander Type adds leadership-specific identity to the Tieren's characteristic tanklike form.
kits.lore: The Tieren is a heavy conventional mobile suit family used by the Human Reform League. The space command version is a specialized evolution of the utilitarian armored series.

kits.lore: The Leo serves OZ and other forces as a versatile ordinary mobile suit during Gundam Wing. Space use calls for equipment adapted to maneuvering away from the ground.

kits.lore: Neuen Bitter is a veteran Zeon commander in Stardust Memory who leads a remnant force in Africa. His modified Zaku II F2 ties an experienced officer to the continued ground fighting after defeat.

kits.summary: This base-specific Zaku II F2 release carries an operational-context identity.
kits.lore: The Zaku II F2 is a revised late One Year War variant that continues in use during Stardust Memory. The Kimberlite Base versions belong to Zeon remnants operating far from their original frontlines.

kits.summary: The slim inner Gundam concealed within Gundam Virtue.
kits.lore: Gundam Nadleeh is the slim, hidden inner mobile suit revealed beneath Tieria Erde's heavily armored Gundam Virtue in Gundam 00. Nadleeh carries the distinctive Trial System, establishing it as more than just an unarmored version of Virtue.

kits.summary: Treize’s personalized Tallgeese II from Gundam Wing.
kits.lore: Tallgeese II is Treize Khushrenada’s custom mobile suit introduced late in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. Derived from the formidable Tallgeese design, it becomes a visual emblem of Treize’s convictions and role in the final stages of the Earth–colony conflict.

kits.notes: This entry names Gabby Hazard rather than other celebrated R-2 pilots. The specialized leg thrusters and custom unit appearance are more relevant than generic Zaku equipment.
kits.summary: This entry names Gabby Hazard rather than other celebrated R-2 pilots.
kits.lore: Gabby Hazard is a Zeon ace represented by a personalized MS-06R-2 high-mobility Zaku. The R-2 variants are closely identified with space-combat performance in MSV material.

kits.summary: The golden third Unicorn-type mobile suit known as Phenex.
kits.lore: The Phenex is Unicorn Gundam Unit 03, an RX-0-series machine recognizable for its gold-colored exterior and birdlike Armed Armor DE equipment. Its story spans Gundam Unicorn-related material and Gundam Narrative, where the machine becomes closely tied to the mystery of Rita Bernal.

kits.summary: This is the Gouf prototype design, not the familiar production MS-07B flown by Ramba Ral.
kits.lore: The Prototype Gouf represents a design stage between Zaku-derived ground machines and the production Gouf. It belongs to the Ground-combat development branch of Zeon mobile suits.

kits.name: GN-X
kits.notes: GN-X models have a sharp angular head, prominent chest geometry and a highly recognizable X-like silhouette. GN-X II, III and IV types are later developments with distinct equipment and should not automatically inherit this base model's kit description.
kits.summary: The first mass-produced GN Drive Tau-powered adversary in Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-X is a GN Drive Tau-powered mass-production mobile suit introduced in Mobile Suit Gundam 00 as world military forces gain access to technology that can challenge Celestial Being. The design marks a major turning point: GN particle-powered combat is no longer the exclusive province of the Gundams. Pilots from the world's major powers use the type during the escalating conflict.

kits.summary: The extensively modified Astray Gold Frame Amatsu.
kits.lore: Gold Frame Amatsu is a drastically altered form of the Astray Gold Frame in the Gundam SEED Astray side stories. Its dark modified armor and specialized equipment reflect the machine's transformation from its original Orb-developed prototype identity.

kits.notes: Seven Sword/G's visual appeal is the dramatic spread of sword shapes around the compact 00 Gundam frame. The Inspection designation distinguishes this release from normal-color Seven Sword/G and standard 00 Gundam products.
kits.summary: Seven Sword/G's visual appeal is the dramatic spread of sword shapes around the compact 00 Gundam frame.
kits.lore: The 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G extends the 00 Gundam concept with multiple bladed weapons and an additional gun. The Inspection version is a specially presented interpretation of that equipment-intensive configuration rather than a separate mobile suit in the television story.

kits.summary: The edition specifies a North American Front variation of the cannon-equipped GM.
kits.lore: The GM Cannon belongs to the Federation's artillery-support GM family. The North American Front label situates this particular appearance within the wider One Year War theater of operations.

kits.notes: The Efreet Custom combines the broad, muscular Zeon design language with a distinctive blue scheme and blade-heavy melee presence. This kit is separate from later Efreet Schneid and ordinary Efreet releases.
kits.summary: The Efreet Custom combines the broad, muscular Zeon design language with a distinctive blue scheme and blade-heavy melee presence.
kits.lore: The Efreet Custom is an enhanced Zeon close-combat mobile suit featured in The Blue Destiny storyline. Its EXAM System creates a dangerous performance advantage and ties it to the series' experimental combat technology.

kits.summary: The fully armed version of Setsuna's 00 Qan[T].
kits.lore: The 00 Qan[T] Full Saber is an equipment variation of Setsuna's movie-era machine, expanding its weapon systems beyond the normal 00 Qan[T]. The configuration preserves the Quantum-era design's central identity while presenting a much more weapon-heavy silhouette.

kits.notes: This Ver.Ka edition portrays the upgraded ZZ proportions and enhanced external structure. Its full title matters: it is distinct from normal ZZ Ver.Ka and the separate Full Armor versions.
kits.summary: This Ver.Ka edition portrays the upgraded ZZ proportions and enhanced external structure.
kits.lore: The Enhanced ZZ Gundam is a strengthened configuration of Judau Ashta's ZZ Gundam, increasing the machine's already formidable presence in the Gundam ZZ lineage. The base ZZ retains its transformation and immense firepower as story hallmarks.

kits.lore: The 00 Gundam is Celestial Being's twin-drive successor to Exia, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Its paired GN Drives become central to the second season's escalating conflicts.

kits.summary: This variant builds on the GN-X's unconventional face and chest language with a stronger developmental-unit identity.
kits.lore: The Advanced GN-X is a development of the GN-X mobile-suit family in Gundam 00 side material. Its design demonstrates how GN technology moved into successive experiments and specialized combat machines beyond Celestial Being.

kits.summary: The Unicorn Version carries a later-era presentation of the GM II, which is cataloged separately from Desert Color or Zeta-era releases.
kits.lore: The GM II is a mass-production Federation suit developed from the original GM. Its continued presence in Unicorn reflects the long service life of the Federation's older mobile-suit designs.

kits.summary: This entry features the R-1 variant associated with Breniss Ox, not a standard F-type Zaku.
kits.lore: Breniss Ox is an experienced Zeon pilot represented in MSV ace-machine lineups. His MS-06R-1 high-mobility Zaku reflects the specialized space fighter branch of the Zaku family.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Cherudim’s long-range focus, large shield-bit equipment and angular body distinguish it from Dynames. GNHW/R and SAGA versions represent different equipment choices, so they must not be merged with the basic Cherudim. Compare their actual armament layouts before selecting the kit entry.
kits.summary: The Gundam 00 second-season successor to Dynames.
kits.lore: Cherudim Gundam is Celestial Being’s later long-range machine in the second season of Gundam 00, piloted by Lockon Stratos’s successor. It develops the sniper concept associated with Dynames while introducing new defensive and remote equipment. The design reflects the organization’s changing technology and the demands of fighting powerful new enemies.

kits.summary: The EW Custom is cataloged independently of the original Sandrock and its separate Armadillo Unit edition.
kits.lore: Quatre's upgraded Sandrock features in the Endless Waltz stage of Gundam Wing, carrying his defensive-minded and close-combat fighting style into the final conflict.

kits.summary: Rollout Unit 1 is a particular early Guncannon configuration.
kits.lore: The Origin portrays early Federation Guncannon development before the fully realized RX-series units of the One Year War. The First Type is part of that revised technological history.

kits.lore: GN-007 Arios Gundam is one of Celestial Being’s machines in the second season of Mobile Suit Gundam 00. The machine continues the role established by Kyrios while bringing a different air-combat-oriented design to Celestial Being’s revived operations.

Seravee also carries a major surprise connected with its companion Gundam Seraphim, tying the design to Celestial Being’s unusual tactical systems.

kits.lore: Hyaku-Shiki Kai is an updated development of Anaheim Electronics' Hyaku-Shiki family, explored outside the core Zeta Gundam lineup. Its revised head and armor differentiate it from the gold original.

kits.name: STAR BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM (RG SYSTEM Ver.)
aliases: MG 1/100 STAR BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM (RG SYSTEM Ver.)
