ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The RG System edition puts special emphasis on the visual appearance of Star Build Strike during this power-up state. Its core design is still the advanced Build Strike, but color and finish choices differ among product versions. Confirm any translucent pieces or effect accessories against the exact release.
kits.summary: Star Build Strike portrayed in its RG System state.
kits.lore: Star Build Strike Gundam is Sei Iori and Reiji's advanced custom Gunpla from Gundam Build Fighters. The RG System represents an important development in how Sei channels energy through his model's internal structure. This version highlights the spectacular visible effects associated with that system during key tournament battles.

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X2
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムX2
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム

kits.name: R-GYAGYA
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Its purple armor, large round shoulder-shield equipment and knightlike silhouette separate R-Gyagya from a standard R-Jarja or Gyan. The custom appearance is central to its Build Fighters Try identity.
kits.summary: Kaoruko Sazaki's distinctive purple R-Gyagya Gunpla.
kits.lore: R-Gyagya is a customized Gunpla operated by Kaoruko Sazaki in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Inspired by the R-Jarja and the Gyan family, it adopts a flamboyant defensive and close-combat identity consistent with its builder's style.

kits.name: AEU ENACT Demonstration Color
aliases: HG 1/144 AEUイナクト（デモカラー）
kits.notes: This Demonstration Color edition depicts the Enact's promotional or rollout-style appearance, with its slim aircraft-inspired frame and visible transformation architecture. It should not be confused with Ali al-Saachez's customized Enacts.
kits.summary: The AEU Enact in its public demonstration color scheme.
kits.lore: The AEU Enact is a transformable conventional mobile suit introduced as a rival to other world powers' next-generation machines in early Gundam 00. Its highly publicized demonstration is interrupted by Celestial Being, setting up a telling confrontation between ordinary weapons and a Gundam.

kits.name: BLAST IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ブラストインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Blast edition emphasizes the broad cannon and heavy-firepower equipment rather than Force Impulse's flight focus or Sword Impulse's melee role. The specific grade remains tracked separately.
kits.summary: The Blast edition emphasizes the broad cannon and heavy-firepower equipment rather than Force Impulse's flight focus or Sword Impulse's melee role.
kits.lore: The Impulse Gundam uses interchangeable Silhouette equipment, and its Blast Silhouette focuses on artillery and heavy ranged attacks. Shinn Asuka pilots the modular machine during SEED Destiny.

kits.name: POWERED GM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: Distinctive reinforced legs and a powerful backpack make the Powered GM look more robust than an ordinary GM Type C. Its test-machine character is central to this model's identity.
kits.summary: Distinctive reinforced legs and a powerful backpack make the Powered GM look more robust than an ordinary GM Type C.
kits.lore: The Powered GM is an Earth Federation prototype and test machine that appears during the early Gundam 0083 story. Its design incorporates updated movement systems as Federation engineers explore performance improvements.

aliases: MG 1/100 FREEDOM GUNDAM Ver.2.0 FULL BURST MODE SPECIAL COATING Ver.

機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: ν GUNDAM HWS Ver.Ka
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 νガンダム HWS Ｖｅｒ．Ka
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: This Ver.Ka HWS version emphasizes additional chest, waist and weapon bulk while keeping the Nu's recognizable asymmetrical funnel silhouette. It should be listed apart from a conventional Ver.Ka Nu.
kits.summary: This Ver.Ka HWS version emphasizes additional chest, waist and weapon bulk while keeping the Nu's recognizable asymmetrical funnel silhouette.
kits.lore: The Nu Gundam is Amuro Ray's psycho-frame-equipped machine in Char's Counterattack. The HWS interpretation applies a heavy-weapon-system concept, turning the relatively clean original design into a more heavily armored configuration.

kits.name: GN ARMS TYPE-D + GUNDAM DYNAMES

kits.notes: This named pairing emphasizes the contrast between the sleek sniper Gundam and the massive GN Arms carrier. It belongs to the Dynames Type-D release identity, not the Exia Type-E combination.
kits.summary: This named pairing emphasizes the contrast between the sleek sniper Gundam and the massive GN Arms carrier.
kits.lore: The GN Arms Type-D supports the long-range Gundam Dynames of Celestial Being, complementing Lockon Stratos's sniper-focused role with a large support platform. Its equipment is tailored to a different tactical approach than Exia's GN Arms Type-E.

kits.name: GUNDAM HEAVYARMS CUSTOM EW
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムヘビーアームズ改 EW
kits.notes: This MG EW release emphasizes the distinct revised design associated with Endless Waltz, not the television Heavyarms Custom or the Igel Unit edition. The multiple ranged weapon housings define its look.
kits.summary: This MG EW release emphasizes the distinct revised design associated with Endless Waltz, not the television Heavyarms Custom or the Igel Unit edition.
kits.lore: The Endless Waltz version of Heavyarms Custom is the final-style heavy-firepower mobile suit associated with Trowa Barton. Its dense missile and gun layout makes it particularly recognizable.

aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 インパルスガンダムブランシュ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

aliases: MG 1/100 PERFECT STRIKE GUNDAM SPECIAL COATING Ver.

機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: SWORD IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ソードインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Sword Silhouette gives the Impulse an unmistakable close-combat look through its large blades and related red equipment. This kit should remain distinct from Force Impulse releases: the central mobile suit shares a design lineage, but the backpack and posing priorities differ greatly.
kits.summary: The close-combat Sword Silhouette version of the Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: Sword Impulse is a melee-focused configuration of the ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. With the Sword Silhouette fitted, the machine changes from flexible ranged movement to aggressive close combat. Shinn Asuka uses the Impulse's different loadouts to respond to the demands of the battlefield, underscoring ZAFT's modular approach.

kits.name: O RAISER
kits.notes: This product represents the stand-alone O Raiser support craft rather than a full Gundam. Its compact winged craft shape and docking purpose are its identifying design features.
kits.summary: This product represents the stand-alone O Raiser support craft rather than a full Gundam.
kits.lore: The O Raiser is a Celestial Being support aircraft designed to synchronize with 00 Gundam's Twin Drive System. When docked, it creates the much more powerful 00 Raiser.

kits.name: GADESSA
kits.notes: Gadessa's heavy long-range cannon, unusual central body and specialized GN machinery distinguish it from related units such as Garazzo and Gaddess. The kit identity centers on this artillery-oriented silhouette rather than a generic Innovade suit.
kits.summary: A powerful long-range Innovade mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The Gadessa is an Innovade-operated mobile suit fielded against Celestial Being in Gundam 00's second season. Designed around a specialized long-range attack role, it belongs to the advanced machine family used by Ribbons Almark's side of the conflict.

kits.name: BUSHIDO'S AHEAD
aliases: HG 1/144 ミスター・ブシドー専用アヘッド
kits.notes: Bushido's Ahead has a samurai-influenced personality compared with the plain A-Laws version, especially in its head and combat styling. It is a named custom machine, not simply an ordinary Ahead painted differently.
kits.summary: Bushido's Ahead has a samurai-influenced personality compared with the plain A-Laws version, especially in its head and combat styling.
kits.lore: The Ahead is an A-Laws mobile suit developed as an advanced successor to earlier Federation GN-powered machines. Mister Bushido's personal configuration reflects his obsession with facing Setsuna F. Seiei in close combat.

aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The kit features the early Bugu's distinct torso, head and armor arrangement. This listing is the non-pilot-specified Bugu, not the separately named Ramba Ral presentation.
kits.summary: The kit features the early Bugu's distinct torso, head and armor arrangement.
kits.lore: The Bugu is an early Zeon mobile suit depicted in Gundam The Origin, bridging mobile-worker experimentation and the mass-production Zaku generation. Its historical role in that continuity is more important than treating it as a standard grunt Zaku.

kits.name: AHEAD SMULTRON
aliases: HG 1/144 アヘッドスマルトロン
kits.notes: Smultron is distinguishable from an ordinary Ahead by its heavier specialty-weapon identity and altered silhouette. This entry tracks Louise's named configuration rather than merging it with other Ahead models.
kits.summary: Smultron is distinguishable from an ordinary Ahead by its heavier specialty-weapon identity and altered silhouette.
kits.lore: The Ahead Smultron is a specially adapted Ahead used by Louise Halevy during the A-Laws conflict in Gundam 00. It is part of the organization's more experimental and specialized GN-powered mobile suit development.

kits.name: LYDO WOLF'S GM SNIPER II

kits.summary: This release names Lydo Wolf directly and should be retained apart from an unmarked GM Sniper II kit.
kits.lore: Lydo Wolf is a Federation ace whose personal mobile suits feature in One Year War variation material. His GM Sniper II places a distinctive pilot identity on a late-war sniper-oriented Federation design.

kits.summary: The Unicorn Version highlights the veteran Gelgoog in a later-era context.
kits.lore: The Gelgoog is Zeon's advanced late-war mass-production mobile suit. By Unicorn, older Gelgoog designs can still appear among the scattered forces and surviving equipment of the Universal Century.

kits.summary: The XN Raiser silhouette is defined by its supplementary structure and additional weapon-bearing surfaces around the 00 Gundam.
kits.lore: XN Raiser develops the 0 Raiser support concept with additional equipment in Gundam 00 side material. When combined with the 00 Gundam, it creates an alternate heavily equipped configuration of the well-known Twin Drive machine.

kits.name: DEBORAH’S ADVANCED GN-X
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 アドヴァンスドジンクス(デボラ機)
kits.notes: This named Advanced GN-X uses the family resemblance of its angular head and GN-powered limbs while preserving Deborah's specific variant identity. It is a separate release from standard GN-X or other Advanced GN-X kits.
kits.summary: This named Advanced GN-X uses the family resemblance of its angular head and GN-powered limbs while preserving Deborah's specific variant identity.
kits.lore: Advanced GN-X variants refine the GN-X family created from GN technology made available beyond Celestial Being. Deborah's named machine belongs to the broader Gundam 00 side-story and derivative design space rather than the main Gundam team's lineup.

kits.summary: This Unicorn Version specifies the Type B Zaku II FZ head and its later-color interpretation.
kits.lore: The Zaku II FZ is a late One Year War variant with a redesigned body and helmet. Type B head styling is a recognizable alternative within the FZ family, which continues to appear in later Universal Century material.

kits.summary: The RE/100 Mass Production Type preserves the angular airframe while specifically representing the rank-and-file variant.
kits.lore: The Bawoo entered Neo Zeon's Gundam ZZ arsenal as a transformable machine capable of separating into two flight units. Mass-production versions reflect its evolution beyond the most prominent commander example.

kits.notes: The Type A.C.D. title indicates a specific version of the 0 Gundam. Preserve the designation rather than replacing it with other available 0 Gundam editions.
kits.summary: The Type A.C.D.
kits.lore: The 0 Gundam is an early Celestial Being test machine whose appearance inspires Setsuna's later sense of what a Gundam represents. Its simple shape has a deliberate connection to classic Gundam styling.

kits.notes: Arche's very long arms and legs, crimson armor and clawlike melee posture create an unmistakable silhouette. It should not be cataloged as a Gundam Throne even though it draws on that development lineage.
kits.summary: Ali al-Saachez's sinister red Arche Gundam.
kits.lore: Arche Gundam is the distinctive red mobile suit operated by Ali al-Saachez during Gundam 00's second season. Its grotesquely stretched limbs and melee weapons echo the threat posed by its ruthless pilot, while the design is related to earlier Throne-family technology.

kits.name: ARIOS GUNDAM GNHW/M
aliases: HG 1/144 アリオスガンダム GNHW/M
kits.notes: The GNHW/M edition focuses on Arios with its additional missile-oriented heavy-weapon equipment. It differs from the base Arios and stand-alone Trans-Am color releases.
kits.summary: The GNHW/M edition focuses on Arios with its additional missile-oriented heavy-weapon equipment.
kits.lore: Arios Gundam is Allelujah Haptism's transformable Celestial Being machine in the second season. Its GN Heavy Weapon expansion adds equipment for the large-scale final conflicts.

kits.name: WING GUNDAM ZERO HONOO
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ウイングガンダムゼロ炎
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Honoo's fiery color treatment and exaggerated wing/body motifs create a strong break from the television Wing Zero. This special Build Fighters version deserves its own searchable identity and visual notes.
kits.summary: The Honoo's fiery color treatment and exaggerated wing/body motifs create a strong break from the television Wing Zero.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam Zero Honoo is a Gunpla Battle customization inspired by Wing Gundam Zero, featured in Gundam Build Fighters side material. Its vivid flame-themed appearance transforms a familiar transformable Gundam into a builder's personal signature.

kits.name: SERAVEE GUNDAM GNHW/B
aliases: HG 1/144 セラヴィーガンダム GNHW/B
kits.notes: The GNHW/B variant is the upgraded Seravee loadout rather than the ordinary Seravee or separate Seraphim machine. Its heavy fire-support silhouette is the distinguishing feature.
kits.summary: The GNHW/B variant is the upgraded Seravee loadout rather than the ordinary Seravee or separate Seraphim machine.
kits.lore: Seravee Gundam is Tieria Erde's heavily armored artillery machine of the second season. GN Heavy Weapons equipment expands the suit's already formidable beam firepower.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (FINAL BATTLE Ver.) [SPECIAL COATING]
aliases: RG 1/144 UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (FINAL BATTLE Ver.) [SPECIAL COATING]
ＲＧ 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム２号機 バンシィ・ノルン (最終決戦仕様) [スペシャルコーティング]

kits.name: GUNDAM ZABANYA (FINAL BATTLE Ver.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムサバーニャ（最終決戦仕様）
kits.notes: The Final Battle Version emphasizes Zabanya's expanded remote-weapon presentation. It is distinct from the earlier basic Zabanya release and the first-season Dynames.
kits.summary: The Final Battle Version emphasizes Zabanya's expanded remote-weapon presentation.
kits.lore: Gundam Zabanya is Lockon Stratos's movie-era ranged-combat machine with numerous GN rifle bits and shield bits. Its final battle in A Wakening of the Trailblazer shows the full range of its fire support.

kits.name: D GUNDAM FIRST
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 Ｄガンダムファースト

kits.name: REBORNS GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 リボーンズガンダム
kits.notes: The machine's red-and-white armor, unusual back structure and dual Gundam/Cannon-type identity make it visually distinct. An individual kit's transformation implementation must be checked against its edition rather than assumed from the anime.
kits.summary: The transformable flagship machine of Ribbons Almark.
kits.lore: Reborns Gundam is the highly advanced mobile suit used by Ribbons Almark in the finale of Gundam 00. It combines multiple combat functions through a transformation concept, reflecting the pilot's determination to surpass Celestial Being's latest Gundams.

kits.name: DESULTOR
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女

kits.name: EXIA TRANSAM MODE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムエクシア（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: This release depicts Exia using a Trans-Am-inspired special color treatment. It is not a distinct Gundam prototype and should remain separate from standard Exia and later Repair editions.
kits.summary: This release depicts Exia using a Trans-Am-inspired special color treatment.
kits.lore: Exia is Celestial Being's close-combat GN Gundam piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. The Trans-Am System temporarily boosts GN-powered machine performance, changing the visual character of its deployment.

kits.name: DYNAMES TRANSAM MODE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムデュナメス（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Mode product is a color-specific Dynames edition. Its special treatment should not be merged with the base green Dynames or a differently named custom weapon set.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Mode product is a color-specific Dynames edition.
kits.lore: Dynames is Lockon Stratos's long-distance Gundam, equipped for accurate shooting and sensor-aided target acquisition. Trans-Am alters the performance and presentation of its GN system.

kits.name: PSYCHO GUNDAM Mk-II
aliases: HG 1/144 サイコ・ガンダムMk-II
kits.notes: The Mk-II's imposing height, segmented armor and intimidating black-toned design dwarf conventional mobile suits. This is a different machine from the first Psycho Gundam, not just an alternate-color build.
kits.summary: The Mk-II's imposing height, segmented armor and intimidating black-toned design dwarf conventional mobile suits.
kits.lore: The Psycho Gundam Mk-II is a massive Newtype-use mobile weapon that builds on the Murasame Institute's colossal Psycho Gundam line. Its role in the late Gryps and subsequent conflicts reflects the dangers of military Newtype research.

kits.name: KYRIOS TRANSAM MODE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムキュリオス（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: This release showcases Kyrios in a Trans-Am-inspired presentation, preserving the transformable design's distinct identity. It is different from the ordinary Kyrios color edition.
kits.summary: This release showcases Kyrios in a Trans-Am-inspired presentation, preserving the transformable design's distinct identity.
kits.lore: Kyrios is Allelujah Haptism's transformable Gundam from the original Celestial Being team. Its high-speed flight form and GN technology underpin its mobility-focused combat style.

kits.name: VIRTUE TRANSAM MODE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムヴァーチェ（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Mode Virtue release centers on the heavy armored form in a special colorway. It must not be confused with separate Nadleeh releases despite their relationship.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Mode Virtue release centers on the heavy armored form in a special colorway.
kits.lore: Virtue is Tieria Erde's heavily armored Celestial Being Gundam, built around overwhelming GN beam firepower. Beneath its armor is the slim Nadleeh with a different tactical role.

kits.name: SERAPHIM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 セラフィムガンダム
kits.notes: Seraphim has a relatively compact body and a design intended to complement Seravee rather than appear as an ordinary independent Gundam. Some releases package the machines together while others differ, so included connections and separation features are specific to the kit.
kits.summary: The concealed companion mobile suit of Seravee Gundam.
kits.lore: The GN-009 Seraphim Gundam is a smaller mobile suit concealed as part of Tieria Erde's Seravee Gundam in the second season of Gundam 00. The unusual arrangement allows Seravee to hide another active Gundam within its own structure. This dual-machine idea underscores Celestial Being's inventive and sometimes deceptive engineering strategy.

kits.name: GN-X III ESF TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144 ジンクスIII（連邦軍型）
kits.notes: The ESF Type identifies the Federation's particular version of GN-X III. Keep this listing distinct from the A-Laws machine and generic GN-X III entries despite similar hardware.
kits.summary: The ESF Type identifies the Federation's particular version of GN-X III.
kits.lore: GN-X III becomes one of the standard machines of the Earth Sphere Federation, reflecting the spread of GN-derived technology to conventional armies.

kits.name: SERGEI'S TIEREN TAOZI
aliases: HG 1/144 セルゲイ専用ティエレンタオツー
kits.notes: This named Sergei Tieren Taozi differentiates a personalized deployment from the better-known pink Taozi used by Soma Peries. The variant title is critical for accurate cataloging.
kits.summary: This named Sergei Tieren Taozi differentiates a personalized deployment from the better-known pink Taozi used by Soma Peries.
kits.lore: Sergei Smirnov is a skilled Human Reform League officer associated with Tieren machines. The Taozi is a specialized high-mobility development originally linked with enhanced-pilot operation.

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA REPAIR II
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムエクシア リペアII
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This is specifically the Repair II configuration. Look for the updated limbs, revised outer armor and differences in sword equipment compared with the base Exia. The name is important because ordinary Exia, Exia Repair and Repair II are separate designs.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The rebuilt form of Setsuna’s Exia from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: Gundam Exia Repair II is a rebuilt form of Setsuna F. Seiei’s GN-001 from Gundam 00, returning to service after the original machine sustained heavy damage. Its revised appearance represents technological and narrative continuity between Celestial Being’s earlier interventions and the later conflict. The machine retains Exia’s close-combat identity while displaying a cleaner, modified configuration distinct from the heavily damaged Exia Repair.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 FULL GRANSA
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-1 フルグランサ

kits.name: GUNDAM AMAZING RED WARRIOR
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムアメイジングレッドウォーリア
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The all-red armor, simple Gundam face and numerous weapon-mounting details form its signature. The Build Fighters Try interpretation should remain separate from the original Plamo-Kyoshiro Red Warrior source design.
kits.summary: Meijin Kawaguchi's Amazing Red Warrior from Gundam Build Fighters Try.
kits.lore: Amazing Red Warrior is a customized Gunpla used by Meijin Kawaguchi in Gundam Build Fighters Try. It reinterprets the classic Perfect Gundam III Red Warrior motif as a high-performance tournament machine with extensive selectable armament.

kits.name: SUSANOWO
kits.notes: Its black-and-red angular armor, long blade equipment and unusual horned silhouette emphasize a samurai-like approach to mobile suit combat. Susanowo is separate from the earlier Masurao and should retain its own catalog entry.
kits.summary: The sword-oriented Susanowo flown by Mr. Bushido.
kits.lore: Susanowo is an advanced melee-focused mobile suit piloted by Mr. Bushido during Gundam 00's second season. It follows the experimental Masurao design, keeping his obsession with high-speed blade combat at the center of the machine's role.

kits.name: GUNDAM AERIAL
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: MGSD ガンダムエアリアル
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Aerial’s design contrasts relatively smooth white armor with translucent-looking shell-unit details and multiple GUND-BIT components. Check the release name carefully: the original Aerial and Aerial Rebuild have different silhouettes and equipment. The standard HG, Full Mechanics and MGSD releases offer distinct interpretations of the same core machine.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
MGSD combines super-deformed proportions with relatively ambitious detail and engineering. It is not assigned a conventional numerical scale.
kits.summary: Suletta Mercury’s GUND-ARM mobile suit from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series. Its battles are tied not only to school duels but also to questions of corporate control, medical technology and the costs of treating people as components of military systems.

kits.name: GADDESS
kits.notes: Gadess has an elegant, elongated silhouette and a specialized weapon profile that sets it apart from the similar-sounding Gadessa. The model's kit identity should preserve that exact name and its unique Innovade-era styling.
kits.summary: Gadess has an elegant, elongated silhouette and a specialized weapon profile that sets it apart from the similar-sounding Gadessa.
kits.lore: The Gadess is an Innovade-operated GN-powered mobile suit seen in the second season of Gundam 00. Anew Returner pilots this refined machine, whose combat design favors remote attacks and a different approach from the melee-focused 00 Gundam.

kits.name: Hiling Care's GARAZZO
aliases: HG 1/144 ヒリング・ケア専用ガラッゾ
kits.notes: The Garazzo design has broad arms, a compact upper frame and aggressive close-range styling. Hiling Care's edition needs its own catalog identity rather than being grouped with generic Garazzo or Gadessa products.
kits.summary: The Garazzo design has broad arms, a compact upper frame and aggressive close-range styling.
kits.lore: The Garazzo is a close-combat Innovade mobile suit in Gundam 00, using powerful GN-based defenses and attacks. Hiling Care's named machine is distinguished from other Garazzo deployments by its pilot-specific association and presentation.

kits.name: O GUNDAM
kits.notes: A comparatively simple white-and-primary-color Gundam silhouette and large circular GN Drive arrangement make the 0 Gundam distinctive among 00 machines. Later color and equipment versions should remain cataloged separately.
kits.summary: The pioneering 0 Gundam that influenced Setsuna F. Seiei.
kits.lore: The 0 Gundam is an early Celestial Being Gundam whose appearance has profound significance for Setsuna F. Seiei in Gundam 00. Its design deliberately recalls the classic RX-78-style Gundam while establishing the beginning of the series' GN-powered mobile-suit lineage.

kits.name: RX-78F00/E GUNDAM
aliases: EXPO2025 ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78F00/E ガンダム

kits.name: OO RAISER+GN SWORD III
aliases: HG 1/144 ダブルオーライザー＋GNソードIII
kits.notes: This named combination focuses on both the 00 Raiser configuration and its GN Sword III, making it visibly distinct from the earlier 00 Gundam arrangement. It is an equipment-specific catalog entry rather than a generic 00 Gundam record.
kits.summary: This named combination focuses on both the 00 Raiser configuration and its GN Sword III, making it visibly distinct from the earlier 00 Gundam arrangement.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser fuses 00 Gundam with the support craft 0 Raiser to stabilize its Twin Drive System. The GN Sword III later becomes a distinctive part of the 00 Raiser's combat silhouette during the escalation of the Innovator conflict.

kits.name: MASURAO
kits.notes: The Masurao's long shoulder and limb shapes, sharp crest and strongly samurai-influenced frame set it apart from mass-produced A-Laws suits. It is also distinct from its later Susanowo development.
kits.summary: The Masurao's long shoulder and limb shapes, sharp crest and strongly samurai-influenced frame set it apart from mass-produced A-Laws suits.
kits.lore: Masurao is the custom GN-powered machine developed for Mister Bushido during the second season of Gundam 00. Its highly stylized swordfighter identity mirrors the pilot's commitment to an honorable duel with Setsuna's Gundam.

kits.name: OO GUNDAM SEVEN SWORD/G
aliases: HG 1/144 ダブルオーガンダム セブンソード/G
kits.notes: This model is specifically the Seven Sword/G form, not the Seven Sword without /G, and not the O Raiser pairing. The weapon-oriented silhouette is the principal difference.
kits.summary: This model is specifically the Seven Sword/G form, not the Seven Sword without /G, and not the O Raiser pairing.
kits.lore: The 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G builds on Setsuna's Twin Drive Gundam with an array of melee weapons and a gun-capable sword. The configuration expands on the earlier Seven Sword concept.

kits.name: ARIOS GUNDAM (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 アリオスガンダム（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションVer.
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Mode Arios release uses a special system-inspired palette, separate from the standard orange color or GNHW/M add-on equipment.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Mode Arios release uses a special system-inspired palette, separate from the standard orange color or GNHW/M add-on equipment.
kits.lore: Arios is the transformable second-generation machine piloted by Allelujah in Gundam 00 season two. Its high-speed design is well suited to hit-and-run tactics and atmospheric or space operations.

kits.name: SUGAI'S GELGOOG（GQ)
aliases: HG 1/144 ゲルググ スガイ機(GQ)

kits.name: SERAVEE GUNDAM & SERAPHIM GUNDAM (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 SERAVEE GUNDAM & SERAPHIM GUNDAM (TRANS-AM MODE)
HG 1/144 セラヴィーガンダム＆セラフィムガンダム（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションVer.
kits.notes: This paired Trans-Am Mode listing explicitly covers both Seravee and Seraphim presentations. It differs from a stand-alone heavy-weapon Seravee or normal-color counterpart.
kits.summary: This paired Trans-Am Mode listing explicitly covers both Seravee and Seraphim presentations.
kits.lore: Seravee is Tieria's heavy GN artillery suit and conceals the smaller Seraphim Gundam within its rear configuration. The paired machines combine heavy firepower with a concealed tactical reserve.

kits.name: REBORNS GUNDAM (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 リボーンズガンダム（トランザムモード）グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: This product gives Reborns Gundam a Trans-Am-inspired finish. It remains the same named unit rather than a new version of Celestial Being's 00 Gundam.
kits.summary: This product gives Reborns Gundam a Trans-Am-inspired finish.
kits.lore: Reborns Gundam is the advanced machine piloted by Ribbons Almark, built for versatile combat with multiple configurations. Its performance reflects the Innovade faction's grasp of GN systems.

kits.name: HI-MOCK
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Hi-Mock is recognizable for rounded, practical surfaces and a less ornate silhouette than many named Gundams. Its simple structure makes it visually suitable for squad displays and customization, without assuming included optional equipment.
kits.summary: Hi-Mock is recognizable for rounded, practical surfaces and a less ornate silhouette than many named Gundams.
kits.lore: The Hi-Mock is a simplified Gunpla Battle machine appearing in Gundam Build Fighters-related releases. Its deliberately straightforward build concept echoes the way hobbyists use basic designs to experiment with custom colors and battlefield roles.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAEA TYPE-F
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアストレア タイプ-F
kits.notes: The Type F's scarlet armor, Gundam-style head and 00-generation weapon design separate it from standard white Astraea. Multiple Type F equipment editions exist, so a basic profile should not claim the Full Weapon Set is included in every release.
kits.summary: The red Astraea Type F from Gundam 00's side stories.
kits.lore: Gundam Astraea Type F is a distinctive red variant of the original Astraea from the Gundam 00 side-story chronology, associated with the covert organization Fereshte. The design emphasizes the overlap between early Celestial Being technology and later secret missions.

kits.name: OO RAISER GN CONDENSER TYPE
aliases: HG 1/144 OO RAISER GN CONDENSER TYPE
HG 1/144 ダブルオーライザー（粒子貯蔵タンク型）
kits.notes: The GN Condenser Type must remain distinct from the normal 00 Raiser and from Trans-Am-colored releases. Its changed equipment concept is part of the named product identity.
kits.summary: The GN Condenser Type must remain distinct from the normal 00 Raiser and from Trans-Am-colored releases.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser merges the 00 Gundam with the support O Raiser. The GN Condenser Type describes an alternate arrangement replacing parts of its characteristic drive equipment.

kits.name: OO QAN[T]
aliases: HG 1/144 ダブルオークアンタ
kits.notes: Its asymmetrical shoulder shield, blue-and-white frame and integrated GN Sword Bits define the movie design. A basic 00 Qan[T] should not be conflated with the additional armaments of the Full Saber variant.
kits.summary: Setsuna's advanced 00 Qan[T] from A Wakening of the Trailblazer.
kits.lore: The 00 Qan[T] is Setsuna F. Seiei's advanced Gundam from the film A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Designed to facilitate communication and understanding with the ELS, it incorporates the Quantum System and a specialized GN Sword and bit arrangement.

kits.name: GUNDAM HARUTE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムハルート
kits.notes: Harute has an angular orange-and-white body, broad aerodynamic equipment and a recognizable transformation concept. Final Battle and other special editions may introduce substantial equipment differences. Avoid listing those as standard accessories for the base machine.
kits.summary: Allelujah and Marie’s transforming Gundam from the Gundam 00 film.
kits.lore: The GN-011 Gundam Harute appears in Mobile Suit Gundam 00: A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Piloted by Allelujah Haptism and Marie Parfacy, it is a fast transformable Gundam designed for complex combat in both mobile suit and flight configurations. Its contribution to the film's conflict is connected to Celestial Being's efforts to confront an unprecedented threat.

kits.name: MSN-04 II NIGHTINGALE
aliases: RE/100 1/100 MSN-04Ⅱ　ナイチンゲール
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: Nightingale's very wide shoulder binders, long rear skirt and low massive silhouette distinguish it sharply from Sazabi. Its literary alternate-continuity association matters to this catalog description.
kits.summary: Nightingale's very wide shoulder binders, long rear skirt and low massive silhouette distinguish it sharply from Sazabi.
kits.lore: Nightingale is a large Neo Zeon mobile suit associated with Char Aznable in the alternate Beltorchika's Children depiction of the Char's Counterattack story. Its sprawling design provides another interpretation of Char's ultimate machine.

kits.name: GUNDAM MK-III
kits.notes: The Mk-III's long limbs, angular surfaces and revised Gundam head establish a more streamlined identity than the Mk-II. This catalog entry is for the Mk-III concept, not a mislabeled standard RX-178.
kits.summary: The Mk-III's long limbs, angular surfaces and revised Gundam head establish a more streamlined identity than the Mk-II.
kits.lore: The Gundam Mk-III is an Anaheim-developed mobile suit concept connected to experimentation after the RX-178 Gundam Mk-II. It belongs to Zeta-era side material rather than the central television protagonist line.

kits.name: GUNDAM GP04 GERBERA
aliases: RE/100 1/100 GP04G ガンダム試作4号機 ガーベラ
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: GP04 Gerbera uses a conventional Gundam face and streamlined frame in contrast to the converted Gerbera-Tetra's different exterior. This catalog entry is the Gundam-type prototype, not the Zeon-styled Tetra.
kits.summary: GP04 Gerbera uses a conventional Gundam face and streamlined frame in contrast to the converted Gerbera-Tetra's different exterior.
kits.lore: The Gundam GP04 Gerbera is an Anaheim development concept from the Gundam Development Project and is closely linked to later Gerbera Tetra design history. Its appearance survives in Gundam expanded material rather than the central on-screen battles.

kits.name: DIJEH
kits.notes: Dijeh's asymmetrical shoulder armor, broad waist and curved head fins break sharply from Amuro's original Gundam. Its earthbound Karaba identity is central to distinguishing this design in the catalog.
kits.summary: Dijeh's asymmetrical shoulder armor, broad waist and curved head fins break sharply from Amuro's original Gundam.
kits.lore: The Dijeh is a ground-use mobile suit associated with Amuro Ray during his activities with Karaba in Zeta Gundam. Its design blends Rick Dias-related development with a distinctive mono-eye-like head shape.

kits.name: RAPHAEL GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ラファエルガンダム
kits.notes: The large unit carried above Raphael's relatively slim Gundam body is the defining design feature. It should be cataloged as the film-era Raphael rather than mixed with the earlier bulky Seravee or Seraphim Gundam.
kits.summary: Tieria Erde's elaborate Raphael Gundam from the Gundam 00 film.
kits.lore: Raphael Gundam is Tieria Erde's machine in the Gundam 00 film A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Its unusual top-mounted Seravee Gundam II equipment allows coordinated combat and continues Tieria's tradition of machines hiding complex systems within their silhouette.

kits.name: EFREET CUSTOM
aliases: RE/100 1/100 MS-08TX[EXAM]　イフリート改
kits.notes: The Efreet Custom combines the broad, muscular Zeon design language with a distinctive blue scheme and blade-heavy melee presence. This kit is separate from later Efreet Schneid and ordinary Efreet releases.
kits.summary: The Efreet Custom combines the broad, muscular Zeon design language with a distinctive blue scheme and blade-heavy melee presence.
kits.lore: The Efreet Custom is an enhanced Zeon close-combat mobile suit featured in The Blue Destiny storyline. Its EXAM System creates a dangerous performance advantage and ties it to the series' experimental combat technology.

kits.name: BAWOO
kits.notes: This RE/100 listing portrays the Bawoo's sharp wings and segmented body with a different modeling scale from the HG offerings. It is not the mass-production-colored version.
kits.summary: This RE/100 listing portrays the Bawoo's sharp wings and segmented body with a different modeling scale from the HG offerings.
kits.lore: Glemy Toto's Bawoo is a notable transformable machine in Gundam ZZ. Its splitting body and aircraft-like elements symbolize Neo Zeon's distinctive approach to complex assault mobile suits.

kits.name: HAMMA-HAMMA
aliases: RE/100 1/100 AMX-103　ハンマ・ハンマ
kits.notes: This RE/100 model focuses on Hamma-Hamma's broad shoulder and torso construction and its unusual armament concept. The remote-hand identity distinguishes it from a typical Zaku-family release.
kits.summary: This RE/100 model focuses on Hamma-Hamma's broad shoulder and torso construction and its unusual armament concept.
kits.lore: The Hamma-Hamma is a Neo Zeon experimental mobile suit used by Mashymre Cello in Gundam ZZ. Its remote-controlled arm weapons and distinctive bulky green outline stand out among the series' machines.

kits.name: GUNCANNON DETECTOR
aliases: RE/100 1/100 MSA-005K ガンキャノン・ディテクター
kits.notes: Twin shoulder-mounted cannons, a broad torso and heavily articulated support-machine proportions create a distinctive shape. It should not inherit the RX-77 Guncannon's original history or armaments simply because the two machines share a name.
kits.summary: A cannon-equipped Federation support mobile suit in the Unicorn era.
kits.lore: The Guncannon Detector is a Federation fire-support mobile suit descended from the Methuss design lineage rather than a direct copy of the original One Year War Guncannon. Its name reflects its role, combining sensor and support functions with robust ranged-combat equipment.

kits.name: VIGNA-GHINA
aliases: RE/100 1/100 XM-07 ビギナ・ギナ

kits.name: GYUNEI GUSS’S JAGD DOGA
aliases: RE/100 1/100 MSN-03 ヤクト・ドーガ（ギュネイ・ガス機）
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: Gyunei's Jagd Doga uses a distinct green-toned palette, large shoulders and funnel mounts. It should be kept separate from Quess's machine, despite both sharing the Jagd Doga platform.
kits.summary: Gyunei's Jagd Doga uses a distinct green-toned palette, large shoulders and funnel mounts.
kits.lore: Gyunei Guss pilots a Jagd Doga for Neo Zeon in Char's Counterattack. The design builds on Geara Doga technology with specialized psycho-frame-era equipment and Newtype-use remote weapons.

kits.name: VIGNA-GHINA Ⅱ
aliases: RE/100 1/100 XM-07B　ビギナ・ギナⅡ

kits.name: ZAKUⅡ FZ
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes: This RE/100 interpretation favors the FZ's rounded revised armor, distinctive head and different proportions over those of the older MS-06F. It is a particular improved Zaku, not a standard green Zaku II kit.
kits.summary: This RE/100 interpretation favors the FZ's rounded revised armor, distinctive head and different proportions over those of the older MS-06F.
kits.lore: The MS-06FZ Zaku II Kai is a late-war modernization of Zeon's famous mass-production mobile suit. Bernie Wiseman's unit in War in the Pocket makes the design central to the series' emotional finale.

kits.name: BRAVE (COMMANDER TEST TYPE)
aliases: HG 1/144 ブレイヴ指揮官用試験機
kits.notes: The Commander Test Type combines aircraft-style surfaces with angular GN-powered armor. Its commander-specific arrangement is a separate release from the standard Brave Test Type, even though both share the same design family.
kits.summary: The Commander Test Type combines aircraft-style surfaces with angular GN-powered armor.
kits.lore: The Brave is a transformable Earth Sphere Federation machine from A Wakening of the Trailblazer. The Commander Test Type is associated with Graham Aker, extending the aviation-themed Flag lineage into the movie-era Federation arsenal.

kits.name: BRAVE (STANDARD TEST TYPE)
aliases: HG 1/144 ブレイヴ一般用試験機
kits.notes: This Standard Test Type centers the Brave's streamlined frame and flight silhouette without folding the commander design into the same catalog entry. The name identifies a specific test-unit presentation of the aircraft-like mobile suit.
kits.summary: This Standard Test Type centers the Brave's streamlined frame and flight silhouette without folding the commander design into the same catalog entry.
kits.lore: The Brave represents the post-00 Gundam 00 Federation's progression from the Union Flag and GN-powered machines toward a refined transformable fighter. The Standard Test Type is the regular trial configuration deployed alongside the commander's version.

kits.name: SHINING GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 シャイニングガンダム

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 NORMAL
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-1 ノーマル
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The core AGE-1 design has a white-and-blue body with bright chest markings. Normal, Titus and Spallow are distinct wearable configurations; compare the full kit names rather than assuming different AGE-1 packages contain interchangeable pieces.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Flit Asuno’s adaptable first-generation Gundam from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-1 is Flit Asuno’s mobile suit in the first generation of Gundam AGE. Developed around the AGE System, it uses an adaptive technology concept in which combat data can guide the creation of new equipment. AGE-1 has several specialized wear configurations, allowing the original Normal form to evolve for different battlefield demands. Its history anchors the series’ multi-generational narrative.

kits.name: BOCATA'S GELGOOG(GQ)
aliases: HG 1/144 ゲルググ ボカタ機(GQ)

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 TITUS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-1 タイタス
kits.notes: Titus is immediately recognizable by oversized red shoulder and leg armor, thick fists, and a weighty fighting stance. The visual identity is its muscular combat-oriented Wear rather than the slim AGE-1 Normal; release-specific effects or parts must be checked against the correct kit manual.
kits.summary: The close-combat, heavily armored Titus configuration of Gundam AGE-1.
kits.lore: In Mobile Suit Gundam AGE, Flit Asuno equips the Gundam AGE-1 with the Titus Wear to confront opponents its standard equipment struggles to stop. The AGE System develops this heavily built configuration for hand-to-hand fighting, placing physical power and close-range pressure ahead of the Normal form’s balanced proportions.

kits.name: G-EXES
kits.notes: G-Exes uses a sharp white silhouette, a pointed head profile and angular armor that looks more Gundam-like than the rounder Genoace. The design belongs to Woolf’s first-generation machine and must not be confused with the later pirate-operated G-Exes Jackedge.
kits.summary: Woolf Enneacle’s white ace machine of Gundam AGE’s first generation.
kits.lore: In the Flit Asuno generation of Gundam AGE, the WMS-GEX1 G-Exes becomes Woolf Enneacle’s new customized mobile suit. Built with help from the Madorna workshop, it gives the White Wolf a machine better suited to his aggressive piloting and stands apart from the Federation’s everyday Genoace units.

kits.name: GAFRAN
kits.notes: Its dark blue armor, claw-like limbs and dragon-like flight arrangement produce a profile very different from Earth Federation designs. Gafran should not be mistaken for its faster Zedas successor or the heavily armored Baqto, even though their shared origins are apparent.
kits.summary: An early transforming enemy mobile suit from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: The Gafran is an early mobile suit of the mysterious Unknown Enemy in Gundam AGE, later understood to be part of Vagan military technology. Its ability to transform into a flight configuration and overwhelm regular Federation suits gives the opening conflict its sense of technological imbalance.

kits.name: ZAKU II HIGH MOBILITY TYPE
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island
aliases: HG 1/144 ZAKU II HIGH MOBILITY TYPE
ＨＧ 1/144 シャア専用高機動型ザクII
機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島

kits.name: SWORD IMPULSE GUNDAM SpecII
aliases: RG 1/144 ソードインパルスガンダムＳｐｅｃＩＩ
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: ZAKU DESERT TYPE PINK PANTHER FORCES
aliases: HG 1/144 ZAKU DESERT TYPE PINK PANTHER FORCES
ＨＧ 1/144 ザク・デザートタイプ ピンクパンサー隊機

kits.name: G-LINE LIGHT ARMOR
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジーライン・ライトアーマー

kits.name: REBEN-WOLF (A.O.Z RE-BOOT Ver.)
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 リーベン・ヴォルフ(A.O.Z RE-BOOT版)

kits.name: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムプルトーネブラック
ADELE
kits.notes: Adele kits show a practical, simplified Gundam-influenced form with a rounded visor head and a familiar Federation color arrangement. The service-machine silhouette is different from one-off AGE Gundams and from later specialized Adele Mk-II variants.
kits.summary: The Federation’s second-generation mass-produced mobile suit.
kits.lore: The RGE-G1100 Adele is an Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit fielded during the second generation of Gundam AGE. Drawing on technologies from the Gundam AGE program, it represents the effort to bring better equipment to ordinary Federation pilots fighting an increasingly organized Vagan threat.

kits.name: ＲＧ 1/144 ガンダムアヴァランチエクシアダッシュ
ZEYDRA
kits.notes: Its crimson armor, pointed head details and elegant aggressive proportions create a recognizable rival-machine silhouette. Zeydra belongs to an earlier period than Zeheart’s later Gundam Legilis and must not be treated as the same machine with a different paint finish.
kits.summary: Zeheart Galette’s red Vagan machine of the AGE-2 era.
kits.lore: Zeydra is an advanced red Vagan mobile suit associated with Zeheart Galette during the second generation of Gundam AGE. As one of Asemu Asuno’s most important rivals, Zeheart brings both personal history and growing military responsibility into their battles across the Federation–Vagan conflict.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 DARK HOUND
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-2 ダークハウンド
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Dark Hound’s black armor, pirate-like insignia and revised head and weapon forms distinguish it from the original AGE-2. Many parts retain a recognizable AGE-2 family outline, but the finished display tells a different story. Choose the correct kit edition to avoid mixing equipment from Normal and Dark Hound.
kits.summary: The pirate-styled later configuration of Asemu Asuno’s AGE-2.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-2 Dark Hound is the dramatically modified successor to the original AGE-2 used by Asemu Asuno under a new identity. Its dark pirate-inspired appearance reflects a different stage of the Gundam AGE story and a changed set of combat priorities. It should be treated as a distinct configuration rather than a simple alternate color of AGE-2 Normal.

kits.name: XAVIER'S GYAN HAKUJI-PACKS
aliases: HG 1/144 エグザベ専用ギャン(ハクジ装備)

kits.name: GENOACE CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 ジェノアスカスタム
kits.notes: White armor and a cleaner, more athletic look separate Woolf’s Genoace Custom from the familiar red-and-white standard Genoace. The changes convey an ace pilot’s machine rather than a generic fleet unit; its exact equipment should not be conflated with later Woolf-operated designs.
kits.summary: Woolf Enneacle’s white personal version of the Genoace.
kits.lore: The Genoace Custom is the personalized first-generation Gundam AGE mobile suit associated with Woolf Enneacle, the celebrated pilot nicknamed the White Wolf. Based on an ordinary Federation Genoace, it expresses his preference for a faster, more individualized machine before he moves on to other mobile suits.

kits.name: BAQTO
kits.notes: Thick purple armor, broad shoulders and an imposing torso give Baqto a heavy, almost fortress-like presence. Its layered defensive silhouette is significantly different from the agile Zedas and the transforming Gafran; accessory details should be verified per release.
kits.summary: The heavily protected enemy machine challenging early Gundam AGE forces.
kits.lore: Baqto is a heavily armored Unknown Enemy mobile suit appearing during Flit Asuno’s first-generation battles in Gundam AGE. Unlike faster Vagan machines, its protection is built to withstand ordinary Federation fire, forcing the protagonists to confront a strong defensive opponent with dangerous close-combat abilities.

kits.name: GENOACE II
kits.notes: The Genoace II retains the approachable visor-headed outline but updates armor shapes and detailing from the original Genoace. Its appearance belongs to a later service era and should not be assigned the original first-generation kit description or Woolf’s personal Custom profile.
kits.summary: The improved Earth Federation Genoace of Gundam AGE’s second generation.
kits.lore: Genoace II is the updated Earth Federation mass-production design used in the second generation of Gundam AGE. It continues the family introduced during Flit Asuno’s youth while adapting the equipment to the new conflict faced by Asemu’s generation, illustrating how older service machines evolve over decades.

kits.name: Ex-S GUNDAM/S GUNDAM (TASK FORCE α Ver.)
aliases: MG 1/100 Ex-S GUNDAM/S GUNDAM (TASK FORCE α Ver.)
ＭＧ 1/100 Ｅｘ-Ｓガンダム/Ｓガンダム (タスクフォースα Ｖｅｒ.)
ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This Task Force Alpha edition is specifically associated with the unit's colors and an Ex-S/S Gundam presentation. Preserve the release title rather than treating it as a plain standard-color S Gundam.
kits.summary: This Task Force Alpha edition is specifically associated with the unit's colors and an Ex-S/S Gundam presentation.
kits.lore: Task Force Alpha fields the S Gundam during the Gundam Sentinel conflict, where the machine's ALICE system is a major element of its story. The Ex-S adds another layer of armor and equipment to that baseline.

kits.name: GUNDAM ZIRIUS
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムジリウス

kits.name: ZEDAS R
kits.notes: Zedas R preserves the thin, angular and flight-oriented profile of the family while presenting its own color treatment. It should be cataloged separately from first-generation Zedas and from Zedas M, the specialized type linked with the Magicians Eight.
kits.summary: A second-generation high-speed variant of the Vagan Zedas family.
kits.lore: Zedas R is a second-generation Vagan mobile suit within the line of agile machines introduced in early Gundam AGE. Its changed coloration and later deployment place it after the original Zedas and show the continued refinement of Vagan high-speed technology as the conflict passes into Asemu Asuno’s era.
highlights: Separate from Zedas and Zedas M

kits.name: GENOACE O CUSTOM
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 ジェノアスＯカスタム

kits.name: DORADO
kits.notes: Its purple-toned armor, broad shielded body and distinctive Vagan head proportions distinguish Dorado from the sleek Zeydra and older first-generation machines. It represents a regular combat type rather than one of the story’s signature Gundam prototypes.
kits.summary: A regular Vagan combat mobile suit from the AGE-2 generation.
kits.lore: Dorado is a Vagan mobile suit used during the second-generation battles of Gundam AGE. As the enemy forces increasingly reveal their organization and military intentions, designs like Dorado make the conflict look less like isolated Unknown Enemy attacks and more like a conventional war.

kits.name: FARSIA
kits.notes: The machine features pink and violet armor, a flower-like head shape and a slim, rounded profile. Its elegant visual design distinguishes it from most aggressive Vagan units; the later Fawn Farsia belongs to a separate development and should not inherit this exact identity.
kits.summary: The delicate-looking X-Rounder mobile suit from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Farsia is an X-Rounder-use Vagan mobile suit associated with Yurin L’Ciel during the first generation of Gundam AGE. Its appearance carries considerable emotional weight in Flit Asuno’s story, while its remotely controlled attacks illustrate a different type of combat from ordinary line mobile suits.

kits.name: R01 AILE STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R01 エールストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R01 Remaster line release focuses on the classic Strike Gundam and prominent Aile pack silhouette, with its back-mounted wings and familiar tricolor armor. It should be distinguished from MG, RG and other HG Strike releases.
kits.summary: The R01 Remaster line release focuses on the classic Strike Gundam and prominent Aile pack silhouette, with its back-mounted wings and familiar tricolor armor.
kits.lore: Aile Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato's early GAT-X105 Strike equipped with the Aile Striker pack for balanced maneuvering. In Gundam SEED, swapping Striker packs lets one core mobile suit take on different battlefield requirements.

kits.name: GALLUSS-J
kits.notes: Its thick forearms, angular shoulders and unusually arranged mechanical details set it apart from contemporary Neo Zeon suits. This Galluss-J is not the later Schuzrum-Galluss form.
kits.summary: Its thick forearms, angular shoulders and unusually arranged mechanical details set it apart from contemporary Neo Zeon suits.
kits.lore: The Galluss-J is a Neo Zeon ground-combat mobile suit in Gundam ZZ, featured during the conflict around Side 1. Its design emphasizes aggressive close-range fighting in an urban environment.

kits.name: R02 DUEL GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R02 デュエルガンダム アサルトシュラウド
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R02 Remaster release interprets Duel's clean GAT-X102 silhouette and angular blue-and-white armor. It is distinct from the Duel Assault Shroud configuration, whose added protective equipment changes the outline.
kits.summary: The R02 Remaster release interprets Duel's clean GAT-X102 silhouette and angular blue-and-white armor.
kits.lore: Duel Gundam is one of the Alliance's G-project mobile suits captured by ZAFT and piloted by Yzak Joule. Its straightforward fighting style contrasts with the more specialized capabilities of other early Gundam SEED machines.

kits.name: R03 BUSTER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R03 バスターガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R03 Remaster edition presents Buster's bulky artillery proportions and prominent large firearms. Its visual identity relies on the shoulder-mounted equipment and heavier torso, separate from later customized Buster variants.
kits.summary: The R03 Remaster edition presents Buster's bulky artillery proportions and prominent large firearms.
kits.lore: Buster Gundam is a long-range G-project mobile suit captured and used by Dearka Elsman during Gundam SEED. Its combined heavy guns are central to its role as a fire-support machine rather than a fast melee-oriented unit.

kits.name: R04 BLITZ GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R04 ブリッツガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R04 Remaster release highlights Blitz's black armor, sharp pointed limbs and specialized stealth-warrior silhouette. The entry is for the original Blitz, not later designs that borrow its components or color palette.
kits.summary: The R04 Remaster release highlights Blitz's black armor, sharp pointed limbs and specialized stealth-warrior silhouette.
kits.lore: Blitz Gundam is a stealth-focused G-project machine captured by ZAFT and piloted by Nicol Amalfi. Its Mirage Colloid system gives it concealment capabilities while its close-range weapons define its more ambush-oriented battlefield role.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM SpecⅡ[FINAL BATTLE IMAGE COLOR]
aliases: HG 1/144 DESTINY GUNDAM SpecⅡ[FINAL BATTLE IMAGE COLOR]
HG 1/144 デスティニーガンダムSpecII[最終決戦イメージカラー]
機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

kits.name: BLAZE ZAKU PHANTOM (DEARKA ELTHMAN CUSTOM)
aliases: MG 1/100 BLAZE ZAKU PHANTOM (DEARKA ELTHMAN CUSTOM)
MG 1/100 ブレイズザクファントム (ディアッカ・エルスマン専用機)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The release specifically identifies Dearka's color and pilot association alongside the Blaze backpack. It is different from both the generic Blaze Phantom and other ace-custom versions.
kits.summary: The release specifically identifies Dearka's color and pilot association alongside the Blaze backpack.
kits.lore: Dearka Elsman is a veteran ZAFT pilot from the Gundam SEED storyline. A named Blaze ZAKU Phantom configuration ties that character to the more advanced SEED Destiny equipment line.

kits.name: MS-06S ZAKUⅡ [HATSUNE MIKU Ver.]
aliases: RG 1/144 MS-06S ザクII [初音ミクVer.]

kits.name: MESSER TYPE-F02 MINELAYER
aliases: ＨＧ 1/144 メッサーＦ０２型 マインレイヤー装備
機動戦士ガンダム 閃光のハサウェイ

kits.name: R05 AEGIS GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R05 イージスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R05 Remaster version centers Aegis's magenta armor, broad limb shapes and distinctive transformation-derived geometry. It is a separate release from larger-scale or differently engineered Aegis kits.
kits.summary: The R05 Remaster version centers Aegis's magenta armor, broad limb shapes and distinctive transformation-derived geometry.
kits.lore: Aegis Gundam is the transformable G-project machine seized by ZAFT and piloted by Athrun Zala in Gundam SEED. Its unusual transformation and mobile-armor capture tactic set it apart from the conventional humanoid Gundams of the same program.

kits.name: R06 MOBILE GINN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R06 Remaster listing captures the GINN's mono-eye face, large shoulder contours and utilitarian infantry appearance. It refers to the ordinary GINN rather than a custom ace unit or specialized High Maneuver version.
kits.summary: The R06 Remaster listing captures the GINN's mono-eye face, large shoulder contours and utilitarian infantry appearance.
kits.lore: The GINN is ZAFT's early mass-produced mobile suit, a mechanical workhorse during the opening stages of the First Alliance-PLANT War. Its military design vocabulary helped establish the Contrast between ZAFT machines and the Earth Alliance's G-project Gundams.

kits.name: R07 MOBILE CGUE
aliases: HG 1/144 R07 モビルシグー
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R07 Remaster CGUE has a sharper angular head and more commanding torso profile than the older GINN. This exact entry belongs to the standard CGUE, not the specialized D.E.E.P. Arms or other custom variants.
kits.summary: The R07 Remaster CGUE has a sharper angular head and more commanding torso profile than the older GINN.
kits.lore: The CGUE is an upgraded ZAFT mass-production machine from Gundam SEED, built to improve on the earlier GINN's battlefield capabilities. Its service among ZAFT forces illustrates the escalation of equipment before and during the arrival of Gundam-class units.

kits.name: R08 CALAMITY GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R08 カラミティガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R08 Remaster kit showcases Calamity's large cannon-mounted silhouette and strong blocky armor styling. It is distinct from later Aile Calamity or Sword Calamity variations, which use different equipment concepts.
kits.summary: The R08 Remaster kit showcases Calamity's large cannon-mounted silhouette and strong blocky armor styling.
kits.lore: Calamity Gundam is an Earth Alliance second-generation GAT-X mobile suit piloted by Orga Sabnak during Gundam SEED. Its strikingly heavy ranged firepower makes it one of the three biological-CPU Gundams deployed against ZAFT.

kits.name: R09 FORBIDDEN GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R09 フォビドゥンガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R09 Remaster design emphasizes Forbidden's distinctive backpack, dark armor and hooked close-range weapon theme. The resulting shape should remain its own entry rather than being merged with Calamity or Raider.
kits.summary: The R09 Remaster design emphasizes Forbidden's distinctive backpack, dark armor and hooked close-range weapon theme.
kits.lore: Forbidden Gundam is the Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Shani Andras during Gundam SEED. Its unusual defensive and beam-deflection capabilities, along with the dramatic backpack system, give it a menacing battlefield identity.

kits.name: R10 RAIDER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R10 レイダーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R10 Remaster entry centers Raider's winged, aircraft-like transformation geometry and harsh mechanical styling. The version is different from the later Boost Raider variation and belongs to the original SEED trio.
kits.summary: The R10 Remaster entry centers Raider's winged, aircraft-like transformation geometry and harsh mechanical styling.
kits.lore: Raider Gundam is the transformable Earth Alliance machine operated by Clotho Buer as part of the biological-CPU team in Gundam SEED. Its aggressive mobile-armor form and melee-oriented tactics complement the other two units.

kits.name: Hi-NU GUNDAM VRABE
aliases: HGBF 1/144 Hi-νガンダムヴレイブ
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: R15 FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R15 フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R15 Remaster Freedom preserves the first Freedom's distinctive blue wing binders and long waist-mounted railgun silhouette. It should not be confused with Strike Freedom or later Freedom 2.0 and special-finish kit editions.
kits.summary: The R15 Remaster Freedom preserves the first Freedom's distinctive blue wing binders and long waist-mounted railgun silhouette.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is the ZAFT-developed nuclear-powered mobile suit acquired by Kira Yamato midway through Gundam SEED. Its multiple ranged weapons and high-mobility wings become central to his effort to stop further fighting.

kits.name: R11 LaGOWE
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R11 Remaster depiction keeps LaGOWE's long animal-like body and low stance at the forefront. Its legs, head and rear equipment create a very different display profile from standard mobile suits.
kits.summary: The R11 Remaster depiction keeps LaGOWE's long animal-like body and low stance at the forefront.
kits.lore: LaGOWE is a four-legged ZAFT mobile suit developed for desert warfare in Gundam SEED and famously used by Andrew Waltfeld. Its quadrupedal mobility and heavy weapon arrangement distinguish it from two-legged military designs.

kits.name: R16 M1 ASTRAY
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R16 Remaster entry focuses on the M1 Astray's simple face, bright angular armor and relatively streamlined production-unit styling. It is not interchangeable with the Red Frame, Blue Frame or Gold Frame Gundam Astrays.
kits.summary: The R16 Remaster entry focuses on the M1 Astray's simple face, bright angular armor and relatively streamlined production-unit styling.
kits.lore: The M1 Astray is Orb's mass-production mobile suit from Gundam SEED, reflecting technology developed around the Astray project. Unlike prototype Gundam-class machines, it represents Orb's effort to field a more conventional defensive force.

kits.name: R12 MOBILE BuCUE
aliases: HG 1/144 R12 モビルバクゥ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R12 Remaster BuCUE preserves the long four-legged chassis and distinct animal-inspired proportions of the ordinary production design. This is not the later multi-headed Cerberus BuCUE Hound adaptation.
kits.summary: The R12 Remaster BuCUE preserves the long four-legged chassis and distinct animal-inspired proportions of the ordinary production design.
kits.lore: The BuCUE is ZAFT's quadrupedal unmanned-looking but piloted mobile suit designed for ground combat in Gundam SEED. Its low-profile running and tracked movement make it an effective and recognizable desert battlefield machine.

kits.name: R13 PROVIDENCE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R13 プロヴィデンスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R13 Remaster edition focuses on Providence's heavily armored body and unmistakable large circular back equipment. The standard release is distinct from special coating and expanded-effect editions.
kits.summary: The R13 Remaster edition focuses on Providence's heavily armored body and unmistakable large circular back equipment.
kits.lore: Providence Gundam is Rau Le Creuset's late-war ZAFT machine in Gundam SEED. Its DRAGOON remote weapon system gives it a fearsome range of attack directions and makes it one of the series' most dangerous climactic opponents.

kits.name: R14 JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R14 ジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R14 Remaster release depicts Justice's red-magenta body and prominent winged Fatum backpack. It is the original Justice, rather than Infinite Justice or other later interpretations of Athrun's machine.
kits.summary: The R14 Remaster release depicts Justice's red-magenta body and prominent winged Fatum backpack.
kits.lore: Justice Gundam is Athrun Zala's ZAFT nuclear-powered mobile suit near the climax of Gundam SEED. Its Fatum-00 backpack can act as an independent support craft, giving the design a versatile airborne fighting style.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-3 NORMAL
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-3 ノーマル
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The AGE-3 Normal has a broad, powerful torso and a clear distinction between core and larger components. Fortress and Orbital kits change the armor and silhouette substantially; this reference is for Normal only. Consult the exact product documentation for its combination features and included weapon parts.
kits.summary: Kio Asuno’s combining AGE-3 Normal from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: The AGE-3 Gundam AGE-3 Normal continues the Gundam lineage in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE and is associated with Kio Asuno. The machine uses a combining Core Fighter and larger body arrangement, moving the family’s design direction toward a more powerful and heavily equipped form. Orbital and Fortress configurations use different equipment and should not be confused with the standard Normal form.

kits.name: CLANCHE
kits.notes: Wing-like shoulder structures and a slender aircraft-influenced body distinguish Clanche from the non-transforming Adele family. It has its own standard appearance separate from the Clanche Custom, whose pilot-specific detailing should be recorded independently.
kits.summary: The Federation’s transformable production mobile suit in later Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Clanche is an Earth Federation mass-produced transformable mobile suit of the third generation in Gundam AGE. Descended from the design ideas behind Gundam AGE-2, it demonstrates how flight-transformation technology eventually reaches ordinary Federation units in the long conflict against Vagan forces.

kits.name: SHALDOLL-KAI
kits.notes: The updated Shalldoll preserves a compact, fairly simple humanoid outline with cleaner armor than most enemy Vagan suits. Its name describes an upgraded type; it should not be merged with the later space-pirate Shalldoll Rogue or a basic Shalldoll release.
kits.summary: An updated version of the Shaldoll in Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Shalldoll Kai is an improved form of the Shaldoll mobile suit lineage seen in Gundam AGE. The original design originates with the Madorna workshop, and later improvements reflect the Federation side’s need for capable but practical machines beyond unique Gundam prototypes.

kits.name: SHALDOLL ROGUE
aliases: HG 1/144 シャルドール ローグ
kits.notes: Its darker, harder-edged appearance separates this Bisidian machine from the earlier workshop-built Shalldoll. Treat this product title as the pirate variant: it is not a standard Federation Shaldoll Custom and should not inherit that model’s assumed equipment.
kits.summary: Bisidian’s customized Shalldoll for the later AGE era.
kits.lore: Shaldoll Rogue is a space-pirate mobile suit from the Bisidian faction in the later stages of Gundam AGE. It develops the older Shaldoll lineage associated with the Madorna workshop, but now serves a different organization and embodies a more rugged combat-oriented identity.

kits.name: GHIRARGA
kits.notes: Long limbs, prominent blades and sharp Vagan armor surfaces make Ghirarga notably more aggressive than the earlier Zeydra. Its standard configuration should remain distinct from the separate Mode X equipment interpretation and from similarly named Build-series custom Gunpla.
kits.summary: Zeheart’s fierce red mobile suit during the later Gundam AGE conflict.
kits.lore: Ghirarga is a Vagan mobile suit associated with Zeheart Galette during the third generation of Gundam AGE. Its fierce close-combat capabilities and red form carry his rivalry forward into a later stage of the conflict, when the fighting has spread to Earth itself.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-3 ORBITAL
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-3 オービタル
kits.notes: Orbital replaces the ordinary AGE-3 silhouette with long, swept forms and prominent propulsion-oriented lines. It has a distinct high-speed visual character; the catalog must not assume its equipment or assembly mechanisms are identical to AGE-3 Fortress.
kits.summary: The high-mobility space configuration of Kio’s Gundam AGE-3.
kits.lore: The AGE-3 Orbital is a specialized form of Kio Asuno’s Gundam AGE-3 during the third generation of Gundam AGE. It is configured for the demands of space combat and high-mobility maneuvering, complementing the bulkier Fortress configuration and the standard AGE-3 form.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-FX
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The AGE-FX has a blue-white color scheme and distinctive remote-funnel elements around a compact Gundam frame. The Burst configuration is a separate late-story presentation and should be labeled distinctly. The exact number of effects and display supports depends on the product release.
kits.summary: Kio Asuno’s advanced C-Funnel-equipped Gundam from the AGE finale.
kits.lore: The Gundam AGE-FX is Kio Asuno’s late-series mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE. It represents a culmination of the AGE System’s approach to evolving equipment across generations of the Asuno family. Its remote C-Funnel weapons support a highly mobile, defensive fighting style that suits Kio’s changing outlook on conflict.

kits.name: GUNDAM LEGILIS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダム レギルス
kits.notes: The white body, dark blue sections and red accents combine familiar Gundam proportions with Vagan head and weapon details. It is not simply Zeydra in new armor: the Legilis has its own machine identity, technology and late-series context.
kits.summary: Vagan’s distinctive late-era Gundam Legilis.
kits.lore: Gundam Legilis is an advanced Vagan machine introduced late in Gundam AGE, strongly associated with the culmination of the conflict and Zeheart Galette’s story. Its Gundam-like form represents the Vagan side’s sophisticated technology and acts as a counterpart to the Asuno family’s increasingly advanced Gundams.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM
aliases: MGSD デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-FX BURST
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-FX バースト
kits.notes: Burst depictions emphasize a dramatic energized appearance around the AGE-FX’s slim blue-white body and floating weapon concept. This is a state or edition of AGE-FX rather than a different pilot’s machine; avoid claiming specific effect pieces for a box without its manual.
kits.summary: The dramatic Burst-state depiction of Kio’s Gundam AGE-FX.
kits.lore: The AGE-FX Burst is a heightened combat state of Kio Asuno’s Gundam AGE-FX during the final stage of Gundam AGE. It reflects the AGE System’s continued development toward a highly responsive mobile suit and the C-Funnel-centered fighting style that distinguishes Kio’s last principal Gundam.

kits.name: DANAZINE
kits.notes: A long neck, dragon-like head and heavy limb shapes give Danazine one of the franchise’s most creature-inspired outlines. It should be distinguished from the earlier transforming Gafran, even though both share the unconventional Vagan design language.
kits.summary: A striking beast-shaped Vagan mobile suit deployed on Earth.
kits.lore: Danazine is a Vagan mobile suit developed for direct operations on Earth in the third generation of Gundam AGE. Its unusual beast-like construction illustrates how Vagan engineers adapt machines to different combat environments instead of simply copying Federation humanoid designs.

kits.name: ADELE (DIVA COLOR)
aliases: HG 1/144 アデル(ディーヴァ所属部隊カラー)

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-3 FORTRESS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-3 フォートレス
kits.notes: Fortress is recognized by its heavy arm and leg equipment, large gun structures and squat artillery-like proportions. Its bulky fighting silhouette is visually separate from both AGE-3 Normal and the sleek Orbital Wear; specific included parts must be checked by edition.
kits.summary: The heavy-firepower Fortress version of Gundam AGE-3.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-3 Fortress is a specialized land-combat configuration developed for Kio Asuno’s third-generation Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE. Where Orbital emphasizes maneuverability, Fortress places overwhelming sustained firepower and a more grounded combat role at the center of the AGE-3 design.

kits.name: G-EXES JACKEDGE
aliases: HG 1/144 Gエグゼス ジャックエッジ
kits.notes: The Jackedge has a pirate-influenced dark armored appearance and sharp styling that differentiate it from Woolf’s original bright white G-Exes. It should be grouped with Bisidian-era designs, not assigned the story of the first-generation White Wolf machine.
kits.summary: Bisidian’s pirate-styled descendant of the G-Exes.
kits.lore: G-Exes Jackedge is a customized machine operated by the space pirates of Bisidian in the later Gundam AGE timeline. It draws on the earlier G-Exes line associated with Woolf Enneacle while giving the design a new faction identity and role after many years of warfare.

kits.name: GM CANNON Ⅱ
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: Its broad shoulder cannons, thick upper torso and protective armor layers create an immediately recognizable fire-support silhouette. The model is distinct from the earlier lighter GM Cannon.
kits.summary: Its broad shoulder cannons, thick upper torso and protective armor layers create an immediately recognizable fire-support silhouette.
kits.lore: The GM Cannon II is an armored Federation support mobile suit used during Gundam 0083, expanding the earlier GM Cannon line with improved protection and shoulder-mounted firepower. It serves alongside other Federation machines in the Delaz Conflict.

kits.name: GUNDAM PORTENT
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムポータント
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Portent's flowing green-toned silhouette and smooth armor transitions make it unusually graceful among competitive Gunpla. It is a unique machine, not a simple color swap of another Gundam 00-derived kit.
kits.summary: The Portent's flowing green-toned silhouette and smooth armor transitions make it unusually graceful among competitive Gunpla.
kits.lore: Gundam Portent is Shia Kijima's custom Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its design emphasizes elegance, speed and precision, matching a pilot whose approach contrasts with the show's more brute-force combatants.

kits.name: DELTA GUNDAM
kits.notes: Gold armor, a sharp Gundam-style face and a sleek transforming-machine lineage define Delta Gundam's appearance. Its model identity must stay distinct from the silver-gray Delta Plus and experimental Delta Kai, which have different histories and silhouettes.
kits.summary: The golden Delta-series design related to Hyaku Shiki development.
kits.lore: Delta Gundam is an Anaheim development concept linked to the Hyaku Shiki and transformable Zeta-era designs in the Universal Century. Its unrealized transformation ambitions became part of the background for later Delta-family machines, including the operational Delta Plus.

kits.name: GUNDAM DELTA KAI
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムデルタカイ
kits.notes: Broad weapon equipment, a Gundam-style head and transformation-oriented bodywork separate Delta Kai from the simple golden Delta Gundam. Its prototype identity and equipment should not be replaced with specifications belonging to Delta Plus.
kits.summary: A more experimental, heavily equipped member of the Delta mobile-suit family.
kits.lore: The Delta Kai is a high-performance experimental machine within the Delta development lineage. Its sophisticated equipment and specialized systems push beyond the more conventional Delta Plus, giving the Universal Century design a distinctly prototype-oriented character.

kits.name: JUAGGU (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ジュアッグ（ユニコーンVer.）
kits.notes: The elephant-like head trunk, broad feet and forearm weapons give Juaggu a distinctive mechanical character. The Unicorn version represents the later anime-era presentation rather than every historical MSV interpretation of the design.
kits.summary: The elephant-like head trunk, broad feet and forearm weapons give Juaggu a distinctive mechanical character.
kits.lore: The Juaggu is an unconventional Zeon amphibious support mobile suit rooted in One Year War design experiments. In Gundam Unicorn, a surviving example appears during the attack on Torrington, making this old machine unexpectedly memorable in a later-generation battle.

kits.name: NEMO (UNICORN VER.)
kits.notes: This Unicorn-branded Nemo preserves the recognizable visor and compact Federation-style armor while using the later-story look. Desert-color and Zeta-era Nemo releases are separate records.
kits.summary: This Unicorn-branded Nemo preserves the recognizable visor and compact Federation-style armor while using the later-story look.
kits.lore: The Nemo is a rugged mass-produced mobile suit introduced in Zeta Gundam. Later Universal Century deployments underline how designs developed for the AEUG continued to serve beyond their original conflict.

kits.name: RAS-96 ANKSHA
kits.notes: The RAS-96 form is identifiable by its circular flight profile and transformation-oriented silhouette. It is distinct from the older Asshimar, despite sharing an airborne design philosophy.
