kits.summary: The RAS-96 form is identifiable by its circular flight profile and transformation-oriented silhouette.
kits.lore: The Anksha is a Federation transformable mobile suit developed from the Asshimar concept. In Unicorn it serves both as a combat machine and as a platform able to carry other mobile suits.

kits.name: ZAKUⅠ SNIPER TYPE (YONEM KIRKS)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ザクＩ・スナイパータイプ(ヨンム・カークス機)
kits.notes: This named Kirks release focuses on the Sniper Type's long-range equipment and specific pilot identity. It should not be merged into a standard MS-05 Zaku I entry.
kits.summary: This named Kirks release focuses on the Sniper Type's long-range equipment and specific pilot identity.
kits.lore: Yonem Kirks is a Zeon remnant sniper pilot in Unicorn, operating a customized old Zaku I Sniper Type. His dramatic long-range support shows how dangerous legacy machines can remain in skilled hands.

kits.name: MARASAI (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 マラサイ(ユニコーンVer.)
kits.notes: This Unicorn edition distinguishes a later deployment from the original Zeta-series Marasai. The curved shoulder armor and tube details remain defining features of the machine.
kits.summary: This Unicorn edition distinguishes a later deployment from the original Zeta-series Marasai.
kits.lore: The Marasai originated as a Titans-era mobile suit, yet surviving machines appear in later conflicts with different users. The Unicorn-era Marasai is one example of equipment crossing the series' shifting factions.

kits.name: MSA-003 NEMO (UNICORN DESERT COLOR Ver. )
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MSA-003 NEMO (UNICORN DESERT COLOR Ver. )
HGUC 1/144 MSA-003 ネモ(ユニコーンデザートカラーVer.)

kits.name: GASTIMA
aliases: ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: ReZEL TYPE-C (DEFENSER b-UNIT) (GR)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 リゼルC型（ディフェンサーbユニット／ゼネラル・レビル配備機）
kits.notes: The General Revil Type-C Defenser b-Unit has a more expanded silhouette than a standard ReZEL. The named unit, attachment and fleet association all matter for kit identification.
kits.summary: The General Revil Type-C Defenser b-Unit has a more expanded silhouette than a standard ReZEL.
kits.lore: The ReZEL Type-C is a specialized Federation transformable unit building on the Zeta Gundam line. Its Defenser b-Unit configuration emphasizes additional supporting equipment for General Revil forces.

kits.name: HAMBRABI
kits.notes: The angular, ray-like transformation and extremely broad shoulder surfaces make Hambrabi one of the most distinctive Titans shapes. Its recognizable blue design is separate from other flying mobile armors.
kits.summary: The angular, ray-like transformation and extremely broad shoulder surfaces make Hambrabi one of the most distinctive Titans shapes.
kits.lore: The Hambrabi is a transforming Titans mobile suit used by Yazan Gable and his team in Zeta Gundam. Its unusual multi-eye sensor arrangement and mobile armor mode support high-speed coordinated attacks.

kits.name: ZAKU-MARINER
kits.notes: The kit's underwater fittings and reinforced Zaku outline are the design focus. It is cataloged independently from ordinary green Zakus and later aquatic variants.
kits.summary: The kit's underwater fittings and reinforced Zaku outline are the design focus.
kits.lore: The Zaku Mariner updates an amphibious Zaku lineage for underwater and coastal duties in Gundam ZZ. It combines the familiar Zaku heritage with equipment designed for a very different battlefield.

kits.name: BASE JABBER (UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ベースジャバー（ユニコーンVer.）

kits.name: GM SNIPER II
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ジム・スナイパーII
機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The GM Sniper II combines a visor-equipped head, angular Federation armor and a long-range rifle silhouette. Its subdued colors help distinguish it from more colorful Gundam protagonists. Compare the standard version with White Dingo and other special editions; their markings and equipment themes differ by release.
kits.summary: A late-One Year War Federation GM variant designed for precise ranged combat.
kits.lore: The RGM-79SP GM Sniper II is a late-One Year War Earth Federation machine associated with improved targeting and high-performance ranged combat. Its most recognizable appearance is in Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket, where Federation forces deploy the type during the conflict surrounding Side 6. Despite the sniper designation, it is built on a capable GM-derived frame rather than functioning only as a stationary rifle platform.

kits.name: BYARLANT CUSTOM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 バイアラン・カスタム
kits.notes: The machine's wide shoulders, long clawed arms, flight-oriented proportions and unusual upright outline make it immediately recognizable. This Custom must be distinguished from the Zeta-era Byarlant and the later Byarlant Custom 02 equipment.
kits.summary: A heavily revised Byarlant known for the Torrington battle in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The Byarlant Custom is an upgraded Earth Federation mobile suit based on the older Zeta-era Byarlant. In Gundam Unicorn, its defense of Torrington base is a memorable example of an older high-mobility design still performing effectively against Zeon remnants.

kits.name: MS-06R-1A ZAKU II BLACK TRISTARS
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-1A ZAKU II BLACK TRISTARS
HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-1A 黒い三連星ザク

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (UNICORN MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (UNICORN MODE)
HGUC 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン(ユニコーンモード)
kits.notes: The Unicorn Mode listing focuses on Banshee Norn before Destroy Mode expansion. Its visible configuration should not be confused with the same mobile suit's separately sold transformed-state kits.
kits.summary: The Unicorn Mode listing focuses on Banshee Norn before Destroy Mode expansion.
kits.lore: Banshee Norn is the second RX-0 Unicorn unit in its revised configuration. Unicorn Mode conceals much of its transformed psycho-frame machinery, leaving a dark armored silhouette punctuated by gold details.

kits.name: GUNDAM Ez8
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Ez8 has a distinctive forehead and chest armor arrangement, subdued military styling and revised front silhouette. Do not treat it as a simple recolor of the Ground Type. Check the exact kit for its weapon and backpack configuration, which can vary between editions.
kits.summary: Shiro Amada’s rebuilt Ground Type Gundam from The 08th MS Team.
kits.lore: The RX-79[G]Ez-8 is Shiro Amada’s repaired and heavily modified Gundam Ground Type in The 08th MS Team. Built with available field resources after major damage, it reflects the series’ grounded depiction of mobile suit warfare. Its unconventional chest and head details and altered armor distinguish it from a standard production Ground Type.

kits.name: MESSALA
kits.notes: Messala's tall rear thruster stacks and long limbs create an imposing silhouette in either form. The large propulsion structures define the kit's appearance more than a conventional Gundam-style backpack.
kits.summary: Messala's tall rear thruster stacks and long limbs create an imposing silhouette in either form.
kits.lore: Messala is a large transformable mobile suit designed and used by Paptimus Scirocco, emphasizing powerful thrust and heavy offensive equipment. Its appearance in Zeta Gundam signals Scirocco's interest in unconventional high-performance machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM G-LUCIFER
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダム Ｇ-ルシファー
ガンダム Gのレコンギスタ

kits.name: MS-06R-1A SHIN MATSUNAGA ZAKU II
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-1A SHIN MATSUNAGA ZAKU II
HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-1A シン・マツナガ専用ザク

kits.name: FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM (UNICORN MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM (UNICORN MODE)
HGUC 1/144 フルアーマー・ユニコーンガンダム(ユニコーンモード)
kits.notes: This Unicorn Mode edition contrasts with the expanded Destroy Mode interpretation of the same Full Armor configuration. The weapon-packed silhouette remains the essential visual focus.
kits.summary: This Unicorn Mode edition contrasts with the expanded Destroy Mode interpretation of the same Full Armor configuration.
kits.lore: The Full Armor Unicorn equips the RX-0 with an unusually large assortment of weapon systems and boosters. In Unicorn Mode the machine retains its closed-armor look despite its extensive external loadout.

kits.name: GERBERA-TETRA
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガーベラ・テトラ
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The rounded red torso, distinctive head and large rear thruster equipment mark it as a different external machine from the Gundam GP04 concept. This entry is the standard Gerbera-Tetra presentation.
kits.summary: The rounded red torso, distinctive head and large rear thruster equipment mark it as a different external machine from the Gundam GP04 concept.
kits.lore: Gerbera-Tetra is a high-performance mobile suit associated with Cima Garahau in Gundam 0083. Its origins are tied to the Gundam Development Project, giving its Zeon-like armor a hidden technical history.

kits.name: DOVEN WOLF (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ドーベン・ウルフ（ユニコーンVer.）
kits.notes: This Unicorn variant showcases the Doven Wolf's blocky frame, heavy shoulders and broad weapons-oriented design. Its later-era scheme must be tracked separately from the original ZZ Gundam-era Doven Wolf release.
kits.summary: This Unicorn variant showcases the Doven Wolf's blocky frame, heavy shoulders and broad weapons-oriented design.
kits.lore: The Doven Wolf is a heavily armed Neo Zeon mobile suit developed in the First Neo Zeon War with a mix of conventional and remote-weapon concepts. Machines from that lineage continue to appear during the Unicorn era, linking successive Neo Zeon generations.

kits.name: ZOGOK (UNICORN VER.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ゾゴック（ユニコーンVer.）
kits.notes: This Unicorn version of Zogok preserves the prominent red armored torso, unusual head launchers and distinctive arm layout. It is not the similarly named Z'Gok family.
kits.summary: This Unicorn version of Zogok preserves the prominent red armored torso, unusual head launchers and distinctive arm layout.
kits.lore: The Zogok is an experimental Zeon amphibious design first associated with concepts for attacking Jaburo. Its appearance in Unicorn shows how obscure Zeon equipment survived into much later fighting.

kits.name: SILVER BULLET
aliases: HGUC 1/144 シルヴァ・バレト
kits.notes: The standard Silver Bullet is different from its Funnel Test Type variant and Gael Chan's separately named unit. The heavy torso and armor design mark it as a discrete catalog entry.
kits.summary: The standard Silver Bullet is different from its Funnel Test Type variant and Gael Chan's separately named unit.
kits.lore: The Silver Bullet is a Federation-linked test and development machine derived from the Döven Wolf design. It has a visually distinctive broad body and remote-arm-related mechanical lineage.

kits.name: WING GUNDAM
aliases: HGAC 1/144 ウイングガンダム
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Bird Mode silhouette and Buster Rifle are the most recognizable features of this original Wing Gundam. It should not be confused with Wing Gundam Zero, whose weaponry, systems and body configuration are significantly different.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Heero’s first Operation Meteor Gundam, noted for Bird Mode.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy’s primary machine early in Gundam Wing. Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.name: HGAW 1/144 GUNDAM DOUBLE X
aliases: HGAW 1/144 ガンダムダブルエックス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Double X’s reflector panels and twin cannon equipment are central to its appearance. The opened reflector pose requires more space than a compact neutral stance. Do not confuse the Double X with the earlier Gundam X, whose satellite weapon arrangement is different.
kits.summary: Garrod Ran’s Twin Satellite Cannon Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GX-9901-DX Gundam Double X is Garrod Ran’s upgraded mobile suit in After War Gundam X. Developed around satellite-cannon technology, its silhouette features large reflector assemblies that open to support the Twin Satellite Cannon. Its place in the story is inseparable from the postwar world’s conflict over the use and fear of devastating weapons.

kits.name: VICTORY GUNDAM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ヴィクトリーガンダム

kits.name: GAIA'S RICK DOM/ORTEGA’S RICK DOM(GQ)
aliases: HG 1/144  GAIA'S RICK DOM/ORTEGA’S RICK DOM(GQ)
HG 1/144 リック・ドム ガイア機/オルテガ機(GQ)

kits.name: WING GUNDAM ZERO
aliases: RG 1/144 ウイングガンダムゼロ
kits.notes: This entry represents the television-style Wing Zero rather than the feather-wing Endless Waltz Zero. Its grade-specific construction is separate from the other Wing Zero record.
kits.summary: This entry represents the television-style Wing Zero rather than the feather-wing Endless Waltz Zero.
kits.lore: Heero Yuy ultimately pilots Wing Gundam Zero, whose ZERO System predicts combat outcomes at great psychological cost. The television-series machine is recognizable for its angular wings and Neo Bird transformation concept.

kits.name: GUNDAM NAION
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムナイオン
機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女

kits.name: UNION FLAG CUSTOM II [GN FLAG]
aliases: HG 1/144 UNION FLAG CUSTOM II [GN FLAG]
HG 1/144 グラハム専用ユニオンフラッグカスタムII(GNフラッグ)

kits.name: MS-06R-1A ZAKUⅡ GAIA/MASH CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 高機動型ザクII（ガイア/マッシュ専用機）
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The Gaia/Mash Custom release represents a named ace configuration of the high-mobility Zaku. Its backpack, leg-thruster and markings should not be conflated with the Ortega version.
kits.summary: The Gaia/Mash Custom release represents a named ace configuration of the high-mobility Zaku.
kits.lore: The MS-06R-1A high-mobility Zaku II supports the Black Tri-Stars' identity as experienced Zeon aces. Gaia and Mash are team members associated with specialized high-mobility machines in Origin-era interpretations.

kits.name: GUNDAM F91
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The F91 stands apart from earlier Gundams through its comparatively compact proportions, shoulder and backpack weapons and face-open design. Its VSBRs are crucial to identification; compare their placement across kit grades. Harrison Madin colors and other variants should be distinguished from the standard Seabook-era configuration.
kits.summary: Seabook Arno’s advanced SNRI Gundam from Gundam F91.
kits.lore: The Gundam F91 is an advanced Federation mobile suit developed by SNRI in the later Universal Century. Seabook Arno becomes its pilot during the events of the Gundam F91 film, confronting the Crossbone Vanguard. Its compact body houses sophisticated equipment, including the pair of VSBR weapons, while its high-performance operation is associated with striking afterimages.

kits.name: G-3 GUNDAM Ver.2.0
kits.notes: The Ver.2.0 presentation combines classic RX-78 proportions with the G-3's subdued prototype coloring. Its identity rests on both the alternate prototype designation and this specific kit generation.
kits.summary: The Ver.2.0 presentation combines classic RX-78 proportions with the G-3's subdued prototype coloring.
kits.lore: The RX-78-3 G-3 Gundam is a sibling prototype to the RX-78-2, generally associated with a gray-toned appearance and upgrades explored in Gundam's expanded Universal Century material. It is a separate machine from Amuro's familiar tricolor Gundam.

kits.name: AILE STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: HGCE 1/144 エールストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Aile Strike models combine the white, blue and red Strike armor with the long-winged Aile Striker equipment. The pack gives the silhouette a very different balance from Launcher and Sword Strike. Included mounts, beam sabers and pack mechanisms vary by grade and edition; do not assume every Strike release contains an Aile Striker.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s Strike Gundam configured for mobile Aile Striker combat.
kits.lore: The GAT-X105 Strike Gundam is an Earth Alliance prototype central to Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and famously piloted by Kira Yamato. Its modular Striker Pack system lets it adapt to different kinds of combat; the Aile Striker is designed around flight mobility and balanced armament. The suit's battles help define the growing conflict between Earth and ZAFT and Kira's changing allegiances.

kits.name: WING GUNDAM ZERO
aliases: HGAC 1/144 ウイングガンダムゼロ
kits.notes: This entry represents the television-style Wing Zero rather than the feather-wing Endless Waltz Zero. Its grade-specific construction is separate from the other Wing Zero record.
kits.summary: This entry represents the television-style Wing Zero rather than the feather-wing Endless Waltz Zero.
kits.lore: Heero Yuy ultimately pilots Wing Gundam Zero, whose ZERO System predicts combat outcomes at great psychological cost. The television-series machine is recognizable for its angular wings and Neo Bird transformation concept.

kits.name: SAYLA’S LIGHT-TYPE GUNCANNON
aliases: HG 1/144 セイラ専用軽キャノン

kits.name: GM SLOEP
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN

kits.name: ∀ GUNDAM
aliases: HGCC 1/144 WD-M01 ターンエーガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Turn A models have a radically different head shape, rounded surfaces and unusual chest construction compared with typical V-fin Gundams. The Moonlight Butterfly effect is associated with the fictional unit; a model’s physical effect parts, if any, depend on the edition. Treat Turn A and the Turn X as separate machines.
kits.summary: Loran Cehack’s ancient Gundam, central to the story of ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn A Gundam is an enigmatic ancient mobile suit discovered in the world of ∀ Gundam. Loran Cehack pilots it amid the conflict between Earth’s people and the returning Moonrace. The machine’s unusual moustache-like facial crest and its connection to the buried history of technology make it one of the most distinctive Gundam designs. Its Moonlight Butterfly system carries enormous narrative significance.

kits.name: MS-06R-2 ZAKUⅡ JOHNNY RIDDEN CUSTOM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-2  ZAKUⅡ JOHNNY RIDDEN CUSTOM
HGUC 1/144 MS-06R-2 ジョニー・ライデン専用ザク

kits.name: DREISSEN
kits.notes: This kit reflects the original ZZ-era Dreissen presentation rather than the subsequently depicted Gundam Unicorn version. Its rounded armored proportions establish the family's visual link to Dom designs.
kits.summary: This kit reflects the original ZZ-era Dreissen presentation rather than the subsequently depicted Gundam Unicorn version.
kits.lore: The Dreissen is a Neo Zeon heavy mass-production mobile suit used during Gundam ZZ, inheriting ideas from the older Dom family. It carries a distinctive bulky body suited to front-line combat.

kits.name: 598'S MONKEY RODI / MONKEY CRAB RODI
aliases: HG 1/144 598'S MONKEY RODI / MONKEY CRAB RODI
HG 1/144 モンキーロディ(598機)/モンキークラブロディ
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (DESTROY MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN (DESTROY MODE)
HGUC 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン（デストロイモード）
kits.notes: This listing specifically describes Norn in its opened Destroy Mode silhouette. It is separate from Banshee's earlier Armed Armor VN/BS configuration and the folded Unicorn Mode Norn.
kits.summary: This listing specifically describes Norn in its opened Destroy Mode silhouette.
kits.lore: Banshee Norn is the reconfigured RX-0 second unit used by Riddhe Marcenas. Destroy Mode expands its psycho-frame and reveals the intense transformed look associated with the Unicorn system.

kits.name: GUNDAM F91 HARRISON CUSTOM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムF91 ハリソン・マディン専用機

kits.name: STRIKE ROUGE
aliases: HGCE 1/144 ストライクルージュ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Strike Rouge models are most immediately distinguished by their pink-toned armor and Strike-derived frame. Different releases use Aile, I.W.S.P. or other backpack configurations; these are not interchangeable as factual kit contents. Confirm the exact product title before listing included pack equipment.
kits.summary: Orb’s pink-armored Strike derivative associated with Cagalli.
kits.lore: The MBF-02 Strike Rouge is Orb's reconstruction and adaptation of Strike Gundam technology in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, strongly associated with Cagalli Yula Athha. Its distinctive pink-red armor and upgraded equipment embody Orb's growing role in the Cosmic Era conflict. The machine later continues to serve as an important bridge between the original Strike and newer technologies.

kits.name: R17 PERFECT STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 R17 パーフェクトストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The R17 Remaster version is visually dominated by equipment carried around the familiar Strike frame. Unlike an ordinary Aile Strike, this named setup puts the all-purpose loadout and its more crowded silhouette at the center.
kits.summary: The R17 Remaster version is visually dominated by equipment carried around the familiar Strike frame.
kits.lore: Perfect Strike combines the Strike Gundam with elements of multiple Striker pack weapon systems to cover several combat roles. It is a heavily equipped interpretation of the core GAT-X105, celebrated for bringing the Aile, Sword and Launcher concepts together.

kits.name: MS-06R-1A ZAKUⅡ ORTEGA CUSTOM

kits.summary: The kit depicts Ortega's pilot-specific configuration and associated markings.
kits.lore: Ortega is one of Zeon's Black Tri-Stars, a team of veteran pilots appearing in Origin-era retellings. His high-mobility Zaku II follows the specialist MS-06R branch rather than the standard Zaku II.

kits.summary: This edition emphasizes the fully transformed RX-0 with extensive external weaponry.
kits.lore: The Full Armor Unicorn carries a heavily expanded external weapon loadout. In Destroy Mode the psycho-frame opens across the suit, producing a dramatic contrast with its closed Unicorn Mode presentation.

kits.name: Re-GZ
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Re-GZ presents a streamlined white-and-blue Federation shape, with design cues linking it to Zeta Gundam. The Back Weapon System is central to the mobile suit’s identity, but included display parts vary between kits. Keep standard Re-GZ editions separate from the Re-GZ Custom and other later variations.
kits.summary: A Zeta-derived Federation mobile suit used in Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: The RGZ-91 Re-GZ is a Federation transformable mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam: Char’s Counterattack, piloted most notably by Amuro Ray before his return to the ν Gundam. Its name abbreviates Refined Gundam Zeta, reflecting design ideas inherited from the Zeta line. Rather than performing a complete transformation alone, the machine uses a detachable Back Weapon System to provide its flight configuration.

aliases: HGUC 1/144 水陸両用モビルスーツセット

kits.name: GUNDAM ZAGAN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The Zagan emphasizes weighty limb shapes and a different armor vocabulary from Barbatos or Kimaris. This named Gundam Frame deserves a separate catalog identity rather than being reduced to a generic Calamity War Gundam.
kits.summary: The Zagan emphasizes weighty limb shapes and a different armor vocabulary from Barbatos or Kimaris.
kits.lore: Gundam Zagan is a Gundam Frame featured in Iron-Blooded Orphans' expanded universe, connected with the legacy of the Calamity War and later noble-family interests. Its broad and unusual proportions create a forceful presence.

kits.name: SAZABI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Sazabi’s defining model features are its bulky red armor, funnel equipment, large shoulder structures and extensive rear thruster area. The Ver.Ka and RG interpretations have very different approaches to panel lines and engineering. When identifying a release, distinguish a standard Sazabi from special editions such as the MSN-04FF.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Char Aznable’s red Newtype mobile suit from Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: Sazabi is Char Aznable’s personal mobile suit in Char’s Counterattack. The massive red machine is designed to exploit the abilities of a Newtype pilot, combining substantial armor and powerful thrusters with funnel remote weapons. Its confrontation with Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam gives the final act of the film much of its emotional weight. Sazabi symbolizes Char’s return to open conflict over humanity’s future on Earth and in space.
highlights: Distinct RG, MG and special-edition interpretations

kits.name: νGUNDAM (HEAVY WEAPON SYSTEM)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 νガンダム(ヘビー・ウエポン・システム装備型)
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: The HWS equipment changes the Nu's slim chest and leg outlines with more substantial armor plates and heavy weapons. This version must be distinguished from the standard RX-93 and other finishing variants.
kits.summary: The HWS equipment changes the Nu's slim chest and leg outlines with more substantial armor plates and heavy weapons.
kits.lore: The Nu Gundam was conceived for Amuro Ray during the final clash with Char Aznable. Its Heavy Weapon System configuration imagines greater defensive and offensive equipment than the regular appearance in the film.

kits.name: GUNDAM GRIEPE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムグリープ
kits.notes: The design combines an unusual angular upper body with strong winged or flight-oriented contours, giving Griepe a profile unlike the simpler Geminass machines. Distinguish the base subject from special armor or product configurations when cataloging exact kits.
kits.summary: The advanced Gundam Griepe from G-Unit.
kits.lore: Gundam Griepe appears in the Gundam Wing: G-Unit side story and represents an advanced mobile suit within its experimental After Colony narrative. Its presence expands the mobile suit technology portrayed beyond the five principal Gundams of the television series.

kits.lore: The Rick Dom II belongs to Zeon's heavy mobile-suit lineage and appears among the late-war forces of War in the Pocket. Different deployment schemes distinguish units of this design.

kits.name: JEGAN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Jegan models feature a mint-green armor palette, a squared visor head and compact Federation equipment. Numerous successor and mission variants exist, including D Type, A Type and later-era color schemes. Check the product title before assuming an ordinary Jegan and a later modified Jegan use the same armor.
kits.summary: The Federation’s long-serving mass-production mobile suit from Char’s Counterattack onward.
kits.lore: The RGM-89 Jegan becomes a major Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit after the Gryps Conflict. It is prominent in Char’s Counterattack and continues to appear, in upgraded forms, across later Universal Century stories. Its design emphasizes reliable deployment and standardized equipment rather than a Gundam prototype’s exceptional performance.

kits.name: NZ-666 KSYATRIYA
kits.notes: The huge four-wing profile and rounded green central body are the Kshatriya's most identifiable design elements. It is not the later Kshatriya Repaired despite the shared base machine.
kits.summary: The huge four-wing profile and rounded green central body are the Kshatriya's most identifiable design elements.
kits.lore: The Kshatriya is a powerful Neo Zeon mobile suit piloted by Marida Cruz. Its four massive wing binders carry funnels and give the machine an unmistakable silhouette in Unicorn.

kits.name: Z-GUNDAM
kits.notes: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette. Exact kit specifications depend on its listed grade and edition, not this shared design background.
kits.summary: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeta Gundam is the AEUG's transformable protagonist machine in the Gryps Conflict, piloted by Kamille Bidan. Its movable-frame construction and Waverider form mark a major advance beyond the earlier Gundam Mk-II.

kits.name: ReZEL
kits.notes: ReZEL's blue-gray armor, narrow visor-like head and long transformation-related bodywork distinguish it from a standard Jegan. Commander and Defenser equipment variants should remain separate catalog entries with their own relevant features.
kits.summary: The Federation's practical transforming ReZEL from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The ReZEL is an Earth Federation mass-production transformable mobile suit inspired by Zeta-era and Re-GZ engineering. Gundam Unicorn features the type as a practical fleet machine that can change into a wave-rider form for fast travel and combat support.

kits.name: ReZEL (CAPTAIN MS)
kits.notes: Its commander-specific back equipment and visually revised ReZEL silhouette separate it from the standard unit. A catalog entry should describe these distinctions without implying that every ReZEL release has the same attachments or display modes.
kits.summary: The commander-focused configuration of the Federation's ReZEL.
kits.lore: The ReZEL Commander Type is a leadership-oriented version of the Federation's transformable ReZEL, with equipment and configuration differences identifying a command machine within Gundam Unicorn's fleet forces. It retains the ReZEL's mobile-suit and wave-rider design concept.

kits.name: GELGOG MASS PRODUCTION TYPE
kits.notes: The standard Gelgoog has a rounded head, broad shoulder armor and flared legs that make it visually heavier than a Zaku. This release is distinct from Char's red machine and specialized Gelgoog Cannon equipment.
kits.summary: The standard Gelgoog has a rounded head, broad shoulder armor and flared legs that make it visually heavier than a Zaku.
kits.lore: The Gelgoog was one of Zeon's most advanced mass-produced mobile suits introduced late in the One Year War. Its performance and beam-weapon capability represented a considerable advance over the earlier Zaku series.

kits.name: ZZ GUNDAM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ダブルゼータガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The ZZ design is more heavily built than the Zeta Gundam, with substantial shoulder and leg armor and a distinctive forehead cannon. Different grades vary in how they realize transformation and combination. A standard ZZ, Enhanced ZZ and Full Armor ZZ are not interchangeable catalog entries.
kits.summary: Judau Ashta’s high-firepower transformable Gundam in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The MSZ-010 ZZ Gundam becomes Judau Ashta’s principal machine during Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ. It continues the transformable Gundam lineage while taking the concept toward greater firepower. Its combination system allows the machine to divide into components, and the powerful high-mega cannon in its forehead is one of its signature weapons. The ZZ is central to the AEUG’s struggle against the renewed Neo Zeon threat.

kits.name: δ(DELTA) PLUS
kits.notes: The Delta Plus favors a metallic gray appearance, long nose-like body elements and a sharply angular profile. Its practical transformable design differs from the gold Delta Gundam concept and the more experimental Delta Kai.
kits.summary: The gray transformable Delta Plus operated in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: Delta Plus is an Anaheim-developed transformable mobile suit belonging to the Delta family. Riddhe Marcenas pilots it during Gundam Unicorn, where its agile wave-rider capabilities connect the machine to earlier Hyaku Shiki and Zeta-era transformation research.

kits.name: GUNDAM GP01-Fb
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Full Burnern models are readily identified by their enlarged rear thruster system and different leg and backpack forms. Treat GP01 and GP01-Fb as separate catalog variants; the differences go beyond a paint change. When comparing kits, examine the treatment of the prominent boosters and the revised proportions.
kits.summary: The GP01’s space-adapted Full Burnern configuration.
kits.lore: The GP01 Full Burnern is the space-combat refit of Kou Uraki’s GP01 in Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory. After the earlier configuration proves unsuitable for its new operational setting, the prototype receives substantial thruster and mobility changes. Its resulting silhouette emphasizes high-speed movement in space while retaining the identity of the original Zephyranthes.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Legend’s dark gray and blue accents, broad backpack and remote-weapon silhouette set it apart from standard frontline Gundams. Its DRAGOON equipment is key to the design, though the way deployed weapons can be displayed differs among releases. Avoid confusing it with Providence despite their shared remote-weapon concepts.
kits.summary: Rey Za Burrel’s DRAGOON-equipped Gundam in SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X666S Legend Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny and is piloted by Rey Za Burrel. It employs a DRAGOON remote-weapon system, reflecting Cosmic Era interest in all-range combat. Legend’s appearance contributes to the conflicts surrounding the Destiny Plan and ZAFT’s final military operations.

aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The kit's early prototype body, rounded features and distinctive joints communicate a machine still in development. It is not a conventional MS-05 or MS-06 combat Zaku.
kits.summary: The kit's early prototype body, rounded features and distinctive joints communicate a machine still in development.
kits.lore: The YMS-03 Waff is an experimental Zeon mobile suit in Gundam The Origin, positioned within the pre-Zaku stages of military development. It explores the forms that eventually mature into the Zaku line.

kits.name: SINANJU
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Sinanju’s gold-on-red Sleeves ornamentation, complex curved armor and substantial backpack are defining display details. Consider how a kit renders the trim and its long weapon silhouettes. Sinanju Stein and recolored Build-series machines are different releases and should not automatically inherit standard Sinanju-specific modeling notes.
kits.summary: Full Frontal’s ornate red command mobile suit in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The MSN-06S Sinanju is Full Frontal’s red command mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its exceptional mobility, elaborate gold markings and heavy equipment support the masked leader of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. Its rivalry with the Unicorn Gundam gives the machine a prominent role in the struggle over Laplace’s Box.

kits.name: UNLEASHED 1/60 ν GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: The Perfect Grade Unleashed 1/60 interpretation presents the Nu Gundam on a very large mechanical scale, with layered interior construction and prominent funnel geometry. It is not an ordinary smaller-scale MG or RG Nu.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade Unleashed 1/60 interpretation presents the Nu Gundam on a very large mechanical scale, with layered interior construction and prominent funnel geometry.
kits.lore: The RX-93 Nu Gundam was designed with Amuro Ray's participation and manufactured by Anaheim Electronics. Its psycho-frame system and fin funnels play a key role during the final battle over Axis in Char's Counterattack.

kits.name: GM CUSTOM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The GM Custom uses a compact visor face, crisp layered armor and more capable mechanical proportions than the standard GM. It should remain separate from GM Quel and GM Type C.
kits.summary: The GM Custom uses a compact visor face, crisp layered armor and more capable mechanical proportions than the standard GM.
kits.lore: The GM Custom is an elite Federation mobile suit appearing in Gundam 0083, distinguished from everyday mass-production GM types by its refined performance and ace-unit use. Its technology feeds into later postwar developments.

kits.summary: A twin Ball set emphasizes paired small support units rather than a humanoid Gundam.
kits.lore: The RB-79 Ball is a compact Federation space combat pod used to supplement conventional mobile suits during the One Year War. Its spherical body, manipulator arms and mounted cannon make it a very different kind of battlefield machine.

kits.summary: This entry identifies the standard GM Type C rather than a Ball pairing or GM Custom.
kits.lore: The GM Type C is a Federation production development represented during the post-One Year War period. Its role shows the Earth Federation's reliance on practical GM variants while experimental Gundams are being tested.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Alex models can be identified by the white-and-blue Federation scheme and their variant armor treatment. Chobham armor changes the silhouette dramatically, but whether it is included depends on the exact release. The NT-1 should not be confused with the earlier RX-78-2 despite their common design lineage.
kits.summary: The RX-78NT-1 Alex tested at Side 6 in War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex is a Federation prototype created for Newtype-oriented operation during the One Year War. In War in the Pocket it is tested by Christina Mackenzie, and its development is central to the conflict around Side 6. Its distinctive appearance can be augmented by Chobham armor, contrasting the slim prototype with an armored protective configuration.

kits.lore: The Jegan ECOAS Type is a special-operations adaptation of the RGM-89 Jegan used by the Earth Federation's ECOAS unit in Gundam Unicorn. Its reinforced equipment reflects the tactical requirements of an elite boarding and operations force rather than standard fleet service.

kits.lore: The Gundam Local Type is a Federation development associated with the Origin-era Mobile Suit Discovery setting. It represents an early adaptation of Gundam technology toward region-specific roles.

kits.name: DOM
kits.notes: Dom kits favor broad shoulders, flared lower-leg armor and a wide hover-equipped stance. Its purple-and-black color arrangement is one of Zeon's most recognizable. The ground-use Dom and space-adapted Rick Dom share major design cues but should not be treated as the same configuration.
kits.summary: Zeon’s heavy, hover-capable ground mobile suit.
kits.lore: The MS-09 Dom is a heavy Zeon ground mobile suit famous for its high-speed hover movement and use by the Black Tri-Stars during the One Year War. Its broad armor and powerful propulsion give it a very different battlefield role from the leaner Zaku. In Mobile Suit Gundam, the Black Tri-Stars' coordinated attacks make the Dom particularly recognizable.

kits.name: RICK-DOM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large skirt armor, bell-shaped legs and imposing torso make Rick Dom visually distinct from slender Zeon suits. The model is a space-use Rick Dom, not simply the terrestrial Dom with a different label.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The space-adapted Dom mobile suit from the One Year War.
kits.lore: Rick Dom is a space-adapted development of the Zeon Dom family during the One Year War of Mobile Suit Gundam. In contrast to the ground-operating Dom, its equipment and mobility systems are adapted to space combat, and it serves alongside other mass-produced Zeon units against Federation forces. Its broad purple-and-black silhouette is among the era’s signature designs.

kits.summary: Amuro Ray’s Fin Funnel-equipped Gundam from Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: Amuro Ray pilots the RX-93 ν Gundam in Char’s Counterattack. Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.lore: The ZII is a Zeta-project-related design that seeks a more practical transformable mobile suit, drawing on engineering lessons from the Zeta Gundam. It belongs to Gundam's expanded Universal Century development histories.

kits.name: QUBELEY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Look for the sweeping shoulder binders, compact central torso, funnel containers and smooth organic armor shapes. Depending on the exact kit, posing the binders and representing deployed funnels can be central to the display. Qubeley Mk-II, mass-production Qubeley and Build-series redesigns deserve separate references.
kits.summary: Haman Karn’s funnel-equipped Newtype mobile suit from Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The AMX-004 Qubeley is a Newtype-use machine associated with Haman Karn and the Axis forces in Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ. Its remote-controlled funnels, curved armor and broad shoulder binders create a silhouette unlike the Federation’s conventional mobile suits. Haman’s ability to employ the Psycommu-controlled weapons makes the Qubeley a formidable opponent. Later Qubeley Mk-II units use related technology but belong to different pilots and must not be mistaken for the original.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.summary: Ramba Ral’s close-combat Zeon mobile suit from the One Year War.
kits.lore: The MS-07B Gouf is a Zeon ground-combat mobile suit notably piloted by Ramba Ral in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Designed with close-quarters fighting in mind, it contrasts with the more widespread Zaku II through specialized equipment and a distinctive battlefield presence. Ral's encounters with Amuro Ray make the blue Gouf one of the early story's memorable rival machines.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gyan models center on a narrow helmet-like head, a fencing-style beam saber and an unusual rounded shield design. The relatively slim torso and broad leg armor give it a unique silhouette. Do not confuse the original Gyan with Gyan Strom or Build-series reinterpretations.
kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

kits.notes: Force Impulse models highlight a red-white-blue core suit with wing-shaped equipment attached at the back. The modular Silhouette idea is central to its identity, but part separation and transformation engineering differ by kit grade. Keep Force, Sword and Blast Silhouette variations distinct when assigning release-specific features.
kits.summary: The high-mobility Force configuration of Shinn Asuka’s Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam is a ZAFT machine from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny, first piloted by Shinn Asuka. Its modular Silhouette System changes combat capabilities; the Force Silhouette prioritizes speed and mobile aerial fighting. The Impulse's dramatic role during the war also sets it against established pilots and their more famous machines.

kits.name: HYAKU-SHIKI
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Hyaku-Shiki model is defined by its gold surfaces, distinctive narrow head and rear binders. Metallic coatings, painted gold and ordinary molded finishes can look very different, even when the underlying machine is the same. Keep the standard Hyaku-Shiki separate from Hyaku-Shiki Kai and custom Build-series variants when comparing products.
kits.summary: The AEUG’s gold mobile suit piloted by Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The golden MSN-00100 Hyaku-Shiki is a prototype mobile suit used by the AEUG during the Gryps Conflict. Quattro Bajeena, Char Aznable operating under an assumed identity, becomes its best-known pilot. Its development is connected to the Delta Gundam design line, and it favors mobility and skilled piloting over a conventional Gundam face. The machine is particularly memorable for its gold armor and its appearances alongside the Zeta Gundam and Gundam Mk-II.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira’s advanced, gold-framed mobile suit from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.name: ZETA GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The elongated shield and wing binders are essential to Zeta’s Waverider configuration. Ver.Ka and other grades interpret the complex transformation differently, so the edition’s actual conversion steps should be checked before handling. The model’s appeal comes from the relationship between mobile suit proportions and its aircraft-like form.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kamille’s transforming AEUG Gundam from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: Zeta Gundam is Kamille Bidan’s signature transformable mobile suit in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Developed for the AEUG, it combines a fast-moving Waverider configuration with high-performance mobile suit combat. Its biography is closely tied to Kamille’s growth, the Gryps Conflict and the tensions between the Earth Federation, Titans and anti-Titans forces. The transformation becomes a defining feature of later variable-geometry Gundam designs.

kits.name: BARZAM
kits.notes: Barzam has a compact face, long limbs and recognizable chest-and-waist geometry. Its unconventional armor planes make it visually distinct from the Gundam Mk-II despite their shared factional context.
kits.summary: Barzam has a compact face, long limbs and recognizable chest-and-waist geometry.
kits.lore: The Barzam is a Titans mass-production mobile suit introduced during the Gryps Conflict. Its unusual torso and head design give the organization a more distinctive late-war look than Hizack-based equipment.

kits.name: EFREET SCHNEID
aliases: HGUC 1/144 イフリート・シュナイド
kits.notes: Multiple heat-dart mounts across dark armor, a stout ground-combat build and a heavily weathered combat identity give Efreet Schneid its signature look. It differs from other Efreet variants in both equipment and its Unicorn-era history.
kits.summary: The heat-dart-equipped Efreet variant seen during Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: Efreet Schneid is a heavily modified descendant of Zeon's MS-08TX Efreet, kept operational by Earth-based remnants into the Gundam Unicorn era. Its combat specialty centers on close-range attacks using numerous heat darts, a striking contrast with ordinary ranged weapon loadouts.

aliases: HG 1/144 GUNDAM GROUND TYPE THE08 MS TEAM
機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Ground Type kits often highlight utilitarian armor, backpacks, knee and shoulder construction, and earthbound battlefield posing. Equipment such as large weapons or storage containers depends on the particular product. Distinguish the Ground Type from the Ez8 field rebuild, whose front and body armor differ noticeably.
kits.summary: A ground-combat Federation Gundam associated with The 08th MS Team.
kits.lore: The RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type is a limited-production Earth Federation machine used for ground combat during the One Year War. It appears prominently in The 08th MS Team, where Shiro Amada leads a team operating in difficult terrestrial conditions. Unlike the iconic RX-78-2, these machines emphasize practical field deployment, maintenance and cooperation with other ground units.

kits.name: BYARLANT
kits.notes: The Byarlant's oversized upper arms, wide shoulders and projecting boosters are the essential design features. This original Titans-era model is distinct from the later Unicorn-era Byarlant Custom versions.
kits.summary: The Byarlant's oversized upper arms, wide shoulders and projecting boosters are the essential design features.
kits.lore: The Byarlant is a Titans experimental mobile suit engineered for atmospheric flight without a conventional transformation. Its unusual thruster and limb arrangements create an instantly recognizable high-mobility silhouette.

kits.name: R-JARJA
kits.notes: This model centers on the R-Jarja's prominent shoulder shields and ornamental Neo Zeon lines. Its distinct design must not be confused with the similarly named Gyan or Galluss series.
kits.summary: This model centers on the R-Jarja's prominent shoulder shields and ornamental Neo Zeon lines.
kits.lore: The R-Jarja is a Neo Zeon mobile suit in Gundam ZZ, associated with the pilot Chara Soon. Its elaborate shoulders, lance-like weapon concept and imposing profile emphasize dueling combat.

kits.name: NARRATIVE GUNDAM A-PACKS
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ナラティブガンダム A装備
機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ）

kits.name: DIJEH
kits.notes: Dijeh's asymmetrical shoulder armor, broad waist and curved head fins break sharply from Amuro's original Gundam. Its earthbound Karaba identity is central to distinguishing this design in the catalog.
kits.summary: Dijeh's asymmetrical shoulder armor, broad waist and curved head fins break sharply from Amuro's original Gundam.
kits.lore: The Dijeh is a ground-use mobile suit associated with Amuro Ray during his activities with Karaba in Zeta Gundam. Its design blends Rick Dias-related development with a distinctive mono-eye-like head shape.

kits.name: GUSTAV KARL (UNICORN Ver.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 グスタフ・カール(ユニコーンVer.)
kits.notes: This Unicorn version presents the Gustav Karl's bulky shoulders and thick lower-body armor in its earlier screen appearance. It is distinct from later Hathaway-era treatments.
kits.summary: This Unicorn version presents the Gustav Karl's bulky shoulders and thick lower-body armor in its earlier screen appearance.
kits.lore: The Gustav Karl is a heavy-set Federation mass-production mobile suit developed in the later Universal Century. Its appearance in Unicorn demonstrates a shift toward larger, heavily armored Federation frontline units.

kits.name: NARRATIVE GUNDAM C-PACKS
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ナラティブガンダム C装備
機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ）

kits.name: SINANJU STEIN (NARRATIVE Ver.)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 シナンジュ・スタイン (ナラティブVer.)
機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ）
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Stein’s more restrained armor and shoulder shapes are the clearest contrast with the Sinanju. Narrative version details and markings must be checked against the specific box, especially when comparing Ver.Ka and earlier editions. Do not replace a Stein catalog entry with standard Sinanju artwork.
kits.summary: A white-armored Sinanju-line mobile suit seen in Gundam Narrative.
kits.lore: Sinanju Stein represents the development lineage behind the red Sinanju. The Narrative version appears in Gundam Narrative in connection with Zoltan Akkanen and the Neo Zeon remnant forces. Its paler, straighter-edged armor makes it visibly different from Full Frontal’s highly ornamented red machine. Version labels matter, because Unicorn and Narrative interpretations are not necessarily the same depicted configuration.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM
aliases: HGCE 1/144 デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.name: ZAKU HALF CANNON
aliases: HG 1/144 ザク・ハーフキャノン
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The model gives a Zaku body a distinctive cannon-equipped artillery silhouette. Its Half Cannon designation separates it from the full Zaku Cannon and ordinary rifle-armed Zaku II.
kits.summary: The model gives a Zaku body a distinctive cannon-equipped artillery silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zaku Half Cannon is an Origin/MSD-era fire-support machine derived from the familiar Zaku base. It embodies Zeon's attempts to adapt mass-production mobile suits to specialized bombardment roles.

kits.name: MAGANAC
kits.notes: This standard Maganac entry represents the basic corps mobile suit rather than the Rasid/Abdul or Auda/Ahmad sets. Its broad shields and rugged desert styling establish its character.
kits.summary: This standard Maganac entry represents the basic corps mobile suit rather than the Rasid/Abdul or Auda/Ahmad sets.
kits.lore: The Maganac is a desert-capable mobile suit operated by Quatre's loyal Maganac Corps in Gundam Wing. The corps' many pilots use machines adapted to their combat environment and individual preferences.

kits.name: GUNDAM SANDROCK EW (ARMADILLO LIZARD)
aliases: ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムサンドロックＥＷ (アーマディロリザード装備)

kits.name: GUNDAM SANDROCK
aliases: HGAC 1/144 ガンダムサンドロック
kits.notes: Its pale armor, rounded helm and paired heat-shortsword motif distinguish Sandrock from other Operation Meteor Gundams. It is not equivalent to the later Sandrock Custom or Endless Waltz interpretations; visual design and armaments change between releases.
kits.summary: Quatre’s protective, desert-oriented Gundam Sandrock.
kits.lore: Gundam Sandrock is the desert-combat Gundam operated by Quatre Raberba Winner in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. Closely linked to his Maganac allies, it combines protective armor with a distinctly melee-oriented fighting identity and reflects Quatre’s concern for the people caught in war.

kits.notes: A huge skirt-like shell, long arms and asymmetric armor make Baund Doc unlike ordinary humanoid Gundams. The machine's mobile armor transformation should be recognized as a key visual element, not confused with other Titans experiments.
kits.summary: A huge skirt-like shell, long arms and asymmetric armor make Baund Doc unlike ordinary humanoid Gundams.
kits.lore: The Baund Doc is an experimental Titans transformable mobile armor with an extremely unusual asymmetrical shape. It is linked to Newtype-related combat during the final stages of the Gryps Conflict.

kits.summary: This Heine Custom kit is identified by its specialized color variant, not the standard Shinn Asuka Destiny Gundam.
kits.lore: The Destiny Gundam is ZAFT's advanced high-performance design associated with the later SEED Destiny storyline. Heine Westenfluss has a distinctive alternate-color Destiny presentation in side or promotional material.

kits.name: ∞ JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: HGCE 1/144 インフィニットジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Justice is distinguished by its red-pink body and broad Fatum backpack, which creates a striking airborne silhouette. Be sure to differentiate it from Infinite Justice and later Justice variants; the lifter, colors and armor shape are not interchangeable. Different kits may offer different display options for the flight unit.
kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.

kits.name: GUNDAM HEAVYARMS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムヘビーアームズ
kits.notes: Red-and-white armor, a broad chest and numerous weapon-port shapes make Heavyarms visually unmistakable. The TV configuration, Heavyarms Custom and Endless Waltz versions have important design differences; specific guns or missiles should be confirmed for the chosen edition.
kits.summary: Trowa Barton’s missile-and-gun-focused Gundam from Wing.
kits.lore: Gundam Heavyarms is the heavily armed Gundam piloted by Trowa Barton in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. Its role in Operation Meteor and later battles is built around saturating an area with ranged fire, a stark contrast to the close-combat specialization of other Gundam pilots.
highlights: Distinct from Custom and EW variants

kits.summary: The HG Windam kit presents the regular Earth Alliance type rather than a specific named ace configuration.
kits.lore: The Windam is an Earth Alliance mass-production mobile suit from Gundam SEED Destiny. Its adaptable Striker Pack compatibility extends the equipment philosophy introduced with the Strike Gundam.

kits.summary: The kit represents the Act Zaku's revised frame in a Kycilia-affiliated presentation.
kits.lore: The Act Zaku is an upgraded experimental Zaku-family machine appearing in Origin-associated mechanical material. Units associated with Kycilia Zabi's forces carry their own operational and visual identity.

kits.name: MS-06 ZAKU II
kits.notes: This MS-06 Zaku II listing focuses on the ordinary machine rather than an ace's personal repaint. Power pipes, rounded torso armor and a strong asymmetrical silhouette are the central model design cues.
kits.summary: This MS-06 Zaku II listing focuses on the ordinary machine rather than an ace's personal repaint.
kits.lore: The MS-06 Zaku II is the archetypal Zeon soldier's mobile suit, widely deployed in ground and space fighting during the One Year War. Its asymmetric shoulder armor and mono-eye sensor became a Gundam design shorthand.

kits.name: DAGGER L
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This HG kit represents the standard Dagger L machine rather than the separate dark variant. Its Federation-style head and practical CE design distinguish it from ZAFT ZAKU Warriors.
kits.summary: This HG kit represents the standard Dagger L machine rather than the separate dark variant.
kits.lore: The Dagger L is an Earth Alliance mass-production mobile suit in SEED Destiny, continuing the Strike Dagger family with updated armor and deployment roles. It is frequently shown as a front-line Alliance unit.

kits.summary: Duo Maxwell’s original stealth-and-scythe Gundam from Wing.
kits.lore: Gundam Deathscythe is the stealth-oriented Gundam piloted by Duo Maxwell in Mobile Suit Gundam Wing. Built for covert operations against OZ, it uses its grim reaper imagery and close-range fighting style to stand out among the five Gundams sent to Earth during Operation Meteor.

kits.name: AMX-004 QUBELEY
kits.notes: Its smooth white surfaces, large binder-like shoulders and narrow head silhouette create an elegant contrast to the bulky machines around it. This is Haman's Qubeley, not a Mass Production Qubeley or Qubeley Mk-II.
kits.summary: Its smooth white surfaces, large binder-like shoulders and narrow head silhouette create an elegant contrast to the bulky machines around it.
kits.lore: The Qubeley is Haman Karn's distinctive Neo Zeon Newtype-use mobile suit, famous for its remote funnel weapons and exceptional mobility. It plays a major role in the transition from the Gryps Conflict into the First Neo Zeon War.

kits.name: ZAKU I (KYCILIA'S FORCES)

機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This kit highlights the Zaku I's early-war silhouette and its Kycilia-affiliated equipment or livery. It is different from Char and Black Tri-Stars Zaku I listings.
kits.summary: This kit highlights the Zaku I's early-war silhouette and its Kycilia-affiliated equipment or livery.
kits.lore: The MS-05 Zaku I is one of Zeon's early combat mobile suits, used before the larger-scale deployment of Zaku II models. The Origin includes distinct units assigned to Kycilia Zabi's command.

kits.name: FA-010A FAZZ
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The model's enormous outer shell and oversized cannon arrangement convey the FAZZ's support-artillery silhouette. The similar names must not cause this item to inherit the Full Armor ZZ's story.
kits.summary: The model's enormous outer shell and oversized cannon arrangement convey the FAZZ's support-artillery silhouette.
kits.lore: The FAZZ is a heavily armored test and support machine from Gundam Sentinel, visually related to the Full Armor ZZ Gundam. Unlike Judau's fully functional Full Armor ZZ, the FAZZ serves a different role and uses simplified equipment.

aliases: MG 1/100 ゼータプラステストカラー
ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The MG kit centers on the A1-style Zeta Plus airframe with its characteristic pointed nose and wing geometry. This is not the C1 space variant listed separately.
kits.summary: The MG kit centers on the A1-style Zeta Plus airframe with its characteristic pointed nose and wing geometry.
kits.lore: The Zeta Plus A1 belongs to a line of transformable Gundams descended from the Zeta Gundam. Its atmospheric operation and variable-form layout contrast with later space-optimized versions.

kits.name: RX-77-2 GUNCANNON
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-77-2 ガンキャノン
kits.notes: The recognizable red armor, broad chest and paired shoulder cannons give the Guncannon an unusually sturdy silhouette. Different releases emphasize shoulder articulation, cannon mounting and cockpit details differently. Compare the original Guncannon with The Origin's earlier Guncannon First Type, which represents a separate developmental stage.
kits.summary: White Base’s red, cannon-equipped Earth Federation support mobile suit.
kits.lore: The RX-77-2 Guncannon is an Earth Federation support mobile suit from the One Year War, operated by White Base's crew alongside the original Gundam. Kai Shiden and Hayato Kobayashi are among its best-known pilots. Its shoulder-mounted cannons and substantial armor emphasize dependable medium-range fire support rather than the Gundam's all-purpose dueling role.

kits.name: MSZ-006C1 ZETAPLUS
aliases: MG 1/100 MSZ-006C1 ゼータプラス C1

kits.notes: This MG C1 emphasizes the space-oriented long-range and variable-airframe silhouette. Preserve its C1 identifier to distinguish it from the A1 and from the HG C1 kit.
kits.summary: This MG C1 emphasizes the space-oriented long-range and variable-airframe silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeta Plus C1 takes the Zeta Plus transformable platform into space duty in Gundam Sentinel. Its changes reflect the different equipment needs of vacuum operations.

kits.name: MASTER GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 マスターガンダム

kits.name: KSHATRIYA
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Four large binders dominate Kshatriya’s visual weight and make shelf clearance an important concern. A standard Kshatriya differs from Kshatriya Repaired, which has a visibly altered equipment arrangement. Confirm the exact kit before assuming support equipment or funnel displays are included.
kits.summary: Marida Cruz’s four-binder Neo Zeon mobile suit from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The NZ-666 Kshatriya is a heavily armed Neo Zeon machine operated by Marida Cruz in Gundam Unicorn. Its four enormous wing-like binders conceal powerful weapons and funnels, giving it extraordinary presence despite being a single mobile suit. Kshatriya’s battles showcase Marida’s skill and the harsh legacy of Newtype experimentation within the Universal Century.

kits.name: MS-06 F2 ZAKUⅡ
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This F2 Zaku is identified by the revised torso, lower legs and head proportions of the later variant. Separate captured Federation and Zeon-specific color releases are not collapsed into it.
kits.summary: This F2 Zaku is identified by the revised torso, lower legs and head proportions of the later variant.
kits.lore: The MS-06F2 is a late-model development of the Zaku II that appears on both Zeon and Federation sides around Stardust Memory. Its body refinements make it different from earlier F-type Zakus.

kits.name: RGM-79C GM TYPE C
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This catalog entry explicitly uses the RGM-79C designation and the standard Type C form. The GM Custom RGM-79N is a different machine and should not inherit this description.
kits.summary: This catalog entry explicitly uses the RGM-79C designation and the standard Type C form.
kits.lore: The RGM-79C is the Federation's GM Type C, a mass-production suit used in Stardust Memory's early Universal Century setting. It represents conventional military hardware next to specialized Gundam prototypes.

kits.name: MSN-02 ZEONG
kits.notes: Zeong kits center on the huge torso, broad skirt thrusters, detachable or articulated arm assemblies and lack of conventional legs. Its display demands differ greatly from ordinary standing humanoid Gunpla. Some editions emphasize internal frame detailing, but those features must be checked against the exact grade and release.
kits.summary: Char Aznable’s experimental Newtype mobile suit at A Baoa Qu.
kits.lore: The MSN-02 Zeong is an experimental Zeon Newtype-use mobile suit deployed by Char Aznable near the end of the One Year War. Its unfinished legless appearance becomes central to the climactic confrontation with Amuro Ray's Gundam at A Baoa Qu. Wire-guided hands and powerful beam weapons make it a striking expression of Zeon's late-war experimentation with remote attack systems.

kits.name: GUNDAM SANDROCK CUSTOM EW
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムサンドロック改 EW
kits.notes: The EW Custom is cataloged independently of the original Sandrock and its separate Armadillo Unit edition. Its updated armor language remains a key part of its model identity.
kits.summary: The EW Custom is cataloged independently of the original Sandrock and its separate Armadillo Unit edition.
kits.lore: Quatre's upgraded Sandrock features in the Endless Waltz stage of Gundam Wing, carrying his defensive-minded and close-combat fighting style into the final conflict.

機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This named F2 release retains the later-type Zaku equipment profile. It differs from the base MS-06F Zaku II and from the separately sold commander or location-specific F2 schemes.
kits.summary: This named F2 release retains the later-type Zaku equipment profile.
kits.lore: The MS-06F-2 is an improved later-generation Zaku II present in postwar Zeon and Federation inventories. Stardust Memory uses its familiar but updated silhouette during ground operations.

kits.summary: The kit retains the Local Type's Gundam-inspired structure but emphasizes its North American Front presentation.
kits.lore: The Local Type Gundam reflects the Federation's adaptation of early Gundam-based technology to specific theaters in the Origin/MSD setting. The North American Front designation anchors this interpretation to a particular deployment.

kits.summary: This MS-14 listing specifies Gato's custom Gelgoog rather than his Rick Dom or GP02A Gundam.
kits.lore: Anavel Gato is an ace pilot of the Zeon forces, whose Gelgoog precedes his high-profile role in Operation Stardust. Named machine colors link the earlier mobile suit to his reputation.

kits.summary: This Repair IV model should be kept separate from Exia Repair III, Repair II and the first heavily damaged Repair appearance.
kits.lore: Exia Repair IV is an advanced later reconstruction of the original close-combat GN Gundam. Its development reflects the continued evolution of Celestial Being's iconic sword-focused machine.

kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy's original transformable Gundam, a central machine in the early Gundam Wing story. Its Bird Mode concept combines a mobile-suit body with an aircraft-like alternative configuration.

kits.summary: This HG kit is Heine's named orange-colored GOUF rather than the mass-produced version.
kits.lore: Heine Westenfluss pilots a specially colored GOUF Ignited while serving ZAFT in Gundam SEED Destiny. The machine's melee equipment complements the pilot's brief but memorable appearances.

kits.name: QUBELEY Mk-II (PLE TWO)
aliases: MG 1/100 キュベレイMk-II（プルツー専用機）
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II retains the striking shoulder binders and curved armored form of the original Qubeley. Color and edition information are vital: Elpeo Ple and Ple Two versions should be treated as distinct kit releases where appropriate. Do not apply the white original Qubeley’s artwork or markings to a Mk-II by default.
kits.summary: A successor Qubeley used by different Newtype pilots in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: Qubeley Mk-II machines are derived from the original Qubeley and appear in Gundam ZZ under different Newtype pilots, including Elpeo Ple and Ple Two. Although related to Haman Karn’s original mobile suit, each machine has its own colors and narrative role. Funnel-equipped all-range attacks remain the defining combat concept, placing the Mk-II within the wider Axis Newtype weapons program.

kits.name: PERFECT ZEONG
aliases: MG 1/100 パーフェクトジオング
kits.notes: Full legs turn the distinctive Zeong torso and skirt assembly into a towering humanoid silhouette. Perfect Zeong must be cataloged separately from the standard legless Zeong because its overall proportions differ dramatically.
kits.summary: Full legs turn the distinctive Zeong torso and skirt assembly into a towering humanoid silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeong was a late-war Zeon Newtype-use machine built for powerful remote arm attacks. The Perfect Zeong concept imagines a completed legged configuration, unlike the legless machine that fought at A Baoa Qu.

kits.name: FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.name: GUNDAM LEOPARD
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムレオパルド
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gundam Leopard’s solid armor, dark green palette and heavy weapon systems establish an artillery-centered silhouette. It is distinct from the Leopard Destroy upgrade and Build-series custom versions. Kits from different lines may differ considerably in weapon mounting and display possibilities.
kits.summary: Roabea Loy’s heavy-firepower Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GT-9600 Gundam Leopard from After War Gundam X is piloted by Roabea Loy, one of the Freeden’s mobile suit pilots. Its weapons and heavy armor support sustained ground firepower, complementing the more agile Gundam X and Airmaster within the group. Its presence helps define the variety of surviving Gundam technology in the postwar After War era.

kits.name: HI-ZACK
kits.notes: The Hizack keeps a mono-eye head and external pipes but uses revised armor and Federation-era proportions. That hybrid lineage sets it apart from an ordinary One Year War Zaku II kit.
kits.summary: The Hizack keeps a mono-eye head and external pipes but uses revised armor and Federation-era proportions.
kits.lore: The Hizack is a Federation and Titans mass-production mobile suit that visibly continues the earlier Zeon Zaku design language. Its presence symbolizes how postwar Federation forces adopted once-enemy machine concepts.

aliases: MG 1/100 ストライクルージュ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Strike Rouge models are most immediately distinguished by their pink-toned armor and Strike-derived frame. Different releases use Aile, I.W.S.P. or other backpack configurations; these are not interchangeable as factual kit contents. Confirm the exact product title before listing included pack equipment.
kits.summary: Orb’s pink-armored Strike derivative associated with Cagalli.
kits.lore: The MBF-02 Strike Rouge is Orb's reconstruction and adaptation of Strike Gundam technology in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, strongly associated with Cagalli Yula Athha. Its distinctive pink-red armor and upgraded equipment embody Orb's growing role in the Cosmic Era conflict. The machine later continues to serve as an important bridge between the original Strike and newer technologies.

kits.summary: Its spherical head and body, telescoping arm shapes and heavy rounded feet give Acguy a softer silhouette than the Z'Gok or Gogg.
kits.lore: The Acguy is a compact Zeon amphibious mobile suit from the One Year War, recognized for its rounded bear-like outline and deployable arms. It is often associated with covert amphibious operations near enemy installations.

kits.name: NEMO
kits.notes: Nemo models are recognizable by the angular helmet, compact body armor and distinctive green coloration in AEUG service. Unicorn-era and desert-color editions can have alternative palettes or equipment details; those should remain tied to their exact kit versions.
kits.summary: The AEUG’s reliable mass-production mobile suit from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The MSA-003 Nemo is a mass-production mobile suit used by the AEUG in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Produced during the Gryps Conflict, it serves as a practical complement to the group's higher-performance Gundams and custom suits. Its role emphasizes how a resistance-aligned fighting force relies on standardized machines as much as on ace pilots.

kits.name: GYAN

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gyan models center on a narrow helmet-like head, a fencing-style beam saber and an unusual rounded shield design. The relatively slim torso and broad leg armor give it a unique silhouette. Do not confuse the original Gyan with Gyan Strom or Build-series reinterpretations.
kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Kira’s advanced, gold-framed mobile suit from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.notes: The Hi-Nu's broad funnels, flowing armor transitions and distinct blue-and-white identity separate it from the film's RX-93 Nu. This catalog entry represents the named Hi-Nu design rather than a standard Nu recolor.
kits.summary: The Hi-Nu's broad funnels, flowing armor transitions and distinct blue-and-white identity separate it from the film's RX-93 Nu.
kits.lore: Hi-Nu Gundam is associated with the alternative Beltorchika's Children interpretation of Amuro Ray's ultimate mobile suit. It builds on the Nu Gundam idea with a different body, color treatment and fin-funnel configuration.

kits.notes: Its black-and-gray armor, angular head, pistol-oriented presentation and Noir Striker binders define a stealthy silhouette unlike the original Aile Strike. The kit should not inherit standard Strike equipment as though both were the same variant.
kits.summary: The covert-operations Strike Noir Gundam from Stargazer.
kits.lore: Strike Noir Gundam is the black-armored Earth Alliance machine used by Sven Cal Bayang in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer. It is part of the advanced Actaeon Project family, developed for covert and specialized combat roles.
