kits.name: ∀ GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 WD-M01 ターンエーガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Turn A models have a radically different head shape, rounded surfaces and unusual chest construction compared with typical V-fin Gundams. The Moonlight Butterfly effect is associated with the fictional unit; a model’s physical effect parts, if any, depend on the edition. Treat Turn A and the Turn X as separate machines.
kits.summary: Loran Cehack’s ancient Gundam, central to the story of ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn A Gundam is an enigmatic ancient mobile suit discovered in the world of ∀ Gundam. Loran Cehack pilots it amid the conflict between Earth’s people and the returning Moonrace. The machine’s unusual moustache-like facial crest and its connection to the buried history of technology make it one of the most distinctive Gundam designs. Its Moonlight Butterfly system carries enormous narrative significance.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM Ver.Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Banagher’s transforming psycho-frame Gundam from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is a prototype mobile suit central to the events of Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.notes: Force Impulse models highlight a red-white-blue core suit with wing-shaped equipment attached at the back. The modular Silhouette idea is central to its identity, but part separation and transformation engineering differ by kit grade. Keep Force, Sword and Blast Silhouette variations distinct when assigning release-specific features.
kits.summary: The high-mobility Force configuration of Shinn Asuka’s Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam is a ZAFT machine from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny, first piloted by Shinn Asuka. Its modular Silhouette System changes combat capabilities; the Force Silhouette prioritizes speed and mobile aerial fighting. The Impulse's dramatic role during the war also sets it against established pilots and their more famous machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM RX-78-2 ver.2.0
kits.notes: The Ver.2.0 interpretation leans toward the original television-style proportions with refined model articulation. This release should remain separate from the newer Ver.3.0 and Perfect Grade Unleashed constructions.
kits.summary: The Ver.2.0 interpretation leans toward the original television-style proportions with refined model articulation.
kits.lore: Amuro Ray's RX-78-2 becomes the Federation's best-known mobile suit during the One Year War, combining agile mobility with beam weapons and a legendary combat record. Its visual vocabulary remains the basis of later Gundam protagonists.

kits.notes: This G-Fighter listing is for the aircraft-like support machine rather than the full G-Armor configuration. Its angular hull and capacity to interact with Gundam equipment define the design context.
kits.summary: This G-Fighter listing is for the aircraft-like support machine rather than the full G-Armor configuration.
kits.lore: The G-Fighter is a Federation support vehicle designed to transport and combine with the RX-78-2 Gundam. It reflects early Gundam's modular support-unit approach before fully integrated transformable mobile suits became common.

aliases: MG 1/100 インフィニットジャスティスガンダム

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Infinite Justice is recognizable by its vivid pink-red armor and the Fatum-01 lifter. Leg-mounted beam weapon themes give it a different silhouette and combat presentation from the earlier Justice. Do not mix it with the Infinite Justice Type II, whose updated design belongs to a later story.
kits.summary: Athrun’s upgraded Justice Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X19A Infinite Justice Gundam is Athrun Zala’s advanced successor to the original Justice in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It maintains the mobile suit’s characteristic high-mobility flight equipment while bringing a stronger close-combat emphasis to the final conflict. It forms a memorable pairing with Kira’s Strike Freedom in the story’s late battles.

kits.name: SINANJU
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Sinanju’s gold-on-red Sleeves ornamentation, complex curved armor and substantial backpack are defining display details. Consider how a kit renders the trim and its long weapon silhouettes. Sinanju Stein and recolored Build-series machines are different releases and should not automatically inherit standard Sinanju-specific modeling notes.
kits.summary: Full Frontal’s ornate red command mobile suit in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The MSN-06S Sinanju is Full Frontal’s red command mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its exceptional mobility, elaborate gold markings and heavy equipment support the masked leader of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. Its rivalry with the Unicorn Gundam gives the machine a prominent role in the struggle over Laplace’s Box.

kits.name: GUNTANK
kits.notes: Guntank models are defined by the long cannon barrels, tread assemblies and wide armored torso. The vehicle-like running gear makes it visually distinct from legged Gunpla. The original RX-75 should not be confused with the Guntank Early Type from The Origin, which depicts a different machine and development context.
kits.summary: The tracked Project V support machine accompanying White Base.
kits.lore: The RX-75 Guntank is one of the earliest Earth Federation Project V machines in Mobile Suit Gundam. Piloted during the One Year War by White Base personnel, it combines a tracked lower body with large-caliber shoulder weapons. Its hybrid tank-and-mobile-suit configuration shows the Federation's experimentation before humanoid Gundams became the dominant symbol of the project.

kits.name: SWORD IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 ソードインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The Sword Silhouette gives the Impulse an unmistakable close-combat look through its large blades and related red equipment. This kit should remain distinct from Force Impulse releases: the central mobile suit shares a design lineage, but the backpack and posing priorities differ greatly.
kits.summary: The close-combat Sword Silhouette version of the Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: Sword Impulse is a melee-focused configuration of the ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. With the Sword Silhouette fitted, the machine changes from flexible ranged movement to aggressive close combat. Shinn Asuka uses the Impulse's different loadouts to respond to the demands of the battlefield, underscoring ZAFT's modular approach.

aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムエクシア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Setsuna’s original Seven Swords mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents. It later undergoes major repairs and modifications following the first season’s battles.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept

kits.name: MS-06J ZAKUⅡ WHITE AUGER
aliases: MG 1/100 MS-06J ザク Ver.2.0 “ホワイトオーガー”
機動戦士ガンダム MS IGLOO

aliases: HGBF 1/144 ういにんぐふみな

aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムアストレイレッドフレーム改
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FRAME 2nd REVISE
aliases: MG 1/100 GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FRAME 2nd REVISE
MG 1/100 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレームセカンドリバイ
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Blue armor highlights, an angular modified body and the large Tactical Arms equipment distinguish Second Revise from the original Blue Frame. It is separate from other Blue Frame Second variants and should retain its own edition-specific identity.
kits.summary: A heavily revised version of Gai Murakumo's Astray Blue Frame.
kits.lore: The Astray Blue Frame Second Revise is a heavily modified version of Gai Murakumo's mercenary-use Blue Frame in the Gundam SEED Astray chronology. It demonstrates the machine's evolution through customized tactical equipment rather than an entirely new Orb prototype.

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA (IGNITION MODE)
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムエクシアイグニッションモード
kits.notes: The Ignition Mode edition emphasizes a particular presentation of Exia's familiar slim proportions, curved GN condenser details and sword-bearing body. It should not be confused with Exia Repair or other alternate Exia products.
kits.summary: The Ignition Mode edition emphasizes a particular presentation of Exia's familiar slim proportions, curved GN condenser details and sword-bearing body.
kits.lore: Gundam Exia is Setsuna F. Seiei's close-combat Gundam in the first season of Gundam 00. Its GN Drive, sword-focused armament and distinctive seven-sword concept make it one of Celestial Being's defining mobile suits.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM SCREEN IMAGE
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-0 ユニコーンガンダム

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムエクシア（トランザムモード）グロスインジェクションVer.
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Mode release highlights the different state of the original Exia design, centering the recognizable head, GN condenser surfaces and sleek limbs. The edition is separate from normal-color and Repair Exia kits.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Mode release highlights the different state of the original Exia design, centering the recognizable head, GN condenser surfaces and sleek limbs.
kits.lore: Trans-Am is a temporary high-output system employed by Celestial Being's true GN Drive-equipped Gundams. This Exia edition represents Setsuna's close-combat machine in that energized state, not a new in-fiction successor to Exia.

kits.name: RX-78-3 G3 GUNDAM Ver.2.0
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-78-3 G-3ガンダム Ver.2.0

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM SCREEN IMAGE SPECIAL
aliases: MG 1/100 UNICORN GUNDAM SCREEN IMAGE SPECIAL
MG 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム HDカラー+MS CAGE

kits.name: WING GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 ウイングガンダム
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Bird Mode silhouette and Buster Rifle are the most recognizable features of this original Wing Gundam. It should not be confused with Wing Gundam Zero, whose weaponry, systems and body configuration are significantly different.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Heero’s first Operation Meteor Gundam, noted for Bird Mode.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy’s primary machine early in Gundam Wing. Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.name: DEATHSCYTHE HELL EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムデスサイズヘル EW
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The large black active cloak assemblies are key to displaying Deathscythe Hell EW. Compare their folded and opened shapes when selecting poses. A standard Deathscythe, television Deathscythe Hell and Endless Waltz Deathscythe Hell are separate visual designs.
kits.summary: Duo Maxwell’s cloak-equipped Deathscythe Hell from Endless Waltz.
kits.lore: Gundam Deathscythe Hell appears in its Endless Waltz form as Duo Maxwell’s close-range machine. Compared with the earlier Deathscythe design, its cloak-like active cloak armor and winged silhouette reinforce its association with stealth and sudden attack. Its signature beam scythe evokes the grim-reaper imagery that characterizes Duo’s Gundam.

kits.name: REVERSIBLE GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 リバーシブルガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: GUNDAM DEATHSCYTHE EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 XXXG-01D ガンダムデスサイズEW(エンドレスワルツ版)
kits.notes: This MG Deathscythe EW edition emphasizes the ordinary EW design, not Deathscythe Hell or the special Rousette Unit. The revised armor contours are edition-specific.
kits.summary: This MG Deathscythe EW edition emphasizes the ordinary EW design, not Deathscythe Hell or the special Rousette Unit.
kits.lore: Duo Maxwell pilots Deathscythe, a stealth-oriented Gundam whose beam scythe and close-combat focus are central to Gundam Wing. Its Endless Waltz version adopts a distinct visual interpretation.

kits.name: FULL ARMOR GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 フルアーマーガンダム
kits.notes: The layered armor and additional mounted artillery give this suit its signature full-armor appearance. It should not be merged with Full Armor Unicorn or other later uses of the term.
kits.summary: The layered armor and additional mounted artillery give this suit its signature full-armor appearance.
kits.lore: The Full Armor Gundam is a classic MSV plan to reinforce an RX-78-family mobile suit with heavy armor and extra weapons. Its green-toned armored profile differs from the deployed tricolor RX-78-2.

kits.name: CORE BOOSTER Ver.Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 コア・ブースター Ver.ka

kits.name: THE・O
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The-O combines broad yellow armor, thick legs, large skirt sections and a surprisingly small head. Its hidden sub-arms are an important identity feature; check how a particular kit represents them. The machine’s bulk makes balance and support more relevant to display planning than its seemingly simple weapon silhouette suggests.
kits.summary: Paptimus Scirocco’s massive, highly responsive mobile suit from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The PMX-003 The-O is Paptimus Scirocco’s personal machine in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Designed around extreme responsiveness and close-quarters combat, it appears massive and heavily armored despite emphasizing control in the hands of its exceptionally capable pilot. Its hidden sub-arms create unexpected possibilities in melee combat. The-O takes a central role in the final battles of the Gryps Conflict.

kits.name: RE-ZEL
kits.notes: ReZEL models have a slim Zeta-descended silhouette with a distinct head and a flight-oriented transformation concept. Commander types, Type-C versions and Defenser packages change equipment and must be treated as separate configurations rather than identical standard kits.
kits.summary: The Federation’s transformable escort mobile suit from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The RGZ-95 ReZEL is an Earth Federation transformable mass-production mobile suit featured in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its name stands for Refined Zeta Gundam Escort Leader and reflects the continued influence of transformable Zeta-series technology. ReZEL units support the fleet and demonstrate how once-experimental design ideas reached organized Federation service.

kits.name: RE-ZEL COMMANDER TYPE
aliases: MG 1/100 RZG-95C リゼル(隊長機)
kits.notes: This entry represents the Commander Type rather than the ordinary ReZEL or General Revil Type-C. Its named equipment configuration is kept separate for collector accuracy.
kits.summary: This entry represents the Commander Type rather than the ordinary ReZEL or General Revil Type-C.
kits.lore: The ReZEL Commander Type is a leader variant of the Federation's transformable ReZEL series. It retains the family's Zeta-inspired transformation idea while introducing command-oriented equipment differences.

kits.name: XXXG-01S SHENLONG GUNDAM EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 XXXG-01S SHENLONG GUNDAM EW VER.
MG 1/100 XXXG-01S シェンロンガンダム EW
kits.notes: This MG Shenlong EW version is the baseline EW-style machine, separate from the Liaoya Unit upgrade and from the double-dragon Altron. Keep the full model title distinct.
kits.summary: This MG Shenlong EW version is the baseline EW-style machine, separate from the Liaoya Unit upgrade and from the double-dragon Altron.
kits.lore: Chang Wufei's Shenlong Gundam reflects his preference for fierce close-range fighting, especially with dragon-inspired equipment. The Endless Waltz interpretation refines its appearance.

kits.name: OO GUNDAM SEVEN SWORD/G
aliases: MG 1/100 ダブルオーガンダム セブンソード/G
kits.notes: This model is specifically the Seven Sword/G form, not the Seven Sword without /G, and not the O Raiser pairing. The weapon-oriented silhouette is the principal difference.
kits.summary: This model is specifically the Seven Sword/G form, not the Seven Sword without /G, and not the O Raiser pairing.
kits.lore: The 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G builds on Setsuna's Twin Drive Gundam with an array of melee weapons and a gun-capable sword. The configuration expands on the earlier Seven Sword concept.

kits.name: OO RAISER
aliases: MG 1/100 ダブルオーライザー
kits.notes: 00 Raiser kits add the 0 Raiser equipment to the already recognizable twin-shouldered 00 Gundam, creating a wider backpack profile. Whether the support craft separates, and how its wings and joints work, depends on the exact release. Full Saber and special Trans-Am editions have distinct identities.
kits.summary: The combined 00 Gundam and 0 Raiser from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The 00 Raiser combines Setsuna F. Seiei's 00 Gundam with Saji Crossroad's 0 Raiser support craft in Mobile Suit Gundam 00. The combined machine is central to unlocking the Twin Drive System's potential and becomes a major symbol of the story's second season. Its capabilities and partnership reflect the series' growing focus on mutual understanding and change.

kits.name: XXXG-01W WING GUNDAM EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 XXXG-01W WING GUNDAM EW VER.
MG 1/100 XXXG-01W ウイングガンダム EW
kits.notes: This MG Wing Gundam EW edition features the Katoki-influenced silhouette without becoming a Wing Zero or Zero EW release. Its original Wing identity remains separate.
kits.summary: This MG Wing Gundam EW edition features the Katoki-influenced silhouette without becoming a Wing Zero or Zero EW release.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is a transformable Gundam associated with Heero Yuy at the beginning of Gundam Wing. The Endless Waltz mechanical designs provide another visual treatment for the five Gundams.

kits.name: GUNDAM EPYON EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムエピオン EW
kits.notes: The MG EW version highlights Epyon's dragon-like profile, whip and sword-centered design language. This is a specific EW-styled edition, not the television kit.
kits.summary: The MG EW version highlights Epyon's dragon-like profile, whip and sword-centered design language.
kits.lore: Gundam Epyon is a formidable melee-focused machine in Gundam Wing, tied to Treize Khushrenada and later Zechs Merquise. Its rejection of ranged weapons makes it a striking contrast to Wing Zero.

kits.name: DELTA PLUS
kits.notes: Delta Plus is recognizable for its muted gray armor, long proportions and sharply swept transformation geometry. Its wave-rider identity can make stands and transformed displays significant, but the specific transformation mechanism depends on grade and release.
kits.summary: Riddhe Marcenas’s transformable Londo Bell mobile suit.
kits.lore: The MSN-001A1 Delta Plus is a transformable mobile suit used by the Earth Federation's Londo Bell forces in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Riddhe Marcenas pilots the machine before later events change his role. Based on the Delta development line, its design combines a sleek mobile suit form with a high-speed wave-rider configuration.

kits.name: RX-0 FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM VER. Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-0 FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM VER. Ka
MG 1/100 RX-0 フルアーマーユニコーンガンダムVer.Ka
kits.notes: This specific Ver.Ka Full Armor Unicorn is a separately named product with its own large weapon-packed visual treatment. It is cataloged apart from HG Destroy Mode versions.
kits.summary: This specific Ver.Ka Full Armor Unicorn is a separately named product with its own large weapon-packed visual treatment.
kits.lore: The Full Armor Unicorn Gundam equips Banagher's RX-0 with an extensive assortment of external weapons in the closing conflict of Unicorn. The Ver.Ka presentation reflects the distinctive Hajime Katoki interpretation.

kits.name: GUNDAM SANDROCK EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 XXXG-01SR ガンダムサンドロック EW
kits.notes: This MG EW edition depicts the baseline Endless Waltz-styled Sandrock, rather than the Armadillo Unit or the separately named Sandrock Custom EW kit.
kits.summary: This MG EW edition depicts the baseline Endless Waltz-styled Sandrock, rather than the Armadillo Unit or the separately named Sandrock Custom EW kit.
kits.lore: Quatre's Gundam Sandrock emphasizes defense and heat-shotel melee fighting. Its loyal Maganac allies underline Sandrock's support and leadership role in Gundam Wing.

kits.name: GUNDAM HEAVYARMS EW VER.
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムヘビーアームズ EW
kits.notes: This MG Heavyarms EW edition represents the baseline Gundam design without Igel equipment or the later Custom changes. Its built-in weapons remain central to its visual identity.
kits.summary: This MG Heavyarms EW edition represents the baseline Gundam design without Igel equipment or the later Custom changes.
kits.lore: Trowa Barton's Heavyarms uses a heavy armament doctrine in Gundam Wing, packing extensive guns and missiles onto a single Gundam. The Endless Waltz visual line revisits its original form.

kits.name: RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM 2 BANSHEE
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-0 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ
kits.notes: The RX-0 unit-two Banshee release should remain separate from Banshee Norn and specialized transformed-state products. The dark armor with gold details defines its look.
kits.summary: The RX-0 unit-two Banshee release should remain separate from Banshee Norn and specialized transformed-state products.
kits.lore: Banshee is the dark second unit of the Unicorn project, a psycho-frame Gundam associated with the Vist Foundation and the Earth Federation. Its visual identity contrasts sharply with the white first unit.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 NORMAL
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-1 ノーマル
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The core AGE-1 design has a white-and-blue body with bright chest markings. Normal, Titus and Spallow are distinct wearable configurations; compare the full kit names rather than assuming different AGE-1 packages contain interchangeable pieces.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Flit Asuno’s adaptable first-generation Gundam from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-1 is Flit Asuno’s mobile suit in the first generation of Gundam AGE. Developed around the AGE System, it uses an adaptive technology concept in which combat data can guide the creation of new equipment. AGE-1 has several specialized wear configurations, allowing the original Normal form to evolve for different battlefield demands. Its history anchors the series’ multi-generational narrative.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 TITUS
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-1 タイタス
kits.notes: Titus is immediately recognizable by oversized red shoulder and leg armor, thick fists, and a weighty fighting stance. The visual identity is its muscular combat-oriented Wear rather than the slim AGE-1 Normal; release-specific effects or parts must be checked against the correct kit manual.
kits.summary: The close-combat, heavily armored Titus configuration of Gundam AGE-1.
kits.lore: In Mobile Suit Gundam AGE, Flit Asuno equips the Gundam AGE-1 with the Titus Wear to confront opponents its standard equipment struggles to stop. The AGE System develops this heavily built configuration for hand-to-hand fighting, placing physical power and close-range pressure ahead of the Normal form’s balanced proportions.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 SPALLOW
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-1 スパロー
kits.notes: Spallow models emphasize a narrow blue-and-white figure, a light-footed stance, and the distinctive short-blade identity of the form. Its reduced armor volume visually distinguishes it from both standard AGE-1 and the bulky Titus Wear; verify exactly which weapon parts each edition includes.
kits.summary: The nimble AGE-1 Spallow Wear created for fast, close-range fighting.
kits.lore: The AGE-1 Spallow is a second specialized Wear developed through the AGE System during Flit Asuno’s battles in Gundam AGE. Where Titus favors brute strength, Spallow is designed for high-speed attacks and evasive movement, using a nimble ninja-like approach to counter fast enemy machines.
highlights: Contrasts with the heavy Titus form

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 NORMAL
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-2 ノーマル
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
AGE-2 Normal kits are identified by their sharp shoulders, wing-like armor and white-blue palette. The later Dark Hound version changes the machine’s identity, colors and equipment, and should be kept separate. Verify the release’s actual transformation instructions rather than assuming identical gimmicks across grades.
kits.summary: Asemu Asuno’s transforming Gundam AGE-2 Normal.
kits.lore: The AGE-2 Gundam AGE-2 Normal becomes Asemu Asuno’s principal Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE. Its fast-moving transformable design contrasts with the AGE-1’s earlier configuration, reflecting the next stage in the Asuno family’s story. The AGE-2 combines a sharp wing-like profile with mobile suit and flight-oriented operation.

kits.name: DUEL GUNDAM ASSAULTSHROUD
aliases: MG 1/100 デュエルガンダム アサルトシュラウド
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The heavy Assault Shroud armor visibly thickens Duel's shoulders, chest and legs, giving it a bulkier identity than the base Duel Gundam. The added shell is the key design distinction; exact removability depends on the kit.
kits.summary: Duel Gundam fitted with its heavier Assault Shroud equipment.
kits.lore: Duel Gundam is one of the Earth Alliance GAT-X prototypes stolen by ZAFT in Gundam SEED and piloted by Yzak Joule. Its Assault Shroud equipment adds armor and weaponry, adapting the relatively straightforward Duel to more demanding front-line engagements.

kits.name: BUSTER GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 バスターガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Buster has an unusually heavy gun-platform silhouette, with long weapons and mounting hardware shaping its outline. This is a better reference for long-range posing than agile sword duels. Exact weapon connections and pose support vary among MG and HG editions.
kits.summary: A long-range support Gundam piloted by Dearka Elsman in Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X103 Buster Gundam is another Earth Alliance machine captured by ZAFT during the Heliopolis raid. Dearka Elsman pilots it as a long-range fire-support unit, using a high-energy rifle and gun launcher that can combine for specialized attacks. Its combat role contrasts with the sword-focused Blitz and versatile Duel in the original five GAT-X machines.

kits.name: BLITZ GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 ブリッツガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blitz has dark armor, angular limbs and a large multifunction shield-mounted weapon system. The aggressive black-purple silhouette contrasts sharply with the brighter Duel and Aegis. Any included effect parts and the execution of its stealth-oriented equipment depend on the specific release.
kits.summary: Nicol Amalfi’s stealth-focused GAT-X machine from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X207 Blitz Gundam is a stolen Earth Alliance prototype piloted by Nicol Amalfi in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Its Mirage Colloid technology allows stealthy approaches that conventional mobile suits cannot easily counter. Nicol’s deployment of the Blitz becomes important in the escalating conflict between the Archangel crew and ZAFT pursuit forces.

kits.name: NEW GUNDAM Ver. Ka
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: This Ver.Ka-labeled Nu Gundam emphasizes detailed exterior panels and modernized proportions compared with older depictions. The entry should be distinguished from regular Nu listings and Heavy Weapon System versions.
kits.summary: This Ver.Ka-labeled Nu Gundam emphasizes detailed exterior panels and modernized proportions compared with older depictions.
kits.lore: The Nu Gundam is Amuro Ray's psycho-frame mobile suit from Char's Counterattack, famous for its fin funnels and asymmetric backpack profile. Ver.Ka releases reinterpret the design with contemporary model engineering and detailing.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 DARK HOUND
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-2 ダークハウンド
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Dark Hound’s black armor, pirate-like insignia and revised head and weapon forms distinguish it from the original AGE-2. Many parts retain a recognizable AGE-2 family outline, but the finished display tells a different story. Choose the correct kit edition to avoid mixing equipment from Normal and Dark Hound.
kits.summary: The pirate-styled later configuration of Asemu Asuno’s AGE-2.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-2 Dark Hound is the dramatically modified successor to the original AGE-2 used by Asemu Asuno under a new identity. Its dark pirate-inspired appearance reflects a different stage of the Gundam AGE story and a changed set of combat priorities. It should be treated as a distinct configuration rather than a simple alternate color of AGE-2 Normal.

kits.name: MSN-06S SINANJU STEIN Ver. Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 MSN-06S SINANJU STEIN Ver. Ka
MG 1/100 MSN-06S シナンジュ・スタイン Ver.Ka
kits.notes: The Ver.Ka Stein version emphasizes the earlier prototype styling instead of the characteristic red Sleeves commander form. Preserve the Stein name when matching catalog entries.
kits.summary: The Ver.Ka Stein version emphasizes the earlier prototype styling instead of the characteristic red Sleeves commander form.
kits.lore: Sinanju Stein is the prototype form connected to the Sinanju developed from Federation test technology. Its pale armor and different head profile contrast with Full Frontal's later red Sinanju.

kits.name: ReZEL TYPE-C (DEFENSER a+b UNIT/GENERAL REVIL)
aliases: MG 1/100 ReZEL TYPE-C (DEFENSER a+b UNIT/GENERAL REVIL)
MG 1/100 リゼルC型(ディフェンサーa+bユニット/ゼネラル・レビル配備機)

kits.name: WING GUNDAM PROTO-ZERO EW
aliases: MG 1/100 ウイングガンダム プロトゼロ EW
kits.notes: This MG Proto Zero edition centers on the television-like wing layout within an EW mechanical styling. Its Proto Zero designation distinguishes it from standard Wing Zero and Wing Zero EW.
kits.summary: This MG Proto Zero edition centers on the television-like wing layout within an EW mechanical styling.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam Proto Zero is a Glory of the Losers reinterpretation connected to Wing Zero's development and story presentation. It retains the ZERO System lineage without using the feather-wing appearance of Zero EW.

kits.name: JESTA
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Jesta kit is recognizable by its dark armor, compact sensor-rich head and broad tactical proportions. The normal Jesta should be distinguished from the heavier Jesta Cannon and Shezarr Team configurations. Different model grades interpret the shoulders, shield system and backpack proportions in their own ways.
kits.summary: A high-performance Londo Bell unit featured alongside the Unicorn Gundam.
kits.lore: The RGM-96X Jesta appears in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn as a high-performance Federation unit connected with Londo Bell and the Ra Cailum. Developed with support for special missions involving the Unicorn Gundam, it combines a subdued tactical appearance with the versatility expected of a modern general-purpose mobile suit. Its deployment underlines how conventional Federation forces operate alongside far more exceptional Newtype-use machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM LIGHTNING BLACK WARRIOR
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムライトニングブラックウォーリア
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM Ver.3.0
kits.notes: The Master Grade Ver.3.0 version draws on modernized statue-inspired detailing, with layered surface work and articulated armor. It is not the same kit as the more anime-like Ver.2.0 or large Perfect Grade versions.
kits.summary: The Master Grade Ver.3.0 version draws on modernized statue-inspired detailing, with layered surface work and articulated armor.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 was the advanced Federation prototype piloted by Amuro Ray in the One Year War, later becoming a landmark icon for Gundam. Ver.3.0 revisits this famous machine through a distinct model-engineering approach.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 DOUBLE BULLET
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGE-2 ダブルバレット
kits.notes: Long equipment binders, bulkier upper-body detailing and a broad combat stance make Double Bullet easy to distinguish from AGE-2 Normal. Its large weapon-bearing silhouette is the core feature; transformations and supplied accessories vary by kit edition.
kits.summary: Asemu’s heavy-firepower Double Bullet configuration of Gundam AGE-2.
kits.lore: The AGE-2 Double Bullet is a heavily armed Wear used by Asemu Asuno in the second generation of Gundam AGE. Built to fight multiple opponents, this configuration trades the normal AGE-2’s straightforward flight emphasis for a striking increase in ranged and close-range firepower.

kits.name: BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM FULL PACKAGE
aliases: MG 1/100 BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM FULL PACKAGE
MG 1/100 ビルドストライクガンダム フルパッケージ
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Build Booster, distinctive blue-white-red armor and revised Strike-style detailing identify the Full Package build. It is separate from the later Star Build Strike and subsequent Galaxy Cosmos descendants.
kits.summary: Sei and Reiji's early Build Strike Gundam Full Package.
kits.lore: Build Strike Gundam Full Package is Sei Iori's early customized Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters, based on the Cosmic Era Strike Gundam. With Reiji as pilot, it introduces the creative team dynamic that drives the first series.
highlights: Sei Iori and Reiji's first main Gunpla

kits.name: BUILD GUNDAM Mk-Ⅱ
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: UNIVERSE BOOSTER
aliases: MG 1/100 ユニバースブースター
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: STRIKE ROUGE (OOTORI UNIT) Ver.RM
aliases: MG 1/100 ストライクルージュ オオトリ装備 Ver.RM
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 03 PHENEX
aliases: MG 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム3号機フェネクス
kits.notes: Gold plating or gold-colored armor and twin sweeping Armed Armor DE binders define the Phenex's appearance. Editions depict different psychoframe colors and narrative versions; these must remain separate rather than assuming one Phenex design covers every kit.
kits.summary: The golden third Unicorn-type mobile suit known as Phenex.
kits.lore: The Phenex is Unicorn Gundam Unit 03, an RX-0-series machine recognizable for its gold-colored exterior and birdlike Armed Armor DE equipment. Its story spans Gundam Unicorn-related material and Gundam Narrative, where the machine becomes closely tied to the mystery of Rita Bernal.

kits.name: STRIKER GN-X
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ストライカージンクス
ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: TURN X
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Turn X’s angular, mismatched armor and prominent chest element distinguish it immediately from Turn A. Its fictional separation features are an important design reference, but a given model’s actual gimmicks must be checked release by release. The standard Turn X should not be conflated with special coating versions.
kits.summary: The asymmetric rival to Turn A Gundam in ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn X is a formidable machine associated with Gym Ghingnham in ∀ Gundam. It stands opposite the Turn A and shares connections to the story’s mysterious high-technology past. Its unusual asymmetric body and ability to separate components make it a striking antagonist design, while its relationship to the Moonlight Butterfly system gives its battles unusual scale.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FLAME D
aliases: MG 1/100 GUNDAM ASTRAY BLUE FLAME D
MG 1/100 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレームD
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: GUNDAM DOUBLE X
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムダブルエックス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Double X’s reflector panels and twin cannon equipment are central to its appearance. The opened reflector pose requires more space than a compact neutral stance. Do not confuse the Double X with the earlier Gundam X, whose satellite weapon arrangement is different.
kits.summary: Garrod Ran’s Twin Satellite Cannon Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GX-9901-DX Gundam Double X is Garrod Ran’s upgraded mobile suit in After War Gundam X. Developed around satellite-cannon technology, its silhouette features large reflector assemblies that open to support the Twin Satellite Cannon. Its place in the story is inseparable from the postwar world’s conflict over the use and fear of devastating weapons.

kits.name: RX-78-02 GUNDAM (THE ORIGIN)
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-78-02 ガンダム(GUNDAM  THE ORIGIN版)
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This MG release represents the specifically titled Origin RX-78-02, with its own revised armor lines and interpretation of the first Gundam. It is not the standard RX-78-2 Ver.3.0.
kits.summary: This MG release represents the specifically titled Origin RX-78-02, with its own revised armor lines and interpretation of the first Gundam.
kits.lore: The RX-78-02 is the Origin continuity's interpretation of Amuro Ray's famous Federation Gundam. Its design updates the classic prototype with a different mechanical and visual treatment.

kits.name: FREEDOM GUNDAM Ver.2.0
aliases: MG 1/100 フリーダムガンダム Ver.2.0
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The Ver.2.0 design emphasizes reworked armor separation, large wing binders and Freedom's familiar multi-weapon silhouette. Keep the edition distinguished from the original MG and special-coating releases; kit-specific mechanics should be verified with its manual.
kits.summary: The revised MG Ver.2.0 interpretation of Kira's Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is the ZGMF-X10A machine piloted by Kira Yamato in Gundam SEED, central to his effort to resist escalating warfare. The Master Grade Ver.2.0 edition revisits the design as a new kit interpretation rather than an in-fiction Freedom Gundam successor.

kits.name: GM SNIPERII
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: MG 1/100 ジム・スナイパーII
機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes: The design's deep visor, specialized head and angular armor separate it from the ordinary GM Command. This Sniper II listing is not interchangeable with the ace-color or other-series releases.
kits.summary: The design's deep visor, specialized head and angular armor separate it from the ordinary GM Command.
kits.lore: The GM Sniper II is an advanced Federation mobile suit derived from the GM Command development line. It appears as a capable late-war machine in War in the Pocket, where a strong long-range role shapes its identity.

kits.name: JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 ジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Justice is distinguished by its red-pink body and broad Fatum backpack, which creates a striking airborne silhouette. Be sure to differentiate it from Infinite Justice and later Justice variants; the lifter, colors and armor shape are not interchangeable. Different kits may offer different display options for the flight unit.
kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.

kits.name: PLAN303E DEEP STRIKER
aliases: MG 1/100 PLAN303E ディープストライカー
ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This MG release is identified by its huge cannon, tanks and booster-heavy configuration. It is a highly specialized S Gundam derivative, not a standard Ex-S Gundam or an ordinary backpack upgrade.
kits.summary: This MG release is identified by its huge cannon, tanks and booster-heavy configuration.
kits.lore: The PLAN303E Deep Striker is an extreme long-range assault concept associated with Gundam Sentinel's S Gundam family. The enormous booster and cannon system pushes the design far beyond a conventional humanoid mobile suit.

kits.name: ZZ GUNDAM Ver.Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 ダブルゼータガンダム Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The ZZ design is more heavily built than the Zeta Gundam, with substantial shoulder and leg armor and a distinctive forehead cannon. Different grades vary in how they realize transformation and combination. A standard ZZ, Enhanced ZZ and Full Armor ZZ are not interchangeable catalog entries.
kits.summary: Judau Ashta’s high-firepower transformable Gundam in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The MSZ-010 ZZ Gundam becomes Judau Ashta’s principal machine during Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ. It continues the transformable Gundam lineage while taking the concept toward greater firepower. Its combination system allows the machine to divide into components, and the powerful high-mega cannon in its forehead is one of its signature weapons. The ZZ is central to the AEUG’s struggle against the renewed Neo Zeon threat.

kits.name: 00 QAN[T] FULL SABER
aliases: MG 1/100 ダブルオークアンタフルセイバー

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE Ver.Ka
aliases: MG 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ Ver.Ka

kits.name: SINANJU STEIN (NARRATIVE Ver.)
aliases: MG 1/100 シナンジュ・スタイン（ナラティブVer.）
機動戦士ガンダムNT（ナラティブ）
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Stein’s more restrained armor and shoulder shapes are the clearest contrast with the Sinanju. Narrative version details and markings must be checked against the specific box, especially when comparing Ver.Ka and earlier editions. Do not replace a Stein catalog entry with standard Sinanju artwork.
kits.summary: A white-armored Sinanju-line mobile suit seen in Gundam Narrative.
kits.lore: Sinanju Stein represents the development lineage behind the red Sinanju. The Narrative version appears in Gundam Narrative in connection with Zoltan Akkanen and the Neo Zeon remnant forces. Its paler, straighter-edged armor makes it visibly different from Full Frontal’s highly ornamented red machine. Version labels matter, because Unicorn and Narrative interpretations are not necessarily the same depicted configuration.

kits.name: Ex-S GUNDAM/S GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 Ex-Sガンダム/Sガンダム
ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This MG listing explicitly names both the S Gundam and Ex-S configuration family. It should remain distinct from the Task Force Alpha-branded color edition and stand-alone Ex-S models.
kits.summary: This MG listing explicitly names both the S Gundam and Ex-S configuration family.
kits.lore: The Gundam Sentinel story centers on Task Force Alpha's S Gundam and its ALICE system. Equipping the machine as the Ex-S greatly strengthens its armor and combat systems.

kits.name: GUNDAM NT-1 Ver.2.0
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes: The MG Ver.2.0 represents Alex with updated model-engineering priorities while keeping its defining white-blue armor and test-unit identity. Keep this version separate from the earlier Alex MG.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.2.0 represents Alex with updated model-engineering priorities while keeping its defining white-blue armor and test-unit identity.
kits.lore: The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex was prepared as a high-performance Federation machine for Newtype use. Christina Mackenzie becomes its test pilot in War in the Pocket, where it faces Bernie's Zaku II Kai.

kits.name: GUNNER ZAKU WARRIOR [LUNAMARIA HAWKE CUSTOM]
aliases: MG 1/100 GUNNER ZAKU WARRIOR [LUNAMARIA HAWKE CUSTOM]
MG 1/100 ガナーザクウォーリア（ルナマリア・ホーク専用機）
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: The HG kit is specifically Lunamaria's red Gunner configuration, distinct from plain green ZAKU Warriors and other pilots' weapon packs. Keep the named pilot and equipment together.
kits.summary: The HG kit is specifically Lunamaria's red Gunner configuration, distinct from plain green ZAKU Warriors and other pilots' weapon packs.
kits.lore: Lunamaria Hawke pilots a red ZAFT ZAKU Warrior with the Gunner Wizard equipment in Gundam SEED Destiny. Its long-range cannon emphasizes support fire from a flexible Wizard-system mobile suit.

kits.name: FAZZ Ver.Ka
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This Ver.Ka release applies a specific Katoki-styled interpretation of the FAZZ's angular armored surfaces. Keep the name and edition distinct from standard FAZZ and Full Armor ZZ kits.
kits.summary: This Ver.Ka release applies a specific Katoki-styled interpretation of the FAZZ's angular armored surfaces.
kits.lore: The FAZZ is Gundam Sentinel's heavy armor test machine, visually echoing the Full Armor ZZ but lacking the same intended deployment role. Its massive cannon and armor are defining design features.

kits.name: GUNDAM KYRIOS
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムキュリオス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Kyrios design combines an orange-and-white color scheme with a pointed, aircraft-influenced silhouette. Its transformation is the most obvious design difference from Exia and Dynames. Whether a model performs a full conversion or uses alternative parts depends on the specific grade and release.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s transformable Gundam piloted by Allelujah Haptism.
kits.lore: The GN-003 Gundam Kyrios is a transformable Gundam operated by Celestial Being in Gundam 00. Allelujah Haptism pilots it and makes use of its aircraft-like form for high-speed operations. Kyrios complements the first-generation Gundam team by giving it mobility and transformation options alongside the other units’ specialist roles.

kits.name: GUNDAM FSD
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The model's more utilitarian Gundam proportions and distinctive equipment layout are central to its identity. The name identifies a separate Gundam FSD rather than a plain Origin RX-78-02.
kits.summary: The model's more utilitarian Gundam proportions and distinctive equipment layout are central to its identity.
kits.lore: The Gundam FSD belongs to the Origin/MSD development lineage, expanding Federation prototypes toward broader practical use. The FSD designation highlights a machine with a different equipment role from the main RX-78-02.

kits.name: DOM
kits.notes: Dom kits favor broad shoulders, flared lower-leg armor and a wide hover-equipped stance. Its purple-and-black color arrangement is one of Zeon's most recognizable. The ground-use Dom and space-adapted Rick Dom share major design cues but should not be treated as the same configuration.
kits.summary: Zeon’s heavy, hover-capable ground mobile suit.
kits.lore: The MS-09 Dom is a heavy Zeon ground mobile suit famous for its high-speed hover movement and use by the Black Tri-Stars during the One Year War. Its broad armor and powerful propulsion give it a very different battlefield role from the leaner Zaku. In Mobile Suit Gundam, the Black Tri-Stars' coordinated attacks make the Dom particularly recognizable.

kits.name: Z GUNDAM
aliases: PG 1/60 MSZ-006 ゼータガンダム
kits.notes: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette. Exact kit specifications depend on its listed grade and edition, not this shared design background.
kits.summary: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeta Gundam is the AEUG's transformable protagonist machine in the Gryps Conflict, piloted by Kamille Bidan. Its movable-frame construction and Waverider form mark a major advance beyond the earlier Gundam Mk-II.

kits.name: GM GARD CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 ジム・ガードカスタム
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The kit's imposing shield and defensive stance distinguish the Guard Custom from an ordinary RGM-79. Its name is preserved as listed despite the catalog's 'GARD' spelling.
kits.summary: The kit's imposing shield and defensive stance distinguish the Guard Custom from an ordinary RGM-79.
kits.lore: The GM Guard Custom is a Federation mobile suit derived from GM development within the Origin/MSD line. Its defensive mission is symbolized by unusually extensive protective equipment.

kits.name: W-GUNDAM ZERO CUSTOM
aliases: PG 1/60 ウイングガンダムゼロカスタム

kits.name: STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: PG 1/60 ストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The core Strike body has a white-blue-red color scheme and a distinctive attachment system for Striker equipment. The standard Strike, Perfect Strike and other package-specific releases must be identified separately; not every product includes all Striker packs.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s adaptable GAT-X105 prototype from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Strike Gundam is the GAT-X105 Earth Alliance prototype that Kira Yamato pilots early in Gundam SEED. Its Striker Pack compatibility allows it to be equipped for different combat roles, including the Aile, Sword and Launcher configurations. The machine’s versatility and conflict with ZAFT’s stolen Gundams place it at the center of the early Cosmic Era narrative.

kits.name: SKY GRASPER
aliases: PG 1/60 スカイグラスパー+エールストライカー
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The Skygrasper's compact aircraft body, broad wings and modular Striker attachment concept distinguish it from a humanoid Gundam kit. Edition-specific Launcher or Sword packs should only be claimed when confirmed for that particular product.
kits.summary: The Strike-support aircraft built for the Cosmic Era Striker system.
kits.lore: The FX-550 Skygrasper is an Earth Alliance atmospheric support craft in Gundam SEED, designed to carry Striker Packs and cooperate with the Strike Gundam. Its role demonstrates how the Striker system extends beyond mobile suit equipment to allied aircraft.

kits.name: STRIKE ROUGE + SKY GRASPER
aliases: PG 1/60 ストライクルージュ＋スカイグラスパー
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY RED FRAME
aliases: PG 1/60 ガンダムアストレイ レッドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astray Red Frame models feature distinctive exposed red frame sections, white armor and sword-oriented posing. They vary considerably between normal, Kai and other equipment configurations. Check the precise edition before assuming a particular katana, backpack or effect part is included.
kits.summary: Lowe Guele’s salvager Gundam with striking red framework and sword imagery.
kits.lore: The MBF-P02 Gundam Astray Red Frame is a prototype from Gundam SEED Astray, the side-story setting around the main Cosmic Era conflict. Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild becomes its signature pilot and uses ingenuity and salvaged equipment to survive much larger battles. The Red Frame is especially associated with a Japanese-style sword, giving it a different fighting identity from ordinary rifle-equipped Gundams.
highlights: Lowe Guele and the Junk Guild

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The original Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray, reinterpreted across numerous Gunpla grades.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. Later Gundam designs repeatedly refer back to its configuration and combat record.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions

kits.name: MS-06S ZAKUⅡ
aliases: RG 1/144 MS-06S シャア専用ザク

kits.name: AILE STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 エールストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Aile Strike models combine the white, blue and red Strike armor with the long-winged Aile Striker equipment. The pack gives the silhouette a very different balance from Launcher and Sword Strike. Included mounts, beam sabers and pack mechanisms vary by grade and edition; do not assume every Strike release contains an Aile Striker.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s Strike Gundam configured for mobile Aile Striker combat.
kits.lore: The GAT-X105 Strike Gundam is an Earth Alliance prototype central to Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and famously piloted by Kira Yamato. Its modular Striker Pack system lets it adapt to different kinds of combat; the Aile Striker is designed around flight mobility and balanced armament. The suit's battles help define the growing conflict between Earth and ZAFT and Kira's changing allegiances.

kits.name: GM INTERCEPT CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 ジム・インターセプトカスタム
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The kit draws attention to a distinctive interceptor outline and supporting equipment rather than the standard GM's simple proportions. This listing remains separate from the GM Guard Custom.
kits.summary: The kit draws attention to a distinctive interceptor outline and supporting equipment rather than the standard GM's simple proportions.
kits.lore: The GM Intercept Custom is a Federation variant presented in Origin/MSD material, built around high-speed interception rather than ordinary mass-production patrol work. It belongs to the early GM specialization family.

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-Ⅱ(TITANS)
aliases: RG 1/144 RX-178 ガンダムMk-II（ティターンズ仕様）
kits.notes: The Titans version is most readily distinguished by its dark armor rather than the AEUG's white scheme. The underlying suit design remains the Gundam Mk-II, but named pilot, color and edition variations deserve precise identification. Armor finish and decal options depend on grade and release.
kits.summary: The Titans’ original dark-colored Gundam Mk-II.
kits.lore: The RX-178 Gundam Mk-II is developed by the Titans before several units are captured by the AEUG at the beginning of Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Its early black-and-dark-blue Titans color scheme signals its original ownership by the elite Federation faction. This machine's movable-frame innovations later influence the wider development of Gryps-era mobile suits.

kits.name: RX-178 GUNDAM MK-Ⅱ(AEUG)
aliases: RG 1/144 RX-178 ガンダムMk-II（エゥーゴ仕様）
kits.notes: This AEUG edition uses the familiar white armor with dark blue and yellow detail rather than the Titans' black color scheme. Its angular head, chest vents and characteristic backpack distinguish it from the RX-78-2. Different grades interpret the early movable-frame concept through different internal construction.
kits.summary: The white AEUG-operated Gundam Mk-II from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The RX-178 Gundam Mk-II begins Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam as a Titans-developed successor to the original Gundam. Kamille Bidan becomes closely associated with the AEUG's captured white-colored version, whose movable-frame technology helps bridge earlier mobile suit design and later Zeta-era machines. Its role remains important even after more advanced units arrive.

kits.name: JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 ジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Justice is distinguished by its red-pink body and broad Fatum backpack, which creates a striking airborne silhouette. Be sure to differentiate it from Infinite Justice and later Justice variants; the lifter, colors and armor shape are not interchangeable. Different kits may offer different display options for the flight unit.
kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.

kits.name: DESTINY GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 ZGMF-X42S デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.name: RX-78 GP01
aliases: RG 1/144 RX-78GP01 ガンダム試作1号機ゼフィランサス
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This catalog item is the initial GP01 Zephyranthes, not the GP01Fb space-upgraded form. Its classic Gundam proportions and specific GP numbering identify the kit.
kits.summary: This catalog item is the initial GP01 Zephyranthes, not the GP01Fb space-upgraded form.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP01 Zephyranthes is a Gundam Development Project prototype operated by Kou Uraki during Operation Stardust. Its initial configuration is optimized for terrestrial operations before the Full Burnern upgrade.

kits.name: RX-78 GP01-Fb
aliases: RG 1/144 RX-78GP01Fb ガンダム試作1号機フルバーニアン
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Fb designation names the space-focused Full Burnern edition. Its enlarged backpack and leg thrusters distinguish it from the ground-use GP01 configuration.
kits.summary: The Fb designation names the space-focused Full Burnern edition.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP01 Full Burnern is the space-modified form of the Gundam Zephyranthes used by Kou Uraki. Its propulsion upgrades make it a much more capable orbital fighter during Operation Stardust.

kits.name: LED UNIT for PG RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM
aliases: PG 1/60 RX-0 ユニコーンガンダム用 LEDユニット

kits.name: GN-0000+GNR-010 OO RAISER
aliases: RG 1/144 GN-0000+GNR-010 ダブルオーライザー
kits.notes: This explicitly combined 00 Raiser listing is a different catalog entry from the individual O Raiser aircraft. Keep its paired designation and do not treat it as standard 00 Gundam.
kits.summary: This explicitly combined 00 Raiser listing is a different catalog entry from the individual O Raiser aircraft.
kits.lore: GN-0000 00 Gundam and GNR-010 O Raiser combine into the 00 Raiser used by Setsuna. Synchronizing the twin GN Drives is central to the machine's enhanced capabilities.

kits.name: XXXG-01W WING GUNDAM EW
aliases: RG 1/144 XXXG-01W ウイングガンダム EW

kits.name: OO QAN[T]
aliases: RG 1/144 GNT-0000 ダブルオークアンタ
kits.notes: Its asymmetrical shoulder shield, blue-and-white frame and integrated GN Sword Bits define the movie design. A basic 00 Qan[T] should not be conflated with the additional armaments of the Full Saber variant.
kits.summary: Setsuna's advanced 00 Qan[T] from A Wakening of the Trailblazer.
kits.lore: The 00 Qan[T] is Setsuna F. Seiei's advanced Gundam from the film A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Designed to facilitate communication and understanding with the ELS, it incorporates the Quantum System and a specialized GN Sword and bit arrangement.

kits.name: ZAKU II TYPE C-6/R6
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: The product title's C-6/R6 identifier distinguishes it from the broad C/C-5 listing and Char's commander machine. Kit details should retain that specialized version designation.
kits.summary: The product title's C-6/R6 identifier distinguishes it from the broad C/C-5 listing and Char's commander machine.
kits.lore: The Type C-6/R6 is an Origin-era MS-06 Zaku II variation with specific equipment and body arrangements. It sits within the early Zaku II production sequence before later standardization.

kits.name: MSN-06S SINANJU
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Sinanju’s gold-on-red Sleeves ornamentation, complex curved armor and substantial backpack are defining display details. Consider how a kit renders the trim and its long weapon silhouettes. Sinanju Stein and recolored Build-series machines are different releases and should not automatically inherit standard Sinanju-specific modeling notes.
kits.summary: Full Frontal’s ornate red command mobile suit in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The MSN-06S Sinanju is Full Frontal’s red command mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its exceptional mobility, elaborate gold markings and heavy equipment support the masked leader of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. Its rivalry with the Unicorn Gundam gives the machine a prominent role in the struggle over Laplace’s Box.

kits.lore: Build Strike Gundam Full Package is Sei Iori's early customized Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters, based on the Cosmic Era Strike Gundam. With Reiji as pilot, it introduces the creative team dynamic that drives the first series.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Banagher’s transforming psycho-frame Gundam from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is a prototype mobile suit central to the events of Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE NORN
aliases: RG 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ・ノルン
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The dark armor, gold psycho-frame appearance and Armed Armor equipment provide the key visual cues. For this release, distinguish Banshee Norn from standard Banshee and the white Unicorn: their backpack and armament arrangements vary.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Riddhe’s dark RX-0 mobile suit from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: Banshee Norn is a reconfigured form of the second RX-0 Unicorn Gundam, associated with Riddhe Marcenas in Gundam Unicorn. Its black-and-gold armor sharply contrasts with Banagher’s white Unicorn, while its advanced equipment and psycho-frame technology make it central to the closing struggle over Laplace’s Box. Banshee Norn is a distinct configuration from the earlier Banshee and from Unicorn Gundam.

kits.name: CROSSBONE GUNDAM X1
aliases: RG 1/144 クロスボーン・ガンダムX1
機動戦士クロスボーン・ガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The skull-and-crossbones chest motif, X-shaped thrusters and beam weapon designs are key visual identifiers. Crossbone X1, X1 Kai, Full Cloth and Build Fighters derivatives are distinct variants, and their extra armor or weapons should not be silently merged into a basic X1 entry.
kits.summary: The pirate-styled Crossbone Gundam X1 from the Crossbone Gundam story.
kits.lore: The Crossbone Gundam X1 operates within the Jupiter conflict depicted in the Crossbone Gundam manga. Its pirate-themed visual motifs contrast with its advanced performance as part of the Crossbone Vanguard’s mobile suit force. The machine is closely associated with Kincade Nau and later Crossbone pilots, and its close-range equipment is designed around the demands of that campaign.
highlights: Different from X1 Kai and Full Cloth

kits.name: ν GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Amuro Ray’s Fin Funnel-equipped Gundam from Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: Amuro Ray pilots the RX-93 ν Gundam in Char’s Counterattack. Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: MS-06S ZAKU II PRINCIPALITY OF ZEON CHAR AZNABLE’S MOBILE SUIT Red Comet Ver.
aliases: HG 1/144 MS-06S ZAKU II PRINCIPALITY OF ZEON CHAR AZNABLE’S MOBILE SUIT Red Comet Ver.
HG 1/144 シャア専用ザクII 赤い彗星Ver.
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This edition is explicitly billed as Char's Red Comet version, not a general mass-production Zaku. Its color scheme, commander antenna and named presentation are part of the model's identity.
kits.summary: This edition is explicitly billed as Char's Red Comet version, not a general mass-production Zaku.
kits.lore: Char Aznable's MS-06S Zaku II is one of Zeon's best-known commander mobile suits. In Gundam The Origin, the Red Comet designation recalls the pilot's extraordinary performance in early space battles.

kits.name: GUNDAM G40 (Industrial Design Ver.)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムG40 (Industrial Design Ver.)
kits.notes: The G40 Industrial Design version emphasizes mechanical articulation and a distinctive redesign of the RX-78 silhouette. It is an interpretive anniversary model, not a screen-accurate edition of the 1979 proportions.
kits.summary: The G40 Industrial Design version emphasizes mechanical articulation and a distinctive redesign of the RX-78 silhouette.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 Gundam's status as a defining mobile suit has inspired reinterpretations far beyond its original 1979 animation model. G40 reimagines the classic Federation prototype through an industrial design perspective.

kits.name: FORCE IMPULSE GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 フォースインパルスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: Force Impulse models highlight a red-white-blue core suit with wing-shaped equipment attached at the back. The modular Silhouette idea is central to its identity, but part separation and transformation engineering differ by kit grade. Keep Force, Sword and Blast Silhouette variations distinct when assigning release-specific features.
kits.summary: The high-mobility Force configuration of Shinn Asuka’s Impulse Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X56S Impulse Gundam is a ZAFT machine from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny, first piloted by Shinn Asuka. Its modular Silhouette System changes combat capabilities; the Force Silhouette prioritizes speed and mobile aerial fighting. The Impulse's dramatic role during the war also sets it against established pilots and their more famous machines.

kits.name: ZEONG
kits.notes: Zeong kits center on the huge torso, broad skirt thrusters, detachable or articulated arm assemblies and lack of conventional legs. Its display demands differ greatly from ordinary standing humanoid Gunpla. Some editions emphasize internal frame detailing, but those features must be checked against the exact grade and release.
kits.summary: Char Aznable’s experimental Newtype mobile suit at A Baoa Qu.
kits.lore: The MSN-02 Zeong is an experimental Zeon Newtype-use mobile suit deployed by Char Aznable near the end of the One Year War. Its unfinished legless appearance becomes central to the climactic confrontation with Amuro Ray's Gundam at A Baoa Qu. Wire-guided hands and powerful beam weapons make it a striking expression of Zeon's late-war experimentation with remote attack systems.

kits.name: Hi-ν GUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wing-like Fin Funnel arrays and the blue-and-white coloring provide Hi-ν’s most recognizable look. Its RG and Ver.Ka editions are substantially different products; comparisons should focus on proportions, color separation and the specific edition’s included stand or weapon parts.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Amuro-associated ν Gundam variant from Beltorchika’s Children.
kits.lore: Hi-ν Gundam is a reinterpretation of Amuro Ray’s advanced mobile suit associated with the Beltorchika’s Children version of the Char’s Counterattack story. It shares the Newtype-oriented concept of ν Gundam but has a distinctive white-and-blue palette and a more symmetrical array of Fin Funnels. Although related in fiction and design development, Hi-ν is not identical to the film’s RX-93 ν Gundam.

kits.name: WING GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 ウイングガンダム
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Bird Mode silhouette and Buster Rifle are the most recognizable features of this original Wing Gundam. It should not be confused with Wing Gundam Zero, whose weaponry, systems and body configuration are significantly different.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Heero’s first Operation Meteor Gundam, noted for Bird Mode.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy’s primary machine early in Gundam Wing. Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.name: GEARA ZULU (BODY GUARD TYPE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ギラ・ズール（親衛隊仕様）
kits.notes: This Body Guard Type release is different from a standard Geara Zulu or Angelo Sauper's purple custom. The officer-protection role and personalized unit styling define it.
kits.summary: This Body Guard Type release is different from a standard Geara Zulu or Angelo Sauper's purple custom.
kits.lore: Geara Zulu is the mass-produced mobile suit used by the Sleeves, a Neo Zeon remnant faction. Bodyguard versions specialize the infantry-like design for close protection of important officers.

kits.name: GUNPLA STARTER SET vol.2

ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Earthree's design highlights the small Core Gundam together with blue outer armor that changes the overall silhouette. Different Planet System releases use different armor modules and may not contain the same core unit. The combined kit's stated parts are authoritative for what can be assembled.
kits.summary: Hiroto’s modular Core Gundam equipped with Earth Armor.
kits.lore: Earthree Gundam is Hiroto Kuga's main Gunpla at the start of Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. It combines a small Core Gundam with Planet System armor pieces, allowing the same central machine to adapt to different combat needs. Hiroto's resourceful use of changing configurations reflects his careful, tactical style and his personal history.

kits.notes: Justice Knight features prominent red armor, a sword-and-shield identity and knight-like equipment mounted on a recognizable Gundam frame. It is a Build-series custom, not the original Infinite Justice from SEED Destiny, so its lore and kit contents should stay separate.
kits.summary: Kazami’s knight-inspired Gundam custom.
kits.lore: Gundam Justice Knight is a Gunpla used by Kazami in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Based on the Infinite Justice lineage, its equipment and appearance are styled after a heroic knight rather than simply a conventional Cosmic Era weapon platform. Kazami's journey with the unit emphasizes the difference between looking impressive and learning to fight effectively as part of a team.

kits.notes: The crimson Zaku body, extra armor and bulky weapon units give the design a distinctive ace-machine feel. It should not be confused with Char Aznable's red Zaku II, despite the intentional homage in its colors.
kits.summary: Tatsuya Yuuki's heavily modified Zaku Amazing.
kits.lore: Zaku Amazing is Tatsuya Yuuki's customized red Zaku-based Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters. It demonstrates his skill before the full Meijin Kawaguchi identity becomes central, using an aggressively equipped machine to challenge other builders.

kits.name: GUNDAM X MAOU

aliases: HGBF 1/144 戦国アストレイ頑駄無

kits.notes: Prominent red armor, tall blade-like shoulder shapes and twin swords create a striking warrior silhouette. This customized build should not be confused with Lowe Guele's original Astray Red Frame from Gundam SEED Astray.
kits.summary: Nils Nielsen's samurai-style Sengoku Astray Gunpla.
kits.lore: The Sengoku Astray Gundam is a custom Gunpla built by Nils Nielsen in Gundam Build Fighters. Based on the Astray concept, it combines Gunpla Battle technology with a deliberately samurai-inspired fighting style and ornamentation.

kits.name: WING GUNDAM FENICE
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ウイングガンダムフェニーチェ
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The machine's green-and-white asymmetry, damaged-looking custom structure and striking single-wing emphasis distinguish it from the original Wing Gundam. Fenice Rinascita is a later reconstruction and must remain a separate entry.
kits.summary: Ricardo Fellini's asymmetrical Wing Gundam Fenice.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam Fenice is Ricardo Fellini's customized Wing Gundam in Gundam Build Fighters. Years of repairs and modifications produce an asymmetrical build that reflects the experienced fighter's personal history and unconventional style.

kits.name: STAR BUILD STRIKE GUNDAM PLAVSKY WING
