HGBF 1/144 スタービルドストライクガンダム プラフスキーウイング
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Plavsky Wing edition identifies a display-focused Star Build Strike configuration centered on its remarkable wing motif. It should not be merged with the earlier Build Strike Full Package or later Galaxy Cosmos.
kits.summary: The Plavsky Wing edition identifies a display-focused Star Build Strike configuration centered on its remarkable wing motif.
kits.lore: Star Build Strike Gundam develops Sei Iori's original Build Strike for the Gunpla Battle competition in Gundam Build Fighters. Its Plavsky-powered systems and distinctive wing effects help define the series' climactic customized Gunpla.

kits.name: KAMPFER AMAZING
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ケンプファーアメイジング
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Its dark blue armor, widened weapon equipment and aggressive Kampfer proportions convey a heavily customized assault machine. It is not a direct depiction of Mikhail Kaminsky's original Gundam 0080 Kampfer.
kits.summary: The weapon-heavy Kampfer Amazing from Gundam Build Fighters.
kits.lore: Kampfer Amazing is a customized version of the classic Kampfer built for Gunpla Battle in Gundam Build Fighters and used by Meijin Kawaguchi. The compact assault suit's original emphasis on mobility and weaponry is expanded through numerous battle-oriented modifications.

kits.name: SD VALKYLANDER
aliases: SDBD:R ヴァルキランダー
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Its SD-sized proportions, dragon-like head and broad fantasy creature styling contrast sharply with the humanoid Gundams around it. Valkylander’s standard design is distinct from the enhanced Ex Valkylander release and should not inherit assumed parts.
kits.summary: Parviz’s dragon-like SD Gunpla from Re:RISE.
kits.lore: Valkylander is Parviz’s small dragon-inspired Gunpla from Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Behind its playful appearance, the machine contains a sophisticated design tied to Parviz’s development as a teammate and to the team’s increasingly difficult missions on Eldora.

kits.name: QUBELEY PAPILLON
aliases: HGBF 1/144 キュベレイパピヨン
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The dark-purple color scheme, graceful Qubeley binders and redesigned remote-weapon identity make Papillon unique. The build is distinct from Haman Karn's original Qubeley and other Qubeley variants.
kits.summary: Aila's customized Qubeley Papillon.
kits.lore: Qubeley Papillon is Aila Jyrkiainen's customized Qubeley-based Gunpla from Gundam Build Fighters. It turns the elegant funnel-equipped Universal Century design into a tournament machine tied to Aila's unusual ability to sense and control battle conditions.

kits.name: GM SNIPER K9
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The dark green armor, sniper equipment and distinctive K9 mobile support unit define the model's battlefield presentation. It should be cataloged as a Build Fighters custom rather than a regular Gundam 0080 GM Sniper II.
kits.summary: The Renato brothers' tactical GM Sniper K9.
kits.lore: GM Sniper K9 is a highly tactical customized Gunpla used by the Renato brothers in Gundam Build Fighters. It adapts the GM Sniper lineage with a detachable support unit, reflecting the team's strategy-driven style rather than a straightforward sniper duel.

kits.name: MISS SAZABI
aliases: ガンダムビルドファイターズ

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA DARK MATTER

kits.notes: Its black-and-red color palette, transformed armor details and distinctive sword arrangement give Dark Matter a deliberately threatening appearance. It must not be treated as the standard Gundam Exia or the unmodified Amazing Exia.
kits.summary: The menacing Gundam Exia Dark Matter of Gundam Build Fighters.
kits.lore: Gundam Exia Dark Matter is a sinister customized Exia used in Gundam Build Fighters. It is associated with the late-tournament storyline and represents a dramatic change from the blue-and-white Amazing Exia's ordinary presentation.

kits.notes: Star Winning has a compact SD silhouette with standout equipment features that transform its visual identity. The named evolution should be tracked separately from the earlier Winning Gundam and other SD releases.
kits.summary: Star Winning has a compact SD silhouette with standout equipment features that transform its visual identity.
kits.lore: Star Winning Gundam is Fumina Hoshino's evolved SD-style Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its design moves beyond the previous Winning Gundam and embraces a new combination of cute proportions and more advanced combat functions.

kits.name: TRANSIENT GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 トランジェントガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Transient has long, clean white armor panels and sharp, angular proportions, giving it an almost ceremonial appearance. This is Wilfrid's original Transient design, distinct from Transient Gundam Glacier.
kits.summary: The Transient has long, clean white armor panels and sharp, angular proportions, giving it an almost ceremonial appearance.
kits.lore: Transient Gundam is the elegant personal Gunpla of Wilfrid Kijima in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its attack style relies on refined performance and specialized energy weapon imagery rather than massive conventional mechanical weapons.

kits.name: GUNDAM SELTSAM
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ガンダムゼルトザーム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: The massively disproportionate right arm and jagged, intimidating proportions define the Seltsam’s appearance. It is visually and narratively distinct from the later Gundam Tertium form, and a Seltsam Arms accessory pack is not the same as the full Gundam kit.
kits.summary: The ominous one-armed Gundam Seltsam from Re:RISE.
kits.lore: Gundam Seltsam is a mysterious antagonistic machine appearing in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Its unusual arm and unsettling presence make it central to early encounters on Eldora, before its history becomes more deeply connected to events beyond the original mission briefings.

kits.name: TRY BURNING GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 トライバーニングガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Its athletic red-white-blue armor, rounded fighting stance and flame-themed effects identify the design. The Try Burning version must be distinguished from the earlier Build Burning Gundam and other successor forms.
kits.summary: Sekai's martial-arts-focused Try Burning Gundam.
kits.lore: Try Burning Gundam is Sekai Kamiki's principal martial-arts Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its fighting style is defined by Sekai's physical-combat techniques and the Build Burning lineage, making movement and energy effects more central than long-range weapons.

kits.name: GUNDAM THE END

kits.notes: The End's black-heavy armor, strong red highlights and unusual oversized arm shapes define its visual identity. It is a rare example where the body design communicates a menacing character before any action pose.
kits.summary: The End's black-heavy armor, strong red highlights and unusual oversized arm shapes define its visual identity.
kits.lore: Gundam The End is Adou Saga's dark, highly unconventional Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its battle presentation uses hidden and extended arm concepts to create a deliberately unsettling contrast with heroic Gundam silhouettes.

kits.name: GUNDAM TRYON 3
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ガンダムトライオン３
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: Bold primary colors, a large combined silhouette and toy-like animal-machine motifs set Tryon 3 apart from ordinary ZZ Gundam-inspired Gunpla. The combination concept is the design's main identity, not an interchangeable feature of other ZZ kits.
kits.summary: The combining super-robot Gunpla Gundam Tryon 3.
kits.lore: Gundam Tryon 3 is a super-robot-inspired customized Gunpla in Gundam Build Fighters Try, created by Minato Sakai. Three separate animal-like machines combine into one spectacular robot, consciously embracing dramatic combination sequences.

kits.name: DENIAL GUNDAM
aliases: HGBF 1/144 ディナイアルガンダム
ガンダムビルドファイターズ
kits.notes: The Denial's dark armor, sharp helmet and long striking limbs make hand-to-hand battle poses the natural centerpiece. The kit belongs to the Build Fighters Try character's custom machine, not to an ordinary Universal Century Gundam.
kits.summary: The Denial's dark armor, sharp helmet and long striking limbs make hand-to-hand battle poses the natural centerpiece.
kits.lore: Denial Gundam is a fearsome Gunpla used by Junya Inose in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its close-combat abilities and sinister design reinforce Junya's aggressive martial-arts style and his connection to Sekai Kamiki's training lineage.

kits.notes: Lightning Z presents sharper, more modern armor lines and a distinct backpack arrangement while preserving the Zeta family's unmistakable head profile. This kit is not interchangeable with the original Zeta Gundam.
kits.summary: Lightning Z presents sharper, more modern armor lines and a distinct backpack arrangement while preserving the Zeta family's unmistakable head profile.
kits.lore: Lightning Z Gundam is a customized Gunpla based on the classic Zeta Gundam lineage in Gundam Build Fighters Try. Its streamlined proportions reinterpret the familiar transformable protagonist design through the Gunpla Battle setting.

kits.notes: The Scramble design combines sharp wing elements, bright color blocks and a prominent flight-oriented profile. The model should remain a distinct Island Wars creation rather than being cataloged under Zeta or Wing Gundam.
kits.summary: The Scramble design combines sharp wing elements, bright color blocks and a prominent flight-oriented profile.
kits.lore: Scramble Gundam is a custom Gunpla associated with Gundam Build Fighters Try: Island Wars. Its powerful airborne silhouette combines motifs of older transformation-capable Gundams with an original, highly aggressive appearance.

kits.lore: Amazing Strike Freedom Gundam is an elaborate Gunpla Battle reinterpretation of Strike Freedom, associated with Gundam Build Fighters side material. It pushes the celebrated SEED Destiny wing-and-remote-weapon vocabulary into a personalized competition design.

kits.lore: Hyper Gyanko is a character-themed Gundam Build Fighters kit that playfully adapts Gyanko iconography into a stylized figure design. It reflects the series' wider range of hobby models beyond conventional robot-only combat machines.

kits.lore: The EB-06 Graze is Gjallarhorn's mainline mobile suit across much of Iron-Blooded Orphans. Command variants use different equipment and presentation while retaining the basic mass-production frame.

kits.summary: McGillis's Schwalbe combines angular Graze ancestry with elite-unit armor and individualized color treatment.
kits.lore: McGillis Fareed operates a customized Schwalbe Graze early in Iron-Blooded Orphans. The advanced machine reflects his status in Gjallarhorn and his preference for swift, decisive combat.

機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The first Gusion's rounded green armor, huge torso and squat limbs conceal its Gundam Frame lineage. Its lumbering original silhouette is very different from the later Gusion Rebake family.
kits.summary: The first Gusion's rounded green armor, huge torso and squat limbs conceal its Gundam Frame lineage.
kits.lore: The original Gundam Gusion is an ancient Gundam Frame repurposed into a bulky, heavily armored space combat machine used by the Brewers. It eventually becomes part of Tekkadan's story through a major change in ownership.

kits.name: GRAZE CUSTOM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The custom retains the Graze's compact head and angular military frame, but changed colors and modified equipment define its new identity. It belongs to Tekkadan's adaptation rather than a standard Gjallarhorn unit.
kits.summary: The custom retains the Graze's compact head and angular military frame, but changed colors and modified equipment define its new identity.
kits.lore: The Graze Custom is a modified Gjallarhorn mass-production machine adapted for use by Tekkadan. Its appearance demonstrates how salvaged technology and practical repairs feature throughout Iron-Blooded Orphans.

kits.name: HYAKURI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Hyakuri's extended flight components and slim central body make it look very unlike a mass-production Graze. The specialized space-combat form is the main visual focus of this distinct Teiwaz entry.
kits.summary: Hyakuri's extended flight components and slim central body make it look very unlike a mass-production Graze.
kits.lore: The Hyakuri is a Teiwaz high-mobility mobile suit known for its unusual space-combat silhouette and relationship to the Hyakuren design family. Its configuration prioritizes swift maneuvering rather than heavy traditional armor.

kits.summary: Kimaris uses bold white and purple armor, prominent shoulder units and a powerful jousting profile.
kits.lore: Gundam Kimaris is one of the surviving Calamity War Gundam Frames and is piloted by Gaelio Bauduin. Its knightly styling and lance-centered combat presentation set it apart from the blunt melee aesthetics of Barbatos.

kits.notes: The Hyakuren has broad shoulders, a heavy chest and a compact faceplate that differ from the Graze. This standard model is separate from Amida Arca's personalized version and other customized appearances.
kits.summary: The Hyakuren has broad shoulders, a heavy chest and a compact faceplate that differ from the Graze.
kits.lore: The Hyakuren is a Teiwaz mass-production mobile suit seen in Iron-Blooded Orphans, built for reliable performance in harsh space operations. Its relatively simple body reflects the series' varied non-Gjallarhorn machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM GUSION REBAKE
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムグシオンリベイク

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gusion Rebake features a broad upper body, a distinctive Gundam face and heavy-duty support hardware. Later Full City upgrades change the machine substantially, so the two should not be treated as identical products. Kit engineering and included handheld weapons vary by release.
kits.summary: Akihiro’s rebuilt Gundam Frame used by Tekkadan.
kits.lore: The ASW-G-11 Gundam Gusion Rebake is a recovered Gundam Frame rebuilt for Tekkadan in Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans. Akihiro Altland becomes closely associated with the machine, whose new body replaces the Gusion’s original bulky pirate-style armor with a configuration suited to Tekkadan’s operations. Its long-range and close-quarters versatility reflects Akihiro’s relentless fighting style.

kits.summary: Its red armor, narrow waist and elongated limbs create a light, knightly silhouette unlike the heavier Graze.
kits.lore: Grimgerde is a Valkyrja Frame machine piloted by McGillis Fareed under another identity in Iron-Blooded Orphans. The old high-performance frame combines exceptional maneuverability with a sleek, sword-oriented appearance.

kits.summary: The vivid custom color and revised Graze profile distinguish the Ryusei-Go from a plain Graze Custom.
kits.lore: Ryusei-Go is the nickname given to Norba Shino's personalized Graze Custom II as Tekkadan adapts salvaged hardware. The name becomes associated with his exuberant individual style throughout Iron-Blooded Orphans.

kits.summary: The sixth form adds a heavier, more armored impression around Barbatos's recognizable white Gundam Frame silhouette.
kits.lore: Barbatos is a Calamity War Gundam Frame used by Mikazuki Augus and modified repeatedly by Tekkadan. Its sixth form incorporates additional protection and equipment as the group faces increasingly dangerous opponents.

kits.summary: The Trooper's distinctive lower-body configuration and cavalry-inspired proportions should be treated as a separate product from standard Kimaris.
kits.lore: Kimaris Trooper is a battlefield configuration of Gaelio Bauduin's Gundam Kimaris, adapting the knightly Gundam Frame for intense combat during Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its outline differs dramatically from the original Kimaris.

kits.name: GRAZE EIN

kits.notes: The Graze Ein has long limbs, oversized torso armor and sharp mechanical details compared with ordinary Grazes. Its imposing silhouette conveys a purpose-built combat threat rather than mass-production utility.
kits.summary: The Graze Ein has long limbs, oversized torso armor and sharp mechanical details compared with ordinary Grazes.
kits.lore: Graze Ein is an extreme Gjallarhorn mobile suit associated with Ein Dalton, whose circumstances lead to an unusually direct man-machine interface. Its intimidating scale and ruthless purpose make it central to the early series climax.

kits.name: CARTA'S GRAZE RITTER

kits.summary: Carta Issue’s squad-issued Graze Ritter from Iron-Blooded Orphans.
kits.lore: The Graze Ritter units used by Carta Issue's forces are elite Gjallarhorn variants visible in Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans. Their styling recalls ceremonial knights while retaining the functionality of military mobile suits. Their actions around Tekkadan place them directly in the story's conflict between established authority and an independent mercenary group.

kits.name: MAN RODI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The Man Rodi's bulbous helmet, short-looking limbs and substantial protective plates produce a squat silhouette. It is different from the later Landman Rodi and other customized Rodi variants.
kits.summary: The Man Rodi's bulbous helmet, short-looking limbs and substantial protective plates produce a squat silhouette.
kits.lore: The Man Rodi is a heavy, low-slung mobile suit used by the Brewers and other groups in Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its thick armor and rugged nature fit the setting's frequent reliance on repurposed equipment.

機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astaroth’s unconventional asymmetric armor and oversized melee weapon distinguish it from the Barbatos family. Astaroth Origin and Rinascimento represent different configurations with significantly altered external parts. Check the specific product name when choosing a reference.
kits.summary: Argi Mirage’s reconstructed Gundam Frame from Iron-Blooded Orphans: Gekko.
kits.lore: ASW-G-29 Gundam Astaroth is a Gundam Frame associated with the Iron-Blooded Orphans: Gekko side story. Its history involves recovery, rebuilding and the efforts of Argi Mirage in a world shaped by the legacy of the Calamity War. Its asymmetrical equipment expresses the improvised state of a surviving ancient frame rather than a pristine prototype.

kits.summary: The Origin's more unified design and original-color presentation contrast with the salvaged Astaroth and Rinascimento appearances.
kits.lore: Gundam Astaroth Origin depicts an earlier configuration of the Gundam Frame before the extensively repaired and asymmetrical forms shown in Iron-Blooded Orphans Gekko. Its appearance helps explain the machine's long history.

kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This edition represents the Lupus redesign, not the original Barbatos or the later Lupus Rex. Focus on the larger shoulders, revised limbs, angular head and signature sword-mace profile. The kit’s grade determines the level of mechanical detailing; check the release-specific contents before assuming extra weapons or optional forms are included.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The upgraded Barbatos form piloted by Mikazuki during Iron-Blooded Orphans.
kits.lore: Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki Augus’s Gundam Frame used as Tekkadan’s conflicts intensify. Its redesigned armor and altered proportions emphasize acceleration and physical aggression, making it visually distinct from earlier Barbatos forms. It retains the defining connection between Mikazuki, the Alaya-Vijnana interface and Tekkadan’s rise through the post-Calamity War political landscape. Its long sword mace reflects the machine’s preference for decisive melee strikes.
highlights: Distinct from Barbatos and Lupus Rex

kits.name: JULIETA'S MOBILE REGINLAZE

kits.notes: Julieta's named Reginlaze combines the updated shoulders and head of the Reginlaze family with personalized combat presentation. It belongs in a separate entry from Iok's machine and the standard Reginlaze.
kits.summary: Julieta's named Reginlaze combines the updated shoulders and head of the Reginlaze family with personalized combat presentation.
kits.lore: Julieta Juris pilots a personalized Reginlaze, Gjallarhorn's more advanced successor-type combat machine. The Reginlaze line reflects an attempt to improve on the mass-produced Graze platform.

kits.name: GUNDAM GUSION REBAKE FULL CITY

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Full City’s larger shoulders, angular face and powerful close-combat styling distinguish it from the original Rebake. This is a separate mobile suit configuration, not simply a different-colored original Gusion. Compare the title and product art carefully before assuming shared parts or weapon contents.
kits.summary: The second-season upgrade to Akihiro Altland’s Gundam Gusion Rebake.
kits.lore: The Gundam Gusion Rebake Full City is the heavily upgraded form of Akihiro Altland’s machine in the second season of Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its reinforced configuration reflects the increasingly intense battles faced by Tekkadan. The machine is especially remembered for its close-combat strength and the resolve Akihiro shows in the organization’s final struggles.

kits.notes: Hugo's bent leg structure and distinctive upright upper body make movement and posing central to its visual character. This catalog entry should not be treated as a generic Gjallarhorn machine.
kits.summary: Hugo's bent leg structure and distinctive upright upper body make movement and posing central to its visual character.
kits.lore: The Hugo is a distinct mobile suit used by criminal groups during Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its reverse-jointed legs and unusual head design give it a markedly different look from the standard Graze and Shiden families.

kits.name: GEIRAIL
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The Geirail's compact head, broad shoulders and basic utilitarian styling make it a historical predecessor to the Graze rather than a simple recolor. This is the standard Geirail rather than a specialized Scharfrichter configuration.
kits.summary: The Geirail's compact head, broad shoulders and basic utilitarian styling make it a historical predecessor to the Graze rather than a simple recolor.
kits.lore: The Geirail is an older Gjallarhorn mass-production mobile suit that predates the Graze family. Its appearance reveals how the organization developed its military hardware before the events of Iron-Blooded Orphans.

kits.name: IO FRAME SHIDEN
aliases: HG 1/144 イオフレーム獅電
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Shiden's angular faceplate, strong block-shaped limbs and utilitarian armor give it a practical military identity. This standard entry differs from Ryusei-Go Shiden and other named pilot versions.
kits.summary: Shiden's angular faceplate, strong block-shaped limbs and utilitarian armor give it a practical military identity.
kits.lore: The Shiden uses the Io Frame developed for Teiwaz and Tekkadan's changing combat needs. It provides a practical mass-production platform amid a conflict also featuring rare Gundam Frames and unique experimental machines.

kits.notes: Hashmal is a sprawling non-humanoid machine with a long, menacing armored shape rather than a Gundam torso. Its scale and predatory outline make it a very different display subject from standard mobile suits.
kits.summary: Hashmal is a sprawling non-humanoid machine with a long, menacing armored shape rather than a Gundam torso.
kits.lore: Hashmal is an autonomous mobile armor from the Calamity War, rediscovered in Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its machine-directed hostility and extreme combat capability reveal why Gundam Frames were created for that earlier conflict.

kits.name: GUNDAM FLAUROS (RYUSEI-GO)

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Ryusei-Go Flauros is recognizable by its bright pink color and enormous paired cannon silhouette. The design also has a low-profile firing configuration, but model-specific transformation parts and stability should be checked per release. Keep it distinct from Calamity War color interpretations.
kits.summary: Norba Shino’s pink heavy-artillery Gundam Frame in Iron-Blooded Orphans.
kits.lore: Gundam Flauros is an ancient Gundam Frame discovered by Tekkadan and restored during Iron-Blooded Orphans. Norba Shino adopts the Ryusei-Go identity for the recovered mobile suit, giving it the flamboyant pink scheme associated with his earlier machines. Its long-range heavy-gun role makes it stand out among the organization’s more melee-focused Gundam Frames.

kits.name: GUNDAM VIDAR

機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes:

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Vidar’s narrow blue armor, distinctive leg equipment and weapons are its defining visual features. It must be treated separately from Gundam Kimaris and Kimaris Vidar, which are related but have different exterior configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The blue armored Gundam Frame used by the masked Vidar in Iron-Blooded Orphans.
kits.lore: Gundam Vidar is an Iron-Blooded Orphans mobile suit operated by the masked pilot Vidar. Its appearance conceals the machine’s deeper history and its pilot’s connection to Gjallarhorn’s internal struggles. The Gundam Frame design favors high-speed melee combat, with distinctive blue armor and unusual bladed weaponry. Its storyline is intimately tied to questions of revenge, identity and the legacy of the Battle of Edmonton.

kits.name: MS OPTION SET 7

kits.notes: Hekija's broad, curved armor, compact head and updated silhouette make it a separate machine within the Teiwaz family. This entry should not be mislabeled as the visually different Hyakuren.
kits.summary: Hekija's broad, curved armor, compact head and updated silhouette make it a separate machine within the Teiwaz family.
kits.lore: Hekija is a Teiwaz-associated mobile suit that appears during the later Iron-Blooded Orphans story. It continues the lineage of distinctive non-Gjallarhorn machines alongside the Hyakuren and Shiden.

機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Reginlaze Julia has elongated limbs, distinctive weapon appendages and a very different proportion from the standard Reginlaze. Its scale can make display and pose planning important. Do not confuse it with the ordinary Reginlaze or other Gjallarhorn mass-production suits.
kits.summary: Julieta Juris’s unique high-performance Gjallarhorn mobile suit.
kits.lore: The EB-08jjc Reginlaze Julia is an advanced Gjallarhorn machine from the second season of Iron-Blooded Orphans. Julieta Juris pilots the long-limbed unit as part of Gjallarhorn’s campaigns against Tekkadan. Its specialized silhouette reflects a different approach to high-performance mobile suits than Tekkadan’s recovered Gundam Frames.

kits.name: HELMWIGE REINCAR
aliases: HG 1/144 ヘルムヴィーゲ・リンカー
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Its huge weapon emphasis, heavy torso and angular knight-like exterior produce a radically different profile from the slim Grimgerde. Despite the related frame background, this is a separate configuration.
kits.summary: Its huge weapon emphasis, heavy torso and angular knight-like exterior produce a radically different profile from the slim Grimgerde.
kits.lore: Helmwige Reincar is a revived Valkyrja Frame configuration associated with Gjallarhorn's later operations in Iron-Blooded Orphans. The design deliberately evokes formidable old-era technology.

kits.notes: Vual has a sharp head, broad armored limbs and a distinctly aggressive equipment layout. It is not an alternate name for Astaroth, although both are part of the Gekko Gundam Frame setting.
kits.summary: Vual has a sharp head, broad armored limbs and a distinctly aggressive equipment layout.
kits.lore: Gundam Vual is a surviving Gundam Frame from Iron-Blooded Orphans Gekko, tied to the shifting ownership and use of old Calamity War technology. Its personalized appearance reflects that side story's focus on recovered machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM DANTALION
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムダンタリオン
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Dantalion's base body uses lean proportions that contrast with its dramatic attachable configurations. Its named identity is important because its designs belong to the same machine's specialized equipment family.
kits.summary: Dantalion's base body uses lean proportions that contrast with its dramatic attachable configurations.
kits.lore: Gundam Dantalion is a Gundam Frame appearing in Iron-Blooded Orphans side material, notable for modular transformation of its combat silhouette through equipment configurations. Its design stands apart from the standard Barbatos line.

kits.name: ROUEI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Rouei combines recognizable Hyakuren ancestry with a different head and armor treatment. It should be cataloged separately from the ordinary Hyakuren and character-specific variants.
kits.summary: Rouei combines recognizable Hyakuren ancestry with a different head and armor treatment.
kits.lore: The Rouei is a Teiwaz-associated mobile suit adapted from the Hyakuren family and used in Iron-Blooded Orphans. It presents a more concealed or modified exterior to suit changing operational needs.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTAROTH RINASCIMENTO
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアスタロトリナシメント
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Rinascimento's layered rebuilt armor and asymmetrical appearance distinguish it from the Origin and first rebuilt Astaroth forms. The name identifies this specific configuration rather than the overall Astaroth line.
kits.summary: Rinascimento's layered rebuilt armor and asymmetrical appearance distinguish it from the Origin and first rebuilt Astaroth forms.
kits.lore: Astaroth Rinascimento is a reconstructed version of Gundam Astaroth from the Iron-Blooded Orphans Gekko side story. Its evolving configuration reflects successive repairs and the story of a rare frame being brought back into service.

kits.name: GUNDAM MARCHOSIAS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムマルコシアス
機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: The Marchosias has ornate shoulders, a narrow armored waist and a dramatic equipment-forward silhouette. Its distinctive historical Gundam Frame form is separate from the ordinary Barbatos designs.
kits.summary: The Marchosias has ornate shoulders, a narrow armored waist and a dramatic equipment-forward silhouette.
kits.lore: Marchosias is an ancient Gundam Frame from the Calamity War era of Iron-Blooded Orphans. It appears in expanded-setting material that explores the deadly machines and exceptional technology of the conflict's distant past.

kits.name: GUNDAM HAJIROBOSHI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ
kits.notes: Hajiroboshi models are recognizable for a white-and-violet armor scheme and angular weapon-centered body. The 2nd Form is a distinct evolution with equipment changes; do not assume those parts are present in the initial Hajiroboshi kit.
kits.summary: Wistario Afam’s recovered Gundam Frame from Urdr-Hunt.
kits.lore: Gundam Hajiroboshi appears in Iron-Blooded Orphans: Urdr-Hunt as a Gundam Frame recovered and operated by Wistario Afam. It extends the Calamity War legacy into a new story centered on people living at the margins of powerful organizations. Its reappearance underscores the continued importance of surviving Gundam Frames long after their original war.

kits.summary: This edition uses the Gelgoog Cannon identity rather than the ordinary Gelgoog or high-mobility type.
kits.lore: The Gelgoog Cannon is an MS-14C fire-support variation built around Zeon's late-war Gelgoog platform. Its shoulder cannon identifies it as a distinct artillery configuration.

kits.name: SELTSAM ARMS

機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: Stamen retains a relatively conventional Gundam torso but has distinctive arm and waist features designed for docking with the larger equipment platform. It is not the full Dendrobium assembly.
kits.summary: Stamen retains a relatively conventional Gundam torso but has distinctive arm and waist features designed for docking with the larger equipment platform.
kits.lore: The GP03S Stamen is the Gundam mobile suit that serves as the core unit of the enormous GP03 Dendrobium weapons platform in Gundam 0083. Its compact appearance contrasts with the vast combined system.

kits.name: MSA-0011[EXT] EX-S GUNDAM
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: The MG interpretation makes the larger outer structures and prominent equipment of the Ex-S especially central to the model's outline. This is the Ex-S rather than the smaller base S Gundam.
kits.summary: The MG interpretation makes the larger outer structures and prominent equipment of the Ex-S especially central to the model's outline.
kits.lore: The MSA-0011[Ext] Ex-S Gundam evolves the S Gundam into a heavily augmented unit in Gundam Sentinel. It combines expanded armor and mobility equipment with the S Gundam's ALICE-related heritage.

kits.name: GOGG
kits.notes: Gogg's very wide torso, squat legs and distinctive folded claw-hands create a compact, bulky outline. These proportions distinguish the model from the more streamlined Z'Gok and the smaller Acguy.
kits.summary: Gogg's very wide torso, squat legs and distinctive folded claw-hands create a compact, bulky outline.
kits.lore: The MSM-03 Gogg is an early Zeon amphibious mobile suit, valued for durability and underwater operation in the One Year War. Heavy armor and powerful arms define its unusual combat role.

kits.name: SDBD：R AVALANCHE REX BUSTER
aliases: SDBD:R アヴァランチレックスバスター
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE

kits.name: RICK DIAS
kits.notes: Rick Dias kits emphasize a broad rounded body, compact head and distinctive rear equipment. Colors vary between standard and Quattro-associated releases. Its styling reflects the same wider design family as many Anaheim machines, but it should not be confused with the similarly named Rick Dom.
kits.summary: The AEUG mobile suit famously associated with Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The RMS-099 Rick Dias is an AEUG mobile suit developed with Anaheim Electronics and used by several important Zeta Gundam characters. Quattro Bajeena pilots a red version, while earlier standard units are seen in a darker scheme. The design reflects the AEUG's blend of cutting-edge engineering and personnel connected to different sides of the previous war.

kits.name: HYAKU-SHIKI+ MEGABAZOOKALAUNCHER
aliases: HGUC 1/144 百式＋メガバズーカランチャー

kits.name: PSYCHO GUNDAM
kits.notes: Unlike ordinary 1/144 mobile suits, Psycho Gundam kits represent a much larger fictional machine and dominate a display shelf. The black armor, red trim, multiple beam emitters and transforming body shape are defining elements. Do not confuse the original model with Psycho Gundam Mk-II.
kits.summary: Four Murasame’s massive transformable Newtype-use machine.
kits.lore: The MRX-009 Psycho Gundam is an enormous transformable mobile armor/mobile suit developed under the Earth Federation's Newtype research programs and operated by Four Murasame in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Its size, transformation system and overwhelming firepower make it a terrifying presence during the Gryps Conflict. Four's story places its destructive capabilities in a deeply personal context.

kits.name: GUNDAM F91
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The F91 stands apart from earlier Gundams through its comparatively compact proportions, shoulder and backpack weapons and face-open design. Its VSBRs are crucial to identification; compare their placement across kit grades. Harrison Madin colors and other variants should be distinguished from the standard Seabook-era configuration.
kits.summary: Seabook Arno’s advanced SNRI Gundam from Gundam F91.
kits.lore: The Gundam F91 is an advanced Federation mobile suit developed by SNRI in the later Universal Century. Seabook Arno becomes its pilot during the events of the Gundam F91 film, confronting the Crossbone Vanguard. Its compact body houses sophisticated equipment, including the pair of VSBR weapons, while its high-performance operation is associated with striking afterimages.

kits.name: RGM-79 POWERED GM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Powered GM model has a broader, more heavily equipped GM silhouette than a regular Type C. The upgrade identity is central to the entry, not a different pilot or faction.
kits.summary: The Powered GM model has a broader, more heavily equipped GM silhouette than a regular Type C.
kits.lore: The Powered GM is a Federation prototype test machine used during the Gundam Development Project period. Its modified powerplant and heavily reinforced proportions support testing of new mobile-suit systems.

kits.notes: The Char version retains the stock Gelgoog's sweeping shoulder armor and flared lower body, but its commander-associated colors identify it as a separate kit. It should not replace the standard Gelgoog catalog entry.
kits.summary: The Char version retains the stock Gelgoog's sweeping shoulder armor and flared lower body, but its commander-associated colors identify it as a separate kit.
kits.lore: Char Aznable uses a personalized Gelgoog late in the One Year War after earlier commanding the Zaku II and Z'Gok. The late-war machine brings Zeon's advanced mass-production technology into the hands of its famous ace pilot.

kits.notes: Jupitive is recognizable by its white-dominant armor and expanded equipment suited to space-combat poses. It shares the Core Gundam concept with Earthree but represents a different armor configuration. Confirm whether a specific product includes the central Core Gundam or only the external armor.
kits.summary: Hiroto’s space-focused Planet System Gundam.
kits.lore: Jupitive Gundam is a Planet System configuration used by Hiroto Kuga in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. It expands the Core Gundam's combat options with a space-oriented equipment arrangement. Its existence illustrates how Hiroto changes strategies by selecting an appropriate armor system rather than replacing the entire central machine.

kits.summary: The prominent backpack mine equipment is the key visual cue separating this variant from the ordinary MS-06 Zaku II.
kits.lore: The Zaku Minelayer reconfigures the ubiquitous Zeon Zaku platform for mine deployment rather than a typical rifle-and-axe frontline role. Its rear equipment gives it a distinctive operational silhouette.

kits.name: ZAKU CANNON
kits.notes: Its shoulder-mounted cannon and support equipment establish the silhouette. The kit is cataloged independently from a standard Zaku II and named ace-specific Cannon variants.
kits.summary: Its shoulder-mounted cannon and support equipment establish the silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zaku Cannon adapts the mass-produced Zaku family for heavier battlefield support fire. It substitutes a more artillery-focused configuration for the basic Zaku's standard infantry role.

ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Unlike a standard humanoid military mobile suit, Mobile Doll May mixes a character-like figure with mechanical combat detailing. This kit has a very different display identity from the large WoDom Pod; verify the edition before promising face parts or alternate forms.
kits.summary: The human-shaped mechanical form of May from Re:RISE.
kits.lore: Mobile Doll May is a character-shaped mechanical body associated with May, an EL-Diver in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. It gives her a distinct form within Gunpla Battle and becomes important when the team learns more about her identity, beyond the WoDom Pod she normally operates.

kits.name: GOUF Ver.2.0
kits.notes: The Ver.2.0 Gouf reinterprets the classic blue armored suit with an emphasis on strong mechanical proportions and articulated equipment. This is a particular Master Grade-era design version rather than every Gouf release.
kits.summary: The Ver.2.0 Gouf reinterprets the classic blue armored suit with an emphasis on strong mechanical proportions and articulated equipment.
kits.lore: The Gouf is a Zeon ground-combat mobile suit, most famously linked to Ramba Ral during the One Year War. Its close-combat focus and integrated arm equipment distinguish it from the mass-produced Zaku series.

kits.name: QUBELEY Mk-Ⅱ (ELPEO PLE)
aliases: MG 1/100 キュベレイMk-II （エルピー・プル専用機）
kits.notes: The kit's blue-and-purple Qubeley Mk-II identity and sweeping shoulder binder design differentiate it from Haman Karn's white original and Ple Two's red unit.
kits.summary: The kit's blue-and-purple Qubeley Mk-II identity and sweeping shoulder binder design differentiate it from Haman Karn's white original and Ple Two's red unit.
kits.lore: Elpeo Ple pilots one of the Qubeley Mk-II machines in Gundam ZZ. It continues the original Qubeley's psycommu-powered funnel concept while expressing its pilot's separate place in the story.

kits.name: GN-X
kits.notes: GN-X models have a sharp angular head, prominent chest geometry and a highly recognizable X-like silhouette. GN-X II, III and IV types are later developments with distinct equipment and should not automatically inherit this base model's kit description.
kits.summary: The first mass-produced GN Drive Tau-powered adversary in Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-X is a GN Drive Tau-powered mass-production mobile suit introduced in Mobile Suit Gundam 00 as world military forces gain access to technology that can challenge Celestial Being. The design marks a major turning point: GN particle-powered combat is no longer the exclusive province of the Gundams. Pilots from the world's major powers use the type during the escalating conflict.

kits.name: OO QAN[T]
aliases: MG 1/100 ダブルオークアンタ
kits.notes: Its asymmetrical shoulder shield, blue-and-white frame and integrated GN Sword Bits define the movie design. A basic 00 Qan[T] should not be conflated with the additional armaments of the Full Saber variant.
kits.summary: Setsuna's advanced 00 Qan[T] from A Wakening of the Trailblazer.
kits.lore: The 00 Qan[T] is Setsuna F. Seiei's advanced Gundam from the film A Wakening of the Trailblazer. Designed to facilitate communication and understanding with the ELS, it incorporates the Quantum System and a specialized GN Sword and bit arrangement.

kits.name: Z GUNDAM
kits.notes: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette. Exact kit specifications depend on its listed grade and edition, not this shared design background.
kits.summary: This name-styled Z-Gundam entry centers on the signature head, swept wings and Zeta transformation silhouette.
kits.lore: The Zeta Gundam is the AEUG's transformable protagonist machine in the Gryps Conflict, piloted by Kamille Bidan. Its movable-frame construction and Waverider form mark a major advance beyond the earlier Gundam Mk-II.

kits.name: νGUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: The characteristic white body, dark torso and asymmetric fin-funnel arrangement make the Nu identifiable at a glance. This standard name entry should not be conflated with HWS or Hi-Nu variations.
kits.summary: The characteristic white body, dark torso and asymmetric fin-funnel arrangement make the Nu identifiable at a glance.
kits.lore: The Nu Gundam is Amuro Ray's advanced Earth Federation mobile suit used by Londo Bell in Char's Counterattack. Its psycho-frame and unique fin funnels distinguish it from the RX-78 lineage that made Amuro famous.

kits.name: TALLGEESE I EW VER.
kits.notes: The MG Tallgeese I EW edition preserves the original prototype identity in Endless Waltz styling. It is not the later Tallgeese II, Tallgeese III or feather-wing Fluegel configuration.
kits.summary: The MG Tallgeese I EW edition preserves the original prototype identity in Endless Waltz styling.
kits.lore: The Tallgeese is an advanced OZ-era prototype, with strong connections to Zechs Merquise and later mobile suits. Its extraordinary performance is balanced against demanding piloting requirements.

kits.name: AILE STRIKE GUNDAM Ver. RM
aliases: MG 1/100 AILE STRIKE GUNDAM Ver. RM
MG 1/100 エールストライクガンダム Ver.RM
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The Ver.RM kit identity centers on revised Strike proportions, armor panel design and the characteristic winged Aile Striker silhouette. Sword and Launcher packs are separate configurations, so the entry must not assume they come with this exact box.
kits.summary: The renewed Master Grade Aile Strike Gundam Ver.RM.
kits.lore: The Aile Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato's early Gundam SEED mobile suit equipped with the flight-oriented Aile Striker. The Master Grade Ver.RM is a renewed model interpretation of the original Strike, not a separate Cosmic Era unit.

kits.name: GUNDAM TERTIUM
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ガンダムテルティウム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Tertium’s angular dark armor and comparatively balanced body proportions contrast with Seltsam’s grotesquely enlarged arm. The complete Gundam Tertium kit should not be confused with the separately sold Tertium Arms equipment or the transformed Seltsam depiction.
kits.summary: The balanced angular Gundam behind the Seltsam story.
kits.lore: Gundam Tertium is an important mobile suit in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE, associated with the story behind the unsettling Gundam Seltsam. The design links a more conventional Gundam figure to the heavily altered opponent the Build Divers first encounter on Eldora.

kits.name: GEARA DOGA
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Geara Doga’s hose-like details, broad shoulder armor and military-green appearance evoke classic Zeon design language. Command colors, ace-pilot customs and Full Frontal-era variants require separate identification. Different releases can represent very different markings despite sharing a related basic silhouette.
kits.summary: Neo Zeon’s mass-production unit during the conflict in Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: The AMS-119 Geara Doga is Neo Zeon’s main mass-production mobile suit during the Second Neo Zeon War in Char’s Counterattack. It continues the Zaku and Geara lineage with military styling intended for use by regular soldiers under Char Aznable’s forces. Its soldiers operate alongside specialized Newtype equipment, reflecting the gap between conventional front-line units and powerful command machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA
aliases: RG 1/144 GN-001 ガンダムエクシア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Setsuna’s original Seven Swords mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents. It later undergoes major repairs and modifications following the first season’s battles.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept

kits.name: MBF-P02 GUNDAM ASTRAY RED FRAME
aliases: RG 1/144 MBF-P02 GUNDAM ASTRAY RED FRAME
RG 1/144 MBF-P02 ガンダムアストレイレッドフレーム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astray Red Frame models feature distinctive exposed red frame sections, white armor and sword-oriented posing. They vary considerably between normal, Kai and other equipment configurations. Check the precise edition before assuming a particular katana, backpack or effect part is included.
kits.summary: Lowe Guele’s salvager Gundam with striking red framework and sword imagery.
kits.lore: The MBF-P02 Gundam Astray Red Frame is a prototype from Gundam SEED Astray, the side-story setting around the main Cosmic Era conflict. Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild becomes its signature pilot and uses ingenuity and salvaged equipment to survive much larger battles. The Red Frame is especially associated with a Japanese-style sword, giving it a different fighting identity from ordinary rifle-equipped Gundams.
highlights: Lowe Guele and the Junk Guild
