aliases: MG 1/100 ジム・スナイパー カスタム
kits.notes: This standard GM Sniper Custom listing reflects the specialized sniper appearance. Named ace machines, including Tenneth A. Jung's version, remain separate retail entries.
kits.summary: This standard GM Sniper Custom listing reflects the specialized sniper appearance.
kits.lore: The GM Sniper Custom is an upgraded Federation GM designed for more specialized precision combat. Its modified sensor visor and weapon-oriented form distinguish it from the everyday RGM-79.

kits.name: GM COMMAND (COLONY TYPE)
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: MG 1/100 ジム・コマンド(コロニー戦仕様)
機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes: This MG Colony Type entry highlights the GM Command's practical armor and defense-oriented appearance. Its exact edition name is retained so it is not confused with the separately cataloged Space Type.
kits.summary: This MG Colony Type entry highlights the GM Command's practical armor and defense-oriented appearance.
kits.lore: The GM Command colony configuration served the Earth Federation as an improved defensive mass-production machine late in the One Year War. It is associated with War in the Pocket's colony fighting.

kits.name: GUNDAM G-ELSE
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ガンダム G-エルス
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE

kits.name: JEGAN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Jegan models feature a mint-green armor palette, a squared visor head and compact Federation equipment. Numerous successor and mission variants exist, including D Type, A Type and later-era color schemes. Check the product title before assuming an ordinary Jegan and a later modified Jegan use the same armor.
kits.summary: The Federation’s long-serving mass-production mobile suit from Char’s Counterattack onward.
kits.lore: The RGM-89 Jegan becomes a major Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit after the Gryps Conflict. It is prominent in Char’s Counterattack and continues to appear, in upgraded forms, across later Universal Century stories. Its design emphasizes reliable deployment and standardized equipment rather than a Gundam prototype’s exceptional performance.

kits.name: FULL ARMOR UNICORN GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 フルアーマー・ユニコーンガンダム

kits.name: GUNDAM DYNAMES
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムデュナメス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Dynames models emphasize a long rifle, shoulder-mounted shields and a comparatively slim chest. A GN-Arms combination is a separate package and should not be treated as the standard Dynames kit. Trans-Am and clear-color releases retain the same broad machine identity but differ in presentation and product specifics.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s specialist long-range Gundam piloted by Lockon Stratos.
kits.lore: The GN-002 Gundam Dynames is Celestial Being’s specialized long-range Gundam in the first season of Gundam 00. Lockon Stratos pilots it as one of the original Gundam Meisters, concentrating on precision shooting while teammates cover other combat roles. Its GN Sniper Rifle and head targeting arrangement support its specialist identity; Haro assists during demanding combat situations.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGEII MAGNUM
aliases: MG 1/100 ガンダムAGEIIマグナム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズ
kits.notes: AGEII Magnum features a sleeker AGE-2-derived body, angular blue armor and a transforming profile. SV and other named equipment versions are separate customizations and should not be assumed to share all accessories with the original Magnum kit.
kits.summary: Champion Kyoya Kujo’s AGE-2-derived custom Gunpla.
kits.lore: Gundam AGEII Magnum is the customized Gunpla operated by champion Kyoya Kujo in Gundam Build Divers. Drawing on Gundam AGE-2 design principles, it combines transformable high mobility with a strong dueling identity. Its reputation in GBN reflects the player's skill as well as a carefully refined custom model.

kits.name: MS-06R ZAKUⅡ(THE BLACK TRI-STARS)
aliases: MG 1/100 MS-06R ザクII（黒い三連星）

kits.name: GOGG
kits.notes: Gogg's very wide torso, squat legs and distinctive folded claw-hands create a compact, bulky outline. These proportions distinguish the model from the more streamlined Z'Gok and the smaller Acguy.
kits.summary: Gogg's very wide torso, squat legs and distinctive folded claw-hands create a compact, bulky outline.
kits.lore: The MSM-03 Gogg is an early Zeon amphibious mobile suit, valued for durability and underwater operation in the One Year War. Heavy armor and powerful arms define its unusual combat role.

kits.name: MSN-04 SAZABI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: Sazabi has rounded crimson armor, a powerful torso and enormous shoulder and skirt volumes. The standard MSN-04 is different from the far wider Nightingale and from finishing-specific Sazabi variants.
kits.summary: Sazabi has rounded crimson armor, a powerful torso and enormous shoulder and skirt volumes.
kits.lore: Sazabi is Char Aznable's personal Neo Zeon mobile suit in Char's Counterattack, built for his final confrontation with Amuro Ray. Its immense armor and remote-weapon equipment embody Char's command role and ambition.

kits.name: RX-93 νGUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-93 νガンダム（ニューガンダム）
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア

kits.name: RGZ-91 Re-GZ
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Re-GZ presents a streamlined white-and-blue Federation shape, with design cues linking it to Zeta Gundam. The Back Weapon System is central to the mobile suit’s identity, but included display parts vary between kits. Keep standard Re-GZ editions separate from the Re-GZ Custom and other later variations.
kits.summary: A Zeta-derived Federation mobile suit used in Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: The RGZ-91 Re-GZ is a Federation transformable mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam: Char’s Counterattack, piloted most notably by Amuro Ray before his return to the ν Gundam. Its name abbreviates Refined Gundam Zeta, reflecting design ideas inherited from the Zeta line. Rather than performing a complete transformation alone, the machine uses a detachable Back Weapon System to provide its flight configuration.

kits.name: MERCUONE UNIT
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 メルクワンユニット
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE

kits.name: RX-78 GP-03 DENDROBIUM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムGP03 デンドロビウム
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Dendrobium's giant equipment frame, thrusters and weapon housings dwarf the central Gundam unit. This entry describes the entire combined platform, not a standalone GP03S Stamen kit.
kits.summary: The Dendrobium's giant equipment frame, thrusters and weapon housings dwarf the central Gundam unit.
kits.lore: GP03 Dendrobium is a colossal Gundam Development Project weapons platform combining the GP03S Stamen with an external mobile-armor-like support system. Its extraordinary firepower is a major climax of Gundam 0083.

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM (CHAR'S COLOR)
aliases: MG 1/100 RX-78/C.A. キャスバル専用ガンダム

kits.name: S GUNDAM
aliases: ガンダム・センチネル
kits.notes: This MG kit focuses on the original S Gundam proportions, before the Ex-S heavy enhancement. Its shoulders, chest and articulated-looking machinery define the subject.
kits.summary: This MG kit focuses on the original S Gundam proportions, before the Ex-S heavy enhancement.
kits.lore: The S Gundam is an advanced Task Force Alpha prototype in Gundam Sentinel, whose ALICE system helps distinguish it from other machines in the Universal Century. Its modular configuration is part of the story's experimental-machine emphasis.

kits.name: DUEL GUNDAM ASSAULTSHROUD
aliases: HG 1/144 デュエルガンダム アサルトシュラウド
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The heavy Assault Shroud armor visibly thickens Duel's shoulders, chest and legs, giving it a bulkier identity than the base Duel Gundam. The added shell is the key design distinction; exact removability depends on the kit.
kits.summary: Duel Gundam fitted with its heavier Assault Shroud equipment.
kits.lore: Duel Gundam is one of the Earth Alliance GAT-X prototypes stolen by ZAFT in Gundam SEED and piloted by Yzak Joule. Its Assault Shroud equipment adds armor and weaponry, adapting the relatively straightforward Duel to more demanding front-line engagements.

kits.name: AEGIS GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 イージスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Aegis kits are notable for their pink-red armor and dramatic mobile suit-to-mobile armor design. Transformation mechanisms, extra connection pieces and stability differ by grade and release. Display planning should account for the far-reaching limbs and MA-mode shape.
kits.summary: Athrun Zala’s transforming GAT-X Gundam in the original SEED series.
kits.lore: The GAT-X303 Aegis Gundam is the transformable GAT-X prototype piloted by Athrun Zala after ZAFT captures it during the Heliopolis attack. Its mobile armor configuration and claw-like transformation allow an unusual style of attack that differs from other SEED machines. Aegis plays a central role in the personal conflict between Athrun and Kira Yamato.

kits.name: RGM-79C GM TYPE C
aliases: MG 1/100 RGM-79C ジム改（スタンダードカラー）
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This catalog entry explicitly uses the RGM-79C designation and the standard Type C form. The GM Custom RGM-79N is a different machine and should not inherit this description.
kits.summary: This catalog entry explicitly uses the RGM-79C designation and the standard Type C form.
kits.lore: The RGM-79C is the Federation's GM Type C, a mass-production suit used in Stardust Memory's early Universal Century setting. It represents conventional military hardware next to specialized Gundam prototypes.

kits.name: BUSTER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 バスターガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Buster has an unusually heavy gun-platform silhouette, with long weapons and mounting hardware shaping its outline. This is a better reference for long-range posing than agile sword duels. Exact weapon connections and pose support vary among MG and HG editions.
kits.summary: A long-range support Gundam piloted by Dearka Elsman in Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X103 Buster Gundam is another Earth Alliance machine captured by ZAFT during the Heliopolis raid. Dearka Elsman pilots it as a long-range fire-support unit, using a high-energy rifle and gun launcher that can combine for specialized attacks. Its combat role contrasts with the sword-focused Blitz and versatile Duel in the original five GAT-X machines.

kits.name: MOBILE GINN
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Ginn is recognized by its mono-eye head, broad backpack and utilitarian armor. The MG interpretation emphasizes the structure of an ordinary ZAFT machine rather than a unique protagonist Gundam. Keep it separate from specialist Ginn variants.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: ZAFT’s recognizable standard mobile suit from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The Mobile Ginn is a standard ZAFT mass-production mobile suit in Gundam SEED. It serves as one of the PLANT forces’ defining early-war units and helps establish how mobile suit technology changed the military balance in the Cosmic Era. Although less exotic than the advanced Gundams, Ginn is essential to the setting as a widely deployed machine whose variants reflect different battlefield needs.

kits.name: JUSTICE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ジャスティスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Justice is distinguished by its red-pink body and broad Fatum backpack, which creates a striking airborne silhouette. Be sure to differentiate it from Infinite Justice and later Justice variants; the lifter, colors and armor shape are not interchangeable. Different kits may offer different display options for the flight unit.
kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.

kits.name: CALAMITY GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 カラミティガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large shoulder-mounted and handheld ranged weapons are central to Calamity’s look. In Full Mechanics scale, the emphasis remains on the heavy-artillery design rather than transformable or close-combat gimmicks.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The Earth Alliance heavy-firepower Gundam from SEED.
kits.lore: Calamity Gundam is one of the Earth Alliance’s advanced Gundam units in Gundam SEED. It is associated with the Biological CPU pilot Orga Sabnak and specializes in heavy artillery support. Its oversized ranged weapons create a broad silhouette distinct from the fast-moving Raider and defensive Forbidden, the two other mobile suits frequently fielded alongside it.

kits.name: ZETA GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The elongated shield and wing binders are essential to Zeta’s Waverider configuration. Ver.Ka and other grades interpret the complex transformation differently, so the edition’s actual conversion steps should be checked before handling. The model’s appeal comes from the relationship between mobile suit proportions and its aircraft-like form.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kamille’s transforming AEUG Gundam from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: Zeta Gundam is Kamille Bidan’s signature transformable mobile suit in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Developed for the AEUG, it combines a fast-moving Waverider configuration with high-performance mobile suit combat. Its biography is closely tied to Kamille’s growth, the Gryps Conflict and the tensions between the Earth Federation, Titans and anti-Titans forces. The transformation becomes a defining feature of later variable-geometry Gundam designs.

kits.name: AILE STRIKE GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 エールストライクガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Aile Strike models combine the white, blue and red Strike armor with the long-winged Aile Striker equipment. The pack gives the silhouette a very different balance from Launcher and Sword Strike. Included mounts, beam sabers and pack mechanisms vary by grade and edition; do not assume every Strike release contains an Aile Striker.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s Strike Gundam configured for mobile Aile Striker combat.
kits.lore: The GAT-X105 Strike Gundam is an Earth Alliance prototype central to Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and famously piloted by Kira Yamato. Its modular Striker Pack system lets it adapt to different kinds of combat; the Aile Striker is designed around flight mobility and balanced armament. The suit's battles help define the growing conflict between Earth and ZAFT and Kira's changing allegiances.

kits.name: FORBIDDEN GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 フォビドゥンガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large scythe, broad rear equipment and curved armor define the Forbidden look. Unlike Raider, its identity centers on defensive systems and unusual beam interactions rather than a flight transformation.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The beam-defense-oriented Earth Alliance Gundam from SEED.
kits.lore: Forbidden Gundam is one of three Earth Alliance advanced units introduced in Gundam SEED. Piloted by Shani Andras, it combines a distinctive heavy, curved combat form with defensive technology designed to distort incoming beam attacks. Its large scythe and dark coloration distinguish it from the Calamity and Raider units used by the same group.

kits.name: RAIDER GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 レイダーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Its black-and-red armor, transformation-oriented shapes and distinctive weaponry set Raider apart from Calamity’s artillery role. Confirm the specific conversion steps and included parts in the edition’s instructions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The transformable Earth Alliance Gundam from SEED.
kits.lore: Raider Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit in Gundam SEED that can transform into a flight-oriented mobile armor configuration. Piloted by Clotho Buer, it operates alongside Calamity and Forbidden as part of the Alliance’s trio of advanced units. Its black-and-red coloring and unusual weapons reflect a design philosophy centered on attack speed and close-range pressure.

kits.name: PROVIDENCE GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 プロヴィデンスガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large DRAGOON units around the backpack and rear silhouette are the defining display features. Providence should not be confused with Legend Gundam or Strike Freedom, which also use remote armaments but have different shapes and equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Rau Le Creuset’s DRAGOON-equipped finale Gundam from SEED.
kits.lore: Providence Gundam is Rau Le Creuset’s heavily armed mobile suit in Gundam SEED. It uses an extensive DRAGOON remote weapon system, allowing multi-directional attacks that challenge the protagonists during the final phase of the war. Its stark head design and radiating backpack distinguish it from ZAFT’s other advanced Gundams, while Rau’s role as its pilot makes it closely linked to the story’s debate over human destiny and resentment.

kits.name: STRIKE ROUGE + IWSP
aliases: HG 1/144 ストライクルージュ＋I.W.S.P.
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The pink-toned Rouge armor and multi-weapon IWSP backpack are the visual anchors of this edition. Keep this configuration separate from plain Strike Rouge, Aile Strike and Grand Slam editions, even if they share underlying Strike-family elements.
kits.summary: Strike Rouge equipped with the heavy IWSP Striker Pack.
kits.lore: Strike Rouge is the Orb-based Strike-derived machine associated with Cagalli Yula Athha in Gundam SEED. The IWSP combination equips the Rouge with an Integrated Weapons Striker Pack, producing a much more heavily armed appearance than its basic setup.

kits.name: MOBILE CGUE
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Its shoulder shape, elongated head profile and refined humanoid mono-eye armor distinguish the CGUE from the stock GINN. This standard machine must not inherit the experimental beam weapons of the CGUE D.E.E.P. Arms variant.
kits.summary: ZAFT's more advanced commander-use CGUE.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-515 CGUE is a ZAFT commander-use mobile suit developed from the earlier GINN family in Gundam SEED. It reflects the growing sophistication of ZAFT's conventional Cosmic Era machines before the wider introduction of later high-performance lines.

kits.name: METEOR UNIT+ FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ミーティアユニット＋フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: DREADNOUGHT GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ドレッドノートガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: The pale armored frame, large backpack equipment and distinctive remote-weapon-related appearance set Dreadnought apart from regular GINN or Strike models. Its technology-driven side-story role is central to its identity.
kits.summary: A significant prototype from Gundam SEED X Astray.
kits.lore: Dreadnought Gundam is a prototype appearing in Gundam SEED X Astray, important to early ZAFT nuclear-powered mobile suit development. Its significance lies in the path toward later high-performance machines and technology such as remote weapon control.

kits.name: RX-78-02 GUNDAM (GUNDAM THE ORIGIN Ver.)
aliases: HG 1/144 RX-78-02 GUNDAM (GUNDAM THE ORIGIN Ver.)
HG 1/144 RX-78-02 ガンダム(GUNDAM THE ORIGIN版)
機動戦士ガンダム THE ORIGIN
kits.notes: This HG Origin Version portrays the RX-78-02 in a separate grade from the MG entry. Its detailing and proportions represent this continuity rather than a conventional original-series RX-78-2 kit.
kits.summary: This HG Origin Version portrays the RX-78-02 in a separate grade from the MG entry.
kits.lore: Amuro Ray's RX-78-02 is the centerpiece of Gundam The Origin's updated One Year War setting. Its mechanical interpretation revisits the original Federation prototype while preserving the iconic Gundam identity.

kits.name: GUNNER ZAKU WARRIOR
aliases: HG 1/144 ガナーザクウォーリア
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes: This ordinary Gunner ZAKU Warrior entry is distinct from Lunamaria Hawke's named red machine. The long-barrel cannon configuration defines the product's equipment role.
kits.summary: This ordinary Gunner ZAKU Warrior entry is distinct from Lunamaria Hawke's named red machine.
kits.lore: A ZAKU Warrior using the Gunner Wizard sacrifices flexibility in favor of long-range artillery support in the SEED Destiny setting. The Wizard concept lets ZAFT change equipment without replacing the whole mobile suit.

kits.name: ZAKU WARRIOR (LIVE CONCERT VERSION)
aliases: HG 1/144 ザクウォーリア(ライブコンサートバージョン)
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY

kits.name: ASSHIMAR
kits.notes: The Asshimar transforms between a broad orange mobile-suit shape and an unmistakable flattened flying form. Those round armor and joint relationships distinguish it from a conventional Titans humanoid suit.
kits.summary: The Asshimar transforms between a broad orange mobile-suit shape and an unmistakable flattened flying form.
kits.lore: The Asshimar is a large transformable mobile armor used by the Earth Federation and Titans, known for its disc-like flight configuration and atmospheric operations. It prominently confronts Karaba and AEUG forces in Zeta Gundam.

kits.name: STRIKE FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ストライクフリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira’s advanced, gold-framed mobile suit from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.name: GABTHLEY
kits.notes: Gabthley's claw-like armor geometry and unusual proportions distinguish it from the flatter Hambrabi or bulkier Messala. The transformable layout is integral to how the kit should be identified.
kits.summary: Gabthley's claw-like armor geometry and unusual proportions distinguish it from the flatter Hambrabi or bulkier Messala.
kits.lore: Gabthley is a transformable Titans mobile suit connected to Paptimus Scirocco's design circle during the Gryps Conflict. It combines an aggressive armored outline with a compact mobile armor configuration.

kits.name: METHUS
kits.notes: Methuss uses a bright yellow frame-like body and long articulated limb sections that lead into an aircraft-like transformation. This unusual lightly armored look is very different from the traditional Gundam torso.
kits.summary: Methuss uses a bright yellow frame-like body and long articulated limb sections that lead into an aircraft-like transformation.
kits.lore: The Methuss is an AEUG support and transformable mobile suit introduced as the Zeta project refined movable-frame technology. Its deployment is closely associated with Fa Yuiry and other AEUG personnel.

kits.name: GAZA C (HAMAN KARN'S MOBILE SUIT)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 GAZA C (HAMAN KARN'S MOBILE SUIT)
HGUC 1/144 ガザC ハマーン専用機

kits.name: GUNDAM GP-02A
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ガンダムGP02A サイサリス
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The GP02A Physalis is recognizable by its heavy armor and enormous shield, distinct from the GP01 and GP03 Gundams. The GP-02A designation is kept separately for product searches.
kits.summary: The GP02A Physalis is recognizable by its heavy armor and enormous shield, distinct from the GP01 and GP03 Gundams.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP02A Physalis is a nuclear-capable Gundam Development Project machine seized by Anavel Gato. Its theft sets the central crisis of Stardust Memory in motion.

kits.name: BLU DUEL GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 ブルデュエルガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes: Dark-blue reinforced armor and revised close-combat equipment distinguish Blu Duel from Yzak Joule's original Duel and Assault Shroud configurations. Its appearance is a separate Stargazer-era design rather than a palette swap.
kits.summary: The Stargazer-era Phantom Pain variant of Duel Gundam.
kits.lore: Blu Duel Gundam is an upgraded Duel-type machine fielded by Phantom Pain in Gundam SEED C.E. 73: Stargazer and associated with Mudie Holcroft. Its enhancements build on the original Duel and reflect the specialized warfare approach of the Actaeon Project.

kits.name: URAVEN GUNDAM
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ユーラヴェンガンダム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Blue-and-white armor, sharp panels and long-range equipment give Uraven a distinct sniper-like silhouette. It should not be collapsed into Earthree, Jupitive or other PLANETS configurations merely because they share the Core Gundam platform.
kits.summary: The long-range-focused Uraven configuration of Core Gundam II.
kits.lore: Uraven Gundam is a form of Hiroto Kuga’s Core Gundam II in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Created through the PLANETS System, this configuration emphasizes precise long-distance engagements and gives Hiroto a specialized option as his team takes on increasingly serious missions.

kits.name: CIVILIAN ASTRAY DSSD CUSTOM
aliases: HG 1/144 シビリアンアストレイ DSSDカスタム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED

kits.name: ACGUY
kits.notes: Its spherical head and body, telescoping arm shapes and heavy rounded feet give Acguy a softer silhouette than the Z'Gok or Gogg. The compact amphibious appearance is the core of this catalog entry.
kits.summary: Its spherical head and body, telescoping arm shapes and heavy rounded feet give Acguy a softer silhouette than the Z'Gok or Gogg.
kits.lore: The Acguy is a compact Zeon amphibious mobile suit from the One Year War, recognized for its rounded bear-like outline and deployable arms. It is often associated with covert amphibious operations near enemy installations.

kits.name: RX-79G GUNDAM GROUND TYPE
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team
aliases: HGUC 1/144 RX-79〔G〕 陸戦型ガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Ground Type kits often highlight utilitarian armor, backpacks, knee and shoulder construction, and earthbound battlefield posing. Equipment such as large weapons or storage containers depends on the particular product. Distinguish the Ground Type from the Ez8 field rebuild, whose front and body armor differ noticeably.
kits.summary: A ground-combat Federation Gundam associated with The 08th MS Team.
kits.lore: The RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type is a limited-production Earth Federation machine used for ground combat during the One Year War. It appears prominently in The 08th MS Team, where Shiro Amada leads a team operating in difficult terrestrial conditions. Unlike the iconic RX-78-2, these machines emphasize practical field deployment, maintenance and cooperation with other ground units.

kits.name: ZOCK
kits.notes: Zock has a massive slab-like torso and broad armored limbs, with an almost mirrored front-to-back design. Its deliberate lack of a conventional humanoid Gundam shape makes this a distinctive display subject.
kits.summary: Zock has a massive slab-like torso and broad armored limbs, with an almost mirrored front-to-back design.
kits.lore: The Zock is an unusual, heavy Zeon amphibious mobile suit with a nearly symmetrical body layout and extensive beam-fire capability. Its squat form makes it one of the strangest machines in the original Gundam conflict.

kits.name: GELGOOG/ GELGOOG CANNON
aliases: HGUC 1/144 量産型ゲルググ／ゲルググキャノン

kits.name: JAGD DOGA (GYUNEI)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ヤクト・ドーガ(ギュネイ・ガス専用機)
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: Gyunei's version has large funnel-bearing shoulders and its recognizable coloring. It must be distinguished from Quess's contrasting Jagd Doga rather than treated as a generic single kit.
kits.summary: Gyunei's version has large funnel-bearing shoulders and its recognizable coloring.
kits.lore: The Jagd Doga is a Newtype-oriented Neo Zeon machine seen during Char's Counterattack. Gyunei Guss's version represents the mass-production Geara Doga concept expanded with remote funnel armament for a specialist pilot.

kits.name: JAGD DOGA (QUESS)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ヤクト・ドーガ(クェス・エア専用機)
機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: Quess's Jagd Doga uses a striking separate color treatment over the Jagd Doga's large rounded armor and funnel equipment. This record should retain the named pilot distinction from Gyunei's edition.
kits.summary: Quess's Jagd Doga uses a striking separate color treatment over the Jagd Doga's large rounded armor and funnel equipment.
kits.lore: Quess Paraya pilots a specialized Jagd Doga in Char's Counterattack after joining Neo Zeon's campaign. The machine belongs to the same psycommu-equipped design family as Gyunei's, though its specific appearance is different.

kits.name: ZAKU II KAI
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes: The kit presents the late-war Kai/FZ silhouette instead of the original MS-06F's familiar lines. This entry is a different grade and release from the RE/100 FZ catalog item.
kits.summary: The kit presents the late-war Kai/FZ silhouette instead of the original MS-06F's familiar lines.
kits.lore: Bernard Wiseman pilots the MS-06FZ Zaku II Kai in War in the Pocket. The FZ design is a modernized version of Zeon's classic Zaku and provides the poignant counterpoint to Gundam Alex.

kits.name: KAMPFER
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Kämpfer’s rounded blue armor, exposed thruster clusters and curved limbs create a very different build from typical Gundam designs. The positions of its carried weapons are an important visual cue. Kämpfer Amazing and other Build-series redesigns are separate machines with different color and equipment concepts.
kits.summary: The fast Zeon assault unit from War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The MS-18E Kämpfer is a Zeon assault mobile suit used in Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket. Mikhail Kaminsky pilots it during the operation against the Federation’s secret Gundam development effort. Designed for a rapid, high-impact strike, the Kämpfer favors mobility and a striking array of carried weapons over prolonged defensive combat.

kits.name: GEARA DOGA
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Geara Doga’s hose-like details, broad shoulder armor and military-green appearance evoke classic Zeon design language. Command colors, ace-pilot customs and Full Frontal-era variants require separate identification. Different releases can represent very different markings despite sharing a related basic silhouette.
kits.summary: Neo Zeon’s mass-production unit during the conflict in Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: The AMS-119 Geara Doga is Neo Zeon’s main mass-production mobile suit during the Second Neo Zeon War in Char’s Counterattack. It continues the Zaku and Geara lineage with military styling intended for use by regular soldiers under Char Aznable’s forces. Its soldiers operate alongside specialized Newtype equipment, reflecting the gap between conventional front-line units and powerful command machines.

kits.name: GUNDAM GP-RASE-TWO-TEN
aliases: ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE

kits.name: GN ARCHER
aliases: HG 1/144 GNアーチャー（ガンアーチャー）
kits.notes: Its orange-and-white body, compact fighter components and partner-machine design distinguish GN Archer from the larger Arios. The equipment is part of its collaboration role, not a replacement identity for the Gundam it supports.
kits.summary: The support transformable mobile suit designed to cooperate with Arios Gundam.
kits.lore: GN Archer is a support mobile suit from the later Gundam 00 television storyline, piloted by Soma Peries/Marie Parfacy. Developed to cooperate with Arios Gundam, it can shift between humanoid and flight-oriented forms for combined operations.

kits.name: OO-RAISER DESIGNER'S COLOR Ver.
aliases: HG 1/144 ダブルオーライザー デザイナーズカラーVer.

kits.name: al-Saache's AEU ENACT CUSTOM Moralia Development experiment type
aliases: HG 1/144 al-Saache's AEU ENACT CUSTOM Moralia Development experiment type
HG 1/144 サーシェス専用AEUイナクトカスタム（モラリア開発実験型）

kits.name: GARAZZO
kits.notes: The Garazzo entry identifies the pointed head and enclosed claw-like combat form without attributing the machine to a single color custom. Named pilot editions can remain separate.
kits.summary: The Garazzo entry identifies the pointed head and enclosed claw-like combat form without attributing the machine to a single color custom.
kits.lore: Garazzo is an Innovade faction mobile suit used by the antagonist forces in the second season of Gundam 00. Its aggressive GN-equipped armor differs substantially from Celestial Being's Gundams.

kits.name: CHERUDIM GUNDAM GNHW/R
aliases: HG 1/144 ケルディムガンダム GNHW/R
kits.notes: The GNHW/R configuration identifies the upgraded rifle-oriented Cherudim loadout, separate from the basic green Cherudim or Trans-Am color edition.
kits.summary: The GNHW/R configuration identifies the upgraded rifle-oriented Cherudim loadout, separate from the basic green Cherudim or Trans-Am color edition.
kits.lore: Cherudim Gundam is Lockon Stratos's second-season sniper machine, succeeding Dynames in the Celestial Being lineup. Its GN Heavy Weapons equipment further expands long-range capability.

kits.name: Hi-νGUNDAM
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes: The Hi-Nu's broad funnels, flowing armor transitions and distinct blue-and-white identity separate it from the film's RX-93 Nu. This catalog entry represents the named Hi-Nu design rather than a standard Nu recolor.
kits.summary: The Hi-Nu's broad funnels, flowing armor transitions and distinct blue-and-white identity separate it from the film's RX-93 Nu.
kits.lore: Hi-Nu Gundam is associated with the alternative Beltorchika's Children interpretation of Amuro Ray's ultimate mobile suit. It builds on the Nu Gundam idea with a different body, color treatment and fin-funnel configuration.

kits.name: SCHUZRUM-DIAS
aliases: HGUC 1/144 シュツルム・ディアス
kits.notes: The kit carries distinctive thruster and shoulder styling on a Rick Dias-derived frame. It is a distinct design and should not receive a standard Rick Dias summary.
kits.summary: The kit carries distinctive thruster and shoulder styling on a Rick Dias-derived frame.
kits.lore: The Schuzrum Dias is a Neo Zeon development derived from the Rick Dias concept, appearing in Gundam ZZ. Its altered armor and equipment show how older AEUG-era technology was adapted for a new faction.

kits.name: EWACK-ZACK
kits.notes: The oversized sensor head and radome-like equipment dominate this kit's shape. Those electronic-reconnaissance elements distinguish the EWAC Zack from a regular Hizack.
kits.summary: The oversized sensor head and radome-like equipment dominate this kit's shape.
kits.lore: The EWAC Zack is an electronic-warfare reconnaissance machine used by Neo Zeon in Gundam ZZ. Its large sensor system changes the older Hizack lineage from a combat suit into a surveillance platform.

kits.name: RX-78-3 FULL ARMOR GUNDAM 7th
aliases: HGUC 1/144 フルアーマーガンダム７号機

kits.name: RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM (DESTROY MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム デストロイモード

kits.name: SATURNIX UNIT
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 サタニクス ユニット
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE

kits.name: GEARA ZULU
kits.notes: Geara Zulu kits emphasize its gas-mask-like head, distinctive chest crest and reinforced soldier silhouette. Standard, Guards Type and pilot-specific versions differ in armor and markings. Compare the exact title rather than automatically assigning a generic Geara Zulu profile to every special configuration.
kits.summary: The Sleeves’ distinctive mass-production mobile suit from Unicorn.
kits.lore: The AMS-129 Geara Zulu is a Neo Zeon mass-production mobile suit featured in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn, associated with the Sleeves organization. Its armored military styling develops ideas seen in the Geara Doga but reflects the equipment and identity of the post-Char Neo Zeon remnants. The suit serves regular soldiers while more exceptional units occupy the center of the conflict.

kits.name: STARK JEGAN
aliases: HGUC 1/144 スタークジェガン
kits.notes: Its additional armor, large shoulder missile pods and reinforced, heavily armed outline distinguish the Stark Jegan from a standard RGM-89. Different Stark Jegan depictions may vary in colors or weapons, so the catalog should keep the specified edition separate.
kits.summary: A missile-equipped Federation Jegan variant featured in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The Stark Jegan is an armed variant of the Earth Federation's Jegan family, adapted for escort and anti-ship or heavy-combat duties. In Gundam Unicorn, a Stark Jegan's engagement with the Kshatriya shows how a conventional Federation pilot can challenge a far more exotic psychoframe-era opponent.

kits.name: RX-0 UNICORN GUNDAM (UNICORN MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム ユニコーンモード

kits.name: F2-ZAKU (ZEON TYPE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-06F-2 ザクII(ジオン軍仕様)
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: The Zeon Type designation points to the F2's Zeon-service appearance. Its colors and faction identity separate it from the Federation-use F2 release based on the same design.
kits.summary: The Zeon Type designation points to the F2's Zeon-service appearance.
kits.lore: The Zaku II F2 remains a useful improved Zeon mobile suit after the One Year War. In Stardust Memory, Zeon remnants continue to deploy the same line with faction-specific equipment.

kits.name: HGAW 1/144 GUNDAM X
aliases: HGAW 1/144 ガンダムX(エックス)

kits.name: CHERUDIM GUNDAM (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 ケルディムガンダム（トランザムモード） グロスインジェクションVer.
kits.notes: The Trans-Am Mode product is a special presentation of Cherudim, rather than an individual heavy-weapon attachment pack. Keep it separate from the standard release.
kits.summary: The Trans-Am Mode product is a special presentation of Cherudim, rather than an individual heavy-weapon attachment pack.
kits.lore: Cherudim is Lockon Stratos's precise, remote-shield-equipped Gundam in the second season of Gundam 00. Its beam rifle and GN Shield Bits enable flexible ranged support.

kits.name: SUSANOWO (TRANS-AM MODE)
aliases: HG 1/144 スサノオ（トランザムモード）グロスインジェクションバージョン
kits.notes: This Trans-Am Mode listing is a special Susanowo color interpretation. It should not be cataloged as Masurao or one of the earlier Flag variants associated with the same pilot.
kits.summary: This Trans-Am Mode listing is a special Susanowo color interpretation.
kits.lore: Susanowo is an advanced customized machine associated with Mr. Bushido's pursuit of Setsuna and the 00 Gundam. Its striking weapon configuration emphasizes close combat.

kits.name: LOTO TWIN SET
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ロト ツインセット

kits.name: F2-ZAKU (EARTH FEDERATION TYPE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 MS-06F-2 ザクII(連邦軍仕様)
機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes: This Federation Type edition keeps the recognizable late Zaku II form in a Federation-colored presentation. It is cataloged separately from the Zeon Type even though both are F2 machines.
kits.summary: This Federation Type edition keeps the recognizable late Zaku II form in a Federation-colored presentation.
kits.lore: The Earth Federation fields captured or reassigned Zaku II F2 machines in Stardust Memory, illustrating how wartime equipment persisted under new owners.

kits.name: GUNDAM ZABANYA
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムサバーニャ
kits.notes: Its layered green armor, large movable weapon containers and multiple bit-related equipment points distinguish Zabanya from the simpler sniper profile of Dynames. The Final Battle configuration is a separate listed edition.
kits.summary: Lockon's advanced long-range Gundam Zabanya.
kits.lore: Gundam Zabanya is Lockon Stratos' long-range Gundam introduced in A Wakening of the Trailblazer. It extends the Dynames and Cherudim lineage by using extensive GN Holster Bits and rifle-type remote weapons for highly mobile defensive and precision fire.

kits.name: ALUS EARTHREE GUNDAM
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 アルスアースリィガンダム
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: Its dark and pale armor scheme and altered Core Gundam silhouette echo Earthree without representing the same protagonist unit. Cataloging it separately prevents the story of Hiroto’s own Earthree Gundam from being assigned to this opposing machine.
kits.summary: The hostile Earthree-like Gunpla associated with Alus.
kits.lore: Alus Earthree Gundam is an antagonistic Core-Gundam-style machine from Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Its use of a familiar Earthree-like framework under different control creates a disturbing reflection of Hiroto’s PLANETS System as the conflict surrounding Eldora is revealed.

kits.name: GOD GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
God Gundam’s appeal is its athletic, fighter-like posture. Notice the segmented chest, the hands associated with its finishing attack, and the opening elements of the Hyper Mode design. Different grades offer different balances of articulated movement, surface detail and display complexity; check the specific edition’s manual for the included hand parts and effect accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Neo Japan’s martial-arts Gundam from G Gundam, known for God Finger and Hyper Mode.
kits.lore: Domon Kasshu pilots the God Gundam in the 13th Gundam Fight, representing Neo Japan after his earlier Shining Gundam. The machine is built for close-range combat rather than conventional ranged warfare. Its responsive motion supports Domon’s martial-arts techniques, including the God Finger, while its Hyper Mode opens distinctive body sections and gives it a striking winged profile. The machine’s rivalry with Master Gundam is closely tied to Domon’s relationship with Master Asia, making its battles both personal and political.
highlights: God Finger and Hyper Mode design

kits.name: GUNDAM AVALANCHE EXIA'
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダム アヴァランチエクシアダッシュ
kits.notes: Avalanche Exia alters the clean original Exia silhouette with bulky propulsion equipment at the shoulders and lower body. This named kit is about that equipment configuration rather than an ordinary Exia armor finish.
kits.summary: Avalanche Exia alters the clean original Exia silhouette with bulky propulsion equipment at the shoulders and lower body.
kits.lore: Gundam Avalanche Exia is a mobility-focused equipment variant of Celestial Being's Gundam Exia, associated with Gundam 00 side stories. Additional thrust hardware gives the sword-centered Exia a distinctive high-speed assault profile.

kits.name: 1.5 GUNDAM
kits.notes: The 1.5 designation is the central product identity and should not be normalized to an ordinary 0 Gundam or 00 Gundam. Its back-mounted silhouette is visually distinct.
kits.summary: The 1.5 designation is the central product identity and should not be normalized to an ordinary 0 Gundam or 00 Gundam.
kits.lore: The 1.5 Gundam, sometimes styled I.5 Gundam, belongs to the expanded Gundam 00 side-story lineage. It combines a classic Gundam-inspired form with powerful GN equipment.

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAEA
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアストレア
kits.notes: This is the standard Astraea design, distinct from red Type-F or special Proto GN blade packages. Its straightforward white Gundam silhouette reflects the earlier generation.
kits.summary: This is the standard Astraea design, distinct from red Type-F or special Proto GN blade packages.
kits.lore: Gundam Astraea is an early Celestial Being GN-drive prototype whose design precedes Gundam Exia. The machine's development informs later GN weapon experimentation and the 00 side-story setting.

kits.name: GEARA ZULU ANGELO SAUPER'S
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ギラ・ズール(アンジェロ・ザウパー専用機)
kits.notes: This release depicts Angelo's personally customized Geara Zulu and its marksman-oriented identity. It is not an ordinary green Geara Zulu or a generic bodyguard type.
kits.summary: This release depicts Angelo's personally customized Geara Zulu and its marksman-oriented identity.
kits.lore: Angelo Sauper is an ardent follower of Full Frontal in the Sleeves, operating a personalized Geara Zulu. His unit is associated with long-range support and distinctive purple markings.

kits.name: GOUF CUSTOM
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The 08th MS Team
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 第08MS小隊
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Gouf Custom’s shield-mounted gatling system and heat-wire equipment dominate its silhouette. Models benefit from poses that express weight and motion rather than a purely upright stance. Standard Gouf and Gouf Custom kits should be cataloged separately because their equipment and outward details differ.
kits.summary: The heavily armed Gouf Custom piloted by Norris Packard.
kits.lore: The MS-07B-3 Gouf Custom is closely associated with Zeon ace Norris Packard in The 08th MS Team. Its combination of heavy armament, speed and aggressive close combat turns a relatively grounded battlefield encounter into one of the series’ most memorable duels. The machine differs from the earlier Gouf design through its distinctive equipment and more specialized appearance.

kits.name: JESTA
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Jesta kit is recognizable by its dark armor, compact sensor-rich head and broad tactical proportions. The normal Jesta should be distinguished from the heavier Jesta Cannon and Shezarr Team configurations. Different model grades interpret the shoulders, shield system and backpack proportions in their own ways.
kits.summary: A high-performance Londo Bell unit featured alongside the Unicorn Gundam.
kits.lore: The RGM-96X Jesta appears in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn as a high-performance Federation unit connected with Londo Bell and the Ra Cailum. Developed with support for special missions involving the Unicorn Gundam, it combines a subdued tactical appearance with the versatility expected of a modern general-purpose mobile suit. Its deployment underlines how conventional Federation forces operate alongside far more exceptional Newtype-use machines.

kits.name: GM Ⅲ
kits.notes: Compared with the classic GM, the GM III has a more angular modernized silhouette and is often associated with additional missile equipment. Standard GM III releases differ from special Desert Color, Unicorn-era and Build-series interpretations; check each kit title before assuming the same markings or parts.
kits.summary: A later-generation Federation upgrade of the mass-produced GM.
kits.lore: The RGM-86R GM III is an upgraded Federation general-purpose mobile suit visible in the late Gryps and First Neo Zeon War eras, with later service appearances in the Universal Century. It updates the older GM lineage with improved equipment and mobility while retaining the practical purpose of a mass-production machine. Its persistence illustrates the Federation's preference for evolving established platforms.

kits.name: UNICORN GUNDAM 02 BANSHEE (UNICORN MODE)
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ユニコーンガンダム2号機 バンシィ(ユニコーンモード)

kits.name: GENOACE
kits.notes: The Genoace has a simple rounded head, prominent visor and relatively plain Federation armor, expressing a practical service machine instead of an experimental Gundam. Its recognizable red-and-white appearance differs from later Genoace II and pilot-specific Genoace Custom models.
kits.summary: The standard Federation mobile suit from the opening era of Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: The RGE-B790 Genoace is an Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit deployed during the first generation of Gundam AGE. It represents the military’s conventional response to attacks by the Unknown Enemy, but initially lacks the power to match those mysterious opponents. The AGE-1’s arrival exposes the limits of this earlier equipment.
highlights: Distinct from Genoace II and Custom

kits.name: GUNDAM AEGIS KNIGHT
aliases: HGBD:R 1/144 ガンダムイージスナイト
ガンダムビルドダイバーズRe:RISE
kits.notes: The prominent shield-like armor and strong knightly silhouette communicate a protector role, while transformation influences set it apart from Justice Knight. This is Kazami’s Build-series machine and not Athrun Zala’s original Gundam Aegis.
kits.summary: Kazami’s upgraded, guardian-themed Gunpla in Re:RISE.
kits.lore: Gundam Aegis Knight is Kazami Torimachi’s upgraded Gunpla in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. Reflecting his growth from showy solo aspirations toward genuine teamwork, the machine succeeds his Justice Knight and combines an armored guardian identity with a design inspired by the Aegis Gundam.
highlights: Separate from Justice Knight and Aegis

kits.name: ZEDAS
kits.notes: The machine’s narrow angular armor, pronounced blade elements and flight-oriented silhouette set it apart from the bulkier Gafran. Its original dark scheme is distinct from later Zedas R and other follow-on designs, which should retain separate catalog identities.
kits.summary: The fast, sharp-edged Unknown Enemy mobile suit from early Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Zedas is a high-mobility Unknown Enemy design encountered during the first generation of Gundam AGE. Its extreme speed and cutting attacks make it a formidable opponent for Flit Asuno; it belongs to the Vagan technological lineage that is gradually revealed as the conflict develops.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-1 SPALLOW
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-1 スパロー
kits.notes: Spallow models emphasize a narrow blue-and-white figure, a light-footed stance, and the distinctive short-blade identity of the form. Its reduced armor volume visually distinguishes it from both standard AGE-1 and the bulky Titus Wear; verify exactly which weapon parts each edition includes.
kits.summary: The nimble AGE-1 Spallow Wear created for fast, close-range fighting.
kits.lore: The AGE-1 Spallow is a second specialized Wear developed through the AGE System during Flit Asuno’s battles in Gundam AGE. Where Titus favors brute strength, Spallow is designed for high-speed attacks and evasive movement, using a nimble ninja-like approach to counter fast enemy machines.
highlights: Contrasts with the heavy Titus form

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 NORMAL
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-2 ノーマル
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
AGE-2 Normal kits are identified by their sharp shoulders, wing-like armor and white-blue palette. The later Dark Hound version changes the machine’s identity, colors and equipment, and should be kept separate. Verify the release’s actual transformation instructions rather than assuming identical gimmicks across grades.
kits.summary: Asemu Asuno’s transforming Gundam AGE-2 Normal.
kits.lore: The AGE-2 Gundam AGE-2 Normal becomes Asemu Asuno’s principal Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE. Its fast-moving transformable design contrasts with the AGE-1’s earlier configuration, reflecting the next stage in the Asuno family’s story. The AGE-2 combines a sharp wing-like profile with mobile suit and flight-oriented operation.

kits.name: GUNDAM AGE-2 DOUBLE BULLET
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムAGE-2 ダブルバレット
kits.notes: Long equipment binders, bulkier upper-body detailing and a broad combat stance make Double Bullet easy to distinguish from AGE-2 Normal. Its large weapon-bearing silhouette is the core feature; transformations and supplied accessories vary by kit edition.
kits.summary: Asemu’s heavy-firepower Double Bullet configuration of Gundam AGE-2.
kits.lore: The AGE-2 Double Bullet is a heavily armed Wear used by Asemu Asuno in the second generation of Gundam AGE. Built to fight multiple opponents, this configuration trades the normal AGE-2’s straightforward flight emphasis for a striking increase in ranged and close-range firepower.

kits.name: G-BOUNCER
kits.notes: G-Bouncer combines angular white armor with a visor-like face and a particularly athletic silhouette. It is neither a G-Exes nor a regular Federation Adele, despite their shared era and color language. Its restrained armor emphasizes movement over oversized weaponry.
kits.summary: Woolf Enneacle’s white high-performance suit in the AGE-2 era.
kits.lore: The G-Bouncer is Woolf Enneacle’s high-performance white mobile suit in the second generation of Gundam AGE. By this stage Woolf has become an experienced commander and mentor to Asemu Asuno, and his machine reflects the agility and personal style that earned him the White Wolf nickname.

kits.name: FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: RG 1/144 ZGMF-X10A フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.name: ZEE ZULU
kits.notes: The Zee Zulu's aquatic gear, powerful lower-leg silhouette and underwater mission identity distinguish it from the standard Geara Zulu it resembles in name.

kits.lore: The Zee Zulu is a modern Neo Zeon amphibious mobile suit used in the Unicorn-era Earth operations. Its equipment is tailored to underwater insertion and close fighting around coastal facilities.

kits.lore: The Dra-C is a Zeon remnant space mobile suit improvised using existing parts and a propulsion-heavy lower section. It is associated with the Delaz Fleet during Operation Stardust.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Aegis kits are notable for their pink-red armor and dramatic mobile suit-to-mobile armor design. Transformation mechanisms, extra connection pieces and stability differ by grade and release. Display planning should account for the far-reaching limbs and MA-mode shape.
kits.summary: Athrun Zala’s transforming GAT-X Gundam in the original SEED series.
kits.lore: The GAT-X303 Aegis Gundam is the transformable GAT-X prototype piloted by Athrun Zala after ZAFT captures it during the Heliopolis attack. Its mobile armor configuration and claw-like transformation allow an unusual style of attack that differs from other SEED machines. Aegis plays a central role in the personal conflict between Athrun and Kira Yamato.

It develops from Fellini's heavily modified Wing Gundam Fenice after years of battles and repairs, demonstrating the attachment of a builder to a frequently rebuilt model. The renewed design returns to a more symmetrical appearance while preserving its flamboyant fighting identity.

kits.name: RX-78-2 GUNDAM
aliases: ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78-2 ガンダム
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The original Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray, reinterpreted across numerous Gunpla grades.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. Later Gundam designs repeatedly refer back to its configuration and combat record.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions

kits.lore: Re:Rising Gundam is a combined final-stage configuration created by the core Build Divers team in Gundam Build Divers Re:RISE. It embodies the collaboration between Hiroto, Kazami, Parviz and May, combining the designs and strengths of their machines during a decisive confrontation.
highlights: Multiple Gunpla joined into one form

aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The GP01 retains a classic Federation Gundam appearance but uses a more layered chest, backpack and armor treatment than the RX-78-2. Distinguish the terrestrial Zephyranthes from the GP01 Full Burnern, whose space-use equipment dramatically changes the silhouette. Compare release-specific specifications instead of assuming common equipment.
kits.summary: Kou Uraki’s Gundam Development Project prototype from Stardust Memory.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP01 Gundam Zephyranthes is an Anaheim Electronics prototype developed through the Gundam Development Project in Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory. Test pilot Kou Uraki takes it into combat after the theft of the GP02A, putting the prototype at the heart of the Delaz Conflict. Its first configuration is intended for general mobile suit operation and is later modified extensively for space combat.

Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. kits.name: GUNDAM GP02A
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A GP02A model’s signature forms are its large shield, heavy shoulder assemblies and imposing bazooka silhouette. Models may differ in how the shield and shoulder equipment are supported. Make sure a GP02A is not mixed with other GP-series kits; their armaments and narrative roles are quite different.
kits.summary: The heavily armored GP02A Physalis seized by Anavel Gato in Stardust Memory.
kits.lore: The RX-78GP02A Physalis is another prototype in the Gundam Development Project. Its controversial design is built around deployment of a nuclear weapon through an atomic bazooka. Anavel Gato seizes the machine early in Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory, setting the conflict in motion. The GP02A’s broad armored shape contrasts with the GP01 and makes its destructive purpose visually unmistakable.

kits.lore: The MS-07B Gouf is Zeon's dedicated ground-combat mobile suit, famously associated with Ramba Ral. Its blue armor and specialized close-quarters equipment make it a more forceful counterpart to the Zaku II.

kits.lore: Operation V was the Federation's secret One Year War program that produced the Gundam, Guncannon and Guntank family of machines. Together they illustrate different roles within the Federation's early mobile-suit development effort.
